signals.title: GTM Engineer
signals.content:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled GTM Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will architect an AI-native tech stack with seamless integrations and build a cohesive, automated engine to drive measurable revenue outcomes. As a builder and systems thinker, you will play a vital role in automating processes, maintaining data integrity, and turning GTM strategy into scalable systems.

Responsibilities

• Architect the GTM Tech Stack: Build an AI native tech stack with seamless integrations.

• Centralize Data: Build a cohesive, automated engine that centralizes data in CRM and eventually data warehouse (Salesforce, Hubspot, Snowflake, Clay, Claude Cowork).

• Own Data Integrity: Build and maintain the data flows, enrichment logic, and sync architecture that keep our systems accurate, deduped, and trustworthy end-to-end.

• Turn Strategy into Systems: Partner with leadership to translate GTM strategy into automated playbooks, dynamic scoring models, and signal-based workflows that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

• Lead CPQ System Design: Lead system design for Salesforce CPQ, including product catalog architecture, pricing and discount rules, quote templates, and approval workflows.

• Optimize Conversions: Optimize quote-to-order conversion ensuring accurate data flow into downstream billing and ERP systems.

• Implement Governance: Implement governance on pricing, discounting, and quote approval thresholds to maintain margin and compliance integrity.

• Improve Deal Velocity: Improve deal velocity by streamlining approvals, leveraging Salesforce CPQ (Revenue Cloud).

• Integrate CLM Tools: Integrate CLM (e.g., Ironclad, Conga, or DocuSign CLM) with Salesforce to automate quote-to-contract and contract-to-order workflows.

• Automate Bottlenecks: Identify repetitive work across the GTM org - account research, CRM hygiene, post-call follow-ups - and replace it with intelligent automation using APIs, webhooks, and AI agents.

Requirements

• Experience: Have 3–5+ years of experience operating in a Growth, GTM Engineer, or Revenue Operations role. Open to candidates that have a technical background that have worked with a GTM team in other capacities.

• Systems Thinking: Are a builder and systems thinker: You want to build moonshot ideas, not just toggle settings. You see the GTM stack as an interconnected machine, not a collection of point solutions.

• Salesforce Expertise: Have Direct experience with Salesforce — you know the data model, you've built on it, and you're comfortable owning CRM-level changes.

• GTM Fluency: Are GTM-fluent: You understand the GTM funnel - not just the data model, but the logic behind every stage. You know what actually converts pipeline because you've worked in or alongside GTM teams.

• Quote to Cash Configurations: Strong working knowledge of quoting tool configurations and CLM (pricing rules, product bundles, approval chains).

• Execution & Ownership: Constant iteration: Be a Kaizen methodology champion by building, shipping and iterating fast. You thrive in ambiguity, operate with high ownership, and move fast without waiting for perfect requirements. But you know when to slow down and ensure you’re shipping the highest quality work possible.

• Technical Capability: Are technically capable: Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, data integrations and can navigate technical documentation without hand-holding.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience at a fast-moving B2B SaaS / AI startup or strong familiarity with the AI tooling ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Clay, bonus points for building data warehouses.

• Prior quoting tool and CLM implementation experience.

• Experience designing enrichment and outbounding process and managing complex data sourcing across multiple providers.

• Experience centralizing selling signals from multiple data sources into a single location.

• You have technical familiarity with GTM & automation tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, CPQ, Ironclad, Clay, Gong, Apollo, Clari, APIs, webhooks, etc.).

As our ideal candidate, you will be part engineer, part hacker, with a passion for cybersecurity and a drive to protect our systems from evolving threats.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $160K-190K + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Application Policy

Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy .

signals.title: Director, Revenue Operations
signals.content:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

Brex is hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to own the operating model for our New Business (AE and SDR) motions. You will report into the Head of Revenue Operations as a strategic leader. This role sets the coverage model, incentive architecture, and operating cadence for the teams you support, and is accountable for their overall performance. You'll manage a team of RevOps managers and individual contributors, and be the decision maker on tradeoffs between speed, rigor, and scale across your domain. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between executive-level narratives and the underlying mechanics that drive performance and coach their team to do the same.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

• Be a trusted business partner to the SVP Sales in owning and improving the strategies, coverage models, operating rhythms, efficiency, and incentive compensation structure to drive revenue growth

• Lead initiatives with enablement, data, finance, systems, marketing, operations, and other revenue operations team members to support your business partners and implement improvements

• Own and improve upon cadences for forecasting, pipeline, capacity planning, rep productivity, territory carving, quota setting, and incentive design

• Lead and develop a team of 6+ supporting New Business Account Executives and Sales Development Representatives Organization

• Present to senior leaders on business strategy, segment performance, and analytical deep dives

• Drive the annual planning process for the GTM teams you support, working closely with business partners, finance, and other teams to set the strategy, align incentives, and ensure operational excellence

• Identify and prioritize efficiency improvements within the Rev Ops org, including processes, reporting, and automation leveraging AI or other tools.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales strategy, or sales operations with at least 2+ years managing managers; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company

• Bachelor Degree required

• A passion for coaching and developing a team with varying levels of experience

• Comprehensive understanding of sales funnels, processes, and methodologies in a scaled revenue organization, including with partners

• Demonstrated success operating in a complex cross functional environment to deliver impactful outcomes

• Direct experience owning incentive compensation design and coverage models for AE and SDR organizations at scale

• Strong problem solving skills and collaborative approach to solutioning within and outside of Rev Ops

• Ability to influence with or without authority, strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills

• Extensive experience with Salesforce and other GTM systems, including examples of AI-driven efficiency improvements

• Analytical mindset with the ability to quickly interpret data and quickly understand complex models

• Strong attention to detail including modeling, communication, and documentation

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $228,000 - $285,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

signals.title: Lead Technical Project Manager, GTM Systems
signals.content:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo's GTM Systems team builds and runs the systems that power marketing, sales, partnerships, customer success, and services. We're looking for a Lenior Technical Project Manager with 8+ years of experience delivering complex SaaS GTM and revenue systems programs, who understands both how the systems work and how the business runs on them, and who is excited to bring AI into how we plan, deliver, and operate.

About the team

Our GTM Systems team sits at the center of Klaviyo's GTM engine, connecting Salesforce, CPQ, billing and finance systems, customer success and support platforms, and professional services tooling. We own the roadmap that lets our teams move quickly, trust their data, and focus on helping customers grow. As we scale, we're rebuilding parts of that stack around AI and agentic workflows as the operating model, not a bolt-on experiment, and we need a program leader who can deliver that change reliably.

About the role

As Lead Technical Project Manager, you own delivery of our highest-impact, highest-complexity GTM systems programs from intake through hypercare. Think CPQ replacement, quote-to-cash changes, customer success and support platform upgrades, and AI-enabled workflows that cut across Sales, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and Internal Audit. You turn ambiguous business goals into clear plans, sequence work across many teams shipping into the same core systems, and keep leadership informed with an honest view of commitments, risks, and progress.

You'll work hands-on with business systems analysts, developers, architects, vendors, and finance and audit partners, and you'll regularly present to senior and executive leadership. You use AI yourself to run programs faster and better, and you help bring it into the way our teams work.

How you'll make an impact

• Own program delivery end to end: intake, prioritization, scoping, sequencing, status, and operating cadence for a multi-quarter GTM systems roadmap, from discovery through launch and hypercare.

• Lead cross-functional programs at scale: manage dependencies across Sales, Deal Desk, RevOps, Customer Success, Services, Finance, Legal, Security, and Engineering, including teams that don't report to you.

• Drive technical decisions with engineers and architects: weigh trade-offs, build-vs-buy calls, integration patterns, and vendor evaluations, and make sure decisions are documented and defensible.

• Deliver with controls built in: partner with Finance, Internal Audit, and Security on revenue-impacting systems work (SOX/ITGC, access, change management, audit traceability) so controls are designed in, tested, and evidenced.

• Manage vendors and implementation partners: run joint project plans, steering committees, decision logs, and risk reviews, and hold partners to commitments.

• Bring AI into GTM and into how we deliver: help scope and ship AI and agentic workflows into production, and use AI tooling to improve planning, status reporting, testing, and documentation.

• Build the operating model: establish intake, planning, release management, and reporting practices that hold up as the portfolio grows, and mentor teammates on program craft.

• Communicate with clarity: give GTM Systems, GTM, Finance, and executive leaders a crisp view of scope, timeline, cost, risk, and decisions needed, in the room and in writing.

What makes you a great fit

• 8+ years of technical program or project management, business systems delivery, or GTM/revenue systems experience at a SaaS company, with a track record of owning large, multi-team programs end to end.

• Deep working knowledge of GTM systems and processes: lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, renewals and amendments, customer success and support, and professional services delivery, and how objects, data, and approvals flow between Salesforce, CPQ, billing/ERP, contracting, and support tools.

• Experience delivering in a Salesforce-centric environment where multiple teams ship into a shared core system on a common release process.

• Experience partnering with finance, audit, or compliance functions on revenue-impacting systems and controls.

• Strong technical fluency: you can read an architecture diagram, discuss integration and data-model trade-offs with developers, and spot delivery risk early.

• Hands-on curiosity about AI: you use LLM tools in your own work, can talk credibly about where AI and agents help GTM workflows and where they need guardrails, and want to help teams adopt them responsibly.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication; comfortable driving outcomes through influence in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to haves

• Experience with CPQ implementations or replacements, quote-to-cash redesign, or billing/ERP integrations (for example NetSuite).

• Experience with customer success, support, or services platforms (for example Gainsight, Zendesk, Certinia) and contracting tools (for example Ironclad).

• Familiarity with SOX ITGC, revenue controls, or SOC reporting for vendor-hosted systems.

• Experience standing up release management or CI/CD for a Salesforce org.

• Exposure to agentic AI frameworks or MCP-based integrations in a business systems setting.

• PMP, Salesforce, or similar certifications (or equivalent demonstrated experience).

• Prior experience at a high-growth software or AI company.

Why this role matters at Klaviyo

• Your programs directly affect how Klaviyo sells, bills, renews, and supports customers, with real visibility to senior GTM, Finance, and executive leadership.

• You'll lead work that sits at the intersection of GTM systems, finance controls, and AI, a combination that is rare and increasingly valuable.

• You'll help shape an AI-first delivery and operating model for GTM Systems, setting practices that outlast any single project.

Massachusetts Applicants:
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Our salary range reflects the cost of labor across various U.S. geographic markets. The range displayed below reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all our US locations. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.

Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Base Pay Range For US Locations:
$132,000 — $198,000 USD

This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.

Get to Know Klaviyo

We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.

AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.

By participating in Klaviyo’s interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process . For more information about how we process your personal data, see our Job Applicant Privacy Notice .

Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. If you do not wish for Klaviyo to process your Personal Data, please do not submit an application. You can find our Job Applicant Privacy Notice here and here (FR).

signals.title: Director of Revenue Operations
signals.content:
WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Rillet sells an AI-native ERP to finance teams, where operational rigor is everything. Our GTM engine should operate at the same standard.

As VP of Revenue Operations, you'll own the systems, data, planning, and processes behind every dollar of ARR, from first touch through renewal. You'll build a predictable, scalable revenue engine and give leadership one trusted view of the business.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own GTM planning and forecasting: Lead annual and quarterly planning, bookings targets, capacity models, hiring plans, quota setting, and forecasting across new business, expansion, and renewals in partnership with Finance.

 - Drive revenue strategy and performance: Own executive and board reporting across ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, win rates, CAC payback, and sales efficiency, translating data into actionable business decisions.

 - Design scalable GTM infrastructure: Build territories, segmentation, account assignments, compensation plans, and rules of engagement across Sales, AM, CS, and Partnerships.

 - Own systems and data integrity: Lead the GTM tech stack (Salesforce, Gong, CPQ, etc.), ensuring clean CRM data, accurate commissions, a trusted source of truth for revenue, and measurable ROI on tools.

 - Optimize revenue processes: Establish pipeline standards, stage definitions, and deal desk operations that accelerate complex deals while protecting pricing, margins, and contract integrity. Partner with Finance on quote-to-cash and AM leadership on renewals.

 - Turn insights into action: Analyze funnel conversion, rep productivity, ramp time, and segment performance while leading weekly forecasts and QBRs that drive accountability.

 - Build and lead the RevOps function: Develop a high-performing team spanning sales operations, systems, analytics, and deal desk to support Rillet's next stage of growth.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years in Revenue, Sales, or Business Operations within high-growth B2B SaaS, including 4+ years leading teams.

 - Proven experience scaling GTM organizations through significant ARR and headcount growth.

 - Deep Salesforce expertise and hands-on experience with CPQ, forecasting, and conversation intelligence tools.

 - Strong financial modeling skills, including building and defending capacity plans with executive leadership.

 - Experience designing compensation plans, territories, and deal desk processes.

 - Strong communicator who builds credibility with sales teams and executives.

 - Experience selling to finance buyers or working in fintech/ERP is a plus.



Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.




LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

• Own program delivery end to end: intake, prioritization, scoping, sequencing, status, and operating cadence for a multi-quarter GTM systems roadmap, from discovery through launch and hypercare.

• Lead cross-functional programs at scale: manage dependencies across Sales, Deal Desk, RevOps, Customer Success, Services, Finance, Legal, Security, and Engineering, including teams that don't report to you.

• Drive technical decisions with engineers and architects: weigh trade-offs, build-vs-buy calls, integration patterns, and vendor evaluations, and make sure decisions are documented and defensible.

• Deliver with controls built in: partner with Finance, Internal Audit, and Security on revenue-impacting systems work (SOX/ITGC, access, change management, audit traceability) so controls are designed in, tested, and evidenced.

• Manage vendors and implementation partners: run joint project plans, steering committees, decision logs, and risk reviews, and hold partners to commitments.

• Bring AI into GTM and into how we deliver: help scope and ship AI and agentic workflows into production, and use AI tooling to improve planning, status reporting, testing, and documentation.

• Build the operating model: establish intake, planning, release management, and reporting practices that hold up as the portfolio grows, and mentor teammates on program craft.

• Communicate with clarity: give GTM Systems, GTM, Finance, and executive leaders a crisp view of scope, timeline, cost, risk, and decisions needed, in the room and in writing.

What makes you a great fit

• 8+ years of technical program or project management, business systems delivery, or GTM/revenue systems experience at a SaaS company, with a track record of owning large, multi-team programs end to end.

• Deep working knowledge of GTM systems and processes: lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, renewals and amendments, customer success and support, and professional services delivery, and how objects, data, and approvals flow between Salesforce, CPQ, billing/ERP, contracting, and support tools.

• Experience delivering in a Salesforce-centric environment where multiple teams ship into a shared core system on a common release process.

• Experience partnering with finance, audit, or compliance functions on revenue-impacting systems and controls.

• Strong technical fluency: you can read an architecture diagram, discuss integration and data-model trade-offs with developers, and spot delivery risk early.

• Hands-on curiosity about AI: you use LLM tools in your own work, can talk credibly about where AI and agents help GTM workflows and where they need guardrails, and want to help teams adopt them responsibly.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication; comfortable driving outcomes through influence in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to haves

• Experience with CPQ implementations or replacements, quote-to-cash redesign, or billing/ERP integrations (for example NetSuite).

• Experience with customer success, support, or services platforms (for example Gainsight, Zendesk, Certinia) and contracting tools (for example Ironclad).

• Familiarity with SOX ITGC, revenue controls, or SOC reporting for vendor-hosted systems.

• Experience standing up release management or CI/CD for a Salesforce org.

• Exposure to agentic AI frameworks or MCP-based integrations in a business systems setting.

• PMP, Salesforce, or similar certifications (or equivalent demonstrated experience).

• Prior experience at a high-growth software or AI company.

Why this role matters at Klaviyo

• Your programs directly affect how Klaviyo sells, bills, renews, and supports customers, with real visibility to senior GTM, Finance, and executive leadership.

• You'll lead work that sits at the intersection of GTM systems, finance controls, and AI, a combination that is rare and increasingly valuable.

• You'll help shape an AI-first delivery and operating model for GTM Systems, setting practices that outlast any single project.

signals.title: Manager, Sales Compensation
signals.content:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

We're looking for a sales compensation leader to own how we pay our go-to-market organisation, and how that changes as our commercial model changes. You will run the engine that pays roughly 350 GTM people accurately and on time, own the design of the plans, quotas and incentives behind it, and lead a small team of analysts.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage and coach a small team, and you will also be in the model, in CaptivateIQ, and in the plan documents yourself.

What you'll do

Run the compensation engine

• Own the monthly and quarterly compensation cycle end to end: crediting, calculation, review, approval and payout, delivered accurately and on time

• Own CaptivateIQ as our system of record for incentive compensation, including plan build, rule logic, testing and release

• Own crediting and comp data integrity across Salesforce and downstream systems, and work with Systems and Deal Desk to fix problems at source rather than in spreadsheets

• Oversee inquiry management ensuring clear SLAs and report on trends to improve overall processes

• Document and keep policies and process up to date for stakeholders and your team

Design the plans, quotas and incentives

• Own annual plan design in partnership with your Senior compensation analyst, GTM leadership, FP&A and People for all commissioned roles

• Collaborate with Revops business partners on the quota setting process for each function to ensure it aligns with broader compensation strategy and benchmarks

• Model attainment distribution, benchmarks and support finance in ad-hoc cost reporting

• Own and build SPIFFs and non-cash incentive programmes, including President's Club,

• Own plan communication and enablement, so reps and managers understand what they are paid for and can self-serve where needed

Evolve the compensation strategy as we grow

• Build the compensation approach for an evolving pricing model and mulit-product business in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Finance

• Represent compensation requirements during larger CPQ and CRM enhancements or changes

• Enhance our approach based compensation reporting: attainment by role and segment, payout curves, quota coverage and programme effectiveness

Lead and grow the team

• Manage, coach and develop a small team of compensation analysts, and set the standard and what good looks like

• Prioritise the team's work, capacity and quarterly OKRs to ensure a balance of reactiveness and impactful projects

• Stay hands-on. This is a doing and leading role, not a management-only role

What you'll bring

Required experience

• 6+ years in sales compensation, revenue operations, sales finance or a closely related field, with experience managing or formally mentoring analysts

• 2-3 years direct management experience

• Proven ownership of a full incentive compensation cycle for a distributed GTM team, including crediting, calculation, payout and dispute resolution

• Hands-on administration of an ICM platform, ideally CaptivateIQ, including building and testing plan logic yourself

• Demonstrated plan design experience: pay mix, leverage, accelerators and quota setting, with the modelling to back the recommendation

• Strong Salesforce data fluency, and the ability to translate commercial requirements into system and crediting logic

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modelling, including capacity, attainment and cost of sale models

• Excellent stakeholder management, with the credibility to hold a position with Sales leaders and the judgement to know when to flex

• You can communicate simply, clearly, and directly, especially with senior leaders, and your written work is polished enough to go straight to an executive audience

Bonus points

• Experience with consumption, usage-based or hybrid pricing models and their compensation implications

• Experience through a CPQ or quote-to-cash migration, ideally Salesforce CPQ or Dealhub

• Experience in cybersecurity, IT or AI markets

• Familiarity with ASC 606 commission capitalisation and audit requirements

• Experience compensating post-sales and partner roles, not just AEs

signals.title: Manager, Commercial Operations
signals.content:
Manager, Commercial Operations

We are looking for a Manager of Commercial Operations to build and run the transactional engine of the commercial function inside Revenue Operations. ClickHouse runs on a usage-based pricing model, and every deal – direct, marketplace, or partner – has to land correctly in the system: quoted against the right rules, ordered against the right contract structure, and booked cleanly enough that Accounting can bill and recognize it without rework. As we scale the cloud business and widen the product line, that path has to carry more volume, more products, and more deal structures without adding people to the middle of it. This role designs the systems, automation, and controls that make that possible.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Commercial Strategy & Operations, you will own the quote-to-order path and order management, along with the build behind it: the CPQ and quoting system requirements, the automation, the validation and controls, and marketplace transaction operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure. The goal is a commercial path where the standard deal is self-service for the field, quality is enforced by the system rather than by who touched the deal, and human review is reserved for the cases that genuinely need judgment. You will be measured by how fast and how cleanly a deal moves, how little intervention it requires, and how good the experience is for the rep. You will partner daily with Sales, Accounting, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own order management and automate it. Run the intake, review, and processing of quotes, order forms, and bookings to defined SLAs through quarter-end peaks, and continuously engineer the manual steps out of that path.

 - Design the quote-to-order flow. Instrument the process, find where it slows or breaks, and redesign it. You own the architecture of the flow, the exception routing, and the automation that makes the standard case hands-off.

 - Own the quoting and order management system build. Write the requirements, design the quoting, validation, and approval logic, drive the roadmap with Revenue Engineering, run UAT, and validate every change in production before the field sees it.

 - Own the handoff into billing and revenue. Partner with Accounting so that what leaves your process arrives structured, complete, and reconcilable – and build the controls upstream that keep downstream rework from happening at all.

 - Build quality in as controls. Validation rules, guided quoting, required-field logic, and automated reconciliation that make an incorrect order hard to submit in the first place.

 - Own the field experience of transacting. Treat the rep as the customer: fewer steps, fewer handoffs, shorter quote cycle time, and a standard path that is obvious and self-service. Measure whether it is getting easier.

 - Build and run marketplace transaction operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Private offers, CSP transactions, co-sell mechanics, and the tooling and automated reconciliation that keep marketplace bookings tied out across the marketplace, Salesforce, and billing.

 - Operationalize commercial review. Encode approval rules and guardrails in the system so routine deals route themselves, and escalate the structures that break the system rather than quietly processing them.

 - Build the transaction path for new products and acquisitions. Stand up order management, quoting, and the marketplace path for new offerings and newly acquired products, test the flow through to booking before go-live, and be ready to transact on day one.

 - Own the integrity of the commercial record. Products, SKUs, pricing, contract terms, and booking attributes in Salesforce, with the controls and monitoring that keep them clean – the forecast and revenue reporting downstream depend on it.

 - Instrument and report on the system you own. Cycle time, touch count, SLA attainment, exception and discount volumes, error and rework rates. Use the data to decide what gets built next.

WHAT YOU BRING ALONG

 - 6+ years in commercial operations, deal desk, order management, sales operations, or revenue operations, including time owning a high-volume transactional process.

 - A track record of building, not just running. You have replaced a manual process with a designed one and can point to the automation, the controls, and the measured result.

 - Hands-on depth in Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ. You write requirements, design quoting and approval logic, configure and test it yourself, and can tell a configuration problem from a process problem.

 - Technical range beyond the admin console: flows and validation logic, API-based and marketplace integrations, and scripting or SQL to reconcile and investigate data at volume. You can partner with Revenue Engineering as a peer on design.

 - Experience with usage-based or consumption-based contracts: metering, commits, overages, contract structure, and the downstream billing and revenue recognition implications.

 - Experience operating across a shared quote-to-cash process. You know where order management ends and Accounting begins, and you design the handoff so neither side is cleaning up after the other.

 - Marketplace operations experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure – private offers, CSP transactions, and reconciliation – strongly preferred.

 - Process-engineering instincts. You instrument before you optimize, design for the standard case and route the exception, and measure by throughput and error rate rather than activity.

 - A bias toward field experience. You have made a transactional process materially faster or simpler for a sales team and can describe how you knew it worked.

 - Comfort partnering with Accounting, Finance, and Legal on order form and contract mechanics.

 - Sound judgment under deal pressure. You can hold the line on a structure that breaks the system, and advocate for the field when the exception is justified.

 - Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a commercial rule to a rep in one paragraph and brief leadership on what's at risk at quarter-end.

 - Experience managing or mentoring analysts a plus; this role is expected to grow a team as volume scales.

 - Bachelor's degree, quantitative or technical field preferred.




PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here https://clickhouse.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice for our Privacy Statement.

signals.title: Commissions Manager
signals.content:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our mission

Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people.

As a Commissions Manager, you’ll help our Sales and go-to-market teams trust how their work translates into compensation. You’ll own accurate, timely commission operations while building the systems and processes that make our incentive programs easier to understand and scale. Working across Commercial Operations, Finance, Revenue Technology, Payroll, People Operations and GTM leadership, you’ll help modernize a complex compensation environment so our commercial teams can focus on bringing more providers onto Zocdoc and connecting more patients with care.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Operations.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

• Motivated by getting the details right and building trust through accurate, transparent compensation.

• Excited to own both recurring commission operations and a significant systems transformation.

• Analytically-minded, and focused on how commercial activity, data and incentive plans connect—and are able to explain those connections clearly.

• Comfortable bringing structure to complex, evolving processes without relying on a one-size-fits-all solution.

• Organized and dependable when coordinating deadlines, stakeholders and competing priorities.

• A thoughtful partner who handles sensitive compensation questions with sound judgment and empathy.

• Energized by simplifying and automating manual work, learning new tools and making processes easier for others.

Your day to day is…

• Own the commission lifecycle for Sales and eligible go-to-market teams, from calculations and reconciliations through approvals, payroll submissions and employee statements.

• Translate approved compensation plans into clear rules, documentation and reliable system configurations; maintain participant and plan-assignment data.

• Lead the move from spreadsheet-based administration to an enterprise incentive compensation management platform, including requirements, vendor evaluation, business case development, data design, historical migration, parallel testing, training and rollout.

• Partner with Commercial Operations, business-unit leaders, Sales leadership and Finance to simplify 25+ legacy compensation structures into a scalable menu of core plan archetypes.

• Establish dependable data flows and governance across CRM, HRIS, Finance and billing systems; automate eligibility and crediting logic, including effective-dated territories, split credits, caps, accelerators and clawbacks.

• Maintain strong approval and audit controls; investigate discrepancies, manage exceptions and disputes, and coordinate fair, well-documented resolutions.

• Coordinate annual plan transitions, fiscal-year rollovers, quota and territory alignment, and mid-year organizational changes with Sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Payroll and People Operations.

• Partner with Finance on payout forecasting, expense accruals and plan-performance analysis, and improve processes to reduce manual effort while maintaining accurate, on-time commission delivery.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

• 8+ years of relevant experience in incentive compensation, Sales or Revenue Operations, or Finance, including direct ownership of recurring commission administration across multiple plans.

• End-to-end commission modeling and operations experience, including eligibility and crediting rules, reconciliations, approval controls and payroll handoffs. You understand that compensation plans may use different bases and revenue measures.

• Experience owning or functionally leading an incentive compensation platform implementation, including requirements, configuration, data validation, testing and rollout. Experience with platforms such as CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Varicent or Xactly is preferred.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and confidence investigating CRM and operational data. Experience with Salesforce, SQL and automated data pipelines is a plus.

• Experience handling complex or large-scale commission programs. Familiarity with SaaS, marketplace or consumption-based revenue models is valuable.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex compensation mechanics to employees, leaders and cross-functional partners.

• Sound judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and respect for confidential compensation information.

• The ability to manage competing priorities, build alignment across teams and improve workflows while maintaining dependable controls.

• The ability to use approved generative AI tools to support documentation, analysis and workflow improvement, while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.

• A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

• Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location

• Unlimited Vacation

• 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

• Commuter Benefits

• 401(k) with employer funded match

• Corporate wellness program with Wellhub

• Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)

• Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement

• Cell phone reimbursement

• Catered lunch every day along with beverages and snacks

• Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

• Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.
NYC Base Salary Range
$140,700 — $190,100 USD

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values . Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

signals.content:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role

Motive is scaling fast, and our Quote-to-Cash engine needs to keep up. The QTC pipeline processes 5,000+ daily orders across 100k+ customers and is critical to IPO readiness and SOX compliance.

As a Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer on the QTC team, you will be a senior member of the engineering team that builds and maintains Motive's Quote-to-Cash stack: Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue (RevPro), NetSuite, Vertex, and n8n/MuleSoft integrations. You will tackle some of the most impactful engineering challenges in the company: ensuring every order flows seamlessly from quote to billing to revenue recognition without manual intervention or data gaps.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an engineer who has lived in the Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash space for years and understands how quoting, billing, revenue recognition, and ERP systems connect. You will solve problems around order automation, billing accuracy, integration reliability, and proactive monitoring that keeps our revenue pipeline healthy as we scale toward an IPO.

We believe in an "everyone is a builder" mentality. Everyone on this team is capable of being a forward-thinking engineer, not just executing tickets but shaping how systems are designed and built. You will build headless apps that surface QTC data and workflows where users already work, and you will leverage AI to accelerate how we work, from agentic development workflows to AI-assisted order processing and intelligent automation across the stack.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain scalable technical solutions across the Quote-to-Cash stack, which today includes Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ), Zuora Billing and Revenue (RevPro), NetSuite, Vertex, and n8n/MuleSoft integrations.

• Configure and customize Salesforce platform components, including Apex, Flows, Triggers, Batch classes, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and SOQL/SOSL, to solve complex business requirements across the QTC lifecycle.

• Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, Zuora, NetSuite, and third-party systems using SOAP/REST APIs and middleware (n8n, MuleSoft).

• Drive integration health across the QTC ecosystem, building proactive monitoring, alerting, and SOPs to detect and resolve failures before they impact customers or revenue.

• Partner with Product Management, QA, and business stakeholders to plan, prioritize, and deliver applications and enhancements in an Agile, sprint-based environment.

• Deliver quality applications and support within a SOX compliance control environment with rigorous change management.

• Establish and uphold engineering best practices, standards, and operational guidelines with a focus on platform reliability, performance, and serviceability.

• Stay current on QTC system releases, new features, product roadmaps, and third-party applications. Evaluate and recommend emerging capabilities, including Salesforce RevCloud, Agentforce, and AI-assisted order processing.

• Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, and the Architecture Review Board to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles and patterns.

• Drive continuous improvement in communication, collaboration, and alignment across teams inside and outside the QTC organization.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of Salesforce configuration and customization experience: Apex, Flows, Triggers, Batch classes, LWC, SOQL/SOSL.

• Deep experience in Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash in a SaaS or recurring revenue company, spanning quoting, order processing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue recognition.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ: quoting, pricing rules, order generation, and approval workflows.

• Integration experience using SOAP/REST APIs and middleware (n8n, MuleSoft) to connect Salesforce with external billing, ERP, and tax systems.

• Understanding of billing and revenue recognition concepts: ASC 606, subscription billing, deferred revenue, and AR reconciliation.

• Experience with Zuora Billing and/or Zuora Revenue (RevPro), and/or NetSuite ERP (GL, journal entries, AR reconciliation).

• Strong understanding of Salesforce security best practices, including the Salesforce security model, threat modeling, and least-privilege / zero-trust access models.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, AutoRabit) in a source-controlled environment.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications using SOAP/REST APIs and middleware.

• Excellent spoken and written communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to deal with ambiguity and thrive in a rapidly changing business environment.

Nice to Haves

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RevCloud) experience or familiarity with Revenue Cloud Advanced.

• Salesforce Agentforce or AI agent building experience.

• SOX compliance / ITGC controls experience in Salesforce.

• Vertex tax engine experience.

• Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification.

• Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification.

• Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud certification.

• Salesforce Agentforce certification.

signals.title: Senior Sales Compensation Analyst
signals.content:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a As the Senior Analyst on the Sales Compensation team, you’ll own the systems and automation that power how Fivetran calculates and pays its sellers. Your focus is CaptivateIQ (or similar compensation platforms Xactly, SPIFF, Varicent), system enhancements, and using automation and AI to remove manual work, improve accuracy, and scale the commission process.

This role reports to the Manager, Sales Compensation Systems and Analytics and partners closely with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Systems/IT, Analytics, Revenue Accounting, and Payroll. This is a full-time role with opportunities to connect and build as a team

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. [If hybrid] Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

CaptivateIQ (or similar compensation platforms Xactly, SPIFF, Varicent), Tableau, or other BI tools

What You’ll Do

• Platform Ownership: Configure and maintain our compensation platform (CaptivateIQ or similar), including plans, crediting rules, quotas, territories, and data loads.

• Systems Enhancements: Own the enhancement backlog end to end: document business requirements and current-state/future-state assessments, then build, test, and release changes with Systems/IT, and lead continuous improvement of program efficiency and best practices.

• Automation: Automate commission calculation, data validation, reconciliation, and statement delivery using platform workflows, SQL, and Python, replacing manual spreadsheet processes.

• AI Enablement: Build and maintain AI-assisted tools and workflows (e.g., LLMs, assistants, agents) for plan documentation, seller inquiries, QA, and anomaly detection, and validate that outputs are accurate.

• Data Integrations & Management: Maintain integrations between the compensation platform, Salesforce, the data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery), and HRIS/Payroll; reconcile and analyze large datasets to ensure accurate quota allocation and performance tracking.

• Plan Design Support: Support the annual compensation planning cycle from design to deployment: plan builds, quota loads, and modeling of plan changes with Sales Strategy and Finance.

• Commission & Quota Operations: Run the monthly and quarterly cycle end to end, including quota distribution and adjustments, revenue crediting, and payout execution, with audit-ready documentation and SOX-compliant controls.

• Stakeholder Support: Serve as the point of contact for sales managers and sellers, resolve complex inquiries and escalations, enforce incentive policy with diplomacy, and deliver training on plans and changes.

• Reporting & Analytics: Build automated dashboards and seller statements that give sellers and managers clear visibility into attainment, earnings, and program performance, and stay current on compensation best practices.

Skills We’re Looking For

• 7 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, or revenue operations, with hands-on administration of CaptivateIQ, Xactly, SPIFF, Varicent, or a similar platform

• Strong system configuration skills: plan builds, crediting logic, data models, formulas, and integrations

• Automation mindset: has replaced manual processes with repeatable, documented, auditable workflows

• Working proficiency in SQL and Python or similar scripting; experience with Salesforce and data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake)

• Expert-level Excel/Sheets modeling, meticulous attention to detail with large datasets, and strong command of commission logic and plan mechanics

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex compensation scenarios, plus experience writing business requirements documents and current-state/future-state assessments, and testing and releasing system changes

• Clear communicator who can explain plans and technical changes to non-technical stakeholders, with the backbone to enforce policy and the diplomacy to do it well

Bonus Skills​

• Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models

• Built with AI: has personally used AI tools (LLMs, assistants, or agent and automation platforms) to build compensation tools or workflows others rely on, and can explain how they work and how outputs were checked

• Experience with Looker, Tableau, or other BI tools

• Experience at a high-growth tech company supporting a sales organization

• Experience with SOX controls over commission processes

Perks and Benefits

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance *

• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

• RSU stock grants*

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities

• Monthly cell phone stipend

• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

* May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

signals.title: Senior Sales Compensation Analyst
signals.content:
Joining Collibra's Sales Compensation team

Collibra is the global leader in data intelligence, helping organizations find, understand, trust, and access data at scale.

You'll join the Sales Compensation team, which sits within Finance and works alongside Sales Operations and Total Rewards to design, calculate, and pay commissions for quota-carrying Collibrians across North America and EMEA. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Compensation you will be the hands-on owner of sales comp operations, plan logic in Xactly, monthly close, dispute resolution, and the annual plan cycle. Because every seller sees the output of this work each month, the team lives our value of being open, direct, and kind : we explain how a number was calculated, we say when something is wrong, and we fix it in the open.

This is a hybrid role based in our Raleigh office or remote US. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team.

The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst at Collibra is responsible for

• Running the monthly commission close end to end data intake, credit validation, reconciliation against Salesforce and Finance ledgers, accrual submission, and payroll handoff, so that sellers are paid accurately and on the close calendar.

• Administering incentive plan logic in our ICM platform , including quotas, rates, accelerators, SPIFFs, and overlay rules, and supporting rep data feeds from Salesforce and Workday, in order to keep the system aligned to approved plan documents.

• Owning the compensation inquiry and dispute queue by tracing data from booking to payout and applying structured exception handling, so that sellers receive a documented root-cause answer within SLA.

• Partnering with Accounting and FP&A on commission expense accruals, quarterly true-ups, and variance explanations, in order to support journal entries and a defensible close.

• Making the function repeatable through SOPs, data maps and dictionaries, audit-ready documentation, and automation of manual workarounds, so that sales comp scales with the go-to-market organization.

You Have

• 6+ years in an analytical role, with at least 4 years in a dedicated sales compensation function at a B2B SaaS or high-growth technology company.

• Demonstrated ownership of monthly commission close payroll handoff, accrual submission, and variance reconciliation plus hands-on administration of an enterprise ICM platform (Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or Spiff)

• Experience managing a compensation inquiry and dispute queue with defined SLAs and structured exception handling.

• Advanced Excel and equivalent Google Sheets proficiency: multi-sheet financial models, named ranges, array formulas, XLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, and dynamic charts, built without hardcoded cell references.

• Working experience with Salesforce, including opportunity objects, field mappings, report builder, and the data pipeline that feeds commission calculations.

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience is required.

• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

You Are

• Rigorous about accuracy: treats each payout cycle as a zero-defect process and self-audits before submission so errors don't reach sellers.

• Able to manage several concurrent workstreams against fixed close-calendar deadlines without trading off quality.

• Able to explain complex plan mechanics to a seller in plain English and present attainment analytics to a VP in a single well-structured slide.

• Comfortable diagnosing ambiguous crediting scenarios from first principles and documenting a defensible conclusion.

• Inclined to ask how a process can be made repeatable and scalable, including by applying AI and automation tools to routine comp work, rather than accepting manual workarounds.

• Familiar with SaaS revenue metrics (ARR, ACV, TCV, bookings versus revenue recognition), quota coverage ratios, and commission accrual mechanics under ASC 340-40 and 606, or willing to learn them.

Measures of success are

• Within your first month, you will have working knowledge of Collibra's core incentive comp plans and mechanics, have shadowed one to two commission closes, and be managing inquiry tickets with Senior Manager oversight on non-standard cases.

• Within your third month, you will run monthly close independently with Senior Manager spot-checks, deliver the payroll file on time, and contribute to ICM implementation testing and reconciliation including parallel-run discrepancy work, with go-live sign-off remaining a shared decision.

• Within your sixth month, you will hold SLA compliance above 95% on all inquiries, have zero payroll correction cycles attributable to calculation errors, and have documented SOPs for the team's top ten processes.

Compensation for This Role

The standard base salary range for this position is $88,000 - $110,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .

signals.content:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

This role is responsible for leading the migration from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud and being responsible for the end-to-end Quote-to-Cash capability. The manager will ensure that quoting, pricing, contracting, ordering, and billing processes operate optimally and scale with business growth. The role requires close partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and IT.

What You Will Be Doing

• Architectural Governance & Technical Leadership

• Architectural Oversight: Define and govern solution blueprints, integration patterns, and engineering standards across Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud (RCA), Billing, and Subscription Management.

• End-to-End Development Leadership: Lead Salesforce development across design, coding, testing, deployment, and support.

• Solution Design & Build: Design and develop scalable solutions using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura; develop, test, and optimize Apex classes, triggers, batch and schedulable jobs.

• Technical Quality & Code QA: Conduct code reviews of engineering deliverables (pull requests, Apex, LWC, SOQL) to ensure quality, maintainability, minimal custom-code debt, and adherence to Salesforce security best practices.

• Integrations & Data Modeling: Guide data modeling strategies and integrate Salesforce with ERP systems, MuleSoft middleware, payment gateways, and third-party financial applications via REST/SOAP APIs and other integration tools.

• Standards & Best Practices: Define and enforce best practices around Salesforce development, security, and data management.

• Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs): Conduct technical discovery and build light PoCs to validate solution designs before committing user stories to sprint development.

• Continuous Improvement: Stay current on Salesforce releases and emerging technologies and recommend improvements.

• Engineering Delivery & Sprint Management

•

• Agile Sprint Execution: Own end-to-end engineering delivery for the Q2C team, running 2-week Agile sprints with strict Definition-of-Ready (DoR) criteria.

• Team Capacity & Roadmap Ownership: Manage capacity, velocity, and delivery roadmaps for direct reports (Salesforce Admins and Engineers across US and India), balancing maintenance with strategic migration milestones.

• Mentorship: Mentor junior developers and raise the team's engineering bar.

• Scope Defense & Vendor Management: Protect sprint commitments against mid-sprint scope creep through stakeholder negotiation; manage external partners when engaged.

• Cross-Functional Strategic Alignment

• Process Excellence: Eliminate internal process complexity and lead technical discovery workshops aligned to revenue recognition and subscription lifecycle requirements.

• Business Requirement Translation: Partner with Sales Operations, Finance, Billing, Legal, architects, and admins to translate commercial policies and requirements into technical designs and executable engineering work.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of IT experience, including 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development.

• 3–4+ years of people management experience leading, mentoring, and scaling Salesforce engineering/configuration teams across onshore and offshore environments.

• 5+ years of Salesforce CPQ & Revenue Cloud expertise: Quote-to-Cash implementations, standard CPQ objects, Revenue Cloud (RCA) data structures, Billing, Subscription Management, and Revenue Recognition.

• CPQ-to-RCA migration track record: Hands-on experience migrating legacy CPQ architectures to Revenue Cloud, including data migration strategies and object model shifts.

• Salesforce Technical Skillset:

• Agile delivery discipline: 2-week Scrum cadences, clear acceptance criteria, velocity management.
