signals.title: Deal Desk Manager
signals.content:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Role

Decagon is looking for a Deal Lead to sit at the intersection of Sales, Finance, and Strategy. You'll be the first dedicated pricing hire and will work closely with the Business Operations team to shape the function from the ground up.

On our Pricing team, your primary goal will be to accelerate and scale our enterprise go-to-market motion - working closely with our account executives to structure and propose deals. Initiatives will include building internal deal processes, proposal structuring, commercial negotiations with customers, and sales enablement.

This is an exciting role blending strategic thinking and high-caliber execution. We are looking for highly-motivated problem solve


About the team

Decagon’s Revenue Operations team is a multidisciplinary group of operators combining strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and high-velocity execution. Covering GTM-wide strategy, operations and analytics, we are proactive, data-driven partners to leadership – providing critical insights, driving operational efficiency and getting things done.


About the role

This is a dynamic, wide-ranging role to join our team shaping Decagon’s go-to-market strategy and driving execution. This is an opportunity to help build Decagon's Deal Desk function from the ground up. You'll design the operating model, stand up the systems, and become the trusted connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Founder's Office, Legal and other teams as deals move from quote to signature. It's a rare shot to stand up a function end-to-end from day one — shaping how a category-defining AI company structures, prices, and closes deals as it scales.


In this role, you will

 - Deal Desk Operator: Serve as the first point of contact for deal reviews and approvals, triaging requests for completeness and policy compliance before routing to other internal departments

 - Deal Structuring: Advise sales teams on pricing, custom terms, and non-standard contract options for complex and enterprise opportunities

 - Cross-Functional Bridge: Connect sales, finance, security, and legal to triage and shepherd complex deals through the internal review process

 - Systems Owner: Stand up and administer the deal desk tech stack (Salesforce, CPQ, quoting and contract tools), building the foundation as new pricing models, packaging, and deal types emerge

 - Process Builder: Design approval workflows, discount guidelines, and order form templates from scratch, and continuously improve them as the business scales

 - Enablement: Train and coach sales on pricing policy, deal structuring options, and how to use deal desk systems and templates as they're built
   

Your background looks something like this

 - 5+ years of experience in Deal Desk and/or Sales/Revenue Operations, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment

 - A builder at heart — you've stood up a process, system, or function before, or you're hungry to prove you can do it from scratch

 - Understands a deal desk function end-to-end — from policy design and systems administration to day-to-day deal review

 - Deep understanding of quote-to-cash workflows, CPQ tools, and CRM platforms (Salesforce)

 - Strong grasp of contract structures, licensing and pricing models, and revenue recognition principles

 - Track record of building approval workflows, discount guidelines, and templates from scratch in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

 - Excellent cross-functional communicator, comfortable acting as the connective tissue between sales, finance, and legal

 - High agency and comfortable with ambiguity — you scope the problem yourself and move, rather than waiting for a fully-formed spec



Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

 - Parental Leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

Decagon offers a competitive benefits package that varies by country and complements local statutory benefits. Details for this location will be provided during the recruitment process.

signals.content:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta’s Go-To-Market (GTM) Compensation Strategy and Incentive Design team plays a critical role in the development and implementation of variable incentive compensation designs across all GTM functions. The team is responsible for driving the compensation plan design, implementation, and assessment of variable pay participants across Okta while delivering compensation plans that ensure alignment with the overall goals and objectives of the GTM organization.

This role will report to the Director, GTM Strategy & Incentive Design and play a pivotal role in developing scalable sales incentive programs for our Go-To-Market Sales and Customer First organizations. Success in this role requires the individual to operationalize Okta’s incentive compensation plans and operational processes to be clear, measurable, cost-efficient, and effective. They will be expected to work cross functionally with a huge emphasis on operational efficiency, scaling our business processes, and driving effective change management.

In this role, you will drive strategic compensation initiatives by developing data-driven recommendations aligned with business objectives, influencing cross-functional leadership, and building consensus on complex compensation architecture decisions. You'll lead compensation plan design and optimization across Go-To-Market functions - ensuring incentives are strategically aligned with role responsibilities and organizational goals. You will establish robust metrics and analytics frameworks to track compensation plan performance, measure ROI, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement using quantitative analysis and business intelligence. Balancing strategic vision with operational rigor, you'll translate high-level business objectives into executable compensation plans while ensuring systems, processes, and analytics support accurate tracking and meaningful insights. Collaborating closely with Sales, Regional Sales Operations, People Ops, Finance and Legal teams, you will own operational excellence, drive productivity improvements through data-informed compensation strategy adjustments, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on compensation strategy, market competitiveness, and sales force effectiveness.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

• Design and implement compensation analytics and reports that align with the company's strategic goals and values. Support a high-performance culture by partnering strategically with our leadership team.

• Oversee the administration of all incentive compensation reporting and analytics to ensure timely and accurate payment of incentives, adhering to design governance. This includes attainment and earnings reports, predictive cost modeling, data validation and reconciliation, and ad-hoc reporting.

• Serve as a data & business process SME demonstrating knowledge surrounding Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) systems, our upstream financial reporting and CRM systems, and downstream BI and reporting capabilities.

• Develop and document data and business process flows. Identify efficiencies to support end-to-end automation, provide requirements and recommendations for ICM Analytics configuration changes, and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) related to commissions.

• Develop cost models, scenario analyses, and insights into our Incentive Plan design and Sales Performance by synthesizing information from various sources. Assist leadership in interpreting findings to make informed decisions and continuously enhance dashboard visualizations.

• Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with key business partners within GTM Operations, Commission Operations, Finance, and Sales.

What we're looking for:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation design, strategy, or analytics within public SaaS, software, or technology companies, with demonstrated expertise in organizational scaling

• Proven leadership capability to build, mentor, and manage diverse teams across multiple levels—from individual contributors and analysts to managers—fostering high performance and professional development

• Deep expertise in sales compensation architecture , including territory management design, account coverage models, sales crediting methodologies, and compensation plan mechanics that drive business outcomes

• Advanced proficiency with Salesforce, Anaplan, Xactly, or comparable incentive compensation management platforms, with the ability to optimize systems for accuracy and insights

• Track record of leading strategic cross-functional initiatives and virtual teams while maintaining executive visibility and stakeholder alignment at senior levels

• Executive-level communication skills —both written and verbal—with the ability to translate complex compensation strategies into compelling narratives, build persuasive business cases, and anticipate senior leadership questions

• Self-directed problem-solver who takes ownership of outcomes, identifies innovative solutions proactively, and consistently delivers high-quality, accurate work within tight timeframes

• Agile mindset with comfort navigating ambiguity, embracing organizational change, and adapting quickly to evolving priorities and new information

Nice to have:

• Systems knowledge of SFDC, Anaplan, and experience working with ICM systems such as Xactly or other related commissions software.

• Expertise with AI/ML using Python to perform predictive analytics, and statistical modeling, tailored to our market and business needs.

signals.content:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.



We are seeking a technically sharp systems builder to own DealHub CPQ. The ideal candidate will have expertise in pricing, quoting, and system integrations, driving efficiency and resolving issues across the DealHub platform and its downstream systems. You will work closely with the Commercial Systems, RevOps, Legal, Accounting, and other departments to enhance business workflows, automate processes, and provide strategic guidance within system constraints. The ideal candidate is strategic and self-directed, understands how complex systems connect, and stays current with new tools.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Manage and configure DealHub CPQ, ensuring accurate pricing, quoting, and product catalog configurations.

 - Collaborate with RevOps and the business to streamline quote workflows and automate pricing processes.

 - Identify what data must pass from DealHub to CRM, CLM, ERP, and billing systems, versus what stays local to DealHub, and build accordingly.

 - Understand the technical integration layer connecting DealHub to CRM and downstream systems, well enough to both diagnose issues and build solutions.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve CPQ-related issues quickly, maintaining system uptime and user efficiency.

 - Regularly audit CPQ system data integrity, catching issues before they impact users or downstream systems.

 - Test all changes prior to release and showcase new functionality to Deal Desk for review and sign-off.

 - Provide technical documentation and support to Deal Desk to help them drive user training and adoption.

 - Drive continuous improvement of CPQ architecture and performance.

 - Stay current on DealHub releases and help evaluate/adopt new features and best practices.

 - Actively evaluate and pilot AI-assisted tools for configuration, testing, and workflow automation, including testing DealHub's native AI solutions as they're released, so the team's tooling keeps advancing rather than just being maintained.


WHAT YOU BRING:

 - 2-4 years of hands-on experience with DealHub CPQ (or equivalent: Salesforce CPQ, Apttus, Conga, etc) and Salesforce CRM.

 - Strong understanding of sales processes, contract management, complex pricing models, and system integrations.

 - Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex system issues in CPQ and CRM tools.

 - Experience in creating and optimizing workflows and automation within CPQ and CRM systems.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce CPQ certification

 - Experience with usage-based (consumption) contract models and pricing solutions

Strong preference for the ability to work until noon Eastern Standard Time 3+ days per week (9:30 pm IST)

Role Overview

As the Senior Commission Manager, you will serve as a key operational leader driving execution, calculation integrity, and continuous process optimization across Okta’s end-to-end sales compensation lifecycle. Supporting a high-growth field organization, this role bridges hands-on commission administration—validations, payment submissions, dispute resolution, and operational modernization—with advanced reporting, enterprise analytics, and AI-driven process automation.

With a sharp focus on execution, data and incentive design governance, process engineering, and emerging AI tools, you will eliminate manual bottlenecks, build scalable reporting infrastructure, and guarantee 100% payout accuracy within tight deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

Commission Execution & Calculation Integrity

• Oversee the monthly commission calculation and payout lifecycle for global sellers, actively streamlining and operationalizing processes to maintain near-zero error margins.

• Operationalize data reconciliations between upstream source systems (CRM and Workday) and Xactly Incent, optimizing workflows to safeguard data integrity, maintain accurate crediting rules, and ensure calculation accuracy.

Process Engineering, Automation & AI

• Map core commission workflows to eliminate friction, slash monthly close processing times, and eliminate manual data manipulation.

• Identify and deploy automation tools, custom scripts, AI-driven efficiencies to streamline commission validations, accruals, payment submissions, and reporting.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

Reporting & High-Impact Analytics

• Monitor payout-to-revenue ratios, quota attainment distributions, error rates, and operational SLA performance.

Governance & SOX Compliance

• Maintain audit-ready control documentation and management review controls across the end-to-end commission processes.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external audit engagements.

Team Leadership & Escalation Management

• Manage, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global commission operations team.

• Act as the primary escalation point for complex rep inquiry resolutions and payment adjustments.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• Core Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation operations, incentive compensation management (ICM), or revenue operations, with a strong emphasis on execution, analytics, and system optimization.

signals.content:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google , meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications

•
7+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience, with 5+ years focused deeply on enterprise-scale Salesforce CPQ or Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM) in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise tech ecosystem.

•
Direct experience writing, testing, and debugging custom JavaScript within the Salesforce CPQ Quote Calculator Plugin (QCP) to execute advanced pricing algorithms that exceed declarative limits.

•
Expert-level mastery of Price/Product Rules, Bundles, Summary Variables, Custom Actions, and Advanced Approvals.

•
Advanced proficiency in Salesforce Flow architecture, design patterns, and platform limits, adhering to scalable enterprise best practices.

•
Strong working knowledge of Quote-to-Cash lifecycles, contract amendments, renewals, co-terming, multi-currency quoting, and downstream billing/revenue recognition touchpoints.

Preferred qualifications

•
Proven experience integrating generative AI coding and reasoning tools into day-to-day configuration, script generation, and testing workflows.

•
Exceptional diagnostic capability to trace and resolve calculation bottlenecks, execution loop issues, and data anomalies across declarative rules and custom scripts.

•
Track record of driving technical initiatives autonomously within an Agile/Scrum environment, utilizing Jira or similar platforms to manage technical debt, sprint deliverables, and release cadences.

•
Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical constraints, trade-offs, and design patterns to non-technical business leaders.

About the job

The Business Systems Team is central to Wiz's operational excellence and growth, ensuring the reliability and evolution of key business systems that support critical functions across the organization. Composed of technical administrators, developers, and analysts, the team focuses on maintaining and optimizing these business systems to drive efficiency and effectiveness. Combining strategic oversight with tactical execution, the Business Systems Team directly contributes to the success of Wiz's core business objectives as the company scales.

As a Senior Revenue Systems Administrator, you will serve as a primary technical owner of our Quote-to-Cash architecture, with a deep focus on Salesforce CPQ. This role sits at the critical intersection between Go-to-Market, Finance, and Product. You will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of complex pricing engines, product catalogs, and contracting pipelines. Combining deep declarative mastery with programmatic customization, you will build resilient, highly scalable revenue systems while leveraging modern AI developer tooling to accelerate solution delivery and automate operational workflows.

Responsibilities

•
Own the administration, architecture, and continuous enhancement of Salesforce CPQ, translating complex commercial models into scalable, maintainable system solutions.

•
Design, develop, test, and maintain custom JavaScript within the CPQ Quote Calculator Plugin (QCP) to execute advanced pricing algorithms, complex bundle configurations, and conditional calculations that exceed standard declarative capabilities.

•
Architect, build, and optimize intricate Price Rules, Product Rules, and search filters, ensuring optimal quote performance, calculation speed, and zero data discrepancies.

•
Build and govern robust, enterprise-grade Salesforce Flows and process automations, strategically evaluating trade-offs between native declarative features and programmatic interventions.

•
Leverage cutting-edge AI development environments to accelerate scripting, prototype complex logic, refactor legacy configurations, and triage system issues.

•
Partner closely with business stakeholders to drive end-to-end Q2C enhancements, triage escalated production blockers, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior administrators.

•
Lead sandbox lifecycle management, deployment strategies, and version control using enterprise Gearset Pipelines to enforce rigorous testing protocols and release hygiene.

Compensation + Benefits

signals.title: GTM Compensation Manager
signals.content:
The GTM Compensation Manager owns the scaling and operation of Sigma’s sales compensation process from start to finish. You’ll make sure every payout is accurate, on time and audit-ready. You’ll also build the automation, controls and reporting that keep compensation in line with business results as Sigma grows. The role suits a self-starter who wants full ownership, can bring structure to ambiguous problems, and works well across Finance, Revenue Operations, People and GTM leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Commission & Incentive Administration

• Own sales compensation administration end to end: setting up plan participants, distributing plans, calculating and validating commissions, confirming payments are ready, and submitting to payroll. You’re accountable for accuracy and timeliness.

• Spot anomalies before payroll and hold payments when a payout looks wrong, so we don’t overpay. Track and carry out decisions on exceptions so every change is documented and can be traced.

• Investigate and resolve crediting errors, quota misalignments, payout disputes and escalations. Explain the root cause and recommend fixes to leadership.

• Support commission accruals and expense reporting during Finance’s month-end close.

Consumption & Plan Mechanics

• Administer and validate compensation tied to both committed bookings and consumption, including commit, ramp and true-up logic.

• Help put quota rules, crediting structures, accelerators, SPIFs and payout policies into practice as plans change.

• Write clear plan documents, policies and FAQs that turn complex compensation logic into language sellers and managers can follow.

Systems, Data & Automation

• Manage Sigma’s compensation platform with the broader team, and keep data flowing cleanly between Salesforce, the HRIS, the comp system.

• Check data against the systems of record before every payout cycle.

• Build reporting and dashboards in Sigma that give sellers, managers and Finance visibility into attainment and payouts.

• Find where AI and automation can do real work, such as catching anomalies, sorting exceptions and reconciling data, and roll it out to reduce manual effort.

Controls & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Build controls, repeatable workflows and documentation that keep the function audit-ready as Sigma scales.

• Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, People, Payroll, Legal and Data. Frame each decision around the seller’s experience, risk and compliance, and act as the first point of contact for compensation escalations.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on sales compensation administration, ideally at fast-scaling SaaS companies.

• Experience with consumption-based or hybrid (commit + usage) compensation models, and an understanding of how plan mechanics influence seller behavior.

• Working knowledge of quotas, target incentive (OTI), accelerators, overlays, SPIFs and crediting rules.

• Strong data validation skills, with a track record of catching anomalies and turning findings into clear recommendations.

• Ability to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority, and to explain complex logic to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Comfort using AI tools day to day, with a practical view of where automation helps and where human judgment is still needed.

• Exceptional attention to detail, a strong systems mindset, and the ability to run reliable processes with minimal oversight.

• Bonus: hands-on experience configuring a modern comp tool (CaptivateIQ, QuotaPath or similar), and audit controls.

Additional Job details
The base salary range for this position is $165K - $200K annually.

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work at Sigma Computing. This role is eligible for stock options, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

About us:

Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.

Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.

Come join us!

Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:

• Equity

• Generous health benefits

• Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!

• Paid bonding time for all new parents

• Traditional and Roth 401k

• Commuter and FSA benefits

• Lunch Program

• Dog friendly office

Sigma is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status. We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.

Note: We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Our Privacy Practices

When you submit a job application on this site, Sigma processes your personal data for the purposes of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Sigma and as otherwise needed throughout the recruitment and hiring process. Please review Sigma’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more details. Please note that your personal data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which it was provided (including to the USA, the UK, and Canada, Australia).

Sigma’s use of AI

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

signals.title: Senior Salesforce Engineer, Quote-to-Cash
signals.content:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com http://amplitude.com.



As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer specializing in Quote-to-Cash to build and evolve the systems behind how we sell, contract, and provision customers. You’ll write production code, develop integrations, and improve the reliability of our existing workflows while delivering changes that support new products, commercial models, and business growth.

As part of GTM Engineering, you’ll partner with Sales Finance, Sales, and Product & Engineering to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Your work will span recurring CPQ defects, customer provisioning, acquisition-related contracting changes, and the evolution of our Quote-to-Cash architecture.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, develop, and maintain Quote-to-Cash solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce Flow, choosing code or configuration based on the problem.

 - Build and extend CPQ capabilities for product launches, pricing, bundling, discount approvals, subscriptions, amendments, and renewals.

 - Diagnose complex quoting, contracting, order, and entitlement defects; trace failures through code, data, and integrations; and implement root-cause fixes with regression tests.

 - Partner directly with Sales Finance and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess tradeoffs, estimate effort, and own delivery from technical design through production validation.

 - Develop contract and subscription data models that support acquisition requirements, multiple contracts per customer, and flexible contract start dates.

 - Partner with EPD Growth to resolve provisioning discrepancies and build reliable provisioning and deprovisioning workflows so customer access matches purchased entitlements.

 - Write bulk-safe, maintainable code with meaningful automated tests; participate in code reviews and deliver changes through version control and the team’s release process.

 - Reduce recurring operational work through automation, improved validation, and targeted fixes that prevent repeat deal escalations and manual data corrections.

 - Build and maintain APIs and integrations connecting Salesforce with contracting, billing, and product-provisioning systems, including error handling, retries, and reconciliation.

 - Document technical designs, data flows, and operational behavior; partner with business users on acceptance testing and validate downstream outcomes after release.

 - Contribute to Quote-to-Cash transformation, including CPQ migration, new currencies and commercial models, and integration of acquired products.

 - Evaluate changes to CPQ and related Salesforce capabilities and recommend improvements that simplify the architecture and reduce ongoing maintenance.


YOUR FIRST SIX MONTHS OF IMPACT

 - Independently deliver Quote-to-Cash enhancements and resolve complex defects, with tested changes and clear ownership of downstream outcomes.

 - Identify recurring quoting and contracting problems, establish a baseline for repeat escalations, and ship fixes that reduce manual intervention.

 - Partner with EPD Growth to address priority provisioning failure modes and improve visibility into entitlement mismatches and failed handoffs.

 - Deliver an agreed milestone on the Quote-to-Cash roadmap, such as acquisition-related contracting, provisioning automation, or CPQ migration readiness.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including production ownership of Salesforce CPQ and Quote-to-Cash solutions.

 - Deep understanding of CPQ product configuration, pricing rules, quote calculations, subscriptions, amendments, renewals, and the quote-to-contract-to-order lifecycle.

 - Strong Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce Flow skills, with experience building bulk-safe solutions, asynchronous processing, and meaningful automated tests.

 - Experience designing and debugging API integrations, including authentication, error handling, retries, and data consistency across connected systems.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into technical designs and explain tradeoffs to Sales, Finance, and engineering partners.

 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and regression testing, with evidence of independently shipping and supporting reliable production changes.

 - A track record of tracing complex defects to root cause and improving existing systems; a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Salesforce Platform Developer I/II or CPQ credentials, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

 - Experience with SaaS billing, revenue processes, entitlements, customer provisioning, or acquisition-related systems integration.

 - Experience migrating CPQ platforms or implementing multi-contract architectures, multicurrency selling, or flexible subscription terms.

 - Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve engineering productivity and reduce recurring Quote-to-Cash support work.


WHY THIS ROLE

Your work will directly shape how Amplitude brings products to market and delivers purchased capabilities to customers. You’ll combine hands-on development with ownership of complex Quote-to-Cash problems, reducing the maintenance burden on the team and helping deliver the next generation of our commercial systems.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY AND DIVERSITY STATEMENT

We are committed to equal employment opportunity in both principle and as a matter of policy. We will recruit, hire, train, promote, compensate and provide benefits to all applicants and employees without regard to ancestry, sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, religion, religious creed, mental and/or physical disability, medical condition, military and/or veteran’s status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all recruiting, hiring, promotions, upgrades, layoffs, compensation, benefits, terminations and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. The firm complies fully with all federal, state and local equal employment opportunity laws.


OUR VALUES:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

 - Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

 - Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

 - Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

 - Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.



We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

 - Excellent  M edical,  D ental and  V ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical,  Dental,   Vision on select plans

 - 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

 - Flexible time off,  p aid holidays, and more

 - Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

 - Excellent Parental benefits including :  12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

 - Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

 - Employee Stock Purchase Program  (ESPP)



Other fun facts about Amplitude:

 - Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution https://www.g2.com/categories/product-analytics/enterprise for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

 - We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

 - We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

 - We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

 - We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

 - We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

 - Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

signals.title: Director, Incentive Compensation
signals.content:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in Deloitte’s Fast 500 (four years running!), LinkedIn’s Top Startups , Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!), Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

About the Role

Attentive is building the future of marketing with AI. We believe AI will change how brands connect with people and open new possibilities for growth. Our ambition is to help define that future, building on the experience and trust we’ve earned with thousands of brands.

We’re thinking big about what comes next, with the urgency of a startup and the foundation of a well-established business. Joining Attentive is an opportunity to help shape an industry primed for a massive change and have a meaningful role in the company we’re becoming.

This hybrid role is based in our New York office, with in-office collaboration Tuesday through Thursday each week.

What You’ll Accomplish

• Lead annual incentive planning across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and other eligible go-to-market roles. Work with leaders to define performance measures, pay mix, payout curves, accelerators, and plan rules.

• Track, report, and work with Accounting to accrue non GTM bonus plans including executive bonuses.

• Make sure incentives reward the right outcomes. Evaluate how pricing, contract terms, customer commitments, usage, and deal margin affect payouts. Recommend changes that support growth without encouraging poor deal economics.

• Build and test compensation models. Show how different levels of attainment and plan structures affect employee earnings and company costs. Explain the tradeoffs and help leaders reach a decision.

• Own commission operations, including calculation, validation, reconciliation, approvals, and delivery to Payroll. Keep payouts accurate and on time, statements clear, and questions resolved promptly.

• Maintain plan documentation and consistent policies for crediting, ramp periods, guarantees, role changes, adjustments, and exceptions. Work with People, Legal, Accounting, and Payroll on controls and approvals.

• Assess whether plans are working. Track attainment, payout distribution, commission costs, and the behavior each plan encourages. Separate actual results from forecast assumptions and turn findings into recommendations.

• Improve compensation systems and data. Work with Revenue Operations and business systems partners on requirements, testing, and data quality. Use automation and AI where they reduce manual work, improve accuracy and enhance customer experience.

• Lead and develop the compensation team. Set clear responsibilities, review work, and coach people through complex questions. Help managers and employees understand their plans through rollout materials and ongoing communication.

• Partner with FP&A and Accounting on commission forecasts, accruals, reconciliations, and explanations of variance. Prepare clear analysis for senior leadership.

Your Expertise

• 8+ years of relevant experience in incentive compensation, incentive design, or related Finance or Revenue Operations roles, with ownership of both plan design and administration.

• Experience managing and developing a team, ideally including at least two years of people management.

• Experience designing and operating incentive programs in a SaaS, technology, or similarly complex business.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You can build a scenario model, trace a calculation to its source, and spot when an assumption does not hold.

• Practical experience with incentive compensation platforms and Salesforce data. You understand how contract terms, bookings, billing, and payouts connect.

• Sound business judgment. You can challenge a proposal constructively and balance employee motivation, financial discipline, and ease of administration.

• Clear communication with executives, managers, and employees. You can explain a complex plan or a difficult payout decision without losing the audience.

• Care with sensitive information and the discipline to get the details right, even during a busy payout or planning cycle.

• Experience with consumption-based revenue, margin-based incentives, expansion and retention plans

• Direct experience with commission management platforms (Xactly preferred, or equivalent SPM systems like CaptivateIQ, Spiff).

You'll get competitive perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

• The US base salary range for this full-time position is $180,000-$270,000 + equity + benefits

• Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location

signals.title: Director, Deal Desk
signals.content:
About Showpad

Showpad is the leader in revenue effectiveness, helping organizations in complex, field-driven industries turn strategy into execution and execution into measurable growth. Purpose-built for industrial organizations such as those in manufacturing, consumer packaged goods, and medical device companies, Showpad’s AI-native platform unifies content management, sales readiness, buyer engagement, and revenue intelligence into a single system of execution.

Powered by GenieAI and grounded in trusted first-party data, Showpad enables revenue teams to automate workflows, scale winning behaviors, and reclaim lost revenue across every customer interaction. More than 2,000 global organizations rely on Showpad to drive consistent, high-impact performance in the field.

Built for effectiveness and recognized for excellence, Showpad is consistently named a Leader by Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Aragon, and backed by 2,500+ five-star reviews on G2 and Gartner Peer Insights.

Job & Department Summary

Showpad’s Revenue Operations team owns the systems, data, and operating processes that allow the go-to-market organization to sell, service, and grow revenue. The team spans GTM Systems, Deal Desk, Insights and Innovation, GTM Strategy, and Sales and Customer Operations, across North America, EMEA, and India.

The Director, Deal Desk is the senior commercial leader within that team and the executive owner of how Showpad prices, structures, governs, and books its business. This leader sets the strategy and standards for the global Deal Desk function, builds and leads the team that delivers it, and is accountable for the integrity of every deal from first quote through signed contract, booking, and handoff to billing and revenue recognition.

This is an executive partnering role. The Director serves as a trusted commercial advisor to the Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Financial Officer, SVP of North America Sales, VP of EMEA Sales, and VP of Revenue Operations, shaping the company’s most strategic, complex, and high-value deals, framing difficult trade-offs for executive decision, and representing the Deal Desk point of view in forecast, pricing, and planning conversations. They are expected to unlock revenue through creative, defensible deal structures while holding a firm, principled line on pricing discipline, margin, and policy, particularly under quarter- and year-end pressure.

The team and how the role operates

The role reports to the Vice President, Revenue Operations and leads a global Deal Desk team, currently three Deal Desk Analysts, supporting North America, EMEA, and APAC, with the majority of volume in North America and EMEA. The Director owns the function’s operating model, organizational design, coverage across time zones, hiring, and talent development, and is expected to scale the team and its capabilities as the business grows. The Director leads largely through influence across the executive team and cross-functional partners: Finance and Accounting on revenue recognition, billing, and collections; Legal on contract terms and risk; GTM Systems on CPQ and quote-to-cash infrastructure; Product Marketing on pricing and packaging; and Sales and Customer Operations on bookings and forecast integrity.

Why this role exists now

Following the Bigtincan merger, Showpad has two heritage customer bases, a recently unified systems landscape, and pricing, packaging, and approval practices that have not yet been fully rebuilt for the combined business. Discounting, deal structures, and quote-to-cash handoffs currently rely heavily on manual effort and individual judgment. Showpad needs a senior leader who can design and implement a scalable, well-governed commercial framework for the combined company, chair the Value Pricing Board, resolve the complex commercial problems that come with integration (heritage contract migrations, conflicting price books, legacy terms, and renewal risk), and give executive leadership a single, trusted partner on deal strategy, commercial terms, and pricing.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Desk Leadership

• Set the vision and strategy for Showpad’s global Deal Desk function, aligned to the company’s revenue, margin, and value-creation objectives.

• Lead, coach, and develop the Deal Desk team, setting a high bar for commercial judgment, responsiveness, quality, and executive-ready communication.

• Own the function’s operating model: regional coverage across North America, EMEA, and APAC, capacity planning, and the case for future headcount as the business scales.

• Establish and publish service levels for quote turnaround, approval cycle time, and order processing, and hold the function accountable to them, especially through month-, quarter-, and year-end.

• Design a tiered engagement and prioritization model so that strategic, high-value, and time-sensitive deals receive senior attention while standard deals move through with minimal friction.

Executive Partnership and Commercial Advisory

• Serve as the primary commercial advisor to the CRO, CFO, SVP of North America Sales, VP of EMEA Sales, and VP of Revenue Operations on deal strategy, pricing, and commercial risk.

• Partner with the SVP of North America Sales and VP of EMEA Sales and their leadership teams to shape the regional deal pipeline, prepare for quarter-end, and align on approach for the largest and most complex opportunities.

• Partner with the CFO and Finance leadership to ensure commercial decisions balance growth with margin, cash, and revenue quality, and that the financial consequences of every non-standard term are understood before signature.

• Frame contested or high-stakes commercial decisions for executive resolution, with the options, economics, risks, and a clear recommendation, rather than escalating open questions.

• Represent Deal Desk in executive forecast calls, QBRs, and annual planning, bringing a credible, data-backed view of deal quality, discounting, and commercial risk.

Complex Deal Strategy and Problem Solving

• Personally lead the structuring of Showpad’s most strategic, complex, and non-standard deals across new logo, expansion, renewal, and multi-year agreements.

• Solve the hardest commercial problems in the business: heritage customer migrations and consolidations, conflicting legacy terms and price books, at-risk renewals, competitive displacements, multi-entity and multi-currency agreements, and channel or partner structures.

• Design creative, defensible deal structures (ramped pricing, multi-year commitments, co-terming, bundling, upgrades, and enterprise agreements) that win while protecting margin, revenue quality, and long-term customer value.

• Partner with Legal on non-standard commercial terms (payment terms, termination rights, price caps, renewal uplifts, liability, and SLAs) and set the commercial position the business is willing to accept.

• Act as the final escalation point for deal-level disputes between Sales, Finance, and Legal, resolving issues quickly and consistently with policy and precedent.

Value Pricing Board and Commercial Governance

• Chair the Value Pricing Board, Showpad’s executive forum for approving deal discounts, non-standard structures, and commercial exceptions.

• Own the Board’s charter, membership, cadence, and decision rights in alignment with the CRO and CFO, ensuring decisions are fast, consistent, and well documented.

• Ensure every deal brought to the Board is executive-ready, with deal economics, discount rationale, competitive context, risk assessment, and a clear Deal Desk recommendation.

• Own and evolve the global discount approval matrix and delegation of authority, ensuring thresholds are clear, consistently applied, and reviewed as the business changes.

• Use Board decisions and outcomes to refine policy, strengthen guardrails, and steadily reduce the volume of deals that require executive escalation.

Quote-to-Cash Strategy and Transformation

• Own the end-to-end quote-to-cash process strategy, from quote creation and approval through contract execution, booking, provisioning, invoicing, and renewal.

• Lead the redesign of quote-to-cash for the combined Showpad and Bigtincan business, identifying bottlenecks, manual effort, and control gaps, and driving a prioritized transformation roadmap.

• Act as the executive business owner for CPQ, approval workflows, contract management, and billing integrations, partnering with GTM Systems on requirements, prioritization, and adoption.

• Ensure bookings are accurate, complete, and audit-ready, partnering with Finance and Accounting on ASC 606 / IFRS 15 considerations and revenue recognition outcomes.

• Drive clean, accountable handoffs between Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success so that what is sold is what is provisioned, billed, and recognized.

• Deliver measurable reductions in quote-to-cash cycle time and booking errors, and report progress to the VP, Revenue Operations and executive leadership.

Pricing Strategy and Commercial Policy

• Partner with the CRO, CFO, and VP, Revenue Operations to shape Showpad’s pricing strategy, including list pricing, packaging, discount guardrails, and renewal uplift policy.

• Bring deal-level evidence to pricing decisions: discount trends, win/loss by price point, deal size and mix, price realization, and regional and segment variation.

• Partner with Product Marketing and Finance on new product and packaging launches, ensuring they are quotable, approvable, and bookable from day one.

• Own the global commercial policy framework (discounting policy, approval matrix, payment terms, and standard deal structures) and ensure it is understood and followed across the field.

• Identify sources of pricing leakage and commercial friction, and bring executive leadership clear, quantified recommendations for change.

• If a global pricing change requires Finance, Legal and GTM Systems to reprioritize work, the Director Deal Desk must own the rollout decision, commit capacity, and be accountable for the result.

Deal Intelligence and Executive Reporting

• Deliver executive-level reporting on discounting, deal velocity, approval cycle time, non-standard terms, and price realization across regions and segments.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Operations to ensure bookings data supports an accurate forecast, and with Finance to reconcile bookings each period.

• Provide the CRO, CFO, and regional sales leaders with quarterly insight into deal quality and commercial trends, with a clear point of view on what should change.

Leadership Standards

• Bring recommendations, not open questions. When a deal or policy decision is contested, propose a path forward and make the trade-offs explicit.

• Build a function that is consistent, auditable, and scalable, with documented processes, policies, and approval logic.

• Champion automation and simplification, working with Revenue Operations colleagues to eliminate manual and spreadsheet-driven steps in the deal and quote-to-cash process.

• Lead change management for pricing, policy, and process updates, communicating clearly and early to executives, sales leaders, and everyone affected.

Key Performance Outcomes

Deal Desk Performance

• Quote turnaround and approval cycle times consistently meet published service levels across all regions, including at quarter- and year-end.

• Booking accuracy improves measurably, with order and contract errors reducing quarter over quarter.

• Sales leadership regards Deal Desk as a strategic enabler of revenue rather than a bottleneck.

Pricing Discipline and Value Pricing Board

• Average discount and discount variance trend toward agreed targets, with improved price realization and reduced pricing leakage.

• The Value Pricing Board runs on a predictable cadence, with decisions made quickly and documented consistently.

• The share of deals requiring executive escalation reduces as policy, guardrails, and seller enablement mature.

Quote-to-Cash Transformation

• End-to-end quote-to-cash cycle time reduces against an agreed baseline.

• A unified quote-to-cash process, approval framework, and price book are in place for the combined business.

• Bookings reconcile to Finance each period without material adjustment, and audit findings related to the deal process are closed.

Pricing Strategy

• Pricing and packaging recommendations are grounded in deal data and adopted by executive leadership.

• New pricing and packaging changes launch on schedule and are quotable and bookable from day one.

Team Leadership and Executive Partnership

• The Deal Desk team is fully staffed, engaged, and developing, with clear career paths and no single points of failure across regions.

• The CRO, CFO, SVP of North America Sales, VP of EMEA Sales, and VP of Revenue Operations regard this role as a trusted commercial advisor and rely on it for the company’s most complex deals.

• Complex commercial issues are resolved at the Deal Desk level, with fewer escalations to executive leadership.

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: Must have

• 10+ years in B2B SaaS go-to-market organizations, with significant experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Finance, or Pricing.

• Proven experience serving as a trusted advisor to C-level and senior sales and finance leaders (CRO, CFO, regional sales executives), including the ability to influence decisions and hold a position constructively under quarter-end pressure.

• Deep experience structuring and negotiating complex enterprise SaaS deals, including multi-year, ramped, co-termed, multi-entity, and non-standard agreements.

• Demonstrated ownership of a quote-to-cash or deal approval process at scale, including leading measurable process and systems transformation.

• Experience chairing or leading an executive deal review or pricing approval forum.

• Experience supporting a global sales organization across multiple regions and time zones, including North America and EMEA.

• Strong working knowledge of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how contract terms affect bookings and revenue.

• Strong analytical and financial acumen, with comfort forming and defending a clear view from imperfect data.

Experience: Nice to have

• Experience shaping SaaS pricing and packaging strategy, including list price changes and new packaging launches.

• Experience leading commercial integration in a post-merger environment with multiple heritage customer bases, price books, and systems.

• Exposure to APAC commercial practices and contracting.

• Experience with reseller, partner, or channel deal structures.

• Background in a private-equity-backed business with value-creation accountability.

Technical Skills: Must have

• Salesforce: strong working knowledge of opportunities, quotes, products, and price books.

• CPQ platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud, DealHub, or equivalent), including experience owning approval workflow design and business requirements.

• Advanced deal modeling capability: discount analysis, multi-year economics, and margin and cash impact.

• Expert grasp of SaaS commercial metrics: ARR, ACV, TCV, NRR, GRR, discount, and price realization.

Technical Skills: Nice to have

• Contract lifecycle management tools such as DocuSign CLM, Ironclad, or equivalent.

• Billing and subscription management platforms such as NetSuite, Zuora, or equivalent.

• QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.

• Revenue intelligence platforms such as Gong or Clari.

Competencies

• Executive presence: credibility and composure with C-level leaders, and the confidence to deliver an unwelcome decision without damaging the relationship.

• Strategic commercial judgment: the ability to balance winning the deal with protecting margin, revenue quality, and long-term value.

• Complex problem solving: breaking down ambiguous, high-stakes commercial problems into clear opt

signals.title: Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations
signals.content:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We are looking for a Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations to lead the worldwide deal function for a rapidly scaling data and analytics business formed by the combination of Fivetran and dbt Labs. This is a commercial strategy role as much as an operational one with a mandate to make our deals bigger, better, and faster. The leader owns the deal structures, pricing inputs, policies, and governance that drive more revenue and higher ASP, cleaner and lower-risk terms, and real velocity across every region and segment, while de-risking the business.

This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment. The business is integrating two commercial engines, two product portfolios, and two sets of systems into a single combined go-to-market. The role sets the strategy for how deals get structured, priced, routed, reviewed, and approved, and acts as a key commercial advisor to GTM leadership on the structures that drive growth, including ELA and commercial strategy, cross-sell, and new product launches. It leads a global team across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Systems, Pricing, and Partner Marketplace to keep decisions fast, consistent, and scalable.

This leader is an equal part strategist, operator, and trusted business partner. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between long-term commercial strategy and hands-on problem solving, has a proven track record scaling a deal function in a global, complex, high-growth SaaS environment, and leads teams through change with clarity and conviction.

Reports to the SVP, Strategy and Operations. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in one of our hub offices: New York, NY; Denver, CO; Oakland, CA; or Austin, TX.

What You'll Do

• Team leadership and organizational development

• Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global Deal Desk organization.

• Coach the team to operate as commercial advisors to the field, raising the strategic value of every interaction with Sales.

• Build capability and bench strength, reducing key-person dependency as the team scales.

• Strategic leadership and vision

• Own and execute the global vision for the Deal Desk organization across the combined Fivetran + dbt business.

• Conceptualize and launch new, high-impact commercial strategies and deal constructs (e.g. multi-year deals, shift to consumption-based pricing, and product-specific ELAs) that grow revenue and move the business forward.

• Lead commercial strategy for the Fivetran + dbt integration, landing one combined operating model, policy set, and deal construct.

• Build the team structure, governance framework, and ways of working needed to support a global enterprise sales engine selling a multi-product, consumption-based portfolio.

• Position the deal function as a driver of growth, net revenue retention, and cross-sell, and align the C-suite behind that mandate.

• Commercial guidance and executive escalation

• Provide strategic counsel to senior sales leadership and account teams on complex deal structures, pricing options, concessions, and negotiation strategy.

• Act as the trusted advisor for high-risk, non-standard, and strategically significant commercial discussions.

• Engage directly with customers on strategic, high-value negotiations when needed, representing the company with credibility.

• AI and automation

• Set the vision for an AI-native deal desk, deploying agents and automation across the deal lifecycle, including deal-structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract and redline review, approval routing, and risk scoring.

• Build a tiered service model where automation handles standardized, low-risk deals end to end, so the team's time goes to complex, strategic ones.

• Scale AI-enabled workflows that improve seller productivity, deal quality, approval consistency, and speed, building on an existing foundation of deal-desk AI agents and AI-assisted deal review.

• Deal governance and cross-functional alignment

• Document and enforce global approval policies, SLAs, delegation of authority, and commercial guardrails across Sales, Finance, and Legal.

• Drive consistency of commercial policy, thresholds, and approval rules across all regions and product lines, so sellers get the same answer wherever a deal originates.

• Own a standing deal-review and inspection cadence (deal reviews, early checkpoints, and exception tracking) that catches risk early and keeps decisions fast.

• Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting to ensure sound revenue recognition, revenue predictability, deal hygiene, and commercial compliance as consumption, ELA, and marketplace structures scale.

• Deal systems and infrastructure

• Lead the strategy and roadmap for deal infrastructure, ensuring scalable, efficient, compliant execution as the two companies converge onto unified quote-to-order systems.

• Partner with Systems, Legal, and Finance to deliver a unified, high-quality quoting and contracting experience across CPQ, CLM, and order management.

• New product introduction and pricing operations

• Partner with Product, Pricing, and Monetization on new product introduction (NPI), making sure new products and packaging land with a clear deal construct, approval path, and field enablement at launch.

• Oversee the Pricing Operations function, supporting packaging, SKU rationalization, and consistent, well-governed pricing execution across the portfolio.

• Marketplace strategy and operations

• Oversee marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks, ensuring a streamlined and compliant transaction experience for customers.

• Shape policies and operational standards for our marketplace presence, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Product, and vendor partners to optimize transaction efficiency and financial accuracy.

Skills We're Looking For

• 15+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Revenue Operations or Commercial Operations within a global SaaS or subscription-based business, or Strategy Consulting with a focus on B2B Pricing and Deal Strategy.

• 8+ years of leadership experience scaling high-performing teams, including meaningful time at the director and ideally senior director level.

• Strong command of SaaS pricing strategy, with specific depth in consumption-based pricing, commercial governance, discounting and margin considerations, and contract risk mitigation.

• Track record of building scalable deal processes, implementing robust approval frameworks, and improving deal velocity in complex, high-growth environments.

• Experience structuring deals across both direct and channel motions, including resellers and cloud marketplaces.

• Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, with a track record of partnering closely with Finance and Revenue Accounting on deal structure.

• Experience applying AI tools to improve deal operations, approval consistency, and seller productivity.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior executives across Sales, Finance, Legal, Systems, and Product, with exceptional analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts simply and persuasively.

• Experience with the commercial tooling a deal process runs on (CPQ, CRM, CLM, and related sales systems), enough to be a strong partner to Systems on what is feasible; specific platform experience such as Salesforce or Ironclad is a plus, not a requirement.

• Experience leading through M&A, systems integration, or large-scale organizational change is a strong plus.

Perks and Benefits

• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

signals.title: Principal Analyst, Revenue Operations Strategy
signals.content:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Principal Analyst II Revenue Strategy & Operations, (North America)

Why We Have This Role

The Revenue Strategy & Operations team ensures that our global sales/revenue organization is positioned to achieve their highest potential by optimizing revenue opportunities across the globe. We do this by leveraging data from many sources, including internal customer purchasing and usage information as well as firmographic, technographic, and intent data from 3rd party sources. We set high targets for our revenue teams and work to exceed them every quarter. Part of our success comes from having world-class business processes, systems, and tools. We love data and we love to show results in the form of more Sales success. We have impressive members on this team, and will continue to add more top talent!

Qualtrics is seeking a Field Operations partner to support our North America Sales Teams, responsible for setting new business and renewal targets, optimizing territories to ensure the greatest opportunity for each individual rep's success, and leading other key strategic revenue-enhancing initiatives.

How You’ll Find Success

• Love working with data and learning new things

• Love helping others find solutions to problems

• Excellent problem solving, decision-making and analytical skills

• Ability to collaborate with teams across the organization while also being able to work independently and as a self-starter

• Proven ability to meet aggressive deadlines

How You’ll Grow

• Leadership Exposure: significant exposure to key leaders in the North America Sales Organization providing the opportunity to work closely with them as a trusted advisor. Helping you develop strong leadership and communication skills, as well as a deep understanding of the company's strategic vision.

• Strategic Thinking: The role involves collaborating with leadership to develop and implement go-to-market strategies. This strategic involvement will allow you to expand your strategic thinking and planning capabilities, which are highly valuable skills for career growth.

• GTM (Go-To-Market) Expertise: As the role involves working closely with sales & success leaders and monitoring performance metrics, it provides an ideal environment for someone looking to deepen their understanding of the GTM processes and methodologies.

Things You’ll Do

• Serve as trusted advisor to Sales leadership, shaping go-to-market strategy that aligns with company objectives.

• Drive forecasting rigor across all deals, with emphasis on large, multi-stakeholder deals - including multi-threading analysis and executive sponsorship visibility.

• Monitor named-account pipeline, opportunity progression, and win/loss patterns; partner with leaders to close performance gaps.

• Own annual and quarterly GTM planning - business modeling, quota setting, and named-account/strategic territory design.

• Partner with Deal Desk and Legal on negotiation strategy for large, complex opportunities.

• Drive adoption of tools, processes, and operating rhythms - including executive-level deal reviews - from front line to senior leadership.

• Build cross-functional relationships with Finance, Marketing, Enablement, and Ecosystem teams to align strategy with execution.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• 8+ years of relevant experience in Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, or Management Consulting with a focus on the following: Forecasting, go-to-market (GTM) execution, sales compensation and incentive plan creation, and partnering with senior sales leaders

• At least 5 years of experience in the software industry and cloud platform businesses

• Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting and analytics experience required

• Experience with Power BI or Tableau, or other data visualization tools

What You Should Know About This Team

• This team is very tenured at Qualtrics (average 6 years) and has great relationships in various departments

• We play a key role across teams and departments at Qualtrics and get to work on important projects that have regular executive level visibility

• Small close-knit team that enjoys working with each other and working on a variety of different projects that ta

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Workspaces: We have quiet spaces to take a call or for deep thinking, and other spaces dedicated to collaboration.

• Commuter Benefits: We offer a generous monthly allowance to be used for transportation and to help you commute to the office.

• Wellness Reimbursement: This can be put toward wellness activities including gym memberships, spa massages, workout equipment, meditation apps, and much more.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations.
