signals.title: Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations
signals.content:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We are looking for a Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations to lead the worldwide deal function for a rapidly scaling data and analytics business formed by the combination of Fivetran and dbt Labs. This is a commercial strategy role as much as an operational one with a mandate to make our deals bigger, better, and faster. The leader owns the deal structures, pricing inputs, policies, and governance that drive more revenue and higher ASP, cleaner and lower-risk terms, and real velocity across every region and segment, while de-risking the business.

This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment. The business is integrating two commercial engines, two product portfolios, and two sets of systems into a single combined go-to-market. The role sets the strategy for how deals get structured, priced, routed, reviewed, and approved, and acts as a key commercial advisor to GTM leadership on the structures that drive growth, including ELA and commercial strategy, cross-sell, and new product launches. It leads a global team across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Systems, Pricing, and Partner Marketplace to keep decisions fast, consistent, and scalable.

This leader is an equal part strategist, operator, and trusted business partner. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between long-term commercial strategy and hands-on problem solving, has a proven track record scaling a deal function in a global, complex, high-growth SaaS environment, and leads teams through change with clarity and conviction.

Reports to the SVP, Strategy and Operations. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in one of our hub offices: New York, NY; Denver, CO; Oakland, CA; or Austin, TX.

What You'll Do

• Team leadership and organizational development

• Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global Deal Desk organization.

• Coach the team to operate as commercial advisors to the field, raising the strategic value of every interaction with Sales.

• Build capability and bench strength, reducing key-person dependency as the team scales.

• Strategic leadership and vision

• Own and execute the global vision for the Deal Desk organization across the combined Fivetran + dbt business.

• Conceptualize and launch new, high-impact commercial strategies and deal constructs (e.g. multi-year deals, shift to consumption-based pricing, and product-specific ELAs) that grow revenue and move the business forward.

• Lead commercial strategy for the Fivetran + dbt integration, landing one combined operating model, policy set, and deal construct.

• Build the team structure, governance framework, and ways of working needed to support a global enterprise sales engine selling a multi-product, consumption-based portfolio.

• Position the deal function as a driver of growth, net revenue retention, and cross-sell, and align the C-suite behind that mandate.

• Commercial guidance and executive escalation

• Provide strategic counsel to senior sales leadership and account teams on complex deal structures, pricing options, concessions, and negotiation strategy.

• Act as the trusted advisor for high-risk, non-standard, and strategically significant commercial discussions.

• Engage directly with customers on strategic, high-value negotiations when needed, representing the company with credibility.

• AI and automation

• Set the vision for an AI-native deal desk, deploying agents and automation across the deal lifecycle, including deal-structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract and redline review, approval routing, and risk scoring.

• Build a tiered service model where automation handles standardized, low-risk deals end to end, so the team's time goes to complex, strategic ones.

• Scale AI-enabled workflows that improve seller productivity, deal quality, approval consistency, and speed, building on an existing foundation of deal-desk AI agents and AI-assisted deal review.

• Deal governance and cross-functional alignment

• Document and enforce global approval policies, SLAs, delegation of authority, and commercial guardrails across Sales, Finance, and Legal.

• Drive consistency of commercial policy, thresholds, and approval rules across all regions and product lines, so sellers get the same answer wherever a deal originates.

• Own a standing deal-review and inspection cadence (deal reviews, early checkpoints, and exception tracking) that catches risk early and keeps decisions fast.

• Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting to ensure sound revenue recognition, revenue predictability, deal hygiene, and commercial compliance as consumption, ELA, and marketplace structures scale.

• Deal systems and infrastructure

• Lead the strategy and roadmap for deal infrastructure, ensuring scalable, efficient, compliant execution as the two companies converge onto unified quote-to-order systems.

• Partner with Systems, Legal, and Finance to deliver a unified, high-quality quoting and contracting experience across CPQ, CLM, and order management.

• New product introduction and pricing operations

• Partner with Product, Pricing, and Monetization on new product introduction (NPI), making sure new products and packaging land with a clear deal construct, approval path, and field enablement at launch.

• Oversee the Pricing Operations function, supporting packaging, SKU rationalization, and consistent, well-governed pricing execution across the portfolio.

• Marketplace strategy and operations

• Oversee marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks, ensuring a streamlined and compliant transaction experience for customers.

• Shape policies and operational standards for our marketplace presence, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Product, and vendor partners to optimize transaction efficiency and financial accuracy.

Skills We're Looking For

• 15+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Revenue Operations or Commercial Operations within a global SaaS or subscription-based business, or Strategy Consulting with a focus on B2B Pricing and Deal Strategy.

• 8+ years of leadership experience scaling high-performing teams, including meaningful time at the director and ideally senior director level.

• Strong command of SaaS pricing strategy, with specific depth in consumption-based pricing, commercial governance, discounting and margin considerations, and contract risk mitigation.

• Track record of building scalable deal processes, implementing robust approval frameworks, and improving deal velocity in complex, high-growth environments.

• Experience structuring deals across both direct and channel motions, including resellers and cloud marketplaces.

• Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, with a track record of partnering closely with Finance and Revenue Accounting on deal structure.

• Experience applying AI tools to improve deal operations, approval consistency, and seller productivity.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior executives across Sales, Finance, Legal, Systems, and Product, with exceptional analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts simply and persuasively.

• Experience with the commercial tooling a deal process runs on (CPQ, CRM, CLM, and related sales systems), enough to be a strong partner to Systems on what is feasible; specific platform experience such as Salesforce or Ironclad is a plus, not a requirement.

• Experience leading through M&A, systems integration, or large-scale organizational change is a strong plus.

signals.title: Revenue Operations
signals.content:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Revenue Operations Manager with a strong track record, a builder’s mindset, and a bias for action to join our in-person team in New York City.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own the inbound lead routing process, partnering with Marketing to ensure proper attribution

 - Run territory management and strategy for geo-based decision-making

 - Support and strategize on every aspect of revenue operations in your territory

 - Own capacity forecasting strategy, including inputs, throughputs, and outputs, and serve as the conduit back to Finance in the US for effective capacity forecasting

 - Provide input and strategy on comp-based decisions and benchmarking

 - Support leadership on overall regional operations and finance strategy across all functions, including sales, presales, and ecosystem

 - Evaluate new tools on the market and be responsible for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales team

 - Build and maintain dashboards, leaderboards, and pipeline reporting to give leadership real-time visibility

 - Monitor deal progression and hold reps accountable for CRM hygiene and accuracy

 - Support deal reviews at the pricing and negotiation stages, coordinating with outside counsel as needed

 - Own the closed-won process from signature through handoff to post-sale

 - Administer commission plans across the sales org, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and serving as the source of truth for comp-related questions




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 3–7 years in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations at a high-growth, usage-based sales organization

 - You’ve built core GTM infrastructure before: lead routing, CRM architecture, pipeline reporting, commission administration, and deal desk

 - You have deep proficiency in CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and data hygiene

 - You’ve owned commissions end-to-end: building the model, calculating payouts, fielding rep disputes, and keeping it reconciled with Finance

 - You’ve run a deal desk, know what makes a contract clean, and catch errors before they become problems

 - You’re strong in Excel or Google Sheets: you can build a pipeline coverage model and know which metrics actually matter

 - You’ve earned trust with a sales team by making their lives easier while holding them accountable to process

 - You have a builder’s mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being asked twice

 - You can zoom out and think strategically while staying close enough to the work to get your hands on the keyboard

 - You have an AI-forward mindset: you actively use AI in your work and are excited to pioneer its use in go-to-market operations

 - You have strong communication and collaboration skills and earn trust across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

 - You’re a player-coach: you’re not above the details, and you’re excited to own the work yourself

signals.content:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Senior Manager, GTM Systems

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $160,000 to $190,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer to join our Revenue Operations team and help us build, scale, and integrate the systems that power Huntress’s commercial engine. Our Salesforce platform underpins quoting, renewals, partner engagement, and integrations across our internal subscription and billing platform and a growing ecosystem of business applications.

In this role, you will partner closely with our Senior Salesforce Technical Architect to design and deliver high-impact features with a heavy emphasis on CPQ, integration development, and an upcoming migration of point-to-point integrations to a centralized iPaaS platform (Workato or Celigo). You will also contribute to an AI-augmented development culture, actively using LLM tools to accelerate your own workflows and building AI-integrated features within Salesforce. This is hands-on, high-velocity work on systems that
matter.

Responsibilities:

•
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions with a primary focus on CPQ workflows like quoting, custom pricing logic, renewals, and subscription lifecycle management.

•
Execute the hands-on migration of existing Salesforce integrations to a centralized iPaaS platform like Workato or Celigo, building reusable components and error-handling patterns.

•
Build and maintain a reliable integration layer connecting Salesforce to our internal subscription platform, CRM applications, and third-party systems.

•
Partner with the Technical Architect to evaluate platform trade-offs, maintain environment stability, and help define integration best practices.

•
Collaborate cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales teams to support strategic initiatives like multi-product quoting and partner channel workflows.

•
Use AI and LLM tools as part of your daily engineering workflow for troubleshooting, code generation, and rapid problem-solving.

•
Participate in code reviews, raise technical standards, and deliver consistently within sprint cycles with clear communication on scope and blockers.

What You Bring To The Team:

•
7+ years of Salesforce development experience with a strong and demonstrable focus on Salesforce CPQ.

•
Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ custom pricing logic, including Quote Calculator Plugin development in JavaScript.

•
Practical experience building and deploying components on one or more enterprise iPaaS platforms like Workato, Celigo, MuleSoft, or Boomi.

•
Mastery of Apex, JavaScript, CSS, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce Flows.

•
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce APIs and modern event-driven integration patterns.

•
Advanced fluency with AI or LLM tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot as active accelerators in your daily engineering workflow.

•
Ability to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical business partners and deliver features end-to-end in an Agile environment.

signals.title: Senior IT Product Manager, CPQ
signals.content:
About the team:

Rubrik's mission is to secure and accelerate the world's AI transformation. IT is where we apply that to ourselves. We're moving Rubrik's own enterprise off a traditional application stack and onto an intelligent one.

Our goal is what we call the Thinking Enterprise: applications that run the business instead of just recording it. They learn from our data, act through our agents, and improve with each decision. That work is already underway, and we'd like you to help build it.

We build the internal products our Sales team and channel partners use every day, the tools that affect how productive sellers are and how fast deals close.

About the role:

In our approach to quote-to-cash, agents understand the portfolio, the pricing logic, and the deal in front of them, and they carry a quote from the first conversation through to booking.

If you're someone who asks why a quote exists, works out what has to be true for a deal to be priced, configured, approved, and booked correctly, and drops everything else; who understands how configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and booking work in practice, and where multi-product and channel-led selling cause them to break; and who is excited about driving deal velocity by removing deal friction, then you're in the right place.

What you'll do:

• Lead CPQ product strategy, drawing on a deep understanding of where quoting and pricing break at scale, and rebuild rather than patch.

• Bring an AI-first approach, introducing agents, evals, and automation into real revenue workflows with enterprise stakes.

• Apply first-principles thinking, breaking hard, ambiguous problems down to their fundamentals and building them back up properly.

• Own the vision and roadmap for next-generation GTM and CPQ capabilities (quoting, configuration, and pricing) as Rubrik expands its product lineup.

• Lead an agent-driven transformation of configuration, pricing, and quoting.Transitioning away from rigid rules engines toward autonomous agents while establishing key human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

• Optimize and simplify the quoting journey for internal sales teams and channel partners, eliminating operational friction and ensuring data precision to accelerate deal execution.

• Architect and streamline the end-to-end quote-to-cash ecosystem, managing cross-system handoffs and addressing complexities across multi-product portfolios and partner channels.

Experience you’ll need:

• Product management experience in enterprise systems, business platforms, or go-to-market technology

• Solid foundation of B2B sales processes and CPQ/quoting fundamentals

• Track record of taking complicated business problems and turning them into simple, scalable products

• Experience leading ambiguous, transformational initiatives across cross-functional stakeholders

• Strong product sense, structured problem solving, and discipline in execution

• Comfort with AI tooling: you use AI-assisted coding and low-code tools to prototype and test ideas quickly

• Experience with quote-to-cash, pricing, product configuration, or sales technology ecosystems

• Experience in channel-led sales environments

• Hands-on work with AI-enabled or agentic workflows in an enterprise

• Experience building or evolving internal platforms for sales operations, IT, or revenue processes

• Experience through a business-model or portfolio shift, such as going from one product to many

• Drive cross functional alignment across Product, Sales, Finance, Deal Desk, and channel leaders along in a bold direction and leave the room with their support.

signals.title: Director, Sales Operations
signals.content:
As Director, Sales Operations , you'll lead Sumo Logic's global sales operations function and act as a strategic partner to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO). You'll partner with sales leadership on headcount and capacity planning, territory planning, quota setting, compensation design, forecasting, reporting, and policy. You're a hands-on leader who welcomes change and turns it into results, improving productivity and efficiency across the sales organization.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CRO, helping shape go-to-market strategy, sales org design, and investment priorities. Translate the CRO's priorities into operational plans, and bring the data and insights that inform their decisions.

• Partner closely with sales, channel, finance, marketing, and legal teams to lead strategic programs, and build strong relationships with cross-functional leaders.

• Lead global sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting. Own accurate, on-time reporting that keeps the sales organization effective, and build a management operating system that tracks the metrics and trends leadership needs to make decisions.

• Lead the systems administration team (a manager and three direct reports) that supports all go-to-market software. Oversee system access and provisioning, RFPs, procurement, and vendor management across the GTM tech stack.

• Help assign sales quotas fairly and allocate them across the team. Build the incentive compensation design process, advise senior leadership on compensation programs, and work with accounting, finance, and people operations to resolve compensation policy questions.

• Maintain high-quality, accurate, and consistent planning and reporting. Coordinate these efforts with other functions, monitor how sales reports are distributed, and recommend new reports and tools as needed.

• Find opportunities to improve the sales process. Work with sales leadership to review process quality, prioritize improvements, and help sales managers understand bottlenecks. Build a culture of continuous improvement.

• Roll out enabling technologies, including CRM, to the field sales team. Monitor compliance with CRM data standards, and work with sales management to get the most from the company's technology investments.

Qualifications and Skills

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• 8+ years of experience in sales performance, including global sales operations, sales management, channel sales/operations, finance, accounting, or compensation management

• 5+ years of experience leading, managing, and mentoring sales teams

• 5+ years of experience with CRM tools, specifically Salesforce, with solid knowledge of systems and data flow and the ability to learn new tools quickly

• Experience acting as a trusted advisor to C-level or senior revenue leadership, including presenting analysis and recommendations that shape strategic decisions

• Strong planning, financial, and analytical skills, including advanced Excel skills (you can build and maintain complex spreadsheets) and the ability to apply them to complex business situations

• A track record of hitting sales, profit, and strategic goals for the teams you've supported

• Experience building and using a management operating system that delivers sales quotas, compensation plans, and performance goals on time

• Experience leading process improvements and implementing strategic initiatives that affect the sales team

• The ability to manage multiple project tracks as a high-energy leader

• Strong attention to detail, a commitment to quality, and a results-driven, customer-focused approach

• The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize rapidly emerging opportunities

• Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills (written and oral)

• Excellent people skills

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. signals.title: Sales Compensation Analyst
signals.content:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/ who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own all compensation communications to the field: plan launches, plan documents, policy updates, and payout notices. Every message should be clear, accurate, and on time.

 - Respond to rep questions quickly and within a defined SLA, and track each request through to resolution so nothing falls through the cracks.

 - Keep the internal sales compensation team aligned on every plan and policy change, and confirm each change is put into practice in calculations, systems, and processes.

 - Make sure every rep understands how they are paid through plan training, new-hire onboarding, office hours, and enablement tools (earnings calculators, plan summaries, FAQs, and training decks).

 - Model the cost, payout, and behavior impact of proposed plan designs and changes, and present tradeoffs that help leaders make decisions.

 - Support the team on the monthly payroll process, including validating payouts, reconciling against plan terms, and preparing the payroll handoff.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years in sales compensation, commissions operations or a closely related finance/RevOps role, with hands-on involvement in at least one full annual plan design cycle.

 - Experience with plan architecture and pay mix, including target incentives, measures and weightings, accelerators, and how plan design drives seller behavior.

 - Strong modeling skills: building plan cost models, payout curves, and scenario analyses that leaders can act on.

 - A track record of rolling out comp plans and changes to sales teams, including writing plan documents, running trainings, and building self-service enablement tools.

 - Experience supporting a monthly commission payroll cycle, including payout validation, reconciliation, and payroll handoff.

 - Experience using Salesforce and sales compensation tools to report on attainment and payouts.


EVEN BETTER…

 - Experience designing compensation for new roles or go-to-market motions at a high-growth company.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

 - Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

 - Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

 - Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

signals.title: Head of Deal Desk, APJ
signals.content:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

HEAD OF DEAL DESK, APJ

We're building out our Deal Desk function in APJ and looking for a high-ownership Head of Deal Desk to be one of our first people on the ground in the region. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, and Revenue Operations, partnering with our APJ sales team to structure, price, and close enterprise deals, and giving the region the fast, in-time-zone deal support it needs as it scales. You'll be one of the first Deal Desk hires in APJ, working closely with the global Deal Desk team while becoming the go-to deal partner for reps across the region. The function is established globally and humming with volume. Your job is to bring that same discipline to APJ and own deal support end-to-end for the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own day-to-day deal desk support for the APJ sales team, pricing, deal structure, quoting, and approvals, in-region and in-time-zone

 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to reps on deal strategy: pricing guidance, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, and contract structure

 - Build and manage quotes and order forms in Salesforce CPQ / Ironclad, and keep deals moving cleanly through the approval and closing process

 - Coordinate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Billing to get non-standard terms reviewed and closed without slowing deals down

 - Stand up and scale APJ deal desk processes, turning recurring rep questions and one-off asks into repeatable playbooks, approval paths, and enablement

 - Apply and help evolve our consumption-based pricing model, surfacing patterns from APJ deal flow back to the global team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 7+ years of experience across deal desk, deal/revenue operations, commercial strategy, consulting, investing, or sales strategy

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Has owned outcomes, not just tasks

 - Experience working on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, with hands-on exposure to pricing, negotiation, and contract structure

 - Experience operating in a high-volume deal environment and a track record of systematizing how you work, playbooks, processes, approval frameworks

 - Highly analytical, comfortable sizing deals, modeling pricing scenarios and ROI in Excel, and grounding recommendations in data

 - A point of view and the ownership to drive it, you don't wait to be told what to think, and you operate with urgency and little hand-holding

 - Collaborate well across Sales, Finance, and Legal, and hold the line on pricing and process without becoming a bottleneck

 - Excited to help build a function in-region rather than inherit a finished one

 - Based in Singapore and able to support the APJ region

 - Bonus: experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing, or standing up a deal desk function in a fast-scaling environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 - Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Singapore office

signals.content:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a As the Manager of Sales Compensation Systems and Analytics, you’ll operate at the center of go-to-market execution —- owning the systems, data, and analytics that power how Fivetran + dbt labs pays its sellers and measures performance against quota. You’ll build and scale the compensation infrastructure, deliver accurate and timely commissions, and provide insights that inform plan design and executive decisions. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, Revenue Accounting, Payroll, Legal, and Analytics.

This role reports to the Sr. Director, Global Sales Compensation and blends sales compensation administration, systems ownership, data analytics, and operational execution. You’ll drive the automation and accuracy of our commission processes, help scale our compensation platform for a hybrid pricing motion that includes both subscription contracts and usage-based (consumption) revenue, and support high-visibility initiatives across the function.

This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who is passionate about leveraging systems, data, and analytics to motivate sales performance and drive operational excellence in a high-growth, cross-functional environment.

This is a full-time role with opportunities to connect and build as a team.

What You’ll Do

• Compensation Systems Ownership: Own the configuration, administration, and roadmap of our sales compensation platform (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or similar), including plan builds, crediting rules, quota and territory loads, and integrations with Salesforce, the data warehouse, and HRIS/Payroll. Partner with Systems and IT on releases, testing, and enhancements.

• Commission Operations: Oversee the end-to-end monthly and quarterly commission calculation, validation, and payout cycle, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with plan documents, including crediting for subscription and consumption-based bookings, overages, and renewals

• Plan Design Support: Partner with Sales Strategy, Finance, and GTM leadership to model, build, and launch annual and in-year compensation plans, quota structures, and SPIFs; quantify cost of sales and the financial impact of plan changes.

• Analytics & Insights: Deliver analysis on plan effectiveness, attainment distribution, pay-for-performance alignment, quota capacity, and comp cost as a percent of ARR/bookings to inform decisions by the CRO, CFO, and Sales Leadership.

• Accruals & Forecasting: Partner closely with Revenue Accounting and FP&A on commission accruals, ASC 340-40 capitalization, variance analysis, and forecast-to-actual tracking of variable compensation expense.

• Governance & Controls: Own SOX-compliant controls, audit readiness, plan documentation, and dispute resolution processes; ensure data integrity and reconciliation between source systems, the comp platform, and payroll.

• Automation & Reporting Infrastructure: Use AI tools, SQL (BigQuery), or Python to automate data pulls, build repeatable and auditable processes, and improve the accuracy, speed, and transparency of commission calculations; partner with Analytics, AI Transformation, and Systems on data quality and self-serve reporting.

• Seller Experience & Reporting: Create automated, executive-ready dashboards and statements (e.g., Looker, Tableau) that give sellers and managers clear, real-time visibility into attainment, earnings, and pipeline-to-pay, and that distill trends into actionable recommendations for GTM leadership.

• Team Leadership: Provide technical guidance, review work, and help raise the process and analytical standards of the Sales Compensation team

Skills We’re Looking For

• 5-7 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on administration of a compensation platform

• Expert-level analytical modeling: builds compensation models from scratch, including cost-of-program scenarios, pay-positioning analysis, attrition and retention-risk modeling, and sensitivity and tradeoff analysis

• Built with AI: has personally used AI tools (LLMs, assistants, or automation and agent platforms) to build compensation tools, models, or workflows others rely on, and can explain how they work and how outputs were checked for accuracy

• Technical aptitude: working proficiency in SQL, Python, or similar scripting; experience with Salesforce, BI tools (e.g., Looker), and data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) a plus

• Statistical judgment: knows when market data is credible or a sample is too small, and presents ranges without false precision

• Compensation expertise: job architecture, compensation frameworks, market pricing, pay cycles, global compensation practices, and pay-for-performance design, with knowledge of competitor compensation at high-growth tech companies

• Reasons from first principles: balances best practice with what the business needs and can rebuild a framework when the standard approach does not fit

• Trusted advisor to senior leaders on sensitive, high-stakes compensation decisions (offers, promotions, retention, org changes), influencing outcomes through data and judgment rather than authority

• Operational excellence: connects systems, stakeholders, and programs to deliver compensation end to end, accurately and on time

• Clear communicator: turns complex analysis into a crisp recommendation an executive can act on in one conversation

• Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models and the associated compensation design challenges strongly preferred

Bonus Skills​

• Experience with Tableau or other BI tools, or building dashboards for leaders

• Experience supporting GTM or sales organizations at a high-growth tech company

• Experience scaling compensation programs through hypergrowth, IPO, or major organizational change

• Background in a quantitative field (e.g., finance, statistics, engineering), or equivalent experience

The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

$148,104 — $185,130 USD

Perks and Benefits

signals.content:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Revenue Operations Manager with a strong track record, a builder’s mindset, and a bias for action to join our in-person team in Stockholm.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own the inbound lead routing process, partnering with Marketing to ensure proper attribution

 - Run territory management and strategy for geo-based decision-making

 - Support and strategize on every aspect of revenue operations in your territory

 - Own capacity forecasting strategy, including inputs, throughputs, and outputs, and serve as the conduit back to Finance in the US for effective capacity forecasting

 - Provide input and strategy on comp-based decisions and benchmarking

 - Support leadership on overall regional operations and finance strategy across all functions, including sales, presales, and ecosystem

 - Evaluate new tools on the market and be responsible for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales team

 - Build and maintain dashboards, leaderboards, and pipeline reporting to give leadership real-time visibility

 - Monitor deal progression and hold reps accountable for CRM hygiene and accuracy

 - Support deal reviews at the pricing and negotiation stages, coordinating with outside counsel as needed

 - Own the closed-won process from signature through handoff to post-sale

 - Administer commission plans across the sales org, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and serving as the source of truth for comp-related questions




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 3–7 years in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations at a high-growth, usage-based sales organization

 - You’ve built core GTM infrastructure before: lead routing, CRM architecture, pipeline reporting, commission administration, and deal desk

 - You have deep proficiency in CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and data hygiene

 - You’ve owned commissions end-to-end: building the model, calculating payouts, fielding rep disputes, and keeping it reconciled with Finance

 - You’ve run a deal desk, know what makes a contract clean, and catch errors before they become problems

 - You’re strong in Excel or Google Sheets: you can build a pipeline coverage model and know which metrics actually matter

 - You’ve earned trust with a sales team by making their lives easier while holding them accountable to process

 - You have a builder’s mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being asked twice

 - You can zoom out and think strategically while staying close enough to the work to get your hands on the keyboard

 - You have an AI-forward mindset: you actively use AI in your work and are excited to pioneer its use in go-to-market operations

 - You have strong communication and collaboration skills and earn trust across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

 - You’re a player-coach: you’re not above the details, and you’re excited to own the work yourself

Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced and strategic Director, RevOps Strategy & Operations to lead revenue operations strategy and drive operational excellence across the organization. This role will optimize revenue processes, systems, forecasting, reporting, and performance management to support scalable growth and cross-functional alignment. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for overseeing day-to-day sales activities, inspiring achievement of sales targets, and ensuring our sales processes are optimized to drive growt About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

The Director, RevOps Strategy & Operations will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and serve as a strategic partner to revenue leadership. This role will oversee the operating cadence of the revenue organization, translating company objectives into actionable plans, scalable processes, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong business judgment, analytical expertise, operational discipline, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

• Run the GTM planning cycle end to end with Finance, Sales leadership, and HR, owning the bottom-up capacity and pipeline model and reconciling it with Finance’s top-down targets

• Design segmentation, coverage, and headcount models across New Business, Growth, Renewals, MSP, Channel, and Public Sector, while pressure-testing supporting capacity across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Deal Desk

• Establish an equitable quota methodology, allocate quotas across every channel and motion, and design territories based on opportunity, including book-of-business cuts for expansion and renewal teams

• Run the weekly pipeline council, forecast cadence for every sales team, and Monday KPI email, while preparing QBR and executive materials with Field Operations leads

• Own key business KPIs, including bookings versus plan, bookings per ramped representative, retention, win rate, and large-deal volume, while ensuring reports remain accurate, well used, and relevant

• Inspect and improve sales process quality across routing, account assignment, stage management, and handoffs between New Business, CSMs, and Renewals, while holding the sales organization to CRM standards established by GTM Governance

• Turn install-base data into Strategic account plans, expansion plays, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and higher PAM attach

• Build deal strategy frameworks and playbooks in partnership with Enablement

• Hire, develop, and lead the Planning and Field Operations teams, setting clear objectives, managing performance, and building career paths for analysts

• Partner with Rev Systems & Tools to maximize the value of GTM tools and scope AI automation that removes manual work

• 4+ years of experience leading revenue operations or sales operations teams in a SaaS or technology organization

• Proven experience developing and executing revenue strategies that support growth, scalability, and operational efficiency

• Strong experience with revenue planning, forecasting, pipeline management, territory design, quota setting, and performance management

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business data, build executive dashboards, and translate insights into clear recommendations and measurable action plans

• Deep understanding of the B2B SaaS revenue lifecycle, including marketing, sales, customer success, renewals, and expansion

• Experience managing and optimizing CRM and revenue technology ecosystems; Salesforce experience preferred

• Strong financial acumen and experience partnering with Finance on modeling, planning, compensation, and forecasting

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across departments

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a continuous improvement mindset

signals.title: GTM Technology Product Owner - Quote to Cash
signals.content:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a GTM Technology Product Owner with a consultant's mindset to join the Revenue Technology team. This role will own the systems that take a customer from first qualified meeting to signed contract to accurate invoice. You will lead the way as an expert advisor as we build the quote-to-cash (Q2C) experience for a seat and usage-based business, using agentic applications and bespoke tooling that reflect Harvey's unique position in a rapidly evolving industry.

The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience at the intersection of technology and business operations, with a background in consulting or a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. You will operate as an advisor and owner for our Q2C stack, with a deep focus on the pricing, contracting and metering layers. This is a role for a problem solver who has a bias for action and enjoys the challenge of building systems that eliminate friction across the deal lifecycle. You will be comfortable operating with high ownership and the ability to navigate complex requirements from multiple business units.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Roadmap Ownership: Own the Q2C product roadmap end to end, from pricing and packaging through quoting, contracting, approvals, order capture and the handoff to billing. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance to translate business objectives into technical requirements, serving as both project liaison and lead analyst. Operate with extreme urgency and agency once prioritization has been agreed upon with leadership.

 - Headless CPQ & Pricing Architecture: Define how pricing, products and discounting logic live in an API-first, headless CPQ layer so that sellers and agents can all quote from the same source of truth.

 - Contracting, Deal Desk & Approvals: Own the connection between quotes and contracts. Design approval matrices, discount governance and non-standard term workflows that keep deals moving fast while protecting margin and compliance.

 - Usage-Based Metering: Partner with Billing, Engineering and Revenue Accounting to define how metered usage maps to entitlements, credits and invoices, and how that data is surfaced back to sales, customers and finance.

 - Data & Agentic Processes: Leverage AI agents and tools to streamline quote creation, deal review and contract workflows. Work closely with managers and ICs across functions to provide expert level advice about what AI is ready to do, and what should be left to humans.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a liaison between Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, RevOps, Enablement, and GTM Systems to deliver a best in class user experience. Guide strategic evaluations of projects and platforms to help leadership make informed decisions on prioritization.

 - Systems Governance: Manage data integrity and system audits across the Q2C stack. You will document our evolving data models and process flows to ensure we remain scalable as we double in size, and verify that the tools we have adopted are driving ROI.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience: 8+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Systems Architect, with deep ownership of quote-to-cash or quote-to-order systems. Background in consulting or a high-growth B2B tech company is required.

 - Headless CPQ: Familiarity with headless, API-first CPQ applications and how they differ from traditional UI-bound CPQ. You can explain tradeoffs in product catalog, pricing rules and quote APIs.

 - Contracting Systems: Hands-on experience with contracting systems (CLM or equivalent) and how they connect to quoting, approvals and downstream systems.

 - Deal Desk & Approvals: Working knowledge of deal desk operations, discount governance and multi-step approval design.

 - Usage-Based Metering: Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing, including metering, rating, entitlements and how usage reaches billing and the general ledger.

 - AI Expertise: Ability to demonstrate a portfolio of AI first principles. You will be expected to both explain the technical nature of different models and platforms, and show micro-apps you have built on agentic applications.

 - The "Glue" Tech: Proven experience understanding the relationship between technology and users. Strong ability to extrapolate data structures across platforms into a baseline that can be used by both end users and agents.

 - Analytical Chops: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with BI tools. Experience with integration patterns for data warehouses and reverse ETL tooling.

 - Consultative Approach: Exceptional ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and transform them into elegant, scalable technical solutions. Track record of iteration with technical development teams and delivering projects from inception to hypercare.


BONUS POINTS (OPTIONAL)

 - Experience migrating from a legacy CPQ to a modern or headless architecture.

 - Familiarity with ASC 606 and SOX compliance, and the revenue accounting implications of usage-based contracts.

 - Experience as part of a hypergrowth company, building a business function 0 > 1.




COMPENSATION

$164,000 - $225,500 USD

signals.title: Director, Deal Desk
signals.content:
***This role must be based in the United States, in the Eastern Time (ET) or Central Time (CT) zone.***

About Showpad

Showpad is the leader in revenue effectiveness, helping organizations in complex, field-driven industries turn strategy into execution and execution into measurable growth. Purpose-built for industrial organizations such as those in manufacturing, consumer packaged goods, and medical device companies, Showpad’s AI-native platform unifies content management, sales readiness, buyer engagement, and revenue intelligence into a single system of execution.

Powered by GenieAI and grounded in trusted first-party data, Showpad enables revenue teams to automate workflows, scale winning behaviors, and reclaim lost revenue across every customer interaction. More than 2,000 global organizations rely on Showpad to drive consistent, high-impact performance in the field.

Built for effectiveness and recognized for excellence, Showpad is consistently named a Leader by Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Aragon, and backed by 2,500+ five-star reviews on G2 and Gartner Peer Insights.

Job & Department Summary

Showpad’s Revenue Operations team owns the systems, data, and operating processes that allow the go-to-market organization to sell, service, and grow revenue. The team spans GTM Systems, Deal Desk, Insights and Innovation, GTM Strategy, and Sales and Customer Operations, across North America, EMEA, and India.

The Director, Deal Desk is the senior commercial leader within that team and the executive owner of how Showpad prices, structures, governs, and books its business. This leader sets the strategy and standards for the global Deal Desk function, builds and leads the team that delivers it, and is accountable for the integrity of every deal from first quote through signed contract, booking, and handoff to billing and revenue recognition.

This is an executive partnering role. The Director serves as a trusted commercial advisor to the Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Financial Officer, SVP of North America Sales, VP of EMEA Sales, and VP of Revenue Operations, shaping the company’s most strategic, complex, and high-value deals, framing difficult trade-offs for executive decision, and representing the Deal Desk point of view in forecast, pricing, and planning conversations. They are expected to unlock revenue through creative, defensible deal structures while holding a firm, principled line on pricing discipline, margin, and policy, particularly under quarter- and year-end pressure.

The team and how the role operates

The role reports to the Vice President, Revenue Operations and leads a global Deal Desk team, currently three Deal Desk Analysts, supporting North America, EMEA, and APAC, with the majority of volume in North America and EMEA. The Director owns the function’s operating model, organizational design, coverage across time zones, hiring, and talent development, and is expected to scale the team and its capabilities as the business grows. The Director leads largely through influence across the executive team and cross-functional partners: Finance and Accounting on revenue recognition, billing, and collections; Legal on contract terms and risk; GTM Systems on CPQ and quote-to-cash infrastructure; Product Marketing on pricing and packaging; and Sales and Customer Operations on bookings and forecast integrity.

Why this role exists now

Following the Bigtincan merger, Showpad has two heritage customer bases, a recently unified systems landscape, and pricing, packaging, and approval practices that have not yet been fully rebuilt for the combined business. Discounting, deal structures, and quote-to-cash handoffs currently rely heavily on manual effort and individual judgment. Showpad needs a senior leader who can design and implement a scalable, well-governed commercial framework for the combined company, chair the Value Pricing Board, resolve the complex commercial problems that come with integration (heritage contract migrations, conflicting price books, legacy terms, and renewal risk), and give executive leadership a single, trusted partner on deal strategy, commercial terms, and pricing.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Desk Leadership

• Set the vision and strategy for Showpad’s global Deal Desk function, aligned to the company’s revenue, margin, and value-creation objectives.

• Lead, coach, and develop the Deal Desk team, setting a high bar for commercial judgment, responsiveness, quality, and executive-ready communication.

• Own the function’s operating model: regional coverage across North America, EMEA, and APAC, capacity planning, and the case for future headcount as the business scales.

• Establish and publish service levels for quote turnaround, approval cycle time, and order processing, and hold the function accountable to them, especially through month-, quarter-, and year-end.

• Design a tiered engagement and prioritization model so that strategic, high-value, and time-sensitive deals receive senior attention while standard deals move through with minimal friction.

Executive Partnership and Commercial Advisory

• Serve as the primary commercial advisor to the CRO, CFO, SVP of North America Sales, VP of EMEA Sales, and VP of Revenue Operations on deal strategy, pricing, and commercial risk.

• Partner with the SVP of North America Sales and VP of EMEA Sales and their leadership teams to shape the regional deal pipeline, prepare for quarter-end, and align on approach for the largest and most complex opportunities.

• Partner with the CFO and Finance leadership to ensure commercial decisions balance growth with margin, cash, and revenue quality, and that the financial consequences of every non-standard term are understood before signature.

• Frame contested or high-stakes commercial decisions for executive resolution, with the options, economics, risks, and a clear recommendation, rather than escalating open questions.

• Represent Deal Desk in executive forecast calls, QBRs, and annual planning, bringing a credible, data-backed view of deal quality, discounting, and commercial risk.

Complex Deal Strategy and Problem Solving

• Personally lead the structuring of Showpad’s most strategic, complex, and non-standard deals across new logo, expansion, renewal, and multi-year agreements.

• Solve the hardest commercial problems in the business: heritage customer migrations and consolidations, conflicting legacy terms and price books, at-risk renewals, competitive displacements, multi-entity and multi-currency agreements, and channel or partner structures.

• Design creative, defensible deal structures (ramped pricing, multi-year commitments, co-terming, bundling, upgrades, and enterprise agreements) that win while protecting margin, revenue quality, and long-term customer value.

• Partner with Legal on non-standard commercial terms (payment terms, termination rights, price caps, renewal uplifts, liability, and SLAs) and set the commercial position the business is willing to accept.

• Act as the final escalation point for deal-level disputes between Sales, Finance, and Legal, resolving issues quickly and consistently with policy and precedent.

Value Pricing Board and Commercial Governance

• Chair the Value Pricing Board, Showpad’s executive forum for approving deal discounts, non-standard structures, and commercial exceptions.

• Own the Board’s charter, membership, cadence, and decision rights in alignment with the CRO and CFO, ensuring decisions are fast, consistent, and well documented.

• Ensure every deal brought to the Board is executive-ready, with deal economics, discount rationale, competitive context, risk assessment, and a clear Deal Desk recommendation.

• Own and evolve the global discount approval matrix and delegation of authority, ensuring thresholds are clear, consistently applied, and reviewed as the business changes.

• Use Board decisions and outcomes to refine policy, strengthen guardrails, and steadily reduce the volume of deals that require executive escalation.

Quote-to-Cash Strategy and Transformation

• Own the end-to-end quote-to-cash process strategy, from quote creation and approval through contract execution, booking, provisioning, invoicing, and renewal.

• Lead the redesign of quote-to-cash for the combined Showpad and Bigtincan business, identifying bottlenecks, manual effort, and control gaps, and driving a prioritized transformation roadmap.

• Act as the executive business owner for CPQ, approval workflows, contract management, and billing integrations, partnering with GTM Systems on requirements, prioritization, and adoption.

• Ensure bookings are accurate, complete, and audit-ready, partnering with Finance and Accounting on ASC 606 / IFRS 15 considerations and revenue recognition outcomes.

• Drive clean, accountable handoffs between Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success so that what is sold is what is provisioned, billed, and recognized.

• Deliver measurable reductions in quote-to-cash cycle time and booking errors, and report progress to the VP, Revenue Operations and executive leadership.

Pricing Strategy and Commercial Policy

• Partner with the CRO, CFO, and VP, Revenue Operations to shape Showpad’s pricing strategy, including list pricing, packaging, discount guardrails, and renewal uplift policy.

• Bring deal-level evidence to pricing decisions: discount trends, win/loss by price point, deal size and mix, price realization, and regional and segment variation.

• Partner with Product Marketing and Finance on new product and packaging launches, ensuring they are quotable, approvable, and bookable from day one.

• Own the global commercial policy framework (discounting policy, approval matrix, payment terms, and standard deal structures) and ensure it is understood and followed across the field.

• Identify sources of pricing leakage and commercial friction, and bring executive leadership clear, quantified recommendations for change.

• If a global pricing change requires Finance, Legal and GTM Systems to reprioritize work, the Director Deal Desk must own the rollout decision, commit capacity, and be accountable for the result.

Deal Intelligence and Executive Reporting

• Deliver executive-level reporting on discounting, deal velocity, approval cycle time, non-standard terms, and price realization across regions and segments.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Operations to ensure bookings data supports an accurate forecast, and with Finance to reconcile bookings each period.

• Provide the CRO, CFO, and regional sales leaders with quarterly insight into deal quality and commercial trends, with a clear point of view on what should change.

Leadership Standards

• Bring recommendations, not open questions. When a deal or policy decision is contested, propose a path forward and make the trade-offs explicit.

• Build a function that is consistent, auditable, and scalable, with documented processes, policies, and approval logic.

• Champion automation and simplification, working with Revenue Operations colleagues to eliminate manual and spreadsheet-driven steps in the deal and quote-to-cash process.

• Lead change management for pricing, policy, and process updates, communicating clearly and early to executives, sales leaders, and everyone affected.

Key Performance Outcomes

Deal Desk Performance

• Quote turnaround and approval cycle times consistently meet published service levels across all regions, including at quarter- and year-end.

• Booking accuracy improves measurably, with order and contract errors reducing quarter over quarter.

• Sales leadership regards Deal Desk as a strategic enabler of revenue rather than a bottleneck.

Pricing Discipline and Value Pricing Board

• Average discount and discount variance trend toward agreed targets, with improved price realization and reduced pricing leakage.

• The Value Pricing Board runs on a predictable cadence, with decisions made quickly and documented consistently.

• The share of deals requiring executive escalation reduces as policy, guardrails, and seller enablement mature.

Quote-to-Cash Transformation

• End-to-end quote-to-cash cycle time reduces against an agreed baseline.

• A unified quote-to-cash process, approval framework, and price book are in place for the combined business.

• Bookings reconcile to Finance each period without material adjustment, and audit findings related to the deal process are closed.

Pricing Strategy

• Pricing and packaging recommendations are grounded in deal data and adopted by executive leadership.

• New pricing and packaging changes launch on schedule and are quotable and bookable from day one.

Team Leadership and Executive Partnership

• The Deal Desk team is fully staffed, engaged, and developing, with clear career paths and no single points of failure across regions.

• The CRO, CFO, SVP of North America Sales, VP of EMEA Sales, and VP of Revenue Operations regard this role as a trusted commercial advisor and rely on it for the company’s most complex deals.

• Complex commercial issues are resolved at the Deal Desk level, with fewer escalations to executive leadership.

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: Must have

• 10+ years in B2B SaaS go-to-market organizations, with significant experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Finance, or Pricing.

• Proven experience serving as a trusted advisor to C-level and senior sales and finance leaders (CRO, CFO, regional sales executives), including the ability to influence decisions and hold a position constructively under quarter-end pressure.

• Deep experience structuring and negotiating complex enterprise SaaS deals, including multi-year, ramped, co-termed, multi-entity, and non-standard agreements.

• Demonstrated ownership of a quote-to-cash or deal approval process at scale, including leading measurable process and systems transformation.

• Experience chairing or leading an executive deal review or pricing approval forum.

• Experience supporting a global sales organization across multiple regions and time zones, including North America and EMEA.

• Strong working knowledge of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how contract terms affect bookings and revenue.

• Strong analytical and financial acumen, with comfort forming and defending a clear view from imperfect data.

Experience: Nice to have

• Experience shaping SaaS pricing and packaging strategy, including list price changes and new packaging launches.

• Experience leading commercial integration in a post-merger environment with multiple heritage customer bases, price books, and systems.

• Exposure to APAC commercial practices and contracting.

• Experience with reseller, partner, or channel deal structures.

• Background in a private-equity-backed business with value-creation accountability.

Technical Skills: Must have

• Salesforce: strong working knowledge of opportunities, quotes, products, and price books.

• CPQ platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud, DealHub, or equivalent), including experience owning approval workflow design and business requirements.

• Advanced deal modeling capability: discount analysis, multi-year economics, and margin and cash impact.

• Expert grasp of SaaS commercial metrics: ARR, ACV, TCV, NRR, GRR, discount, and price realization.

Technical Skills: Nice to have

• Contract lifecycle management tools such as DocuSign CLM, Ironclad, or equivalent.

• Billing and subscription management platforms such as NetSuite, Zuora, or equivalent.

• QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.

• Revenue intelligence platforms such as Gong or Clari.

Competencies

• Executive presence: credibility and composure with C-level leaders, and the confidence to deliver an unwelcome decision without damaging the relationship.

• Strategic commercial judgment: the ability to balance winning the deal with protecting margin, revenue quality, and long-term v
