signals.title: Deal Desk Analyst
signals.content:
Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here .

About the team

Revenue Operations is a small team with outsized reach. Deal Desk is the part of RevOps closest to the deal: we help reps structure pricing, build quotes, and move contracts through approval so they can close faster without giving away margin. As Alloy sells into more banks, credit unions, fintechs, and channel partners, more deals come through the desk every quarter, and they're getting more varied. This role reports to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Deal Desk, and will be the second person on the desk.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll be doing

You'll be the first stop for reps working through the mechanics of a deal: building and checking quotes, keeping the approval queue moving, and making sure what gets signed is what gets booked and billed. It's a high-volume, detail-heavy seat with a front-row view of how Alloy prices, packages, and contracts, and a lot of room to make the process better as you learn it.

• Build and review quotes from Salesforce CPQ all the way through the Ironclad workflow process, checking that products, pricing, terms, and opportunity setup (new business, renewal, amendment, upsell, channel) are correct before they move forward.

• Work the twice-daily Ironclad approval queue alongside Legal and Accounting, reviewing order forms against our standard terms and Deal Desk Levers and flagging anything non-standard.

• Support the triage of incoming requests in Deal Desk, Ironclad, and the Rev Ops Help queues, confirm each one has the context needed for review, and route it to the right person.

• Manage first-pass pricing using our pricing calculator and guidelines, so senior Deal Desk time goes to large and novel deals.

• Partner with our Systems and Salesforce admins to improve CPQ and quoting workflows: flag where reps get stuck, document requirements for fixes and enhancements, test changes before they go live, and update guides once they ship.

• Review closed-won contracts for booking accuracy (ACV, CARR, term, billing frequency, uplifts) and keep the bookings tracker current.

• Pull weekly reporting on deals in flight, request volume, turnaround time, and discount and approval trends.

• Help maintain CPQ, Ironclad, and Deal Desk process, and turn repeat questions into documentation (CPQ Handbook)

Who we’re looking for

Must-haves:

• 1-3 years in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Order Management, or a similar analytical role supporting a sales team.

• Hands on Salesforce experience with opportunities, quotes, and reports.

• Salesforce CPQ (or similar) experience.

• Interest in automating manual deal desk work.

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

• Sharp attention to detail, with a habit of catching the wrong date or mismatched number before it reaches a customer.

signals.title: Go-To-Market Compensation Lead
signals.content:
We’re looking for a Go-To-Market Compensation Lead to build and scale the incentive compensation programs that support our revenue growth. You’ll lead compensation design in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM and Finance leadership, translating business priorities into plans that are clear, motivating, and financially sound.

You’ll own commission operations end to end, including our incentive compensation management (ICM) system. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move from strategic recommendations to detailed execution, operate independently through ambiguity, and take extreme ownership of both the numbers and the employee experience.

What you’ll do

 - Lead compensation design: Partner with the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM and Finance leadership to develop and evolve incentive plans across GTM roles. Recommend performance measures, payout structures, accelerators, and crediting rules that align incentives with company goals.

 - Model business impact: Build scenarios to assess compensation cost, earnings opportunities, and incentive alignment. Evaluate plan performance and recommend changes as our products, pricing, and go-to-market motion evolve.

 - Own commission operations: Run the full commission cycle, from source-data validation and crediting through calculations, reconciliation, approvals, and payroll handoff. Deliver accurate, on-time payouts and resolve questions and disputes with clear, consistent reasoning.

 - Own the ICM system: Lead system configuration, plan implementation, testing, administration, and ongoing improvements. Partner with systems and data teams to maintain reliable integrations and reduce manual work.

 - Build scalable processes and controls: Establish documentation, approval workflows, and audit trails for plans, exceptions, and adjustments. Create consistent processes for new hires, role changes, departures, and territory or account changes.

 - Make compensation understandable: Lead plan communications and enablement so employees and managers understand how incentives work. Be the trusted point of contact for compensation questions and complex edge cases.

 - Partner with Finance: Provide reliable payout reporting, accrual inputs, forecasts, and variance analysis. Maintain visibility into compensation spend and proactively flag risks or discrepancies.
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Relevant experience: 4+ years of GTM compensation experience in SaaS or another high-growth industry, with meaningful ownership of both plan design and commission operations.

 - Autonomy and extreme ownership: A track record of setting priorities, identifying gaps, making sound recommendations, and driving work to completion without close supervision. You surface risks early and stay accountable through resolution.

 - Exceptional attention to detail: A rigorous approach to validating data, testing calculations, documenting decisions, and catching errors before they affect payouts.

 - Hands-on systems expertise: Experience administering an ICM platform and working with the CRM, finance, and payroll data that feed commission processes.

 - Strong analytical judgment: Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills, with the ability to evaluate trade-offs and turn complex analysis into practical recommendations.

 - Clear communication and partnership: The ability to influence senior stakeholders, explain complex compensation mechanics simply, and handle sensitive information with discretion.

 - Tact and sound judgment: The ability to handle exception and clarification requests from Sales tactfully, balancing responsiveness with consistent application of compensation policies. You know when to resolve requests independently and when to escalate to senior leadership with clear context and a recommendation.

 - AI perspective and drive: A strong perspective on how AI is changing traditional commissions and compensation plan processing, and a passion for putting that perspective into practice across the business while maintaining accuracy, transparency, and controls.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Evolving business models: Experience with consumption-based, usage-based, or hybrid subscription models.

 - Systems implementation: Experience implementing or migrating an ICM platform and automating compensation workflows.

 - Technical fluency: SQL or BI skills to investigate data issues and improve reporting.

signals.title: Deal Operations Strategist
signals.content:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the go-to deal desk and pricing expert for ElevenLabs' North American sales team -- the person that the sales team comes to when a deal is complex, competitive, or needs to move fast. You'll own pricing strategy and deal structuring for our most critical customers, partnering with stakeholders to get non-standard terms across the line, and build the processes that make the whole machine run faster.

 - Own the pricing and deal structure for complex enterprise deals, advising sales on commercials and trade-offs in real time to keep things moving toward close.

 - Work closely with engineering to maintain and evolve our Configure Price Quote tool.

 - Translate customer requirements into deal structures that work commercially and operationally, knowing where to flex and where to hold firm.

 - Own the path through internal complexity, aligning Finance, Legal, Product, and leadership so deals don't stall on process.

 - Partner with Finance to build deal-level P&L models and communicate pricing trends back to the business, informing strategic pricing decisions at the leadership level

 - Develop and maintain pricing frameworks, discount guardrails, and approval policies that scale with the business.

 - Build the analytics and feedback loops that surface where deals are slowing down and why — and fix it.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands‑on experience configuring and maintaining CPQ rulesets, price books, and approval workflows.

 - Experience in finance or deal pricing at a company, or experience within investment banking or management consulting

 - Excellent financial modeling, verbal, and written communication skills

 - Proven track record of process optimizations or automation.

 - Ability to make value judgements that balance business, financial, and legal priorities.

Bonus:

 - Knowledge of AI/ML industry pricing models and competitive landscape

 - Experience scaling deal desk processes in a high-growth environment




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required.

• Oversee international Deal Desk support and approval queues, ensuring requests are processed accurately, efficiently, and within established SLAs

• Partner closely with ROW regional Deal Desk teams to ensure consistency across regions, share best practices, and continuously improve global Deal Desk operations

• Support new processes and commercial offerings, adapting to evolving business requirements while identifying opportunities to streamline and scale operations

• Leverage AI, automation, and other technologies to improve Deal Desk workflows, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency

• Experience working in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment and supporting the transition from product-led to sales-led growth

signals.content:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for an Analyst, Deal Operations to help drive Ramp’s next phase of growth! Reporting to the Senior Manager, Deal Desk, you’ll be a key partner in taking our Sales organization to the next level, responsible for quoting, pricing structure, and contracting for our Sales team. You'll be an integral part of the Deal Operations team with a focus on offering guidance to drive deal execution while complying with company policies and procedures and ensuring consistency to manage risk. You’ll work directly with our Sales, Legal, Accounting, and cross-functional leadership to better streamline efficient workflows and enhance sales productivity.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Quote & contract approvals — review and approve quotes and contract workflows within policy; escalate exceptions with clear context

 - Feature & subscription activation — enable product tiers, configure accounts, and manage trial extensions, and coordinate billing

 - Policy & process guidance — be the first line of support for AEs with questions about deal structure, approval requirements, and process

 - Playbook development — document what you learn; help build the SOPs and escalation guides that make this function scalable

 - Drive consistency across deal processes by helping to optimize, streamline, and automate quote-to-cash processes

 - Serves as a subject matter expert on deal constructs, operational procedures, approval policies, and controls




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 3-5 years in a Deal Desk environment, preferably in a high growth SaaS company.

 - Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, and other sales-related systems, including pricing and data enrichment tools.

 - Exceptional communication skills, written and verbal.

 - Excellent project management instincts, with an ability to manage multiple projects at one time.

 - You have a “get things done” mentality; you can dissect problems, identify solutions, and drive these solutions to completion with a high degree of autonomy.

signals.title: Senior Business Systems Engineer, Salesforce CPQ Developer
signals.content:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Engineer specializing in Salesforce CPQ to serve as a technical subject matter expert for the Salesforce CPQ platform. This role will design, configure, develop, and support scalable CPQ solutions that enable accurate product configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation.

The position will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and other business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective Salesforce CPQ solutions. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on Salesforce CPQ architecture, development, enhancements, deployments, and ongoing support.

What You'll Do

• Design, configure, and maintain Salesforce CPQ solutions, including product configuration, pricing, discounting, approval rules, and quote templates.

• Develop scalable solutions using Salesforce technologies such as Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and Visualforce, as appropriate.

• Configure and support Salesforce CPQ features, including product rules, price rules, discount schedules, bundles, contracted pricing, and Advanced Approvals.

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, evaluate options, and deliver solutions that support Sales and business growth.

• Own CPQ enhancements from technical design and development through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Troubleshoot CPQ issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.

• Maintain system performance, data integrity, security, and usability within Salesforce CPQ.

• Support release management and deployments using Salesforce development tools, source control, and established change management practices.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, and solution design documentation.

• Collaborate with teams that own adjacent Salesforce capabilities and enterprise systems when CPQ changes require cross-functional coordination.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience working with Salesforce, including significant hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience preferred.

• Demonstrated experience designing, configuring, developing, and supporting Salesforce CPQ solutions.

• Strong knowledge of the Salesforce CPQ object model, product configuration, product rules, price rules, discounting, bundles, approvals, and quote templates.

• Experience with Salesforce Advanced Approvals.

• Proficiency with Salesforce technologies, including Flow, Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce security concepts.

• Experience managing Salesforce deployments through established development, testing, source control, and release management practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working directly with business stakeholders and cross-functional technology teams.

• Salesforce CPQ certification or relevant Salesforce certifications.

• Experience supporting complex product catalogs, pricing models, discounting structures, and approval processes.

• Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly changing business environment.

• Experience with Salesforce DevOps tools, Git, and CI/CD practices.

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

signals.content:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Revenue Operations Manager with a strong track record, a builder’s mindset, and a bias for action to join our in-person team in San Francisco.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own the inbound lead routing process, partnering with Marketing to ensure proper attribution

 - Run territory management and strategy for geo-based decision-making

 - Support and strategize on every aspect of revenue operations in your territory

 - Own capacity forecasting strategy, including inputs, throughputs, and outputs, and serve as the conduit back to Finance in the US for effective capacity forecasting

 - Provide input and strategy on comp-based decisions and benchmarking

 - Support leadership on overall regional operations and finance strategy across all functions, including sales, presales, and ecosystem

 - Evaluate new tools on the market and be responsible for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales team

 - Build and maintain dashboards, leaderboards, and pipeline reporting to give leadership real-time visibility

 - Monitor deal progression and hold reps accountable for CRM hygiene and accuracy

 - Support deal reviews at the pricing and negotiation stages, coordinating with outside counsel as needed

 - Own the closed-won process from signature through handoff to post-sale

 - Administer commission plans across the sales org, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and serving as the source of truth for comp-related questions




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 3–7 years in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations at a high-growth, usage-based sales organization

 - You’ve built core GTM infrastructure before: lead routing, CRM architecture, pipeline reporting, commission administration, and deal desk

 - You have deep proficiency in CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and data hygiene

 - You’ve owned commissions end-to-end: building the model, calculating payouts, fielding rep disputes, and keeping it reconciled with Finance

 - You’ve run a deal desk, know what makes a contract clean, and catch errors before they become problems

 - You’re strong in Excel or Google Sheets: you can build a pipeline coverage model and know which metrics actually matter

 - You’ve earned trust with a sales team by making their lives easier while holding them accountable to process

 - You have a builder’s mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being asked twice

 - You can zoom out and think strategically while staying close enough to the work to get your hands on the keyboard

 - You have an AI-forward mindset: you actively use AI in your work and are excited to pioneer its use in go-to-market operations

 - You have strong communication and collaboration skills and earn trust across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

 - You’re a player-coach: you’re not above the details, and you’re excited to own the work yourself

signals.title: Program Manager, Deal Desk Operations
signals.content:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive is looking for a Program Manager, Deal Desk Operations to own programmatic pricing, product launch pricing readiness, and AI-powered tooling for our Deal Desk. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Deal Desk, you will manage projects, deliverables, training and communications for strategic initiatives that help our Sales and GTM teams price and structure deals faster and with greater consistency.

You will turn recurring pricing and process requests into scalable programs, playbooks and AI-enabled tools, and you will partner across Sales, Finance, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Sales Enablement, GTM AI Ops and Enterprise Systems to get them adopted.

What You'll Do:

• Own programmatic pricing for partnerships, franchises, networks and promotions: build the pricing frameworks, intake and approval paths, and playbooks that let the Deal Desk team handle these requests consistently.

• Serve as Deal Desk's lead for product launches, defining pricing guardrails, CPQ and SKU readiness, approval rules and seller guidance in partnership with Product, Finance and Enterprise Systems.

• Build and run pricing enablement: onboarding playbooks, trainings, deal-structuring guides and launch communications, and measure adoption across the sales org.

• Design and roll out approval matrix updates and process improvements, with a communications cadence around program updates, blockers and risks.

• Ask "How can AI solve this?" of every Deal Desk workflow. Identify bottlenecks and prototype agents, automations and applications using tools such as Glean, n8n, Salesforce (including Agentforce) and models like Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude.

• Co-own the Deal Desk Pricing Tool and AI roadmap with GTM AI Ops: gather user feedback, write requirements and user stories, prioritize the backlog, run UAT and drive launch.

• Manage the cost envelope for production AI use cases, balancing model performance against token consumption.

• Act as Deal Desk's Salesforce and CPQ expert, and liaise with Business Intelligence and Enterprise Systems so system changes are reflected in Deal Desk reporting.

• Build dashboards and apply analytical rigor to Deal Desk policies and recommendations to support company financial goals.

What We're Looking For:

• 5+ years of operations experience in a high-growth technology company in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Pricing or Business Operations.

• Proven program management skills: you can scope an ambiguous problem, align stakeholders and ship a repeatable process or tool.

• Hands-on experience with generative AI at work, including prompt engineering and a working understanding of context windows, token cost and agent guardrails. Experience with n8n, Python or other automation tools is a plus.

• Strong pricing and commercial acumen, including ASP, margin, credits and ARR/ACV. Partner, channel or franchise pricing experience is a plus.

• Experience with Salesforce and CPQ; familiarity with CLM tools such as Ironclad preferred.

• High degree of SQL proficiency and experience building dashboards in BI tools such as Hex or Tableau.

• Strong slidecraft and storytelling, with exceptional written and verbal communication.Attention to detail, sound judgment, and a bias toward action in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits .

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. Motive uses three geographic zones to determine pay range. For this role, the compensation ranges are:

$144,000 — $198,000 USD

$125,000 — $172,000 USD

$126,000 — $173,000 USD

(“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.

signals.title: Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst
signals.content:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst to help build and scale 1Password’s Commercial Deal Desk capability within Revenue Operations. You’ll partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams on complex commercial decisions, while turning what you learn into clear processes, guidance, and tools that help teams move faster with confidence. This role will help strengthen 1Password’s enterprise commercial capabilities as deal complexity and volume grow.





How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within the UK.



Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

 -  4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance, or a related function within a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Salesforce Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ)/Revenue Cloud, including resolving complex quoting and cross-object issues.

 -  Strong understanding of commercial deal structures, including annual recurring revenue (ARR), multi-year agreements, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, stub billing, bundled products, and discounting.

 -  Demonstrated ability to build or improve processes, documentation, approval workflows, and commercial policies in an evolving environment.

 - Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer and seller needs with pricing discipline, revenue integrity, and business risk.

 - Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to influence effectively without formal authority and explain complex commercial concepts clearly.

 - Experience using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or workflow tools to reduce manual work and improve the quote-to-cash process is preferred.
   
   



What you can expect:

 - Partner with Enterprise Account Executives (AEs), Sales Managers, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on complex, non-standard, and high-impact deals.

 - Advise on deal structure, pricing, terms, discounting, approvals, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, bundled products, and other commercial considerations.

 - Review and execute deal submissions in Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, ensuring quotes and contracts are accurate, complete, and ready for approval and invoicing.

 - Build the foundations of the Commercial Deal Desk, including intake processes, approval routing, discount governance, exception handling, service-level agreements (SLAs), and documentation.

 - Create playbooks, training materials, office hours, and practical guidance that help sales teams navigate commercial processes and quoting tools.

 - Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tooling, and CPQ configuration, while partnering with technical teams to implement scalable solutions.

 - Use deal data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify bottlenecks, improve deal quality, and recommend changes that support efficient, sustainable growth.



UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £60,000 GBP and £84,000 GBP, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

signals.content:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As Director, Global Field Sales Operations, you’ll partner with Sales and Revenue Operations leadership to run the operating rhythm of a global sales organization serving customers from Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) through Enterprise across multiple regions. You’ll lead forecasting, pipeline management, planning, and productivity initiatives while building a scalable field operations function. By helping sales teams operate with greater clarity and consistency, you’ll support 1Password’s mission to help businesses protect what matters most with simple, human-centric security. Reporting to the Vice President, Revenue Operations, this role is remote in the USA or Canada.



How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

• 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales strategy and operations within Business-to-Business (B2B) software, including 3+ years leading teams.

• Deep experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, sales process, and operating rhythms across multiple segments.

• Experience leading annual planning, territory design, quota setting, and in-year adjustments.

• Experience supporting sales organizations across multiple regions, including Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).

• Ability to build trusted relationships with senior Sales leaders, communicate clearly, and influence decisions using sound judgment and data.

• Experience hiring, developing, and coaching strong sales or revenue operations leaders.

• Experience using Salesforce and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve forecasting, pipeline management, or sales productivity.



What you can expect:

• Partner with Sales leaders to set quarterly priorities, align hiring plans and trade-offs, and create recovery plans when teams fall behind.

• Establish consistent global standards for forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

• Develop independent forecasts for each team, lead large-deal reviews, and turn insights into clear decisions.

• Improve sales productivity through stronger coverage, faster ramping, and effective support from solution engineering and Privileged Access specialists.

• Lead the use of AI in forecasting and pipeline work, helping managers reinvest time saved into selling and coaching.

• Run annual planning with Sales Strategy and Planning and Enablement so that teams begin each year with clear territories and quotas.

• Lead and develop a high-performing global field sales operations team.





USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $187,000 USD and $257,000 USD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $160,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future

signals.content:
About G2 - The Company


G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.



Now, we have joined forces with Capterra https://www.capterra.com/, SoftwareAdvice https://www.softwareadvice.com/, and GetApp https://www.getapp.com/ to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.



And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.



Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!



About G2 - Our People



At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our  PEAK values— (Performance + Entrepreneurship + Authenticity + Kindness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.



You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI https://company.g2.com/dei and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives https://company.g2.com/gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

G2 is looking for a Salesforce Engineer based in Bangalore, India to serve as the primary technical partner embedded with our sales and revenue-facing business stakeholders, someone who can move fluidly from a conversation about pipeline OKRs to writing Apex code to shipping a solution in production.

This is a hybrid role based out of our Bangalore office for regular in-person collaboration.It is a high-autonomy, high-ownership role. You are the engineer, the analyst, the architect, and the delivery owner. You will operate across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Accounting to understand what they need, design the right solution, build it, test it, deploy it, and iterate on it. If you thrive in environments where you can see the direct impact of what you build on the revenue teams depending on it every day and where you're expected to bring both technical depth and business judgment, this role is for you.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL FOCUS ON:

 - Partnering directly with Sales, Marketing, Partner, and Revenue Accounting stakeholders  including collaborating across time zones with G2's US-based teams  to understand goals, OKRs, and process friction, translating them into technical solutions without a PM or BSA intermediary

 - Owning the full delivery lifecycle: requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing iteration

 - Building and maintaining solutions across G2's revenue tech stack, including Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ), Gong, ZoomInfo, and Slack and evaluating new tools as the GTM ecosystem evolves

 - Developing within Salesforce using both declarative configuration and custom code  writing Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) for solutions that go beyond what clicks can deliver

 - Designing and deploying AI-powered GTM workflows leveraging Claude Code, Dust, and native AI capabilities within the stack to automate and augment how Sales and Marketing teams operate, from lead routing to pipeline hygiene to revenue recognition support

 - Maintaining the reliability, performance, and governance of the systems you own including documentation, change management, and proactive monitoring




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

 -  8+ years of experience in a Salesforce-centric technical role, with demonstrated ownership of solution delivery end-to-end

 - Salesforce development proficiency: Apex (classes, triggers, batch jobs), Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and platform configuration (flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets)

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ including quote configuration, pricing rules, approval workflows, and order management

 - Experience working directly with Sales and Marketing business stakeholders comfortable running discovery conversations, scoping solutions, and managing delivery expectations without a PM layer

 - Familiarity with one or more tools in the revenue tech ecosystem: Gong, ZoomInfo, or comparable GTM platforms

 - Demonstrated ability to operate without a PM or QA function you write your own test cases, own your own deployments, and catch your own bugs

 - Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and genuine curiosity about applying LLMs and AI agents to Sales and Marketing operations

 - Strong written and verbal communication able to collaborate effectively across time zones with US-based stakeholders and explain technical decisions to non-technical business partners

 - Must be based in Bangalore, India or within commutable distance to the Bangalore office





WHAT CAN HELP YOUR APPLICATION STAND OUT:

 -  Experience with Salesforce integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials)

 - Exposure to AI workflow automation tools (Claude Code, Dust, n8n, or similar)

 - Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, CPQ Specialist, Administrator, Advanced Administrator)

 - Prior experience supporting Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations in a B2B SaaS environment

 - Experience working in a global team with cross-timezone collaboration, particularly with North America-based stakeholders





Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity



At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Learn more about our commitments here https://culture.g2.com/commitments.

For job applicants in California, the United Kingdom, and the European Union, please review this applicant privacy notice https://legal.g2.com/applicant-privacy-notice before applying to this job.



How We Use AI Technology in Our Hiring Process
G2 incorporates AI-powered technology to enhance our candidate evaluation process. These tools may assist with initial application screening, skills assessment analysis, and identifying candidates whose qualifications align with specific role requirements. While AI technology supports our recruitment workflow, all final hiring decisions remain under human oversight and judgment.


Your Choice Matters: If you would prefer that your application be reviewed without AI assistance, you can opt out by entering your email address in the email entry field at the bottom of the Automated Processing Legal Notice. Choosing to opt out will not disadvantage your application in any way—we will ensure your materials receive a thorough manual review by our hiring team.
For additional details about how we handle your information throughout the application process, please review G2's Applicant Privacy Notice https://legal.g2.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

ABOUT CLAY

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nytimes.com%2F2026%2F09%2F09%2Fbusiness%2Fdealbook%2Fclay-ai-fundraising.html%3Fsmid%3Durl-share%26unlocked_article_code%3D1._1A.E5rN.MeYsbgEsUKbB&urlhash=XS4q&mt=4bpSf4a8omAKuAHqAqZx6C11QpbLK_QwIhSV7gSf4Wf9aywPF_KBSiX9IkWE1AhXBEjPH8mK6fAEN7CMFlpvo0lPAtKRjs-dhgzYqHiVKUMCRtw0jScFgxWCRRfYs4HCX0YL9L6PCQz-edBLinvRdU_TaVUL2dA3&isSdui=true&lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Ad_flagship3_feed%3BoQmIsufoRJm7X2HC5Rqd%2Fw%3D%3D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

 - Our community http://community.clay.com includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs https://luma.com/claylive, and 30k members on Slack.

 - Our culture https://nextplayso.substack.com/p/spotlight-clay is unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

 - All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

 - Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/685d83a71452245cc1129791_4d770abfd83e276ec15315a2e06945bd_Clay2025_OperatingPrinciples.pdf.

 - Read about us in the NYT https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/05/business/dealbook/clay-ai-marketing-fundraise.html, Forbes http://google.com/search?q=forbes+clay&rlz=1C5OZZY_enUS1155US1155&oq=forbes+clay&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQABiABDIHCAIQABiABDIHCAMQABiABDIHCAQQABiABDIHCAUQABiABDIHCAYQABiABDIHCAcQABiABDIHCAgQABiABDIHCAkQABiABNIBBzkzM2owajSoAgOwAgHxBVAe8UAxJx_p&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8, First Round Review https://review.firstround.com/podcast/inside-clays-unconventional-path-to-1-25b/, and more https://www.clay.com/press.
   
   

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Clay-EI_IE9850794.11,15.htm page!







HEAD OF GTM STRATEGY & OPS @ CLAY

We’re excited for our Head of GTM Strategy & Ops to design and build our revenue engine so that sales, marketing, and CX are rowing in the same direction with clear accountability and real leverage. Internally you’ll be at the center of designing how we plan, inspect, incentivize, and course-correct. You’ll partner closely with our GTM leaders. Externally, you’ll immerse yourself with our customers as a practitioner-evangelist of Clay and the future of GTM.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architect the GTM operating rhythm end-to-end: sit in every forecast call, design inspection and accountability cadences, and close inefficiencies across sales, CX, and marketing. Partner closely with our GTM leadership.

 - Design GTM process and methodology: design and implement sales process changes, develop playbooks, and create field assets

 - Define rules of engagement: establish clear swim lanes, design territory assignments, manage deal splits, and refine routing and handoffs

 - Lead implementation and change management for GTM initiatives, ensuring proper sequencing, communication, and measurement of field adoption

 - Partner with GTM Finance on planning and incentives: operationalize comp rollout, provide operational assumptions for capacity models, and collaborate on high-leverage questions like segment prioritization, connect the dots across the GTM

 - Partner with GTM Engineering and GTM Ops: to push Clay's product into new use cases, propose extensions, and contribute to our practitioner-led product feedback loop

 - Build a high-performing and supportive team, the clay way




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in business strategy, operations, and analysis with at least 5 years in revenue operations & strategy at a hyper-growth SaaS company

 - 5+ years of people management experience in hyper-growth environments: Proven track record of hiring and developing high-performing teams: you've enabled and supported impressive careers

 - You’ve implemented novel GTM strategies with measurable business impact: reinvented the playbook before from first principles and are excited to do it again

 - Exceptional quantitative modeling skills with expertise in SaaS GTM finance and measurement

 - Executive (but still grounded) presence: you communicate clearly, challenge assumptions in the room, and are comfortable saying "I don't know yet!”

 - An informed perspective on AI and real examples of how you've put it to work in your workflows or team processes

 - You’re excited to spend time speaking with our customers and community to bring Clay's best practices to market

signals.title: Deal Desk Analyst - Americas
signals.content:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

DEAL DESK ANALYST - AMERICAS

We're scaling our Deal Desk function and looking for a high-ownership IC to join the Americas team. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, and Business Operations, partnering closely with Americas sales leaders to structure and win the enterprise deals that form the backbone of our growth, and just as importantly, you'll help us systematize and scale how we get those deals done. We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco and Manhattan, New York, complete with well-stocked libraries. This role requires five days a week in office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Partner with Americas sales, legal, finance, and revenue operations to structure, negotiate, and close complex enterprise deals

 - Serve as a thought partner to sales reps on deal strategy: pricing, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, contract structure, executive engagement

 - Help evolve our pricing model and deal frameworks as the market and customer base shift, spotting trends across your deal flow, surfacing the patterns to finance and leadership, and driving the changes through

 - Lead cross-functional projects that systematize how we operate at scale, approval workflows, contracting playbooks, pricing guardrails, sales enablement materials, deal desk operating cadence

 - Improve the tools and processes we already have (Salesforce, Ironclad, our pricing infrastructure) by partnering with the GTM systems team, without needing to build them yourself

 - Balance a high-volume deal workload with longer-horizon strategic initiatives, managing competing priorities across multiple reps and deal cycles simultaneously

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5+ years of experience across consulting, investing, commercial strategy, deal desk, or a combination

 - Experience working on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, and direct experience with $1M+ ACV contracts

 - Experience operating in a high-volume deal environment and a track record of scaling yourself, building processes, playbooks, and enablement so you're not the bottleneck

signals.title: GTM Strategy & Operations
signals.content:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling is looking for a GTM Strategy & Operations lead to drive high-impact global initiatives, while providing in-region operational and analytical leadership and support for EMEA. Reporting to the Head of RevOps and partnering directly with sales leadership, you'll own the operating cadence that keeps the business running — from annual planning and capacity modeling to forecasting, pipeline health, and quarterly business reviews. You'll also shape how AI gets applied across the GTM org, identifying high-impact use cases and driving adoption. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll work closely with Marketing, Strategic Finance, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, and Business Intelligence to turn data into decisions. We're looking for someone who thrives on ambiguity, is comfortable owning a full operating rhythm end to end, and wants to have a direct hand in how Benchling scales its go-to-market motion


RESPONSIBILITIES

 Report directly to the Head of RevOps and partner closely with sales leadership on planning, prioritization, and execution

 - Lead Sales Operations for the EMEA region, from owning annual planning to running the day-to-day operating cadence

 - Build sales capacity, coverage, and quota models that align hiring plans with revenue targets

 - Size and segment the addressable market to inform territory design, whitespace analysis, and account prioritization; design and maintain territory planning

 - Drive the sales forecasting methodology, delivering a defensible quarterly view and improving accuracy over time

 - Own weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and quarterly business reviews using data-driven insights to flag risks early and drive proactive decisions

 - Help drive the analytical rhythm of the business by owning performance reporting and analyzing data to generate meaningful insights and recommendations

 - Proactively drive operational efficiency and team productivity by continuously improving processes, tools, and reporting

 - Shape the GTM AI roadmap, from defining high-impact use cases, building or buying the right solutions, and ensuring successful adoption of new capabilities

 - Partner with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Strategic Finance, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, Technology & Systems, Business Intelligence, etc.

 - Drive various high priority cross-functional initiatives from ideation and planning, through execution


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, or related analytical/GTM roles,

 - A builder mentality, with a track record of repeatable and scalable systems and processes.

 - A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and brings structured thinking to solve problems and drive results.

 - Advanced analytical skills with the judgment to turn data into a clear recommendation

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams like Finance, Marketing, Enablement, and Product to drive shared initiatives

 - Excited by applying AI/automation to GTM workflows, with a bias toward pragmatic, high-impact use cases over novelty

 - Excellent written and verbal communicator who can flex between detailed analysis and executive-level narrative 
   
   

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

signals.title: Senior Deal Desk Analyst
signals.content:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard is hiring a Senior Deal Desk Analyst to join our growing Deal Desk team. As a key member of a small but mighty Deal Desk function, you’ll partner closely with our global Sales team to support the end-to-end deal lifecycle. From pricing strategy to quote creation and contract execution, you’ll ensure deals move efficiently, align with internal policies, and scale with our growth. This is an exciting opportunity to build high-impact, scalable processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What You Will Do:

• Deal Desk Management:

• Deliver full quote-to-signature support for global Account Executives, including quote creation, pricing approvals, order form (OF) generation, and accurate opportunity closure in Salesforce.

• Manage and monitor the quote queue and approval workflows, ensuring timely responses and maintaining exceptional organizational standards.

• Proactively drive deal momentum, especially at month- and quarter-end, by resolving blockers and delivering excellent partner support.

• Provide pricing insights, product guidance, and analytical support on large, complex, or non-standard deal structures.

Systems Oversight:

• Help administer Chainguard’s CPQ (Roadrunner) and CLM platform (Ironclad), including updates to the company's price books and legal workflows.

• Maintain high standards of data integrity and system hygiene across CPQ, CLM, and CRM (Salesforce).

• Ensure seamless order management and alignment across internal systems for accurate product and partner attribution tracking.

Process Ownership and Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Support the documentation of Deal Desk processes and procedures to drive clarity, efficiency, and scalable growth across the organization.

• Partner closely with stakeholders in Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product, ensuring seamless alignment and coordination to streamline deal execution, uphold compliance, and remove roadblocks.

• Serve as a trusted cross-functional partner and primary point of contact for deal-related matters, fostering collaboration and accountability across multiple teams.

About You:

• 2-3 years of Deal Desk experience within an Enterprise SaaS B2B environment

• Administrative experience with a CPQ and CLM tools a plus

• Strong business acumen, analytical and problem-solving skills, and demonstrated ability to partner with upstream GTM teams and other cross-functional departments

• Understanding of Marketplace offerings through AWS, GCP, and Azure (nice to have)

• Highly organized, internal customer-focused and strong attention to detail

• Ability to multitask and prioritize at times of high volume, and have schedule flexibility during End of Month and End of Quarter

• Have an understanding of quote to cash process and sales contracts; proficient in identifying risks associated in deal terms and structures

• Ability to travel for QBRs (1x per quarter)

Compensation: $110,000-$130,000 base salary plus bonus
About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

• We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

• We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

• We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

• We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

• Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

• Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

• 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

• ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

• 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice .
