signals.content:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.




THE ROLE

You will own the commercial structuring and economics of Baseten's highest-priority customer deals end to end. You will play a critical role in scaling our revenue by serving as a trusted partner to Sales, Finance, and Legal on complex and non-standard deals. You'll help our products reach customers quickly while maintaining the financial discipline and risk management that a fast-scaling AI company requires.

This role is ideal for someone who has excellent commercial judgment, is highly analytical, and wants to build the deal strategy function from the ground up at a hypergrowth company. You'll help define how the world's leading AI companies buy inference and directly impact our most strategic customer relationships.




THE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Deal Structuring: Partner with Sales to structure deals that meet customer needs while protecting Baseten's financial and strategic interests, spanning pricing, discounts, commitments, and contract terms.

 - Customer Negotiations: Join customer conversations and represent Baseten with senior finance and procurement stakeholders, bringing pricing and commercial depth so the account team can stay focused on the relationship.

 - Financial Analysis: Conduct deal profitability, margin, and discount impact analysis, and translate the results into clear, data-driven recommendations for leadership.

 - Deal Review and Approvals: Review enterprise deals that fall outside standard parameters, and own the approval thresholds and escalation paths that keep decisions moving quickly.

 - Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Legal, Revenue Accounting, RevOps, and Billing to ensure every deal is contracted, booked, and billed accurately.

 - Pricing Insights: Track discounting, win rates, and deal outcomes across the book, and use those insights to shape pricing, packaging, and commercial policy.

 - Process and Systems: Build the playbooks, guidelines, and workflows that let our deal process scale with the business. Use AI and automation extensively to keep the function fast and lean as deal volume grows.




THE REQUIREMENTS

 - 8+ years of experience in deal strategy, pricing, strategic finance, investing, and/or revenue operations at a high-growth technology company

 - Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex enterprise deals, especially in a consumption-based environment

 - Strong commercial judgment, with the presence to negotiate directly with customers and represent Baseten externally

 - Excellent system design, financial modeling, and analytical skills

 - Ability to earn the trust of sales teams and influence senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Legal

 - Proficiency in CPQ/CRM tools and a strong understanding of how deal terms affect billing and revenue recognition

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn complex deal structures into clear recommendations for executives
   
   


STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

 - Experience at an AI, cloud infrastructure, or data platform company

 - Familiarity with GPU and compute economics

 - Experience building a deal desk or deal strategy function from scratch

 - Prior quantitative experience



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

signals.title: Business Systems Analyst, New Product Introduction
signals.content:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We launch new products, models and pricing often, and each launch has to work in our systems on day one. A seller needs to be able to quote it, Deal Desk needs to be able to approve it, billing needs to charge for it correctly, and Finance needs to report on it. This role owns how a launch gets into our quote-to-cash systems, from the first pricing conversation to the first invoice.

We are looking for someone who treats every launch as a change across many systems. You will join launch planning early, work out what has to change across catalog, quoting, contracts, billing, tax and reporting, and get all of it ready before the launch date. You will build a good part of the Salesforce work yourself and partner with our Salesforce developers and Billing Engineering on the rest. You will be the named owner of the NPI process for systems, and the person Product, Pricing and Finance call when they want to know what it takes to launch something.

We are an AI-first systems team. You will use Claude as a normal part of how you design, build, test and document, and you will look for ways to make launches faster and more repeatable with AI.

Key responsibilities

•
Own the systems side of new product and pricing launches, from the first pricing discussion through launch day and the first billing cycle

•
Turn a pricing and packaging decision into concrete system changes: SKUs, price books, bundles, discount and approval rules, contract terms, billing plans, tax codes and reporting

•
Build and run a repeatable NPI playbook: intake, a readiness checklist, sign-offs, a launch calendar and a post-launch review

•
Join launch planning early with Product and Pricing. Push back on pricing ideas that cannot be quoted, billed or reported cleanly, and offer options that can

•
Design how new pricing models work end to end, including usage-based, seat-based, tiered, committed and multi-year ramp pricing, and which system is the source of truth for each part

•
Plan the impact on existing customers: moving customers to new SKUs, grandfathering, amendments and co-termination, and how renewals will work

•
Own end-of-sale and retirement of products and prices, so old SKUs leave the catalog without breaking renewals, billing or reporting

•
Coordinate the changes across Salesforce, billing and our tax platform, working with the teams who own each system

•
Partner with Deal Desk, Sales, Finance, Accounting, Tax and Legal so each team signs off on what changes for them before launch

•
Make sure sellers and Deal Desk are ready on launch day, including quote templates, approval paths, guidance and enablement

•
Check every launch after it goes live: do quotes, orders, invoices and Finance reports match? Add the control or reconciliation that catches the gaps

•
Build and ship declarative solutions yourself where that is the right call, and write specs clear enough that developers can build the rest without several rounds of questions

•
Use AI to shorten launch cycles, for example generating catalog changes from a pricing spec, checking launch readiness, and testing quote and billing scenarios

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience in GTM or revenue systems as a Business Systems Analyst, Q2C Systems Lead or similar role, with hands-on ownership of product and pricing launches

•
Experience launching new products or pricing models at a fast-growing company, owning the change across catalog, quoting, contracts and billing

•
Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud or a similar CPQ tool, especially product and pricing data models, price books, bundles and approval rules

•
Working understanding of how a pricing decision flows into bookings, invoicing, tax and revenue recognition

•
Experience running a cross-functional process with many sign-offs (Product, Finance, Legal, Sales) and getting to launch on a fixed date

•
Hands-on Salesforce admin skills (Flow, validation rules, page layouts, approval processes) and comfort building meaningful parts of your own solution

•
Clear communication across Product, sellers, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal and engineers, adjusting the level of detail for each

Preferred qualifications

•
Experience in GTM, revenue or finance systems roles

•
Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing, and with billing platforms such as Stripe, Metronome or Zuora

•
Experience moving existing customers onto new pricing, including migrations, grandfathering and amendments at scale

•
Experience with tax setup for new products (tax codes, tax engines such as Anrok or Avalara)

•
Experience with integrations between Salesforce and billing, ERP or provisioning systems, and comfort reading API payloads and integration logs

•
Basic SQL and comfort using a data warehouse to check launch data

•
Salesforce Administrator certification. CPQ Specialist, Advanced Administrator or Business Analyst certification is a plus

•
Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude or similar) in how you design, build or document systems, and the ability to explain how you check their output

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$270,000 — $315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Revenue Platform Architecture & Development

Own the revenue systems architecture and development supporting multi-entity operations and global subsidiaries

•
Design and implement scalable data pipelines using DBT/SQL frameworks to transform high-volume financial transactions with low-latency response times for real-time integrations

•
Build and maintain automated revenue recognition workflows ensuring ASC 606 compliance for complex subscription and consumption-based billing models

Data Engineering & Pipeline Orchestration

Modify, enhance, and optimize data transformation models using DBT/SQL to support standardized data flows across accounting, billing engineering, and product teams

Establish comprehensive testing frameworks for data transformations, formally documenting successful behavior to support System Integration Testing (SIT) and audit requirements

•
Collaborate with Revenue Accounting, Data Infrastructure, and BizTech teams to design enterprise-grade integration patterns supporting significant transaction volume growth

•
Implement automated reconciliation engines achieving rapid variance detection and substantially reducing manual revenue team effort

•
Provide technical expertise during month-end close processes, ensuring system reliability and performance during peak transaction volumes

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

•
Pioneer AI integration for revenue operations, building intelligent agents for discrepancy investigation, automated testing, and self-service analytics

•
Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to modernize integration architecture

•
Establish best practices with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment workflows maintaining high reliability standards

•
Mentor team members on technical best practices, code reviews, and documentation standards

Minimum qualifications

•
Possess strong technical proficiency in Python, SQL, DBT, and modern data engineering tools (workflow orchestration, infrastructure as code, cloud data warehouses)

•
Have extensive experience with enterprise billing platforms and revenue recognition requirements (ASC 606)

•

•

Track record of leading technical workstreams during ERP transformations or major system migrations

•
Are skilled at designing scalable integration architectures, including both real-time APIs and batch processing patterns for high-volume financial transactions

•

•
Understanding of consumption-based pricing models, usage metering platforms, and marketplace billing

•
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you'll balance innovation with operational stability

•
Have excellent communication skills to bridge technical and business stakeholders, including Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, and Engineering teams

Preferred qualifications

• Have 12+ years of experience in revenue systems engineering, with deep hands-on expertise in Order-to-Cash (OTC) implementations

•
Experience implementing revenue platforms at scale for SaaS or subscription-based businesses processing high transaction volumes

•
Background in financial systems implementations supporting multi-entity, multi-currency operations with complex revenue recognition scenarios

•
Hands-on experience with CRM/CPQ platforms and integration patterns connecting sales systems to billing and ERP systems

•
Specific experience with: Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, Zuora, Stripe Billing,, Workday Financials

•
Familiarity with Workday Prism and Oracle Accounting Hub solutions for managing third-party transaction data

•
Technical expertise with iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi) and advanced API patterns (GraphQL, event-driven architectures)

•
Experience leveraging agentic development workflows

•
Experience with AI/LLM integration for financial operations, including document processing, data extraction, and intelligent automation

•
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in matrix organizations coordinating across multiple teams

•
Knowledge of SOX compliance requirements, financial controls, and audit readiness for revenue systems

•
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related technical field

•
Hands-on experience with modern data stack tools: Airflow, Terraform, BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks

•
Build and maintain Airflow DAGs orchestrating complex financial workflows, including Python scripts for DBT execution, authenticated API calls, and data quality validation

•
Familiarity with financial reporting and business intelligence tools (Hex, Looker, Tableau, Power BI) for revenue analytics and executive dashboards

signals.content:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Resellers are a major route for organizations to buy Claude. Our reseller program runs across two motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems. Each motion brings its own agreements, systems and cloud counterparts, and the program is expanding across regions at the same time.

As our Resale Operations Lead, you will run resale operations: how resellers get authorized, transact, get reported on, get paid and get supported, across both motions and every live cloud. The resale business team sets the strategy and the commercial framework. You will build and run the processes, playbooks and team that put that framework into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows.

This is an operator and builder role, not a partner manager role. You will be hands-on in the detail of a private offer or a partner quote while you build the team, the vendor coverage and the Claude-powered automation that keep resale operations from growing in line with partner count.

Reporting to Head of Partner Operations and Systems · San Francisco or New York based

What you'll do

•
Lead the resale operations team: set priorities, coach the reseller operations managers, and keep every region on the same playbooks rather than a set of local processes.

•
Build the resale runbook and launch kit across AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, so that authorizing, onboarding and supporting a reseller works the same way wherever it can, and each new cloud comes online from the kit.

•
Run hyperscaler resale operations: marketplace authorizations and private-offer processing with the cloud alliance teams, and operational escalations with AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, raised through the cloud alliance teams.

•
Stand up direct resale operations: partner quotes in Salesforce CPQ, order forms, booking and provisioning, and commit tracking and true-ups, working with Deal Desk, Commercial Operations, Finance and Tax.

•

•

Channel, reseller, distribution or partner operations experience at a technology company, including managing a small team.

A track record of building a resale or channel operations process from an early stage and running it as volume grew.

Fluency in order-to-cash, including Salesforce CPQ or a comparable tool and the Finance, Deal Desk, Legal and Tax coordination that comes with it.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. You'll work both autonomously and collaboratively across RevOps, Order Management, Legal, Billing Engineering, Deal Desk, Finance and Accounting, and Product to translate pricing and packaging requirements into scalable Apex, Flow, and integration solutions, and to extend our capabilities with custom code where necessary. signals.title: Senior Sales Ops Analyst
signals.content:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box is the Content Cloud—empowering every person and business to securely manage the entire content lifecycle. Our Global Go-To-Market Strategy & Sales Compensation team ensures our sellers are motivated, rewarded accurately, and focused on what matters most: delivering for our customers.

We’re hiring a Senior Sales Compensation Analyst to own the monthly mechanics of variable compensation—turning complex data into precise payouts and actionable insights. You’ll be the go-to partner for commissions accuracy, working across Salesforce, Workday, and Excel models to support global GTM teams. Your rigor and attention to detail will directly impact seller trust, revenue operations cadence, and leadership decision-making.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Own end-to-end monthly commission calculations , validations, and approvals across global GTM roles with zero-defect execution

•
Aggregate and reconcile data from Salesforce, Workday, and other sources; build and maintain robust Excel models (advanced functions, complex lookups, error checks)

•
Manage monthly run-the-business workflows, timelines, and stakeholder communications with Commissions, Finance, and GTM leaders

•
Partner with GTM Strategy, Finance, and Commissions to troubleshoot exceptions, resolve data discrepancies, and document decisions

•
Build and iterate forecast and scenario models to support planning cycles, quota changes, and new-hire ramp assumptions

•
Calculate new-hire quotas and proration logic; coordinate with People/HR and Sales Ops to ensure timely set-up and policy alignment

•
Create clear reporting and audit trails; standardize processes, controls, and SOPs for scale and repeatability

•
Contribute to continuous improvement—identify automation opportunities, streamline handoffs, and uplevel data quality

•
Document processes and policies related to Rules of Engagement for the GTM teams.

WHO YOU ARE

•
3+ years in Sales Compensation, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or related analytics roles

•
Advanced Excel expertise (e.g., INDEX/MATCH/XLOOKUP, nested logic, pivot tables, complex data modeling, error handling). SQL familiarity a plus

•
Proven experience reconciling and transforming large datasets from CRM/HRIS/Financial systems (Salesforce and Workday experience strongly preferred)

•
Meticulous attention to detail with a track record of delivering accurate payouts under tight monthly deadlines

•
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams

•
Process-first mindset with the ability to document, standardize, and improve recurring workflows

•
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

•
Nice to have: experience with commissions platforms, quota/proration logic, or financial modeling for GTM planning

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Box strives to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and is committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees. Inclusiveness is core to our culture at Box, and we strive to ensure you get the most from your interview experience.

Box makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please complete this form . Reasonable accommodations may include scheduling adjustments, document dictation and beyond.

Notice to applicants in Los Angeles: Box, Inc and its related branches will consider for employment, qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chair Ordinance. The Fair Chance Ordinance is provided here .

Notice to applicants in San Francisco: Box, Inc and its related branches will consider for employment, qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chair Ordinance. The Fair Chance Ordinance is provided here .

For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice. If you are a California-resident, please read our California Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice here .

NOTICE OF USE OF AI

At Box, we believe in the power of AI to improve the recruiting process while keeping people at the heart of every decision. For more information on the use of AI in our hiring process, please visit our webpage here .

Box is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual base salary (or OTE if commissionable role) is dependent upon factors such as: knowledge, skill level, experience, and work location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits. For more information , check out our benefits and perks .

In accordance with OFCCP compliance, here is the Pay Transparency Provision .

signals.title: Director, Revenue Operations
signals.content:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

Brex is hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to own the operating model for our New Business (AE and SDR) motions. You will report into the Head of Revenue Operations as a strategic leader. This role sets the coverage model, incentive architecture, and operating cadence for the teams you support, and is accountable for their overall performance. You'll manage a team of RevOps managers and individual contributors, and be the decision maker on tradeoffs between speed, rigor, and scale across your domain. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between executive-level narratives and the underlying mechanics that drive performance and coach their team to do the same.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

• Be a trusted business partner to the SVP Sales in owning and improving the strategies, coverage models, operating rhythms, efficiency, and incentive compensation structure to drive revenue growth

• Lead initiatives with enablement, data, finance, systems, marketing, operations, and other revenue operations team members to support your business partners and implement improvements

• Own and improve upon cadences for forecasting, pipeline, capacity planning, rep productivity, territory carving, quota setting, and incentive design

• Lead and develop a team of 6+ supporting New Business Account Executives and Sales Development Representatives Organization

• Present to senior leaders on business strategy, segment performance, and analytical deep dives

• Drive the annual planning process for the GTM teams you support, working closely with business partners, finance, and other teams to set the strategy, align incentives, and ensure operational excellence

• Identify and prioritize efficiency improvements within the Rev Ops org, including processes, reporting, and automation leveraging AI or other tools.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales strategy, or sales operations with at least 2+ years managing managers; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company

• Bachelor Degree required

• A passion for coaching and developing a team with varying levels of experience

• Comprehensive understanding of sales funnels, processes, and methodologies in a scaled revenue organization, including with partners

• Demonstrated success operating in a complex cross functional environment to deliver impactful outcomes

• Direct experience owning incentive compensation design and coverage models for AE and SDR organizations at scale

• Strong problem solving skills and collaborative approach to solutioning within and outside of Rev Ops

• Ability to influence with or without authority, strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills

• Extensive experience with Salesforce and other GTM systems, including examples of AI-driven efficiency improvements

• Analytical mindset with the ability to quickly interpret data and quickly understand complex models

• Strong attention to detail including modeling, communication, and documentation

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $258,000 - $322,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

signals.title: Director, Revenue Operations
signals.content:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

Brex is hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to own the operating model for our New Business (AE and SDR) motions. You will report into the Head of Revenue Operations as a strategic leader. This role sets the coverage model, incentive architecture, and operating cadence for the teams you support, and is accountable for their overall performance. You'll manage a team of RevOps managers and individual contributors, and be the decision maker on tradeoffs between speed, rigor, and scale across your domain. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between executive-level narratives and the underlying mechanics that drive performance and coach their team to do the same.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

• Be a trusted business partner to the SVP Sales in owning and improving the strategies, coverage models, operating rhythms, efficiency, and incentive compensation structure to drive revenue growth

• Lead initiatives with enablement, data, finance, systems, marketing, operations, and other revenue operations team members to support your business partners and implement improvements

• Own and improve upon cadences for forecasting, pipeline, capacity planning, rep productivity, territory carving, quota setting, and incentive design

• Lead and develop a team of 6+ supporting New Business Account Executives and Sales Development Representatives Organization

• Present to senior leaders on business strategy, segment performance, and analytical deep dives

• Drive the annual planning process for the GTM teams you support, working closely with business partners, finance, and other teams to set the strategy, align incentives, and ensure operational excellence

• Identify and prioritize efficiency improvements within the Rev Ops org, including processes, reporting, and automation leveraging AI or other tools.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales strategy, or sales operations with at least 2+ years managing managers; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company

• Bachelor Degree required

• A passion for coaching and developing a team with varying levels of experience

• Comprehensive understanding of sales funnels, processes, and methodologies in a scaled revenue organization, including with partners

• Demonstrated success operating in a complex cross functional environment to deliver impactful outcomes

• Direct experience owning incentive compensation design and coverage models for AE and SDR organizations at scale

• Strong problem solving skills and collaborative approach to solutioning within and outside of Rev Ops

• Ability to influence with or without authority, strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills

• Extensive experience with Salesforce and other GTM systems, including examples of AI-driven efficiency improvements

• Analytical mindset with the ability to quickly interpret data and quickly understand complex models

• Strong attention to detail including modeling, communication, and documentation

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $258,000 - $322,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

signals.title: Sales Operations Lead
signals.content:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Sales Operations Lead, you will be the operational and analytical partner to our Global Account Management and AI Sales leadership team, owning the planning, process, and data foundations that drive expansion at scale. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens: you’ll keep today’s data and processes running, while shaping how we scale them and build the team to support continued growth.

Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning

• Own the annual territory and account-assignment process for Global AM and AI Sales, ensuring accuracy and equitability, and recommend structures that drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to attainment

• Collaborate with regional Sales Ops leaders to align on coverage and rules of engagement between Account Management, AI Sales, and Account Executives, including account assignment, crediting, and handoffs

• Build capacity models that translate growth targets into global headcount, coverage, and quota scenarios, and partner with Finance and Sales Leadership on quota and comp plan inputs

Scaling Our Processes

• Run the operating cadence and turn tribal-knowledge processes into ones that are documented and repeatable

• Lead cross-functional initiatives from scoping to adoption to evolve our sales processes, identifying bottlenecks before they slow down the business

Data & Reporting Infrastructure

• Define the metrics framework and reporting for Global AM and AI Sales that give leadership real time visibility into performance

• Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights and provide recommendations to leaders on where to focus

• Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and own forecast data quality and accuracy

AI-Driven Process Improvement

• Collaborate with Sales Ops leaders to drive the AI strategy for Sales Ops, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to use AI to automate manual workflows

• Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the Global AM and AI Sales team, partnering with our in-house AI architect team to bring them to life and measure impact

WHO YOU ARE

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience

• 6+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company

• Experience with overlay or specialist sales models and supporting a global team across regions a plus

• Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of Salesforce flows and automations; you’ll translate business needs into requirements and own prioritization with Business Systems

• Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, Outreach, or Fullcast

• Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch

• Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to present key insights and the “so what” to senior sales leaders, to build trust quickly, and to push back with data when needed

• Has built structure and process where none existed, and takes ownership of strategy and outcomes, not just tasks

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $89,000 and $129,600/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $101,000 and $144,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid
WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

• To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

• To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com .

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page .

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here .

Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

signals.content:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you will be a key partner to our AMER sales leadership team to help support long-term growth. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens. You will be responsible for maintaining the data and processes the region runs on today, while bringing data-driven recommendations to the table on how we should scale our processes and build the team to support continued growth.

Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning

• Lead our annual territory carve for AMER, getting into the weeds of the underlying data to ensure accuracy and equitability, and bringing clear, data-driven recommendations on how we should structure territories to drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to hit their targets.

• Build capacity models that translate growth targets into recommended headcount, territory coverage, and quota scenarios for leadership to evaluate.

Scaling Our Processes

• Bring data-driven recommendations for how our sales processes need to evolve as the region and company grow, identifying bottlenecks before they slow the business down.

• Partner with our Business Systems team to scope and prioritize Salesforce flows and automations.

• Continuously evaluate where manual, one-off, or tribal-knowledge processes need to become documented and repeatable.

Data & Reporting Infrastructure

• Design dashboards (Tableau, Looker, Salesforce, Clari) that give leadership real time visibility into performance.

• Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights on what is working and what isn’t, and provide recommendations on where leaders should focus their attention.

• Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and keep forecast data clean, current, and trustworthy.

AI-Driven Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate manual Sales Ops workflows, such as data analysis and process improvement.

• Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the broader sales team.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 4+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company.

• Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of how Salesforce flows and automations work and a sense for the art of the possible; you won't be building these yourself, but you'll partner closely with our Business Systems team to scope, prioritize, and validate the right builds.

• Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay , ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, or Fullcast.

• Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch.

• Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes.

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to present data and findings to senior sales leaders clearly and concisely, and to build trust quickly.

• A creative, solutions oriented thinker who is energized by ambiguous problems that don't have an existing answer.

• A proactive self starter who takes initiative without waiting to be asked.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $80,000 and $125,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $90,000 and $129,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

signals.title: Senior Analyst, Revenue Operations
signals.content:
We are looking for a Senior Analyst, Strategy & Planning to serve as the operational counterpart to FP&A inside Revenue Operations. This role is accountable for headcount and expense management, comp plan execution, forecast roll-ups, and the analytical work that keeps the GTM organization on plan.

Reporting to the Director of Strategy & Planning, you will partner directly with FP&A and across Revenue Operations. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role with broad exposure to the operating mechanics of the GTM organization.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Program-manage the annual planning cycle across Sales and Finance: own the timeline, drive the deliverables, coordinate stakeholders, and synthesize the output into a single plan.

 - Own headcount and expense management for the GTM organization: track plan vs. actual, manage requisitions, partner with hiring managers and recruiting on capacity.

 - Run the comp plan modeling and execution cycle: scenario modeling, plan documentation, exception handling, and partnership with the comp administrator on payout accuracy.

 - Build and maintain forecast roll-ups across regions and segments. Partner with FP&A on variance analysis and corporate forecasting.

 - Support territory and quota deployment: produce the analytical work that underpins the annual plan and mid-year adjustments.

 - Maintain the Strategy & Planning analytical layer: dashboards, recurring reports, and the data quality work that makes the rest of the team's work possible.

 - Partner with FP&A on month-end close, commissions accruals, and revenue reporting.


WHAT YOU BRING ALONG

 - 5+ years in revenue operations, sales finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or a similar analytical role. SaaS or consumption-based business model experience preferred.

 - Owner-operator mindset. You treat your scope as a system you own end-to-end: you build it, you run it, you fix it when it breaks, and you measure it by what it produces.

 - Comfortable program-managing a cross-functional process. You can hold a timeline, drive deliverables across Sales and Finance leadership, and synthesize across stakeholders without being told how.

 - Strong financial modeling skills. Driver-based modeling in Excel and Google Sheets, built independently.

 - SQL fluency required; Python a plus. Familiarity with ClickHouse, dbt, or a comparable modern analytics stack. Comfort working in code, not just spreadsheets.

 - Working knowledge of accounting principles: how revenue, commissions, and expense flow through the financial system.

 - Detail-oriented and comfortable with operational rigor. You see controllership as a discipline, not a chore.

 - Strong written and verbal communication. Able to translate analytical work into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with Salesforce, comp administration platforms (CaptivateIQ, Spiff, or similar), and BI tools.

 - Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

signals.title: Business Systems Engineer
signals.content:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀




JOB SUMMARY

 

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

 

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 


AI-NATIVE AUTOMATION & AGENT DEVELOPMENT

 

 - Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

 - Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

 - Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

 - Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

 - Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

 


BUSINESS SYSTEMS INTEGRATION & ARCHITECTURE

 

 - Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

 - Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

 - Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

 - Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

 


PLATFORM DEVELOPMENT & TOOLING

 

 - Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

 - Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

 - Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

 - Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

 


RELIABILITY, OBSERVABILITY & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 

 - Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

 - Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

 - Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

 - Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

 


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION & STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT

 

 - Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

 - Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

 - Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 


EXPERIENCE

 

 - 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

 - Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

 - Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

 - Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

 - Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

 


SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

 

Technical

 

 - Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

 - NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

 - Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

 - Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

 - Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

 - Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

 

Operational & Mindset

 

 - Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

 - Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

 - AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

 - Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

 - Growth: You stay current on emerging AI capabilities, evaluate what's production-ready, and continuously raise the bar on what GTM systems can do.

 


WHAT YOU'LL WORK WITH

 

 - Salesforce: CRM platform — automations, Flow, Apex, data model, reporting, and CPQ/OTC integrations.

 - NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

 - ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

 - Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

 - AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

 - Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

 - Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

The Senior Sales Compensation Manager sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales, and Revenue Operations, making variable pay accurate, understandable, and dependable.

 

The Role

 - Own the monthly commission calculation process for sales roles, translating approved plan rules and sales data into accurate payout results delivered on schedule.

 - Reconcile source data and compensation-system records, investigate discrepancies, and document calculations and adjustments so payout results are clear and auditable.

 - Own the investigation and resolution of complex commission exceptions, identify root causes, and partner across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Payroll to implement lasting improvements to processes and controls.

 - Partner with FP&A, Sales, Revenue Operations/Sales Operations, and Payroll to manage handoffs and keep recurring commission workflows reliable.

 - Experience using AI tools and building AI-powered workflows to streamline sales compensation calculations, reconciliations, and reporting, with the ability to validate outputs for accuracy and protect confidential compensation data.

 - Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills, including working with detailed datasets, formulas, reconciliations, and error checks.

signals.title: Deal Desk Manager, AMER
signals.content:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

The customers you’ll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they’re trying to solve are real and urgent. You’ll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role

This high-visibility position as a Deal Desk Manager will lead the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of Cockroach Labs' deal desk function. Reporting to the Director, Commercial Operations, you'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor to sales leadership on our largest, most complex, and non-standard transactions — balancing deal velocity with sound commercial and financial judgment.

Beyond structuring individual deals, you'll own the deal desk playbook: the pricing guardrails, approval workflows, and cross-functional processes that scale as we grow. You'll partner closely with Legal, Finance, Product Management, Marketing, and Professional Services to drive high-stakes deals across the finish line. This role involves extensive interaction with senior executives and requires someone highly motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

You Will

• Serve as the primary point of escalation and strategic advisor for complex, high-value, and non-standard deal structures, guiding the sales organization from opportunity to close

• Own and continuously improve deal desk processes, pricing frameworks, approval matrices, and quote-to-cash workflows to increase deal velocity without sacrificing governance

• Partner cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services to structure commercially sound, operationally executable agreements

• Establish and enforce deal governance, pricing policy, and discounting guardrails, and advise leadership on exceptions and their downstream impact

• Provide deal structuring guidance that maximizes revenue, margin, and strategic value while managing risk

• Develop reporting and analytics on deal trends, cycle times, discounting, and desk performance to inform GTM leadership decisions

• Drive enablement for the sales organization on deal structuring best practices, pricing, and approval processes

• Champion continuous improvement of CPQ and deal desk tooling in partnership with Revenue Operations

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you will complete general and sales onboarding programs, familiarize yourself with our message and product, and get an in-depth understanding of current revenue operations and systems.

In your first 60 days, you will gain hands-on experience with our systems (particularly Salesforce), processing procedures, and the Deal Desk workflow. Begin assisting with and processing standard requests.

After 90 days, you will independently manage all deal desk requests and contribute to cross-functional projects and team initiatives.

You Have

• 8-12+ years of experience in Deal Desk, financial analysis, sales operations, revenue operations, pricing, or related fields, including experience with complex deal structuring

• Demonstrated ability to influence and build trust with senior sales and cross-functional leaders

• Experience defining and scaling deal desk processes, policies, and governance in a high-growth environment

• Strong customer-focused attitude with a proactive and energetic work ethic

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to distill complexity for executive audiences

• Superior organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority deals with attention to detail

• Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced, high-growth technology environment

• Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) required

• Proficiency in Salesforce CRM; experience with Salesforce CPQ strongly preferred

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com .

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

Benefits

• Medical Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Life and Disability Insurance

• Professional Development Funds

• Flexible Time Off

• Paid Holidays

• Paid Sick Days

• Paid Parental Leave

• Retirement Benefits

• Mental Wellbeing Benefits

• And more!

The annual anticipated base salary range for candidates for this role is listed below. Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds for professional development, flexible paid time off, paid sick days and holidays, paid parental leave, and wellbeing benefits. We have a match on 401(k) contributions in the U.S.

We set competitive pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Benefits programs are designed according to local market practices. Actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. In addition, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.
