signals.content:
WHO ARE WE

Cognism is the leading provider of European B2B data and sales intelligence. Ambitious businesses of every size use our platform to discover, connect, and engage with qualified decision-makers faster and close more deals. Headquartered in London with global offices, Cognism’s contact data and contextual signals are trusted by thousands of revenue teams to eliminate the guesswork from prospecting.

OUR WORK MODEL

Hybrid: This is a hybrid role, requiring you to work from our London office 3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely on other days.

YOUR ROLE

As VP of Revenue Operations, you will drive revenue growth, operational efficiency, and cross-functional alignment across Cognism’s global commercial organization. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you’ll oversee the strategy, processes, and systems that power our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams—ensuring every function operates with precision and scale.
You’ll be a key member of the leadership team, driving decision-making, accountability, and transformation to enable Cognism’s next phase of growth.

YOUR CHALLENGES & OPPORTUNITIES

•
Define & Execute Strategy – Develop and lead Cognism’s revenue operations strategy, aligning GTM execution with company objectives.

•
Drive Operational Excellence – Optimize end-to-end revenue processes to ensure predictable, efficient, and scalable growth across global markets.

•
Lead Annual Planning – Oversee forecasting, quota design, territory planning, and GTM alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

•
Technology Enablement – Evaluate, implement, and optimize revenue tech stack tools (CRM, enablement, automation platforms) that support high-performance operations.

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and IT to drive alignment and accountability.

•
Data-Driven Decision Making – Build and scale analytics and reporting frameworks to deliver actionable insights and inform strategic decisions.

•
Continuous Improvement – Champion process optimization, efficiency initiatives, and frameworks that enable sustainable global growth.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

•
Professional Experience – 10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field, including 5+ years in senior leadership.

•
Strategic Leadership – Proven ability to design and execute revenue strategies that deliver measurable growth and operational excellence.

•
Analytical Expertise – Deep data fluency, able to translate complex performance metrics into clear business insights and actions.

•
Tech-Savvy Mindset – Advanced experience with Salesforce and other revenue enablement tools (e.g., Seismic), with strong understanding of automation, data hygiene, and reporting.

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration – Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across executive, GTM, and technical teams.

•
People Leadership – Skilled at hiring, developing, and inspiring diverse global teams, fostering a culture of performance and accountability.

•
Growth Mindset – Adaptable, resourceful, and energized by leading through change in a fast-paced, scaling environment.

OUR TECH STACK

•
Salesforce – CRM platform supporting global Sales and Customer Success operations

•
HubSpot – Marketing automation and lead management.

•
Gong – Revenue intelligence and call analytics platform.

•
Outreach – Sales engagement and automation.

WHY COGNISM

At Cognism, we’re not just building a company - we’re building an inclusive community of brilliant, diverse people who support, challenge, and inspire each other every day . If you’re looking for a place where your work truly makes an impact , you’re in the right spot!

Our values aren’t just words on a page—they guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we grow together. They shape our culture, drive our success, and ensure that everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to do their best work.

Here’s what we stand for:

🤝 We Own the Outcome Together.
🤓 We Deeply Understand our Customers.
🏆 We Celebrate Impact Wherever It Comes From.

At Cognism, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals typically underrepresented in tech, so if this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply!

Senior GTM Strategy and Operations Manager

Overview of Position

Are you passionate about driving growth and operational excellence? If you thrive in a dynamic environment where strategy meets execution, this role is for you! We’re hiring a Senior GTM Strategy and Operations Manager to develop and execute strategies that enhance growth, improve efficiency, and foster valuable partnerships. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that shapes how we grow revenue and go-to-market strategies. This role reports directly to the Director of GTM Strategy and Operations.

Overview of Team

The GTM Strategy & Operations team is dedicated to developing and executing strategic initiatives that drive growth and operational efficiency across the company. We work collaboratively with departments such as marketing, sales, finance, product management, and customer success to ensure alignment and drive impactful results. Our team prioritizes data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and customer engagement to refine our approach and maximize impact. We value agility and aim to deliver measurable results quickly while fostering a culture of innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Analytics Leadership:

• Oversee the development and maintenance of comprehensive dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights on key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

• Lead and execute projects to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement across all GTM to provide data-driven recommendations for strategic initiatives.

• Forecasting and Planning:

• Own the annual and quarterly revenue planning process, establishing and tracking quotas and attainment, partnering with Finance and Sales leadership to develop bottoms-up forecasts.

• Build and maintain dynamic forecasting models that incorporate pipeline, bookings, expansion, and churn signals.

• Drive monthly and quarterly business reviews with actionable analysis and clear recommendations.

• Operations Management:

• Optimize end-to-end GTM processes, including lead management, opportunity management, and customer lifecycle workflows.

• Develop and implement best practices for data management, ensuring data integrity.

• Identify process gaps and drive cross-functional initiatives to close them

• Build and deploy AI agents to automate recurring workflows, streamline key business reporting, and so the team can focus on strategic work.

What we’re looking for:

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales strategy, operations, or related industries, and will be comfortable navigating both strategic and operational aspects of the role. You will bring:

• Proven experience in developing and implementing customer success strategies that drive measurable outcomes.

• A solid understanding of customer engagement metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and how to apply them to influence business results.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions and use AI when appropriate.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling you to build relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across various teams to drive initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction.

• Bonus: Experience with Hubspot.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

• Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's most challenging problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Databricks is looking for a motivated Strategy and Execution Manager to join our Deal Desk Transformation team that helps define Quote-to-Order (QtO) strategy and drive scalability. You will collaborate with the Deal Desk functions, senior leaders, and stakeholders across lines of business to execute on process and system enhancement projects. You will also own the operating model and automation roadmap for cloud Marketplace Private Offers across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Managing stakeholder expectations and ensuring smooth implementation of process/system changes are key aspects of this role. You will be accountable for end-to-end transformation project lifecycle support, from strategic QtO process design and requirements gathering through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live, and post-release enablement and support. Your ability to manage resistance to change, lead cross-functional conversations, and influence stakeholders sets you apart. You thrive in a dynamic environment and excel at problem-solving, project management, and driving results. You are passionate about helping us build a Deal Desk function with industry-leading business agility, process scalability, and automation in an environment of rapid growth.

The impact you will have:

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Strategy & Operations, Finance Data and Strategy (FDS), IT systems teams, and relevant stakeholders such as GTM, Legal, Order Management, Field Sales, and Finance to roll out new and improved system/process enhancements and new commercialization initiatives

• Effectively enable internal stakeholders and field organization on new system/process enhancements and new commercialization initiatives

• Be a trusted partner to the Strategy & Execution Leadership by being independently capable of driving small-to-medium projects and initiatives

• Contribute to the delivery team by working with the IT, business, and product owners to refine user stories and requirements and perform UAT and go-live on said requirements

• Solve complex business problems by breaking them down into tangible steps for business systems developers to implement.

• Own the end-to-end Marketplace Private Offer process across AWS, Azure, and GCP: intake, offer creation, matching price and terms to the approved CPQ quote, custom EULA handling, acceptance tracking, and handoff to Order Management and Billing

• Design and deliver automation across the offer lifecycle, such as generating offers directly from approved quotes, syncing offer status and acceptance back to Salesforce, and flagging offers that are expiring or don't match the booking, to shorten cycle times and reduce manual errors

• Partner with Cloud Partnerships, Finance, and Billing to reconcile marketplace transactions against bookings (commit drawdown, usage metering, disbursements), including partner-led scenarios such as AWS CPPO and Azure multiparty private offers

• Define and report Private Offer KPIs such as turnaround time, acceptance rate, rework rate, and share of offers processed without manual work

• Shape QtO strategy and set up prioritization processes so the team works on the right things at the right time

• Formulate your own key questions and analyze large datasets from multiple sources to identify the highest-impact opportunities and actionable insights.

What we look for:

• 6+ years of experience in a business analyst, operations strategy, tech quote-to-cash, or corporate strategy role (with a focus on operational performance). Experience in the enterprise software, SaaS, and B2B industry preferred.

• Ability to effectively deliver enablement materials to both internal stakeholders and field organizations.

• Advanced research and analysis skills that you can flex to define, prioritize, and break down complex problems.

• The propensity to summarize and communicate complex ideas and concepts within internal teams with authority, influencing stakeholders including Databricks executives and department leadership.

• Comfortable and thrive in a rapidly scaling and dynamic startup environment

• Process expert: Envision E2E process change to solve our needs, drive agreement, document requirements, guide execution in partnership with IT, perform UAT, and report on progress.

• Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ and common Go-to-Market and Deal Support business processes

• Hands-on experience running Private Offers on at least one of AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace (Partner Center), or Google Cloud Marketplace; multi-cloud experience preferred. Understanding of how marketplace deals interact with cloud commit programs (AWS EDP/PPA, Azure MACC, GCP commits) is a strong plus

• Track record of automating manual ops workflows using marketplace APIs, marketplace integration platforms (e.g., Tackle, Saasify, or Clazar), Salesforce Flow, or scripting. SQL or Python, and experience applying AI agents to ops work, are a plus

• Self-driven, able to deliver on ambiguous projects with incomplete data and to hit deadlines across multiple projects in a fast-paced environment without losing sight of accuracy

• A service mindset and patience working with various cross-functional teams and business partners

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), Jira, and Lucidchart, plus SQL (ideally on Databricks) to build dashboards, reports, and analyses

signals.content:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.




We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.




So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.




🚀 THE ADVENTURE AHEAD

Our Salesforce org is the system of record for how Docebo sells, renews and serves customers. It carries CPQ, document generation, e-signature, provisioning and billing integrations, and a growing set of AI-driven workflows. The team that runs it is small, senior, and split between Canada and Italy. We've spent this year putting real structure behind it: a formal development lifecycle, a definition of ready for every ticket, a security standard for integrations, and a hardening program that is cleaning up years of accumulated access.

We're adding a senior developer to carry that forward. You'll build on the platform every week, but you'll also be one of the people the rest of the team turns to when a design needs a second opinion, a connected app needs scrutiny, or a request needs someone to say "not like that, and here's why."




⚡ THE DAY-TO-DAY

 - Design and build. Deliver production-quality solutions in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow and platform configuration, from a clear problem statement through solution design, build, test and release. You'll work the full lifecycle, not just the ticket in front of you.

 - Integration security and governance. Review every new or changed integration against our integration security standard: connected app scopes, OAuth and token lifecycle, dedicated Okta-provisioned integration users, least-privilege permission sets. You'll push back on anything that asks for more access than it needs and document the decision.

 - Code and design review. Act as a reviewer for the team's pull requests and solution designs. Hold the line on maintainability, test coverage, deployment readiness and SOX-relevant change controls, and give feedback people can act on.

 - Platform health. Own a share of the technical-debt and hardening backlog: retiring unused automation, consolidating permission models, cleaning up legacy packages and integration users, and reducing the org's risk surface one deliberate change at a time.

 - Access and provisioning backstop. Be a point person for user activation, license allocation and permission assignment, and help move that work from manual cloning toward documented roles and automation.

 - Delivery partnership. Work directly with Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing and Customer Success on scoping, and with the team's administrators and QA partner on testing and release. Take part in the daily check-in and the biweekly backlog and capacity review.

 - AI in the day-to-day. Use AI tooling to move faster on triage, documentation and build, and apply the judgment to validate what it produces before it ships. We care about both halves.


🌟 YOUR SUPERPOWERS

 - Deep hands-on Salesforce development. Several years shipping Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow and integrations (REST, platform events, middleware) in a production org with real users and real release discipline.

 - A security mindset. You understand connected apps, OAuth scopes, permission sets, profiles and integration users well enough to spot a risky configuration and explain the fix. You treat "valid until revoked" as a problem, not a default.

 - Review experience. You've reviewed other engineers' code and designs and know how to be direct and useful at the same time.

 - Comfort in a governed environment. SOX controls, structured deployment windows, mandatory UAT, a source-control-backed deployment pipeline (we use Gearset and GitLab).

 - Clear communication, written and spoken, with technical and non-technical stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off to a VP and a defect to a developer.

 - Independence and judgment. You scope your own work, ask for clarity early, and don't wait to be told that a request is under-specified.

 - Working hours that overlap the team. Our daily check-in runs at 09:30 Eastern / 15:30 Central European; you'll need to be reliably available for it from either location.


🎯 BONUS POINTS

 - Salesforce Platform Developer II, Application Architect or Integration Architect certification.

 - Experience with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud, Conga or similar document generation, DocuSign, or a billing migration (we're moving billing to NetSuite).

 - Experience with Slack, Okta, Fivetran or Datadog as they relate to a Salesforce org.

 - Exposure to Data Cloud or Agentforce.

 - Italian language skills, or prior experience on a team split across North American and European time zones.

 







OUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.




OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

 - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

 - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.
   




OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍

 - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

signals.title: Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations
signals.content:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We are looking for a Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations to lead the worldwide deal function for a rapidly scaling data and analytics business formed by the combination of Fivetran and dbt Labs. This is a commercial strategy role as much as an operational one with a mandate to make our deals bigger, better, and faster. The leader owns the deal structures, pricing inputs, policies, and governance that drive more revenue and higher ASP, cleaner and lower-risk terms, and real velocity across every region and segment, while de-risking the business.

This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment. The business is integrating two commercial engines, two product portfolios, and two sets of systems into a single combined go-to-market. The role sets the strategy for how deals get structured, priced, routed, reviewed, and approved, and acts as a key commercial advisor to GTM leadership on the structures that drive growth, including ELA and commercial strategy, cross-sell, and new product launches. It leads a global team across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Systems, Pricing, and Partner Marketplace to keep decisions fast, consistent, and scalable.

This leader is an equal part strategist, operator, and trusted business partner. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between long-term commercial strategy and hands-on problem solving, has a proven track record scaling a deal function in a global, complex, high-growth SaaS environment, and leads teams through change with clarity and conviction.

Reports to the SVP, Strategy and Operations. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in one of our hub offices: New York, NY; Denver, CO; Oakland, CA; or Austin, TX.

What You'll Do

• Team leadership and organizational development

• Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global Deal Desk organization.

• Coach the team to operate as commercial advisors to the field, raising the strategic value of every interaction with Sales.

• Build capability and bench strength, reducing key-person dependency as the team scales.

• Strategic leadership and vision

• Own and execute the global vision for the Deal Desk organization across the combined Fivetran + dbt business.

• Conceptualize and launch new, high-impact commercial strategies and deal constructs (e.g. multi-year deals, shift to consumption-based pricing, and product-specific ELAs) that grow revenue and move the business forward.

• Lead commercial strategy for the Fivetran + dbt integration, landing one combined operating model, policy set, and deal construct.

• Build the team structure, governance framework, and ways of working needed to support a global enterprise sales engine selling a multi-product, consumption-based portfolio.

• Position the deal function as a driver of growth, net revenue retention, and cross-sell, and align the C-suite behind that mandate.

• Commercial guidance and executive escalation

• Provide strategic counsel to senior sales leadership and account teams on complex deal structures, pricing options, concessions, and negotiation strategy.

• Act as the trusted advisor for high-risk, non-standard, and strategically significant commercial discussions.

• Engage directly with customers on strategic, high-value negotiations when needed, representing the company with credibility.

• AI and automation

• Set the vision for an AI-native deal desk, deploying agents and automation across the deal lifecycle, including deal-structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract and redline review, approval routing, and risk scoring.

• Build a tiered service model where automation handles standardized, low-risk deals end to end, so the team's time goes to complex, strategic ones.

• Scale AI-enabled workflows that improve seller productivity, deal quality, approval consistency, and speed, building on an existing foundation of deal-desk AI agents and AI-assisted deal review.

• Deal governance and cross-functional alignment

• Document and enforce global approval policies, SLAs, delegation of authority, and commercial guardrails across Sales, Finance, and Legal.

• Drive consistency of commercial policy, thresholds, and approval rules across all regions and product lines, so sellers get the same answer wherever a deal originates.

• Own a standing deal-review and inspection cadence (deal reviews, early checkpoints, and exception tracking) that catches risk early and keeps decisions fast.

• Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting to ensure sound revenue recognition, revenue predictability, deal hygiene, and commercial compliance as consumption, ELA, and marketplace structures scale.

• Deal systems and infrastructure

• Lead the strategy and roadmap for deal infrastructure, ensuring scalable, efficient, compliant execution as the two companies converge onto unified quote-to-order systems.

• Partner with Systems, Legal, and Finance to deliver a unified, high-quality quoting and contracting experience across CPQ, CLM, and order management.

• New product introduction and pricing operations

• Partner with Product, Pricing, and Monetization on new product introduction (NPI), making sure new products and packaging land with a clear deal construct, approval path, and field enablement at launch.

• Oversee the Pricing Operations function, supporting packaging, SKU rationalization, and consistent, well-governed pricing execution across the portfolio.

• Marketplace strategy and operations

• Oversee marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks, ensuring a streamlined and compliant transaction experience for customers.

• Shape policies and operational standards for our marketplace presence, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Product, and vendor partners to optimize transaction efficiency and financial accuracy.

Skills We're Looking For

• 15+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Revenue Operations or Commercial Operations within a global SaaS or subscription-based business, or Strategy Consulting with a focus on B2B Pricing and Deal Strategy.

• 8+ years of leadership experience scaling high-performing teams, including meaningful time at the director and ideally senior director level.

• Strong command of SaaS pricing strategy, with specific depth in consumption-based pricing, commercial governance, discounting and margin considerations, and contract risk mitigation.

• Track record of building scalable deal processes, implementing robust approval frameworks, and improving deal velocity in complex, high-growth environments.

• Experience structuring deals across both direct and channel motions, including resellers and cloud marketplaces.

• Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, with a track record of partnering closely with Finance and Revenue Accounting on deal structure.

• Experience applying AI tools to improve deal operations, approval consistency, and seller productivity.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior executives across Sales, Finance, Legal, Systems, and Product, with exceptional analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts simply and persuasively.

• Experience with the commercial tooling a deal process runs on (CPQ, CRM, CLM, and related sales systems), enough to be a strong partner to Systems on what is feasible; specific platform experience such as Salesforce or Ironclad is a plus, not a requirement.

• Experience leading through M&A, systems integration, or large-scale organizational change is a strong plus.

Business reviews and insight

• Keep the leadership team on top of the number with accurate, timely, decision-ready analysis.

Process and systems

• Improve the machine, not just run it. Build scalable, repeatable processes where none exist and remove manual, error-prone work.

• Act as a power user of our core stack (Salesforce, Omni, Looker) and raise the bar on data quality and pipeline hygiene across the region.

signals.content:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

The Revenue Operations team at Motive is a high-impact, cross-functional group that drives our Quote-to-Cash (QTC) strategy, optimizes key processes, and ensures peak performance across our core business metrics. We thrive on tackling complex operational challenges partnering with GTM, Legal, Accounting, and Finance, delivering practical, high-leverage solutions that help Motive scale efficiently. We are a low-ego, highly motivated team dedicated to cross-functional collaboration and decisive execution.

What You'll Do:

• Lead QTC Improvement Initiatives: Scope, manage, and execute targeted 3–12 month projects aimed at streamlining the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle, reducing deal friction, and improving cycle times.

• Partner with Enterprise GTM: Collaborate closely with Enterprise Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance to identify operational bottlenecks and align on cross-functional solutions.

• Optimize CPQ & Billing Workflows: Audit existing quote, contract, and invoicing processes to identify gaps, automate manual handoffs, and enhance system adoption.

• Map & Redesign Core Processes: Define clear, scalable process workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and governance models across the end-to-end revenue lifecycle.

• Drive Change Management: Own user enablement, documentation, and training to ensure smooth rollouts and high adoption rates for updated QTC tools and processes.

• Track & Measure Performance: Establish KPIs to evaluate the success of project rollouts—monitoring metrics such as quote turnaround time, error rates, and deal velocity.

• Serve as the QTC Subject Matter Expert: Act as a key consultative resource for business partners, bridging technical system configuration with business strategy.

What We're Looking For:

• 6+ years of Field Sales/Revenue Operations experience at a high-growth SaaS company, including direct support of an Enterprise or Strategic segment

• Exceptional spreadsheet and data management skills to quickly structure analyses, answer key business questions, and drive decision making

• Experience in building Salesforce reports and dashboards, knowledge in how SFDC applications integrate with each other, and ability to enable sales on SFDC best practices and related tools

• Experience partnering with Sales Leadership, ESYS, Accounting, Finance and Supply chain

• Experience scoping and reviewing analytical work delivered by offshore or distributed teams

• Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter — you will take the initiative to own projects and can operate well with little guidance

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple concurrent projects in a rapidly changing, hyper-growth environment

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Excel and Google Sheets expertise is a must; SQL proficiency and hands-on experience in a notebook-based analytics tool such as Hex querying a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake is strongly preferred

• Genuine AI proficiency and curiosity — you already use LLMs in your daily work and have built something real with agent, scripting, or workflow automation tooling (Glean, Google Apps Script, n8n, or equivalent). We are an AI-first operations team, and we value operators who build their own solutions

signals.content:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive's GTM Intelligence & Operations team owns the systems, data, and governance behind how 2,000 sellers, managers, and marketers engage our customers worldwide. As Manager, GTM Intelligence & Operations, reporting to the Senior Director of GTM Intelligence & Operations, you'll lead a team of systems administrators and program owners responsible for our end to end GTM SaaS stack: Salesforce at the core, plus sales engagement, prospecting, enrichment, gifting, references, conversation intelligence, and the integrations that connect them. You'll own the stack's roadmap, architecture, budget, and licensing, and partner with Sales Operations, Sales leadership, Enterprise Systems, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to deliver our biggest GTM initiatives.

You're a battle tested enterprise systems leader with a business owner's mindset. You've run GTM platforms at scale, built and led admin teams, and seen enough implementations, migrations, and outages to know what good looks like. You know why every field, integration, and setting you own exists, and you use that to make better decisions, not just faster ones. You stay calm when a platform goes down and the field still needs to sell by lunch. You lead with data and translate technical and regulatory requirements into plain language that sellers and executives can act on. Above all, you grow your people into independent experts and keep the focus on the business.

What You'll Do:

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of GTM systems administrators and program owners by setting clear priorities, delegating platform ownership, and developing each person into a trusted subject matter expert.

• Own the end to end GTM platform ecosystem as a connected system, with Salesforce at its center, including architecture, data model, profiles and permissions, automation, integrations, and the downstream tools that depend on it. Serve as the final escalation point for complex platform issues.

• Set the standard for Salesforce administration across the GTM org, including release management, change control, documentation, and the quoting and CPQ processes that connect pipeline to revenue, in partnership with Enterprise Systems.

• Own the strategy, budget, renewals, and license governance for the broader GTM SaaS portfolio, including our sales engagement platform, and partner with Finance and Procurement on ROI, seat forecasting, and investment decisions.

• Lead vendor evaluations and major tool migrations from requirements and diligence through build, launch, change management, and retirement of the legacy tool, so that multi-million dollar decisions are grounded in data and the voice of the user.

• Partner with Legal, Security, and Marketing to design and enforce GTM compliance and governance across markets, covering consent management, Do Not Contact, call recording, texting, and email deliverability. Provide data and audit support to Legal and leadership when needed.

• Act as the systems lead for major cross-functional initiatives such as new market launches, rebrands, and new sales motions, and partner with Enablement to deliver onboarding, training, and documentation that drive lasting adoption.

• Keep the revenue engine running when things break by leading incident response with vendors and ESYS, engineering workarounds, protecting data integrity, and keeping field and executive leaders informed.

What We're Looking For:

• Deep, hands-on Salesforce administration experience at an enterprise scale of 1,000+ users, including objects, security and sharing, profiles and permission sets, automation, reporting, and integrations. signals.title: Senior Manager, GTM Field Operations
signals.content:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

About the Role

Field Operations is the connective tissue between GTM strategy and what actually happens in the field. We translate annual plans into revenue-unit-level execution, own the forecast and pipeline cadence, and are the first to see — and act on — performance gaps before they become planning problems.

We're hiring a Senior Manager, GTM Field Operations to serve as the embedded operational partner and single point of contact for one of our North America Revenue Units (Sales and Revenue Architect teams with an annual revenue target upwards of $300M). You'll own the operating rhythm for your segment, turn data into decisions, and represent a unified Ops voice alongside Strategy & Planning, RevOps, and Enablement — not a siloed, segment-only function.

The ideal candidate pairs operational rigor with a genuine bias for action: solving today's fire without losing sight of the scalable, repeatable process underneath it. You'll need to build trust with senior stakeholders based on credibility and reliability — not just being agreeable — and be comfortable delivering hard operational calls (policy changes, resource reallocation, ROE enforcement) with clarity and empathy.

Responsibilities

Segment Leadership & Trusted Advisory

• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for your assigned segment's reps, managers, and senior leaders — owning end-to-end ops needs.

• Maintain constant, fluent command of your segment's numbers: targets and quotas, real-time actuals and forecast trajectory, leading KPIs (pipeline generation, close rates, cycle length), and the top 15-20 deals and risks in-quarter.

Operating Rhythm & Performance Management

• Own and enforce the business operating rhythm without exception: weekly/monthly forecast and pipeline reviews, deal reviews, account reviews, KPI and headcount tracking, and QBR/MRR prep.

• Coach and hold segment leaders and reps accountable to their deliverables inside that rhythm — this includes rules of engagement (ROE) enforcement and flagging violations back to central RevOps.

• Bring proactive analysis to the table, not just reactive reporting: surface pipeline coverage gaps, ramp-time stalls, and emerging risks before they show up in a QBR.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with Strategy & Planning on territory methodologies, capacity models, and headcount plans that translate the annual plan into RU-level execution priorities.

• Partner with RevOps to enforce ROE, escalate systems/process gaps for triage, and stay aligned on shared tech stack strategy (Salesforce, Gong, planning/analytics tools).

• Partner with Enablement on new-hire integration, role excellence, and surfacing field skill gaps that should shape program design.

• Build cross-functional relationships with Marketing, Finance, and Product so operational strategy stays aligned to broader GTM goals — not just your segment's.

• Serve as a subject matter expert and voice of your segment in planning and strategy sessions and annual planning cycles.

Reporting, Analytics & Tooling

• Collaborate with Analytics/BI to design reporting and dashboards giving visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline health.

• Champion adoption and hygiene of sales tools (Gong, Salesforce, planning/analytics platforms), and identify new use cases as the tech stack evolves.

• Act as "Customer Zero" for the processes and data you enable in Gong — using the product as a segment leader would, and feeding use cases and feedback back to the product team.

Resource Stewardship & Scale

• Evaluate the cost/benefit of any proposed solution — people, tools, or process — before recommending it; favor scalable fixes over one-off, high-touch solutions.

• Apply a "global-first" mindset: significant projects and process designs should be broadly applicable across the wider Field Ops org, not built solely around your segment.

• Stay aware of your draw on shared resources (central RevOps, Systems, Enablement bandwidth) and scope requests so other segments can get their fair share.

• Maintain documentation and enforce compliance around policies, processes, and rules of engagement.

What Success Looks Like

• You're the first call, not the last resort, for your segment's leadership on anything operational.

• Forecast and pipeline data are trusted because your operating rhythm is airtight — deadlines are never missed, no exceptions.

• You've built direct relationships with individual reps (not just their managers) and know where the ground-level friction actually is.

• Your solutions get reused by other segments, not rebuilt from scratch.

Qualifications

• 6+ years in Sales/Business Operations or GTM Strategy, with strong understanding of SaaS business models.

• SQL proficiency and strong analytical skills, with proven ability to build and standardize reporting in Snowflake and BI tools such as Tableau and Retool.

• Advanced Excel/Sheets skills — pivot tables, data visualization, INDEX/MATCH, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, and array formulas.

• Experience supporting sales and CS orgs of 100+ reps selling $1M+ deals to Fortune 100 companies.

• Proven success building territory models, forecasting processes, and headcount/capacity plans.

• Demonstrated ability to apply AI and emerging technologies to optimize revenue processes and shorten the path to revenue — including working knowledge of MCP servers and the data nuances that inform which LLM tools are fit for a given use case.

• Strong organizational and project management skills; able to execute multiple priorities with urgency.

• High degree of ownership — turning insights into measurable outcomes, not just flagging opportunities.

• Executive presence; able to navigate complex senior stakeholders and high-stakes decisions.

• Track record of building high-trust VP+ relationships grounded in credibility and reliability, not agreeableness

• Comfortable delivering unpopular operational decisions with clarity and empathy, and holding the line once a decision is made.

Nice to Have

• Experience working in or selling to highly regulated industries such as Healthcare and Financial Services.

• Experience navigating complex contract commercials with deal desk and finance, including approval processes and infosec/legal roadblocks.

• Proven outcomes supporting Enterprise sales cycles distinct from high-volume/transactional motions.

PERKS & BENEFITS

• We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.

• Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.

• Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.

• 401(k) program to help you invest in your future.

• Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development.

• Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.

• Paid parental leave to support you and your family.

• Company-wide recharge days each quarter.

• Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.

The annual salary hiring range for this position is $138,000 - $210,000 USD.

Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.

We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored.

Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for a Sales Operations Manager to support our GTM organization by managing advanced models, improving our data structure, and strengthening our operational processes. Reporting to the Sr Director of Field Operations, this role will focus on target setting, quota creation, and reporting for our consumption based product suite.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, excels at translating complex business realities into structured models, and thrives in a fast-paced, data-heavy environment.

What you'll be doing:

• Improve and maintain core models of our account base as it relates to consumption growth across the GTM organization.

• Partner with the larger Revenue Operations and Compensation team to manage monthly compensation updates and drive improvements in existing processes.

• Conduct deep-dive analyses on our customer product engagement to drive decisions around our product investment, GTM segmentation, and territory planning decisions.

• Work within Google BigQuery (SQL) to extract large datasets for reporting. Influence data orchestration between BigQuery, Google Sheets, and compensation tools to streamline calculations and execution of compensation.

• Manage exceptions directly with Sales.

• Independently execute ad-hoc reporting requests, delivering actionable insights

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• 4+ years of experience in strategy and operations, consulting, business analytics, or compensation.

• Comfort working with large datasets and ambiguous problems, with the ability to distill key takeaways.

• Strong problem-solving skills – able to translate business challenges into structured models and insights.

• Excellent communication skills with executive audiences - explain “what it is”, “why it matters” and “what should we do” in terms of your data and analysis.

• Ability to work independently and drive analysis with minimal guidance.

• Expert-level Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.

• Proficiency in SQL and data orchestration between BigQuery and GTM tools

• Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, validation rules, and flows.

• Experience with compensation tools like Xactly, Apttus, or CaptivateIQ

Bonus Points For:

• Previous experience in open source

• Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau or Looker. Grafana visualization as a plus

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $ 125,000 - $148 ,000 Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

#LI-Remote

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

signals.title: Senior Revenue and Technical Accounting Manager
signals.content:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Senior Revenue & Technical Accounting Manager to join our Accounting team!

As Greenhouse evolves toward AI-driven, usage-based SaaS pricing, you'll be the accounting lead who makes sure our revenue story is accurate, compliant, and built to scale. You'll own end-to-end revenue accounting under ASC 606, author the technical accounting positions behind our most complex transactions, and serve as the accounting owner of our usage-billing platform, Metronome, alongside our NetSuite and Salesforce CPQ revenue stack.

Reporting to our Assistant Controller, you'll be a strategic finance partner to Billing Operations, Legal, FP&A, Product, Sales Engineering, and RevOps, shaping how new pricing models and AI add-ons are designed, billed, and recognized. This role starts as a hands-on individual contributor with a clear path into people leadership as the team grows, making it a great fit for an experienced revenue accountant who wants to build something new and grow into leading a team.

Who will love this job

• A technical expert – you live in ASC 606, you enjoy a hard contract-modification or variable-consideration question, and you can defend your conclusions to auditors with confidence.

• A translator – you turn complex accounting standards into clear, practical guidance that Product, Engineering, and Sales teams can actually act on.

• A builder – you get energy from new pricing models, new systems, and new processes, and you like putting the controls in place that let them scale.

• A curious learner – you're open to rolling up your sleeves with AI tools and finding new ways to work smarter, even if they're new to you.

What you’ll do

• Lead end-to-end revenue accounting under ASC 606, with a focus on usage-based, consumption, and hybrid subscription models.

• Evaluate standalone selling prices, performance obligations, variable consideration, and contract modifications as our pricing evolves.

• Write technical accounting memos and position papers on complex revenue transactions, stock-based compensation (ASC 718), and emerging technical topics.

• Oversee month-, quarter-, and year-end revenue close, including balance sheet reconciliations, deferral schedules, and usage-variance analyses.

• Design, document, and maintain SOX-ready internal controls across revenue, billing systems, and stock administration.

• Prepare and review financial statements, disclosures, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting.

• Mentor accounting teammates today, and build and lead a team as the function grows.

• Own the accounting side of Metronome, making sure real-time consumption data flows accurately into NetSuite and Salesforce CPQ.

• Partner with Product, Sales, and Legal to review non-standard contracts, AI add-ons, and novel deal structures, and advise RevOps on commission plan design and FP&A on revenue reconciliation and analysis.

• Represent revenue recognition positions and technical judgments with our external auditors.

• Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require.

You should have

• An active CPA, CA, or equivalent accounting designation

• 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3–5 years in a B2B SaaS environment

• Deep, hands-on expertise with ASC 606 and ASC 718, and a track record of writing technical accounting memos

• Experience with usage-based, consumption, or hybrid pricing models in a SaaS or tech setting

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite and Salesforce CPQ

• Experience designing SOX-ready controls and partnering with external auditors through audits

• An openness to learning and using AI tools hands-on in your day-to-day work

• Experience managing and developing accounting professionals, a plus

• Experience with usage metering and billing tools such as Metronome, Orb, or Togai, strongly preferred

• Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada as of the start date chosen by the Company. We are unable to support sponsorship at this time.

For purposes of processing or administering your employment relationship, personal information that you provide to the Company may be transferred to and accessed by an affiliate in the United States or elsewhere, or to agents and contractors (such as payroll companies, insurance companies, information technology consultants, etc.) that provide services to the Company.

The expected base salary for this role is CAD $182,800 - $237,800 per year. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus with a target of 5% of base salary, based on company performance. This role is eligible to be considered for stock option awards. This posting is not for an existing vacancy.

signals.content:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking to hire a Deal Operations Analyst to support Harvey AI’s growing global sales organization. This role sits at the center of quote-to-cash execution, partnering closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to ensure deals are accurately structured, approved, and closed.

This is a hands-on operational role for someone who enjoys being close to the deal flow, solving process issues in real time, and helping scale systems and workflows as the business grows.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review, validate, and process customer orders to ensure accuracy, compliance with pricing and contracting policies, and readiness for booking and billing

 - Support Sales reps with Salesforce (SFDC) opportunity management, quoting workflows, and deal hygiene

 - Manage and triage a Deal Operations ticketing queue, ensuring timely responses and clear communication with stakeholders

 - Act as a frontline support resource for SFDC and CPQ-related questions from Sales

 - Assist with CRM and CPQ enhancements, including:
   
   - gathering and drafting business requirements
   
   - supporting user acceptance testing (UAT) and QA
   
   - helping roll out new workflows, fields, or guardrails

 - Contribute to sales and deal desk enablement, including documentation, process guides, and training support

 - Identify recurring issues or inefficiencies in quote-to-cash processes and surface recommendations for improvement




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 2-4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Deal/Order Operations, Revenue Operations, or Order Management

 - Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex deal structures

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC) as a CRM, including opportunity and quoting workflows

 - Exposure to CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, DealHub, Ironclad CLM, or similar), with a basic understanding of how pricing and approvals are operationalized

 - Experience managing or working within a ticketing or queue-based support model (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce cases, or similar)

 - Prior involvement in CRM/CPQ projects or enhancements, such as documenting requirements, participating in testing, or supporting system rollouts

 - Ability to communicate clearly with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes are still being defined




COMPENSATION

$108,300 - $148,950 USD

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a GTM Technology Product Owner with a consultant's mindset to join the Revenue Technology team. This role will own the systems that take a customer from first qualified meeting to signed contract to accurate invoice. You will lead the way as an expert advisor as we build the quote-to-cash (Q2C) experience for a seat and usage-based business, using agentic applications and bespoke tooling that reflect Harvey's unique position in a rapidly evolving industry.

The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience at the intersection of technology and business operations, with a background in consulting or a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. You will operate as an advisor and owner for our Q2C stack, with a deep focus on the pricing, contracting and metering layers. This is a role for a problem solver who has a bias for action and enjoys the challenge of building systems that eliminate friction across the deal lifecycle. You will be comfortable operating with high ownership and the ability to navigate complex requirements from multiple business units.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Roadmap Ownership: Own the Q2C product roadmap end to end, from pricing and packaging through quoting, contracting, approvals, order capture and the handoff to billing. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance to translate business objectives into technical requirements, serving as both project liaison and lead analyst. Operate with extreme urgency and agency once prioritization has been agreed upon with leadership.

 - Headless CPQ & Pricing Architecture: Define how pricing, products and discounting logic live in an API-first, headless CPQ layer so that sellers and agents can all quote from the same source of truth.

 - Contracting, Deal Desk & Approvals: Own the connection between quotes and contracts. Design approval matrices, discount governance and non-standard term workflows that keep deals moving fast while protecting margin and compliance.

 - Usage-Based Metering: Partner with Billing, Engineering and Revenue Accounting to define how metered usage maps to entitlements, credits and invoices, and how that data is surfaced back to sales, customers and finance.

 - Data & Agentic Processes: Leverage AI agents and tools to streamline quote creation, deal review and contract workflows. Work closely with managers and ICs across functions to provide expert level advice about what AI is ready to do, and what should be left to humans.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a liaison between Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, RevOps, Enablement, and GTM Systems to deliver a best in class user experience. Guide strategic evaluations of projects and platforms to help leadership make informed decisions on prioritization.

 - Systems Governance: Manage data integrity and system audits across the Q2C stack. You will document our evolving data models and process flows to ensure we remain scalable as we double in size, and verify that the tools we have adopted are driving ROI.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience: 8+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Systems Architect, with deep ownership of quote-to-cash or quote-to-order systems. Background in consulting or a high-growth B2B tech company is required.

 - Headless CPQ: Familiarity with headless, API-first CPQ applications and how they differ from traditional UI-bound CPQ. You can explain tradeoffs in product catalog, pricing rules and quote APIs.

 - Contracting Systems: Hands-on experience with contracting systems (CLM or equivalent) and how they connect to quoting, approvals and downstream systems.

 - Deal Desk & Approvals: Working knowledge of deal desk operations, discount governance and multi-step approval design.

 - Usage-Based Metering: Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing, including metering, rating, entitlements and how usage reaches billing and the general ledger.

 - AI Expertise: Ability to demonstrate a portfolio of AI first principles. You will be expected to both explain the technical nature of different models and platforms, and show micro-apps you have built on agentic applications.

 - The "Glue" Tech: Proven experience understanding the relationship between technology and users. Strong ability to extrapolate data structures across platforms into a baseline that can be used by both end users and agents.

 - Analytical Chops: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with BI tools. Experience with integration patterns for data warehouses and reverse ETL tooling.

 - Consultative Approach: Exceptional ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and transform them into elegant, scalable technical solutions. Track record of iteration with technical development teams and delivering projects from inception to hypercare.


BONUS POINTS (OPTIONAL)

 - Experience migrating from a legacy CPQ to a modern or headless architecture.

 - Familiarity with ASC 606 and SOX compliance, and the revenue accounting implications of usage-based contracts.

 - Experience as part of a hypergrowth company, building a business function 0 > 1.




COMPENSATION

$164,000 - $225,500 USD

signals.title: Sr. Sales Operations Analyst
signals.content:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

This is your chance to own one of the most technical, horizontal levers in GTM planning: building the scalable models and infrastructure that enable every route to market to grow efficiently. As Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you’ll partner with GTM leaders, Finance, Revenue Operations, and GTM Ops to develop and execute segmentation, book-of-business design, quota setting, and capacity planning. You’ll turn GTM strategy into concrete, automated models that determine how customers are segmented, how reps are staffed, and what they are held accountable for.

This role takes an end-to-end, platform-minded view across GTM motions, not just a single sales team. You’ll identify where manual work, fragmented logic, or inconsistent processes limit scale and build durable planning infrastructure that drives revenue outcomes as the business evolves. You’ll own the outcome: balanced books, defensible quotas tied to capacity, and scalable models that hold up under scrutiny.

About the Team

You'll sit within GTM Operations, working as the dedicated segmentation, book-of-business, and capacity planning owner for our Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales teams. We think of ourselves as builders and problem solvers: we turn ambiguous planning questions into scalable, defensible models, and we hold the line on rigor even when the business is moving fast and priorities compete.

You'll work in close partnership with each organization's GTM leaders and their dedicated GTM Ops partners, leaning on their operational and business context, while you own building, defending, and maintaining the segmentation, book, quota, and headcount models that everyone plans against.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day

Segmentation & Book of Business

• Own the design and ongoing maintenance of customer/account segmentation for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales, translating org-level segmentation strategy into concrete, rules-based models these teams can operate against.

• Build and maintain balanced books of business across reps and teams, accounting for account potential, workload, geography, and product mix; own rebalancing when the business shifts (new hires, departures, territory changes, book splits).

• Set and maintain clear, documented rules for account assignment, routing, and reclassification, and serve as the ruling authority when edge cases or disputes come up.

• Partner with Sales, GTM Ops, and Systems & Tooling to ensure segmentation and book structures are reflected accurately in Salesforce and downstream systems.

Quota Setting

• Own the end-to-end quota-setting process for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: translating top-down revenue targets into bottoms-up, capacity-based quotas by rep, team, and segment.

• Build and maintain the quota models and methodology, ensuring quotas are defensible, equitable across territories/books, and tightly tied to book-of-business design and headcount capacity.

• Partner with RTM leaders, Finance, and Sales Compensation to align quotas with comp plans, revenue targets, and business priorities each planning cycle.

• Own quota administration through the cycle: true-ups for territory or book changes, new-hire ramp adjustments, and mid-cycle corrections.

Headcount & Capacity Planning

• Partner with GTM Ops & Finance on capacity planning for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: modeling the headcount needed to cover segmented books and hit revenue targets, and identifying where the org is over- or under-staffed relative to opportunity.

• Build the headcount models that inform hiring plans, partnering with RTM leaders and Finance on timing, sequencing, and prioritization of new roles.

• Continuously monitor capacity against actual book size, productivity, and attrition, flagging gaps or imbalances before they become a problem.

• Own scenario planning for headcount and territory changes (reorgs, new segments, M&A, product launches), modeling the impact before decisions are made.

Cross-functional Partnership & Communication

• Partner closely with RTM leaders and their GTM Ops partners across Direct, Expansion, and Benefits to ensure segmentation, book, quota, and capacity decisions reflect real operational context, while retaining ownership of the outcome and the execution.

• Work with GTM Ops, Finance, and Sales Compensation to stay aligned with org-wide segmentation frameworks, revenue targets, and comp design.

• Communicate clearly and proactively with sales leadership on plan status, tradeoffs, and risk: you're the trusted authority on "how the books, quotas, and headcount are built and why."

• Document methodology and decisions so segmentation, quota, and capacity models are transparent, auditable, and repeatable across planning cycles.

Here's what we're looking for

• 5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role, with direct, hands-on experience owning segmentation, territory/book design, quota setting, or headcount/capacity planning; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.

• Proven ability to own outcomes and execution, not just analysis or recommendations: you're comfortable being the accountable owner when a quota, book, or headcount plan is challenged.

• Strong sales process & tooling proficiency: you can build and audit account assignment/routing logic, manage territory and book structures, and build reporting that leaders trust.

• Analytical depth; comfortable building and defending quantitative models (quota, capacity, segmentation) under time pressure.

• Experience running planning processes on a recurring cadence (annual/quarterly quota setting, ongoing book rebalancing, headcount reviews) across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; you can defend a model's methodology to GTM leaders and senior sales leadership, and hold your ground when a decision is unpopular but correct.

• A first-principles problem solver who can build a defensible model from ambiguous inputs and translate org-level strategy into concrete, rules-based execution.

• A strong cross-functional partner, able to work closely with GTM leaders and GTM Ops peers without ceding ownership of the outcome.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience owning segmentation, book-of-business, or quota/capacity planning across multiple sales organizations or motions simultaneously (e.g., new business, expansion, and a distinct product line).

• Experience in payroll, HR tech, benefits, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions.

• Experience partnering with Sales Compensation and Finance on quota-to-comp alignment.

• Experience designing or improving account assignment/routing automation (e.g., lead-routing tools, rules engines).

Compensation

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $100,000 - $120,000/yr in Scottsdale, $105,000 - $130,000/yr in Denver and Atlanta, $130,000 - $155,000/yr in San Francisco and New York, and $120,000 - $145,000 CAD/yr for Toronto. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere.
