When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

signals.title: Senior Sales Operations Manager
signals.content:
Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What’s the opportunity?

As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will be a strategic and operational partner to Fin’s Sales organization, helping build the systems, processes, reporting, and operating rhythms that enable our go-to-market teams to scale effectively.

You’ll work at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Data Engineering, Marketing, and GTM leadership. You’ll own critical sales operations programs across forecasting, pipeline management, territory and quota planning, compensation, performance reporting, and process optimization.

This is a high-impact role for a systems thinker and commercially minded operator who can move comfortably between detailed analysis, cross-functional program management, and executive-level recommendations. You’ll have the opportunity to improve how Fin’s sales organization operates while helping scale the GTM engine behind one of the fastest-growing AI products in the market.

What will I be doing?

• Own and optimize core sales operations processes, systems, and operating cadences across the sales organization.

• Partner with Sales leadership and Finance to build and maintain forecasting processes, pipeline reporting, quota models, attainment tracking, and performance insights.

• Develop clear, trusted reporting and dashboards that give leaders visibility into funnel health, productivity, conversion, win rates, capacity, and revenue performance.

• Lead territory planning, segmentation, coverage, and capacity analysis to support efficient allocation of sales resources.

• Partner with Finance and Sales leadership on compensation planning, plan administration, performance measurement, and reporting.

• Translate business requirements into scalable solutions across CRM, BI, sales planning, compensation, and other GTM systems.

• Partner with Business Systems and Data Engineering to improve data quality, data models, integrations, automation, and reporting infrastructure.

• Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks across the sales cycle, including lead routing, opportunity management, approvals, contracting, handoffs, and post-sale transitions.

• Establish and maintain consistent definitions, governance, documentation, and processes for key sales metrics and data.

• Lead complex cross-functional projects from discovery through implementation, including requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, testing, rollout, and change management.

• Build executive-ready analyses and recommendations that help leadership make decisions about growth, investment, productivity, and organizational design.

• Use AI tools and automation thoughtfully to reduce manual work, improve data access, and increase the speed and quality of sales execution.

• Create scalable operating processes that support growth without requiring linear increases in headcount.

• Act as a trusted advisor to sales leadership on performance trends, operational risks, process improvements, and strategic priorities.

• Support quarterly and annual planning activities, including business reviews, headcount planning, goal-setting, and operating plan development.

What skills do I need?

• 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, Sales Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or a related field, preferably in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, forecasting, pipeline management, quota and territory planning, compensation, and sales performance metrics.

• Experience owning or significantly improving CRM, BI, planning, compensation, or revenue technology systems.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with BI or reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar.

• Familiarity with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms; experience partnering with Business Systems or Data Engineering teams is highly valuable.

• Experience designing scalable processes, data governance frameworks, reporting systems, and operational workflows.

• Ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

• Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect operational improvements to revenue outcomes.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present recommendations to senior leaders.

• Comfortable working hands-on in the details while maintaining a strategic view of the broader business.

• AI fluency and curiosity about applying AI, automation, and emerging tools to improve sales productivity and operational efficiency.

• High ownership, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action.

• Comfortable and energized operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve quickly.

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $162,000-$180,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

#LI-Hybrid
Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values .

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

signals.content:
Island is shaping the future of work - creating an enterprise workspace for both knowledge workers and agents - where access, security, and AI-powered productivity are built in. Our enterprise agentic control plane boosts productivity across devices, browsers, applications, networks, and data while protecting sensitive information, simplifying access, and helping enterprises scale AI safely.

Behind all of that is a team of people who care deeply about their craft and want to do the biggest and best work of their careers. At Island, character and drive matter more than your resume.

Backed by Coatue Management, Insight Partners, Sequoia Capital, Cyberstarts, and other world-class investors, Island is used by millions of people at some of the planet’s largest enterprises.

Come build with us. Together, we’re changing how the world works.

2026 - #28 + ONLY DFW Company on the CNBC Disruptor 50 List

2025 - #1 in LinkedIn's Top Startups of 2025

2025 - #6 in the 2025 Dallas 100™ Entrepreneur Awards

2025 - Forbes Cloud 100

About the Role

In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted partner to Sales and GTM leadership, helping Island scale its revenue engine through process optimization, analytics, and strategic insights. You’ll own critical forecasting and reporting rhythms, bring clarity to performance metrics, and ensure that data-driven decisions power every stage of our growth. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving complex operational challenges, and are energized by helping teams win — this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact at one of the most innovative companies in cybersecurity.

How We Work

Note: This position is full-time five days per week in-office at our Coppell, TX headquarters (Monday through Friday). We believe collaboration and culture thrive face-to-face, and we can’t wait to welcome you to the team.

What You’ll Do

• Strategic Partnership & Process Optimization

• Partner closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, Channel, and Customer Success leadership to identify and implement operational improvements that enhance productivity and scalability.

• Help drive delivery and adoption of new GTM processes, tools, and methodologies in partnership with leadership.

• Own and evolve the operational infrastructure that supports pipeline visibility, forecasting, and reporting.

• Forecasting & Analytics

• Lead the bi-weekly forecasting cadence, analyzing week-over-week changes and driving improved forecast accuracy.

• Build and mature executive-level KPIs and dashboards across GTM functions, ensuring data accuracy and clarity.

• Deliver actionable insights to leadership and the Board that translate complex data into strategic decisions.

• Revenue Planning & Territory Management

• Partner with GTM leaders on annual territory planning, quota setting, and capacity modeling.

• Support leadership in the design and rollout of compensation structures and letters.

• Maintain data integrity across closed bookings, invoicing, and pipeline management.

• Sales & Customer Success Performance

• Conduct comprehensive analyses of GTM performance, including pipeline health, forecast accuracy, retention, and productivity.

• Provide actionable insights and trend analyses to guide GTM strategy and execution.

• Collaborate with Customer Success leadership to develop renewal and expansion strategies that drive customer lifetime value.

You Might Be a Fit If

• ~5 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a high-growth SaaS environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Technology, AI, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and data visualization skills with the ability to translate insights into actions.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce, CPQ, forecasting, reporting, and data visualization tools.

• Proven track record of partnering cross-functionally and influencing at all levels of leadership.

• Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and high energy.

• Experience working in high-growth or scaling companies is preferred.

• Deal Desk experience or knowledge of deal structure, pricing, and approval workflows is a plus.

Benefits and Per ks

• Medical, dental, vision

• Company paid Life and AD&D Insurance

• Company paid STD and LTD Insurance

• 401(k) with company contributions

• Paid Time Off & 9 Company Holidays

• In-office wellness instructor and daily lunches (for office-based roles)

Physical Environment

This position requires the ability to perform sedentary work, which involves exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects as needed. The employee will primarily operate standard office equipment and keyboards, and may require close visual acuity for tasks like analyzing data and reading extensive text.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Island is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their background or protected characteristics.

E-Verify

Island Technology participates in E-Verify. For additional information please review the E-Verify Participation & Right to Work Poster from the Department of Homeland Security

General Disclosure

The job description is subject to change with or without prior notice, and a reasonable accommodation may be requested to perform the essential functions of the job.
Data Privacy

You can find information on how we process and protect your personal data in our Candidate and Employee Privacy Notice . For any privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@island.io .

Position Overview:

How you will make a difference:

As the Revenue Accounting Manager, you will play a critical role in overseeing the company's revenue recognition and cash conversion processes. As a key individual contributor, you will be instrumental in the deal desk process, contributing to pricing contracts, structuring deals, and ensuring favorable terms for new business and renewals. You will help optimize processes, build scalable practices and enhance systems in compliance with ASC 606. This is an incredible opportunity to join a highly motivated and dynamic team poised for success.

One of our core values is a growth mindset and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this is a role that excites you, please apply as we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond a job description.



You’ll get to:

 - Manage accounting related functions including, but not limited to, Revenue,  Commissions, month end close, flux analysis and account reconciliations

 - Review the accuracy and completeness of Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts and Deferred Revenue.

 - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Legal and other cross functional teams during the day to day operations

 - Review and ensure revenue contracts are accurately recorded in accordance with ASC 606

 - Able to articulate technical revenue accounting guidance in simple English to business including the concept behind it, and apply in real world situations

 - Drive Automation and AI adoption

 - Implementation functional owner in ad hoc revenue accounting projects

 - Partner with external auditors to complete annual financial audits related to orders to cash processes

 

We are looking for people who have:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and CPA. Public accounting experience preferred.

 - Strong understanding and experience with US GAAP, and SaaS revenue recognition guidance (ASC 606).

 - Experience with Netsuite (required) (ARM - required), and  Salesforce CPQ (preferred)

 - Advanced Excel skills with the ability to synthesize and analyze large sets of data

 - High degree of analytical and problem-solving capability to offer business solutions to leadership

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate complex scenarios and topics to team members and leadership in a clear, logical manner

 - Highly organized detail-oriented with experience managing multiple priorities, large-scale projects, and meeting required deadlines under pressure.

 - Process-driven, with a track record of building, documenting, and standardizing close procedures, policies, and controls that scale

 - Leverage AI-driven tools to continuously improve, automate, and scale core Revenue Accounting processes

ABOUT THE ROLE

Iterable is looking for a Senior Deal Desk Analyst to be the trusted commercial partner to our Sales team and help build the next stage of our Deal Desk. You will lead our most complex deals today while designing the processes and tools that let us scale tomorrow.

This is a hands-on role for a true operator, someone who runs the day-to-day with confidence and solves problems without waiting to be asked. You will sit at the center of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Billing, and Revenue Accounting, and you will often be the person who brings them together to get a deal done. Beyond individual deals, you will work directly with sales and operations leadership to design and implement the systems and processes behind how we sell.


IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL GET TO:

Own complex deals

 - Review deals and structure non-standard agreements end to end across the full customer lifecycle, from new business through expansion and renewal

 - Advise account teams on discounting and the trade-offs across price, term, volume, and risk, and recommend structures that work for the customer and for Iterable

 - Model deal economics, including margin, attach rate, and payment terms, and propose alternatives when a deal falls short of targets

 - Evaluate non-standard terms for revenue recognition, billing, and compliance implications before they reach approval

 - Make judgment calls on exceptions, own your recommendation through approval, and serve as the escalation point for the Deal Desk queue and GTM leadership

 - Keep deals moving within internal SLAs, especially at month-end and quarter-end

Connect the teams around the deal

 - Be the central point of contact across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, Billing, and Revenue Operations, coordinating the path to close

 - Give sales leadership clear, timely visibility into deal status, risks, and blockers

 - Coach sellers on pricing, discounting, and contract structure through deal reviews, office hours, and training built with Enablement

 - Represent Deal Desk in cross-functional projects, such as new product pricing and packaging launches, and present recommendations to leadership

Build how Deal Desk scales

 - Spot bottlenecks in quoting, approvals, and contracting, then design and roll out the fix, including automation and AI-assisted workflows

 - Design and implement improvements to our quoting and CPQ tools, partnering with systems teams from requirements through testing, rollout, and adoption

 - Build and publish metrics on turnaround time, discounting and concession trends, and non-standard terms to inform pricing and policy decisions

 - Oversee order entry and ensure Salesforce contract data is accurate and aligned with billing and financial reporting systems

 - Own standard operating procedures, pricing guidelines, and approval documentation


WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE:

 - 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Finance at a B2B SaaS company. Earlier experience in management consulting, investment banking, or a similarly analytical role is a strong plus

 - A track record of owning non-standard deals independently, from structuring through approvals to close

 - Fluency in SaaS deal construction, including subscription and usage-based pricing models, margin analysis, and how contract terms affect booking, billing, invoicing, overages, and revenue recognition

 - The ability to read, interpret, and draft commercial terms in order forms

 - Strong financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including scenario analysis

 - Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, including accounts, opportunities, contracts, orders, products, and price books, and how they connect from quote to order

 - Hands-on experience with CPQ, including how pricing rules, approvals, and quote templates are configured

 - The communication skills to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success: explaining complex trade-offs simply to anyone from a new rep to a senior executive, and steering disagreements to a productive outcome

 - Sound judgment in ambiguity: knowing when to make the call, when to push back, and when to escalate

 - A history of improving a process, not just running it, with examples you led from idea to adoption

 - Curiosity about new tools, including AI, paired with good judgment on output quality and data privacy

 - The ability to juggle competing priorities and stay detail-oriented during month-end and quarter-end crunch time


BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience implementing, testing, or administering a CPQ system

 - Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent admin experience

 - Previous experience with email marketing, push, or SMS software

 - Experience in a pricing or deal strategy function

 - Exposure to incentive compensation, SPIFFs, or commission calculations

signals.content:
Hybrid role (3 days in the office, 2 days remote), based in our London office at HYLO, 103–105 Bunhill Row, London EC1Y 8LZ.

At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. If you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of a critical mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

We are looking for a self-motivated trusted advisor to the sales management who works with sales teams on large, complex, and non-standard deals, discounts, contract terms, and commercial structures to get those deals moved along as seamlessly as possible. This person will act as a primary point of contact for all the departments and key stakeholders involved in the completion of non-standard deals. Build scalable solutions that help our sales teams and leadership make informed decisions and are essentially helping craft deals that drive our revenue growth.

As a Deal Desk Specialist at JFrog you will...

• Be the trusted advisor to the Sales leadership and team, collaborating on pricing and commercial terms for non-standard transactions

• Be a subject matter expert on sales and revenue compliance policies and advise Account Executives on alternative compliant contract options

• Partner with the Revenue, Finance, Legal and Sales Ops teams, to review or address revenue recognition concerns, Finance and billing issues, special terms, and pricing for non-standard deals

• Own day-to-day quote management and pricing approvals, ensuring compliance with sales and business approval policies

• Perform analysis on nonstandard and discounted deals

• Present analyses of deals to decision-makers in a clear and concise fashion that enables them to make a quick and informed decision

• Acts as a point of escalation for deal-related matters

• Serve as a gatekeeper to the senior management by reviewing requests before they are escalated

• Develop robust and repeatable deal processes, identifying process improvement and automation simplifying

• Provide sales training and enablement of quoting, pricing and processes

To be a Deal Desk Specialist in JFrog you need...

• 3 years of proven success in a Deal Desk function or other direct sales support role

• MBA or Master’s Degree in Finance or Economics

• Experience with Salesforce and CPQ

• Strong understanding of Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), revenue recognition and order process principles

• Experience working with enterprise software sales teams

• Excellent team player and effective communicator with all levels of management and cross-functional organizations

• Self driven with strong business acumen, strong reporting and analytics skills, troubleshooting and problem-solving

• High attention to detail is required to ensure accuracy in complex deal structures.

• Highly organized, customer-focused, innovative and strong attention to detail

• Ability to multitask and prioritize at times of high volume, schedule flexibility during End of Month, End or Quarter

• English Native Speaker

signals.title: GTM Systems Manager
signals.content:
Keeper Security is hiring a hands-on and solutions-oriented GTM Systems Manager to design, build and optimize the systems that support the go-to-market organization. This role will own Salesforce administration and development, automation, territory management, quoting, integrations and release management to help Keeper scale its revenue operations, and report to the Director of Sales Operations. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for overseeing day-to-day sales activities, inspiring achievement of sales targets, and ensuring our sales processes are optimized to drive growth.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

You’ll be a hands-on Salesforce builder for a sales organization of approximately 430 Salesforce users that is growing rapidly. You’ll build the automation, territory logic, quoting capabilities and integrations behind Keeper’s 2027 go-to-market changes. You’ll also establish scalable documentation and processes to ensure system knowledge is shared and no single person is the only one who can make critical system changes. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with strong business judgment, project management skills and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to sales and operations stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain Salesforce Flows for routing, stage management, hand-offs and approvals

• Configure and maintain Salesforce Enterprise Territory Management, including annual territory and quota loads

• Configure and support quoting and CPQ processes, including renewal opportunities and quotes automatically created 120 days in advance

• Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and GTM tools such as ZoomInfo, Apollo, marketing automation platforms and billing systems

• Manage Salesforce releases through sandboxes in partnership with the QA Analyst, including testing, documentation and deployment according to a release calendar

• Translate GTM technology roadmap initiatives into technical designs and deliver solutions on schedule

• Establish documentation, change management and knowledge-sharing practices that reduce system dependency on any one individual

• Provide technical input for the quote-to-cash and Revenue Cloud assessment

• Build and support initial AI agent pilots for the go-to-market organization

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Developer within a B2B SaaS organization

• Expert-level experience with Salesforce Flow, including hands-on experience with Enterprise Territory Management and CPQ or quoting

• Salesforce certifications such as Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder or CPQ Specialist

• Experience managing sandboxes, change sets or deployment tools, as well as building and maintaining integrations through APIs

• Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data models, automation and system governance

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and solutions

• Strong project management and release management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver on schedule

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to sales, operations and other business stakeholders

• Highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)

• Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life

• Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

• 401K (Roth/Traditional)

• A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

signals.content:

Keeper Security is hiring a strategic and execution-oriented Senior Manager, GTM Business Planning to lead go-to-market planning and operational execution across the revenue organization. This role will drive annual and quarterly planning, forecasting, performance management, and cross-functional alignment to support scalable growth. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. About the Role

The Senior Manager, GTM Business Planning will serve as a strategic partner to go-to-market leadership, helping translate company objectives into actionable plans and measurable outcomes and will report to the Director, Revenue Strategy & Operations. This role will lead the planning and operating cadence across the revenue organization, including territory and quota planning, forecasting, headcount planning, performance reporting, and business reviews. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and financial skills with excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management abilities.

Responsibilities

• Run the annual and quarterly GTM planning cycles end to end, including bookings targets, capacity and hiring models, segmentation, and coverage, on a dependable planning calendar

• Establish an equitable quota methodology, build territory frameworks, and manage in-year changes for hires and transfers

• Deploy territories and quotas in Salesforce in partnership with Territory & Account Operations

• Establish and manage the go-to-market operating cadence, including business reviews, forecasting, and performance reporting

• Build and maintain accurate revenue forecasts by partnering with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance leaders

• Partner with FP&A and People Operations to design incentive compensation plans that drive the right behaviors, model payout scenarios, and establish compensation policies; Sales Operations will manage payouts

• Track quota attainment, ramp, and hiring pace by team, providing sales leaders and the People team with insights on hiring needs, ramp challenges, and coaching opportunities

• Develop executive dashboards and reporting that provide clear visibility into bookings versus plan, productivity, pipeline health, retention, win rates, and other key performance metrics

• Maintain audit-ready quota, territory, and compensation data across Salesforce and downstream systems in partnership with Sales Operations

• Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to improve lead management, funnel progression, pipeline generation, and campaign performance

• Collaborate with Customer Success and Finance to improve renewal, expansion, retention, and revenue reporting processes

• Lead headcount planning, organizational design, capacity modeling, and resource allocation across the go-to-market organization

• Lead and develop the Pipeline Analyst, Segmentation & Market Analyst, and Pricing Manager, aligning their work into one integrated planning view

• Drive the roadmap for planning tools and automate manual planning processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability

• Lead cross-functional go-to-market initiatives from strategy through execution, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes

• Prepare and present business performance updates, recommendations, and strategic insights to senior leadership

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Strategy, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Finance, or a related field

• 2+ years of experience leading strategic planning, business planning, or revenue operations initiatives in a SaaS or technology organization

• Experience managing and developing teams, with the ability to lead analysts and cross-functional planning partners

• Proven experience managing annual and quarterly planning processes across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or other go-to-market functions

• Strong experience with forecasting, pipeline management, territory design, quota setting, capacity planning, and performance management

• Experience designing incentive compensation plans, modeling payout scenarios, and establishing compensation policies

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business data, build executive dashboards, and translate insights into clear recommendations and measurable action plans

• Deep understanding of the B2B SaaS revenue lifecycle, including marketing, sales, customer success, renewals, and expansion

• Strong financial acumen and experience with business modeling, headcount planning, compensation, and revenue analysis

• Experience managing and optimizing Salesforce, business intelligence, and other go-to-market technology ecosystems

• Experience improving data governance, automating planning processes, and driving adoption of operational tools

• Exceptional communication, presentation, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across departments

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a continuous improvement mindset

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred

Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)

• Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life

• Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

• 401K (Roth/Traditional)

• A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

signals.title: Director Partner Programs & Operations Manager
signals.content:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



About the Role:

Partners are one of Kong's biggest levers for AI Gateway pipeline and bookings, and our partner business is growing fast. Kong is hiring a Director, Partner Operations to build the operating model that helps it scale.

You'll be the operating partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders, sitting in Revenue Operations. You own how partner business flows through Kong — registration, deal structure, attribution, crediting, and payout — and you bring an AI-first mindset to how it runs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business partner to Ecosystem leadership
Serve as the strategic and operational partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders across theaters. Run an AI-assisted operating cadence — forecast and pipeline reviews, QBRs, and executive reporting — where the prep is automated and meetings go to decisions. Facilitate cross-functional alignment on people, then process, then systems, so changes are agreed before they are configured.

Partner GTM strategy & planning
Lead annual and quarterly planning for the partner organization, including targets, capacity, and coverage. Help build a business that maximizes the impact of partner investments and resources. 

Rules of engagement, deal registration & attribution
Own the rules that govern how partner deals are registered, protected, sourced, and credited, including sourced vs. influenced credit, lookback windows, and the line between partner credit and partner marketing credit. Encode them into systems and agents so they apply automatically.

Partner lead & deal workflows: Define and own how partner-touched leads and deals move between ADR, PSD, and AE, including routing, SLAs, and prioritization. Cover partner event leads, prospective partners, existing partners, and deal registrations, and give PSDs one view of the leads that need their action.

Partner deal execution
Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to make partner deals easy to structure, discount, and book across resale, referral, and cloud marketplace routes

Partner compensation & crediting
Partner with Incentive Compensation on channel-neutral crediting and referral fees, so sellers choose the best route to market.

Manage cloud marketplace operations: Own Kong’s cloud marketplace operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including listings, private offers, channel partner private offers (CPPOs), and co-sell registration. Lead the launch of marketplaces in new regions, and manage marketplace dynamics with Deal Desk, Finance, and the cloud alliances team, including fees, customer commit drawdown, and partner involvement on marketplace deals.

Performance insights & data quality
Define and report the partner KPIs that matter, give every partner leader a run-the-business view, and keep partner data accurate.

Partner marketing measurement & MDF
Work closely with Partner Marketing and Marketing Ops to define how partner marketing is measured. Tie MDF and event spend to registered deals by capturing funding source on deal registrations, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately.
Operational playbooks & enablement
Build and maintain the partner operations handbook and repeatable workflows, from partner onboarding to software access, including prospective partner intake and ADR and PSD training on routing rules, so every seller knows the process on day one.

Systems & data architecture
Own partner data design and routing rules. That includes partner account structure, alignment of deal registration approval with lead routing, and alerts when opportunities open on partner accounts. Evaluate whether the PRM remains the right long-term fit.

AI & automation roadmap
Own the Partner Operations AI roadmap: find the highest-leverage workflows, build or buy the agents and automations, and measure the hours returned to the field. Own business requirements for partner tooling across Salesforce, PRM, and CPQ.

Lean, high-output team
Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.

Required Experience:

 - 10+ years in Partner or Channel Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure software company, including 3+ years leading partner operations - with direct ownership of deal registration, rules of engagement, and partner attribution.

 - 3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

 - Hands-on partner deal execution end to end - resale, referral, and cloud marketplace transactions, partner discounting, and order form requirements - in partnership with Deal Desk and Finance.

 - 3+ years experience leading partner planning - targets, quota, capacity, and coverage  and designing channel-neutral crediting with Incentive Compensation.

 - Proven track record as a trusted advisor to VP-level Partner or Sales leaders, with the presence to hold a governance line and the judgment to know when to evolve it.

 - Deep Salesforce fluency (opportunity design, sourcing fields, reporting) plus PRM and BI tools, and hands-on use of AI tools to automate ops workflows.

Preferred experience:

 - Hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace mechanics: AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate, Marketplace private offers, Microsoft co-sell, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

 - Experience supporting a shift to usage-based or consumption pricing and reflecting it in partner deal structures and crediting.

 - Experience leading a team from building processes to running them at scale.

 - API, cloud infrastructure, or AI platform experience.
   
   #LI-JW1



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

signals.title: Order Management Analyst, OTC
signals.content:
About the Job:

As the Order Management Specialist, you will ensure that system inputs are complete and accurate, orders are processed in a timely manner, work with the Deal Desk and Internal Systems team to resolve issues, and ensure accounts are provisioned. You will have excellent attention to detail, solve problems, and ability to multi task.

Responsibilities:

Order & Opportunity Review

• Review opportunities in Salesforce to ensure completeness and accuracy prior to downstream processing into NetSuite, validating pricing, product/SKU alignment, contract terms, and required fields.

• Review Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) on opportunities to confirm accuracy and alignment with contract terms and pricing before deals proceed through the order-to-cash cycle.

• Create and monitor indirect sales orders via AWS Marketplace. Work with AWS Support to resolve any offer issues or errors.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data discrepancies or missing information before orders progress through the order-to-cash cycle.

• Serve as a quality checkpoint between deal closure and financial system entry, minimizing rework and downstream billing errors.

Provisioning & Deal Documentation

• Review and approve provisioning details to ensure customer setup aligns with the terms of the executed agreement.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Deal Management to confirm that all required documentation (order forms, amendments, approvals, contracts) is complete, accurate, and obtained prior to processing.

• Act as a point of escalation for missing or inconsistent deal documentation, coordinating resolution across stakeholders.

Systems & CPQ Administration

• Work closely with the internal systems/IT team to ensure Salesforce CPQ configurations (pricing rules, product bundles, approval workflows) remain accurate and up to date.

• Support testing and validation of CPQ and Salesforce-to-NetSuite integration changes, flagging issues that could impact order accuracy or revenue processing.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of order-to-cash tools, workflows, and controls.

Revenue Recognition & Compliance

• Apply a working understanding of ASC 606 principles when reviewing deal structures, contract terms, and provisioning to flag potential revenue recognition considerations.

• Support Finance/Accounting during month-end and quarter-end close by ensuring orders and documentation are audit-ready.

• Help maintain internal controls around deal review, approval, and order processing.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Act as a trusted liaison between Sales, Customer Success, Deal Management, Finance, and Systems teams to keep the order-to-cash process moving efficiently.

• Provide guidance and training to Sales and Customer Success on Salesforce, CPQ, and documentation requirements.

• Report on order accuracy, cycle times, and recurring issues, and recommend process improvements.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 4+ years of experience in Order to Cash, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a related finance/systems role, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ (or other CPQ systems); experience with NetSuite and AWS Marketplace strongly preferred

• Working understanding of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles as they apply to SaaS/subscription contracts.

• Strong attention to detail and comfort working with high volumes of orders, especially during month-end/quarter-end close.

• Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with proven ability to partner effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Deal Management, Finance, and IT/Systems teams.

• Analytical mindset with strong Excel skills; experience with reporting/dashboard tools (e.g., Tableau) a plus.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and manage ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting Salesforce-to-NetSuite integrations or similar CRM-to-ERP data flows.

• Familiarity with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign CLM).

• Prior experience contributing to systems testing, UAT, or process documentation for order management tools.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

• Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

• Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

• Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

• Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

• Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

signals.title: Sales Commissions Analyst
signals.content:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Commissions Analyst to help administer accurate, timely commission programs for the Revenue organization. The role will validate commission calculations, maintain commission and quota data in commissions tool, support accrual and payroll submissions, and respond to employee and leader inquiries.

Working with Sales and Customer Success leaders, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Payroll, this analyst will investigate discrepancies, support quota and plan administration, and deliver ad hoc reporting. We’re looking for someone with commission experience, strong spreadsheet skills, curiosity, and attention to detail who will improve how work gets done—automating manual processes and thoughtfully using approved internal AI tools while maintaining appropriate review and controls.

Responsibilities:

•
Validate monthly commission calculations against plan terms and source data; build spreadsheet checks and reconcile discrepancies with commissions tool

•
Prepare commission accruals for Finance and commission payment submissions for Payroll according to local Payroll schedules, with accurate supporting analysis and reconciliations

•
Support the build and implementation of commission plans in the commission tool; administer employee records and plan inputs

•
Calculate individual quota assignments from approved base quotas, partnering with Revenue Operations to validate changes and resolve discrepancies

•
Address and resolve any commission or compensation-plan-related inquiries

•
Track and administer incentive spiffs, adjustments, and exceptions

•
Deliver ad hoc reporting and analysis

•
Support compensation plan distribution and track participant review and approval status

•
Improve commission processes by standardizing controls, automating repetitive work, and thoughtfully using approved internal AI tools with appropriate human review

•
Maintain clear process documentation and audit-ready reconciliations

•
Handle confidential compensation data with discretion

Qualifications:

•
3+ years of experience in sales commissions or incentive compensation; experience supporting multiple commissionable roles is preferred

•
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience

•
Experience with a commissions platform such as QuotaPath, Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Everstage or similar, and familiarity with Salesforce or related business systems

•
Highly proficient Excel and Google Sheets skills, including formulas, lookups, validation workbooks, and reconciling large data sets

•
Strong analytical and investigative skills; able to trace discrepancies to source data, understand calculation logic, and explain findings clearly

•
Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing requests

•
Clear written and verbal communication skills and comfort partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Payroll

•
Demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and ownership, with the ability to assess existing processes critically and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and controls

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

• Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $108,800 - $149,600**

• Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $97,900 - $134,640**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

signals.title: Senior Director, GTM Planning & Analysis
signals.content:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

The Senior Director of GTM Planning & Analysis will lead the integrated planning, forecasting, and performance management process across Justworks’ go-to-market organization.

This leader will connect company strategy and the financial plan to an integrated GTM plan, translate that plan into functional priorities and resource decisions, measure performance against it, and help leadership adjust investments, execution, or strategy as results evolve.

Justworks operates a multi-product platform with a mix of product-led and self-service acquisition, managed sales, partner-led growth, and customer expansion. This role will ensure those motions are planned and managed as one integrated growth system rather than as separate channels.

The role will bring together top-down company objectives and bottom-up operating assumptions to create a credible path to the financial plan. This includes connecting marketing investment, demand generation, pipeline, product-led conversion, sales capacity and productivity, partnerships, retention, expansion, product mix, and customer economics into one shared view of the business.

This is not primarily a reporting, BI, or attribution function. It is a strategic planning and decision-support function responsible for helping Justworks make better decisions about where to invest, how to deploy resources, and what needs to change when performance differs from plan.

What You’ll Work On

• Lead the annual and long-range GTM planning process, translating company growth goals and financial targets into an integrated operating plan across Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Customer Success, Product, and other GTM functions.

• Build and maintain the integrated GTM model connecting marketing investment, demand generation, pipeline, conversion, sales capacity, productivity, retention, expansion, product mix, and revenue outcomes.

• Connect top-down company objectives with bottom-up functional plans and assumptions, identifying gaps, trade-offs, and the actions required to create a credible path to the financial plan.

• Ensure Marketing and Revenue plans, investments, resources, and capacity ladder to shared GTM priorities and company objectives.

• Model performance across Justworks’ growth motions, including product-led and self-service acquisition, managed sales, inbound, outbound, partnerships, and customer expansion.

• Partner closely with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing spend by channel and program to expected demand, pipeline, bookings, CAC, payback, and return on investment.

• Own GTM forecasting and reforecasting processes, identifying performance gaps, underlying drivers, risks, and opportunities.

• Lead sales capacity, headcount, productivity, quota, and territory planning in partnership with Sales and Revenue Operations leadership.

• Develop scenario models that help executives evaluate trade-offs across investment, hiring, productivity, channel mix, product mix, and growth.

• Establish a consistent performance-management framework across the GTM organization, including shared definitions, metrics, reporting, and operating cadences.

• Turn performance into action by helping leadership determine when to adjust investments, capacity, priorities, execution, or underlying assumptions based on actual business results.

• Improve visibility into funnel economics and unit economics across channels incustomer segments, products, and sales motions.

• Support executive-level GTM reporting with clear insights into performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and required decisions.

• Partner closely with Finance to ensure the GTM operating plan and company financial plan remain tightly connected throughout the year.

• Support longer-range GTM strategy through scenario planning, business performance analysis, and evaluation of the conditions required to achieve future growth ambitions.

• Build a more automated and scalable planning and analytics environment, leveraging AI, automation, and modern data capabilities to reduce manual work and improve the speed and quality of decision-making.

• Lead and develop a high-performing GTM Planning & Analysis team.

What You’ll Bring

• Significant experience in GTM planning, strategic finance, FP&A, revenue strategy, Revenue Operations, or a related analytical leadership role.

• Demonstrated experience building integrated business or GTM plans that connect financial targets with functional operating assumptions and execution plans.

• Strong understanding of B2B SaaS or technology GTM models, including Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Customer Success, and expansion.

• Experience operating in a multi-motion environment that combines product-led or self-service growth with managed sales and partner-led channels.

• Strong understanding of the economics of a multi-product platform business and how product mix, customer behavior, acquisition motions, and investment decisions affect growth.

• Demonstrated ability to connect marketing investment to demand, pipeline, revenue, CAC, payback, and return on spend.

• Deep experience with forecasting, scenario modeling, capacity and productivity planning, resource allocation, and business performance management.

• Strong financial and analytical judgment, with the ability to move comfortably between detailed operating models and executive-level recommendations.

• Ability to reconcile top-down objectives with bottom-up assumptions, identify gaps or unrealistic expectations, and construct a credible path between the two.

• Ability to move from measurement to action by diagnosing performance, identifying underlying drivers, and recommending changes to plans, investments, or priorities.

• Strong executive communication skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into a small number of clear insights, trade-offs, and decisions.

• Ability to influence senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Customer Success, Product, and Finance.

• Comfort operating in a complex, evolving environment and creating structure where processes, definitions, or ownership may not yet be fully established.

• A bias toward simplification, automation, and scalable operating models.

• Experience building or leading high-performing analytical teams.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

• Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

What Success Looks Like

Justworks will have a single, integrated view of how we plan, fund, execute, and manage GTM growth.

Our financial plan and company strategy will translate into a clear GTM plan, with Marketing, Revenue, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Product operating from shared assumptions and priorities. Leaders will understand what investments and resources are required, what outcomes are expected, and how those outcomes contribute to company growth.

During the year, we will have a consistent view of performance across product-led, self-service, managed sales, partnerships, and customer growth motions. When results differ from plan, we will understand why and make deliberate decisions about what needs to change.

Ultimately, this role will create a more rigorous and dynamic planning discipline that enables Justworks to make faster, better decisions and continuously improve how we invest to drive durable growth.

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $212,000.00 - $274,000.00 per year.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-SP1
Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location. Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks .

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com . Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.

Our DEIB Report
