signals.title: Manager of Payroll and Benefits (Global)
signals.content:
TAKE YOUR CAREER TO NEW HEIGHTS WITH LOOPIO! 🚀✨



Loopio is seeking a global Manager of Payroll and Benefits to ensure the accurate and timely payment of our employees and the effective administration of our benefits programs across all of our regions. In this role, you will own the payroll and benefits function end to end, with the autonomy to manage day-to-day execution in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment. You will champion a positive employee experience and support and promote our competitive total rewards strategy.

You will report to the Chief People Officer and work closely with the Senior Director of Finance. As a member of the People team, you will at times work closely with Sales and Revenue Operations, especially for Variable compensation planning.

We run payroll in-house for employees in Canada, India, the UK and the US. You will have a strong working knowledge of payroll processing and statutory compliance in each of these jurisdictions, including tax withholding, remittances, and year-end reporting.



 Note: This is an existing vacancy on the team 




💻 WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Payroll
   
   - Prepare, process and review payroll accurately and on time for employees in Canada, the UK, India and the US, in line with the regulations of each country
   
   - Own and manage payroll operations end to end across all four jurisdictions, including pay calendars, data changes, off-cycle payments, terminations and final pay
   
   - Resolve pay issues quickly and handle sensitive conversations with employees and leaders with care and discretion
   
   - Own statutory remittances, filings and year-end reporting in every jurisdiction, including: Canada: CRA remittances, T4s and ROEs, provincial requirements such as Ontario EHT and workers’ compensation
   
   - UK: PAYE and National Insurance, HMRC Real Time Information (RTI) submissions, P60s, and workplace pension auto-enrolment
   
   - India: TDS and quarterly returns, Provident Fund, ESI, Professional Tax and Form 16
   
   - US: federal, state and local withholding, payroll tax deposits and quarterly filings, W-2s, and state unemployment
   
   - Ensure we meet every deadline and statutory obligation in each jurisdiction, and manage any government notices, registrations and audits
   
   - Complete and make all Commission and variable compensation plan calculations and payments (monthly and quarterly)

 - Benefits
   
   - Oversee the day-to-day administration of our health and benefits plans, including enrolments, carrier invoices and reconciliations, and renewals with our broker
   
   - Be the go-to expert for People Operations and employees on benefits questions, and provide a great Looper experience

 - Month-end close and variable compensation
   
   - Prepare and post payroll, bonus and commission accruals and other compensation and benefits journal entries each month
   
   - Reconcile payroll and benefits activity to the general ledger, across currencies and entities
   
   - Calculate variable compensation plans and commission accruals monthly, working closely with Sales and Revenue Operations

 - Reporting
   
   - Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual payroll and benefits reporting for People,  Finance and GTM  leaders (including ad hoc reports)

 - Controls, compliance and audit
   
   - Establish and maintain controls, payroll guidelines and procedures that keep us compliant with payroll and employment legislation
   
   - Support quarterly reporting and annual audit requests from external auditors
   
   - Stay current on changes to payroll legislation and tax law, and act on them before they affect our people

 - Continuous improvement
   
   - Look for ways to simplify and automate processes and reporting, including where AI can improve accuracy and speed
   
   - Create an updated Payroll & Benefits playbook, and contribute to various dashboards across People ops, Finance and at times other teams.
   
   - Take on ad hoc accounting projects and requests as needed
   
   - Ensure data is kept up to date for all Loopers on our internal sites and for all New Hires
     
     


✨ WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Must have
   
   - 7 years of experience managing payroll and benefits with global exposure/experience (Canada, ideally with exposure to India, UK and US)
   
   - Tech industry experience, preferably in
   
   - A Canadian Payroll Association designation (PCP or CPM) and up-to-date knowledge of Canadian payroll legislation and tax law
   
   - Experience with calculating and paying commissions and variable compensation
   
   - A thorough understanding of compensation and benefits regulations in Canada
   
   - Hands-on experience with month-end close, journal entries, accruals and supporting external audits
   
   - Advanced Google Sheets or Excel skills
   
   - Experience calculating commissions and variable compensation in a SaaS or sales-led business
   
   - Strong written and verbal communication, and the relationship skills to manage difficult conversations with empathy, honesty and confidentiality
   
   - The ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment without sacrificing accuracy
   
   - Curiosity about using automation and AI to improve payroll and reporting processes

 - Nice to have / Preferred experience
   
   - Experience with Dayforce, BambooHR, and Deel
   
   - Working knowledge of payroll and benefits requirements in the UK, US and India, or experience managing them through EOR and vendor partners




WHERE YOU’LL WORK 📍

 - We are currently looking only for candidates who live in the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding areas, where you can access our co-working space in Downtown Toronto for the occasional Team get-together.

 - Loopio is a remote-first workplace because we recognize the advantages of working flexibly. We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from.

 - Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in 🇨🇦 Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), 🇺🇲 US, 🇮🇳 India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru), and 🇬🇧 London.

 - The majority of our team is based in ON and BC, which means these employees live and work remotely within a 300km radius of Toronto (within Ontario) and Vancouver (Within BC). 

 - We offer flexible co-working locations available to Loopers in ON and BC. Those based in ON have the option of working out of our convenient co-working space located in the heart of Downtown Toronto and a 12-minute walk from Union Station. BC Loopers have the option to work centrally in Vancouver. It is whatever works best for you!

 - You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work 🙇🏾 during the workday

 - We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global #OneTeam!




WHY YOU’LL ♥️ WORKING AT LOOPIO

 - Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice https://lattice.com/e-lp/talent-products?utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid-search&utm_campaign=NOAM_Google_Search_Brand_Core_Tier_1__OCT-Conv-Test-HR&utm_adgroup=Brand_Core_Tier_1&attribution=lattice-mktg&_bt=645279480236&_bk=lattice&_bm=p&_bn=g&_bg=149106216630&cq_src=google_ads&cq_cmp=19577143427&cq_con=149106216630&cq_term=lattice&cq_med=&cq_plac=&cq_net=g&cq_plt=gp&qgad=645279480236&qgterm=lattice&gad_source=1&gclid=Cj0KCQiA-5a9BhCBARIsACwMkJ4OzbQBp30JTrxoLWSv3ht4C0NBeu9uyrTE7GCIu8D_lqBGuC3CG7kaAiWnEALw_wcB for our 1:1s and performance conversations  

 - You will have the opportunity to elevate 🪄 your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact.

 - We offer a wide range of health and wellness benefits https://loopio.com/perks-benefits/ to support your physical and mental well-being, starting day 1️⃣ with Loopio.

 - We’ll set you up to work remotely with a MacBook laptop 🍏, a monthly phone and internet subsidy, and a work-from-home budget to help get your home office all set up.  

 - We’ll give you a Claude account to experiment with, automate your routine tasks, and build tools so you can work smarter every day.

 - You’ll be joining a supportive culture that has thoughtfully built out opportunities for connections in a remote first environment.

 - Participate in 🎤 townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and company celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!

 - Our four  Employee Resource Groups https://loopio.com/annual-deib-report/ offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round. 

 - You’ll be a part of an award-winning workplace 🏆with an opportunity to make a big impact on the business.

Questioning your qualifications? Read this ‼️ Hi there, we recognize that all too often, potential candidates don’t apply for a position simply because they don’t hit every single criteria included in the job description—particularly members of underrepresented groups. 

Whether or not your experience ✅ checks off all the boxes on a job posting, we still encourage you to apply to ensure that your application receives a review from our team. We understand that a resume can only showcase so much during the applicant stage, so we've created prompts in the application for you to share more about yourself. If you've made a career transition (or a few!), you’re self taught in a new role, or you have skills/experience you’d like to highlight, we want to hear more about what you could bring to the table.



AI in Recruitment  👩🏻‍💻  At Loopio, we leverage  artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI  serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both  an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions  solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with  industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines



AI Usage in Interviews 🤖 The Loopio interview process is designed to help us better understand your professional experiences, as well as your unique perspective and approach to delivery and collaboration. To ensure a fair and accurate assessment, we expect candidates to refrain from using AI-generated content to produce responses to our interview questions during the live interview, as our goal is to evaluate your own knowledge and problem-solving abilities - not those of an AI assistant. If AI-generated responses are identified during the interview, Loopio reserves the right to disqualify candidates from the interview process.

For specific roles that include a take-home assignment, our AI Interviewee Policy allows the use of AI for initial support; however, the final submission must be a true reflection of your personal insights, skills and decision-making.



Loopio is an equal opportunity employer that is deeply committed to building equitable workplaces that are diverse and inclusive. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds and lifestyles to consider us as a future employer. Please contact a member of our Talent Experience team (work@loopio.com) should you require accommodations at any point during our virtual interview processes.

signals.title: Deal Desk
signals.content:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Linear is in a unique position—we are profitable, which gives us the flexibility to invest thoughtfully as we grow. We want to build a company that scales well—not just in our product, but in how we run our GTM programs. In this role, you’ll design and evolve the systems and process that power our deal desk process. This person will help build the mechanics behind our sales-led deals: quotes, order forms, pricing, discount approvals, and contract terms. A strong candidate has run quote-to-cash at a SaaS company and can spot where the process is slow, manual, or leaky.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America (west coast). We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the quote-to-order-form workflow: accurate quotes, correct terms, and a clean path from verbal yes to signed and billed

 - Build and run the deal approval and discount matrix, so Account Executives know what they can self-serve and what needs sign-off

 - Be the single point of contact for deal structuring questions that today land on Account Executives mid-deal

 - Partner with Finance and Legal to keep the order-to-cash process clean, controlled, and free of revenue leakage

 - Support usage-based and consumption deals as AI billing rolls out, from how they are quoted through the hand-off to billing

 - Find and remove manual work: automate what can be automated, document what needs to be documented

 - Help us get and stay audit ready by making sure deals are recorded correctly

What we're looking for

 - 3-5 years in deal desk, order management, revenue operations, or quote-to-cash, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

 - Strong command of the full quote-to-cash cycle, from pricing and approvals through order form and billing hand-off

 - Comfortable building process from scratch: workflows, approval logic, controls, and documentation, without a playbook handed to you

 - Sound judgment on the tradeoff between deal speed and control, and on sensitive pricing and deal information

 - A clear communicator who can hold a deal conversation with an Account Executive, Finance, and a customer, and have each one walk away with what they need

 - Proficiency with CRM and quoting tools; experience with usage-based billing, multi-currency, or CPQ is a strong plus

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $172,000—$220,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

signals.title: Principal GTM Operations Analyst
signals.content:
GTM Operations & Strategy at MongoDB is a global team of builders and innovators focused on unleashing MongoDB’s sales greatness by pairing world‑class analytics with scalable operations. Within GTM Operations, the GTM Intelligence - Applied Science team turns complex GTM data into tools, models, and insights that help our sales organization make better, faster decisions across our people, segmentation, territory design, forecasting, and account prioritization.

As a Principal Analyst on the Applied Science team, you will set the technical direction for our GTM model portfolio and personally lead our highest‑stakes programs, from framing problems with SVP‑level stakeholders, through data engineering and model design, to productionalized workflows, dashboards, and executive‑ready narratives that change how the field operates. This role will be based remotely Canada, and supports a global stakeholder set across regions and GTM functions.

What You’ll Do

Own the model portfolio and roadmap for one or more domains

• Set the multi‑quarter roadmap for a given GTM model portfolio domain, deciding what to build, retire, or invest in based on measured business impact

• Act as the senior analytical thought partner to GTM leadership, shaping which questions the team takes on, not just how it answers them

Translate GTM questions into analytical projects

• Partner with GTM Ops, Sales Strategy & Planning, Sales Leadership, and Central Analytics to scope problems, define success criteria, and prioritize work across areas like segmentation, territory design, account prioritization, and pipeline/forecast health

• Structure ambiguous questions into hypotheses, analytical plans, and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders (SVPs, RVPs, functional leaders)

Design and build scalable analytics & models

• Develop and maintain statistical and machine learning models (e.g., NARR prediction, deal qualification, account momentum, workload identification) that inform forecast expectations, territory assignments, and deal prioritization

• Engineer robust data pipelines and features (SQL/Python) on top of our GTM data stack (Salesforce, product usage, call transcripts, marketing signals, etc.) in partnership with data and platform teams

Own core GTM analytics assets

• Lead flagship programs such as Forecasting 3.0 / Atlas Forecasting Calculator, Customer 360 Revamp, GTM Metrics 3.0, and territory optimization initiatives, ensuring they are statistically sound, explainable, and operationally durable

• Build and govern self‑serve analytics assets (e.g., Sigma workbooks, curated datasets) that allow GTM stakeholders to answer their own questions safely and consistently

Measure and prove impact

• Design experiments, holdouts, and causal analyses that quantify the revenue and efficiency impact of our models and GTM investments, and make that evidence the basis for investment decisions

Turn analysis into decisions and change

• Deliver concise, executive‑ready narratives (memos, scorecards, and QBR/MBR content) that highlight trade‑offs and explicit recommendations, not just data and charts

• Run stakeholder working sessions to align on scenarios, validate model outcomes, and embed recommendations into operating rhythms (e.g., segmentation reviews, annual planning, forecast calls)

Advance our GTM data & AI foundations

• Define how we use new GTM data sources such as call transcript modeling, workload inference, and account intelligence to unlock novel scoring and routing use cases

• Set the standards for testing, monitoring, documentation, and change management of GTM models and analytics products, in partnership with Central Analytics and GTM Tech

Multiply the team

• Mentor analysts and data scientists, review their technical work, and raise the bar for rigor across our teams

• Create clear documentation, playbooks, and training to help other analysts and GTM stakeholders understand and safely use the models, tools, and datasets you own

• Contribute to a strong culture of technical rigor, peer review, and knowledge sharing within Sales Intelligence and the broader GTM Operations community

What We’re Looking For

Experience

• ~8-12+ years in analytics, sales operations, data science, or strategy/consulting roles supporting B2B or SaaS go‑to‑market teams (or equivalent high‑impact analytical experience)

• Demonstrated track record owning complex analytics projects end‑to‑end (from scoping through production deployment and stakeholder adoption), ideally in forecasting, segmentation/territory design, or account/deal scoring domains

• Track record of leading multi‑quarter, cross‑functional analytics programs and influencing executive decisions without direct authority

• Experience setting technical direction or standards for a team or a portfolio of production models

• Experience working directly with senior commercial stakeholders (e.g., Sales/GTM leaders) and turning analysis into concrete decisions and measurable business impact

Technical Skills

• Advanced SQL and strong Python (or equivalent) for data wrangling, feature engineering, and statistical / ML modeling

• Comfort working with large, messy datasets spanning CRM (Salesforce), product usage, and marketing/sales engagement tools

• Experience with at least one modern BI / analytics environment (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Tableau) and building self‑serve, governed assets for business users

• Solid grounding in statistical thinking (sampling, backtesting, lift/impact measurement) and model validation practices

• Experimentation and causal inference (e.g., A/B and holdout design, difference‑in‑differences, regression discontinuity)

• Experience with forecasting and time‑series models

Problem‑Solving & Communication

• Ability to decompose ambiguous business questions into structured analytical plans, with clear assumptions, risks, and trade‑offs

• Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain complex models and data decisions in simple, GTM‑friendly language and build trust with non‑technical stakeholders

• Bias toward action and ownership: you are comfortable making recommendations under uncertainty and iterating as new data arrives

Nice to Have

• Prior experience in Sales Operations / Revenue Operations or GTM Strategy at a high‑growth SaaS company

• Experience with commercial applications of NLP / LLMs (e.g., call transcript analytics, opportunity notes analysis)

• Familiarity with MongoDB’s ecosystem (Atlas, GTM motions, sales process) or similar modern cloud data platforms

• Experience contributing to cross‑functional programs such as Customer 360, self‑serve analytics initiatives, or GTM data/metrics standardization

About Team

The IT SaaS Engineering Team is the backbone of MongoDB's go-to-market operations. We build and run the Salesforce platform — with the automation, security, and governance that Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, and Compliance rely on daily to manage customer relationships and drive business growth.

Role Overview

Join us as a Senior Salesforce Engineer and take ownership of the CPQ and CLM systems that power MongoDB's quote-to-contract lifecycle. You'll design and build scalable pricing, quoting, and contract automation solutions end-to-end — from first design conversation to production support — working alongside senior engineers and stakeholders across Sales, Deal Desk, and Legal. This is a role for an engineer who enjoys solving hard technical problems, cares deeply about accuracy and compliance in revenue-critical systems, and wants to bring modern, AI-augmented development practices into how enterprise Q2C solutions get built.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, and maintain scalable CPQ configuration (product rules, price rules, bundles, discounting logic) and CLM workflows (clause libraries, approval chains, e-signature integration)

• Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance stakeholders to translate quote-to-cash requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions

• Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle — design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support

• Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, well-governed CPQ/CLM solutions in an Agile environment

• Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance

• Identify opportunities to simplify pricing logic, reduce legacy quote template debt, and strengthen the overall Q2C operating model

• Troubleshoot complex pricing, approval, or contract-generation issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes

• Stay current on CPQ/CLM platform capabilities and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality

• Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes, Claude Code, Cursor) to improve productivity, code quality, and documentation — with sound judgment on security, privacy, and responsible AI usage.

Responsibilities

• Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality CPQ/CLM solutions aligned with business and compliance needs

• Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across CPQ, CLM, and related integrations (ERP/billing)

• Investigate pricing, contract, and integration issues, working closely with development, operations, Deal Desk, and Legal teams to resolve them

• Communicate clearly with stakeholders on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution trade-offs

• Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery

• Research new CPQ/CLM platform capabilities and engineering approaches to improve the Q2C ecosystem

• Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed

• Contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

• 9+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering, with 3+ years specifically in CPQ and/or CLM implementation

• Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (product/price rules, quote templates, approval processes) and a CLM platform (Malbek, DocuSign CLM, Conga, or similar)

• Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and platform customization

• Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design

• Experience integrating CPQ/CLM with ERP/billing systems (NetSuite preferred)

• Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization

• Salesforce Platform Developer II (PD2) certification strongly preferred; Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification a plus; JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect certifications also valued

• Working knowledge of AI-powered and agentic development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes) and the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity and delivery

Success Measures

• In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders

• In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team

signals.title: Deal Strategy & Operations Lead
signals.content:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

Our largest customers are running more workloads on Modal than ever, and their deals are getting bigger and more creative. Increasingly, every major deal involves a pricing decision, a capacity decision, and a contract decision at the same time.

As the Deal Strategy & Operations Lead, you will own the commercial structure and economics of Modal’s largest and most complex deals from first proposal to signed contract. You will design deal structures that fit how customers actually use compute, work directly with customers on the terms that matter, set the guardrails that protect margin, and make sure what we sell lines up with what we can deliver. Your job is to help us close fast without giving away the economics.

You will work closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and Infrastructure. This is a chance to build Modal’s deal strategy function from the ground up, with a lot of scope and direct exposure to leadership.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

Deal strategy and structuring

 - Partner with Sales on Modal’s most strategic accounts to structure multi-workload, multi-year agreements

 - Design deals around how each customer’s usage actually behaves, blending flexible on-demand compute with committed and guaranteed capacity where it makes sense

 - Turn technical requirements into commercial terms, and adjust those terms as customers grow

 - Structure ramps, commitments, renewals, and other non-standard terms that help customers make Modal their primary platform

Customer negotiations

 - Join late-stage negotiations alongside Sales and represent Modal directly with customers’ finance, procurement, and engineering leaders

 - Explain the reasoning behind our pricing in ways that build trust, and know when to hold firm and when to trade

Pricing and commercial policy

 - Own the discounting framework, approval thresholds, and escalation paths for non-standard deals

 - Work with Product, Finance, and leadership to shape pricing and packaging for new products and hardware

 - Track deal outcomes and the competitive landscape, and turn what you learn into recommendations on pricing, packaging, and policy

Capacity-aware dealmaking

 - Connect the commercial pipeline to infrastructure planning so the commitments we make are commitments we can keep

 - Help shape how Modal makes fair, consistent capacity decisions as demand grows

Deal desk operations

 - Run the day-to-day flow of strategic deals, reviewing non-standard requests and keeping approvals moving

 - Build the playbooks, templates, and workflows (with RevOps, in Salesforce and CPQ) that let Sales move quickly without an exception on every deal. Use AI and automation heavily so the function scales

 - Work with Legal, Accounting, RevOps, and Billing so deals are contracted, booked, billed, and recognized correctly

Deal economics and analytics

 - Model deal profitability, margin, and the impact of discounts and terms, and bring clear recommendations to leadership on the deals that matter most

 - Track and report on the health of the function: deal velocity, approval turnaround, pricing discipline, and booking accuracy




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 5+ years in deal strategy, deal desk, pricing, strategic finance, investing, or revenue operations at a high-growth company, including several years structuring complex, non-standard deals

 - You have a track record of negotiating directly with customers on large deals, and the commercial judgment to know which terms matter

 - You have a deep understanding of usage-based pricing: commitments, drawdowns, tiered discounts, true-ups, and multi-year agreements. Experience with committed-capacity models is a strong plus

 - You have strong financial modeling skills. You are comfortable reasoning about unit economics, utilization, and margin tradeoffs

 - You have a working understanding of how deal terms flow through to billing and revenue recognition

 - You are able to act as both architect and operator: you can design the framework and then run the deal through it the same afternoon

 - You are able to influence senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Legal, with crisp written and verbal communication for executive audiences

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and building process from nothing in a fast-moving environment

 - You have proficiency with Salesforce and CPQ tools, and an instinct to automate anything you do more than twice




NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Experience at a cloud infrastructure, GPU, or AI infrastructure company

 - Familiarity with GPU and compute economics

 - Experience building a deal desk or deal strategy function from scratch at a high-growth company

 - Enough technical fluency to talk through workload requirements with a customer’s engineers

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Revenue Operations Manager with a strong track record, a builder’s mindset, and a bias for action to join our in-person team in London.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own the inbound lead routing process, partnering with Marketing to ensure proper attribution

 - Run territory management and strategy for geo-based decision-making

 - Support and strategize on every aspect of revenue operations in your territory

 - Own capacity forecasting strategy, including inputs, throughputs, and outputs, and serve as the conduit back to Finance in the US for effective capacity forecasting

 - Provide input and strategy on comp-based decisions and benchmarking

 - Support leadership on overall regional operations and finance strategy across all functions, including sales, presales, and ecosystem

 - Evaluate new tools on the market and be responsible for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales team

 - Build and maintain dashboards, leaderboards, and pipeline reporting to give leadership real-time visibility

 - Monitor deal progression and hold reps accountable for CRM hygiene and accuracy

 - Support deal reviews at the pricing and negotiation stages, coordinating with outside counsel as needed

 - Own the closed-won process from signature through handoff to post-sale

 - Administer commission plans across the sales org, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and serving as the source of truth for comp-related questions




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 3–7 years in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations at a high-growth, usage-based sales organization

 - You’ve built core GTM infrastructure before: lead routing, CRM architecture, pipeline reporting, commission administration, and deal desk

 - You have deep proficiency in CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and data hygiene

 - You’ve owned commissions end-to-end: building the model, calculating payouts, fielding rep disputes, and keeping it reconciled with Finance

 - You’ve run a deal desk, know what makes a contract clean, and catch errors before they become problems

 - You’re strong in Excel or Google Sheets: you can build a pipeline coverage model and know which metrics actually matter

 - You’ve earned trust with a sales team by making their lives easier while holding them accountable to process

 - You have a builder’s mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being asked twice

 - You can zoom out and think strategically while staying close enough to the work to get your hands on the keyboard

 - You have an AI-forward mindset: you actively use AI in your work and are excited to pioneer its use in go-to-market operations

 - You have strong communication and collaboration skills and earn trust across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

 - You’re a player-coach: you’re not above the details, and you’re excited to own the work yourself

Navan is seeking a Sr. Analyst of Deal Strategy to collaborate closely with our sales team in driving deal negotiations. • 3+ years of software industry experience, (Deal Desk, Finance, Sales Operations experience preferred)

• Customer facing experience preferred

• Strong eye for business and proven track record in commercial negotiations

• Self-motivated and able to work under pressure; diligent with deliverables and deadlines, able to multitask

• Solid understanding of software revenue recognition principles

• Basic understanding of commercial law

• Experience in contract management

• Excellent interpersonal skills – verbal and written

• Strong analytical skills along with the ability to demonstrate practical judgment in sophisticated situations

• Great leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact regularly with senior management

signals.title: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, Data Quality
signals.content:
Navan is modernizing the infrastructure of business travel, expense, and spend management — and data is central to that mission. We are seeking a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, Data Quality to own the integrity and trustworthiness of our go-to-market data, enabling Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to move faster and smarter.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, measuring, and improving the quality of GTM data across systems, with a focus on solving problems at the point of data creation. You’ll also own the integration and management of third-party data sources into our CRM, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and usability across the GTM tech stack.

You’ll partner cross-functionally with system owners, data analysts, and operations teams to build scalable data quality practices that support revenue growth and operational excellence. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on getting into the details of complex data problems while building processes and tooling that scale.

What You’ll Do:

• Own all phases of GTM data quality projects from project planning through execution and completion

• Define and maintain data quality rules, standards, metrics, and processes, including ROI calculations

• Build Data Quality dashboards and other methods to measure and report on data quality

• Lead the integration and maintenance of 3rd party data sources into our CRM , ensuring proper mapping, deduplication, and usage across systems

• Work cross-functionally to identify and fix data quality issues using sustainable and best-practice tools and processes

• Maintain a backlog of data quality issues, priorities, and status

• Investigate root causes of recurring issues and implement long-term, scalable solutions

• Collaborate across multiple stakeholders and elevate critical issues and blockers to leadership when necessary

• Lead the central design and operationalization of GTM territories in partnership with Sales Strategy, ensuring scalable, data-driven segmentation across geographies, segments, and roles

• Maintain clear, centralized documentation of territory logic, segmentation rules, and account assignment workflows to ensure transparency and consistency

• Build tools and dashboards to monitor territory coverage, account distribution, and rep capacity, enabling leadership to make informed planning decisions

What we’re looking for:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or equivalent

• 3+ years of Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, and/or Marketing Operations

• 3+ years of experience managing 3rd party data vendors or providers

• Experience owning 3rd party data integrations into a CRM, including field mapping, deduplication logic, and system performance impact

• 2-3+ years of experience developing complex SQL, including multi-table joins and analytical functions.

• Can confidently pass a live SQL interview assessment

• 3+ years interfacing with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms

• 3+ years managing projects end-to-end, including task definition, work estimation, and status reporting

• Experience solving for data quality problems in Salesforce

• Demonstrated ability to work in fast-paced, often ambiguous environments with adaptability and focus

Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced in SQL and other analytics tools Snowflake, BigQuery, Etc

• Experience with territory data management

• Experience working for a B2B SaaS or high-growth software company

• Prior exposure to 3rd party data strategy across a globally diverse user base

• Familiarity with ticketing systems like JIRA or ServiceNow

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the Japan/APAC region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with Japan leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local Japan markets and customers while providing support for other APAC priorities as needed.

 - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics

 - Build reporting and presentations for Japan/APAC sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organization

 - Act as a partner to the Japan/APAC sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

 - Enable smooth, efficient deal execution by supporting day-to-day deal operations, including opportunity hygiene, quote preparation, and coordination of approvals and internal handoffs, helping sellers navigate processes and remove friction throughout the deal lifecycle

 - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment

 - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the Japan/APAC sales org

 - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution

 - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modeling, territory carving, etc.

 - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

 - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue

 - Excellent analytical and quantitative modeling skills; ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results

 - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management

 - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly

 - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people

 - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality.

You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering.



This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust.

 - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure.

 - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices.

signals.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager - GTM Business Planning
signals.content:
At New Relic, we shape the future of intelligent observability, building technology that helps companies understand and optimize their complex systems. We are a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, mutual support, and solving hard technical challenges together. As we grow, we are looking for thoughtful problem-solvers ready to make a real impact.

That open, forward-thinking approach extends to how we hire. We actively work with modern AI tools every day and support candidates using them to prepare for interviews. To keep our process authentic and fair, please review our Candidate AI Interview Guide to see our general guidelines, including where AI is encouraged and what practices are prohibited before you apply.

About the Opportunity

New Relic is looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager – GTM Business Planning to own the operating system behind how we plan, pay, and scale our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. Sitting at the intersection of Sales, Finance, and Systems, you will architect the annual GTM plan, design incentive compensation programs, and govern processes across quota, territory, and comp data.

What You'll Do

• Quota Management & Strategy: Establish fair quota methodologies, manage ongoing adjustments for transfers/hires, and evaluate rep productivity to handle market shifts.

• Operations & Governance: Govern monthly sales compensation data within Salesforce and downstream systems to maintain audit-ready accuracy across territories and quotas.

• Systems & Automation: Own the deployment of annual territories and quotas in Salesforce, drive the roadmap for GTM planning systems, and lead automation initiatives to eliminate manual effort and scale operations.

This Role Requires

• B2B SaaS Experience: 6–8+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations, Sales Comp, FP&A, or GTM Strategy within high-growth, consumption-based B2B SaaS technology companies.

• Annual Planning Execution: Demonstrated success leading annual GTM planning cycles end-to-end (capacity modeling, territory carving, quota setting, and Salesforce deployment).

• Analytics & Technical Proficiency: Advanced expertise in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets), business intelligence platforms (Looker, Tableau), and Salesforce architecture (flow automation, custom objects, and schemas). Proven background collaborating with IT and Business Applications teams on CRM data structures and process automation.

• Builder & Leadership Mindset: A "zero-to-one" operator skilled at building scalable GTM systems, translating vague business problems into technical workflows, and leading cross-functional projects.

• Communication & Education: Exceptional stakeholder management and executive presentation skills, paired with a BS/BA degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a quantitative field.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience with AI-powered GTM tools for predictive scoring, forecasting, or territory carving.

• Intermediate SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or AWS data pipelines.

• Advanced degree (MBA or related master's).

signals.content:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

Reporting to the Director of Business Systems, the Salesforce Administrator will play a crucial role in ensuring the seamless and efficient execution of our Lead to Cash processes within the Salesforce ecosystem. The ideal candidate possesses hands-on SFDC configuration skills, with a particular emphasis on solution design and flows. This role will be involved with projects, small enhancements, troubleshooting bugs, and occasional project management. They must possess a service-oriented demeanor and a passion for working with Salesforce technology (and platform partners).

Your Mission

•
Configure and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, validation rules, and flows.

•
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Finance, Accounting, Operations) to clarify requirements and implement solutions that optimize the entire Lead to Cash process.

•
Ensure accurate data capture, validation, and processing, adhering to established business rules and standards

•
Enforce data security measures, including user access controls, data sharing rules, and field-level security.

•
Troubleshoot and resolve user-reported issues, collaborating with other technical teams when necessary

Continuous Improvement:

•
Stay up-to-date with Salesforce updates, new features, and best practices, and proactively recommend enhancements to the Lead to Order process.

•
Lead or participate in process improvement initiatives to drive efficiency and accuracy.

•
Designing and documenting a flexible, scalable, and robust state-of-the-art architecture for Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, E-commerce, and Partner systems.

•
Evaluating the scalability of proposed configuration changes to ensure they can handle future growth and changing business needs.

•
Providing advanced support for Salesforce requests and escalated administrative needs of users, which can include managing Epics (large bodies of work that can be broken down into smaller items), Tasks, Spikes (temporary work items to explore unknowns), Stories, and Bugs.

•
Overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for large deployments.

•
Keeping up to date with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices and making recommendations to management regarding their implementation.

You Are/Have

You are able to effectively communicate with stakeholders and maintain good working relationships with them. You are also able to scope internal customer requirements into scalable technical designs and lucidchart diagrams. The solutions you design do not reach System Governor limits, or reduce our proximity to them.

•
Salesforce Flows and know when to use a Before Save, After Save, Before Delete or Scheduled Flow, and when something should be in an Apex Trigger or Class rather than Flow.

•
Ability to QA configuration in a developer sandbox, promote it to a full copy sandbox for UAT, then release to Production

•
Complex Formula writing - able to write formulas for formula fields, validation rules, entry criteria, etc. that follow best practices and utilize the fewest characters to achieve the goal

•
5+ Years experience in a Salesforce Advanced Admin role

•
Bachelor's degree

•
Acknowledged expert in their designated offering. Demonstrates full competency and knowledge of two or more offerings within the function (CPQ, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, etc)

•
Proficiency in Salesforce Flows

•
Proficiency in writing Salesforce Validation Rules & Formulas

•
3+ Years experience in a Salesforce Admin role

•
Experience gathering requirements for Salesforce configuration

Extra Awesome

•
Experience working at a startup

About the Team

OpenAI's Compensation team plays a crucial role in rewarding and retaining world-class talent who will ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. By crafting and implementing innovative compensation strategies, we ensure our compensation offerings are competitive, equitable, and aligned with OpenAI's mission to scale intelligently and ethically.

About the Role

We are expanding our Compensation team and seeking a Compensation Business Partner to help build the compensation pillar for our go-to-market organization. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who brings deep GTM compensation expertise and enjoys turning evolving business needs into practical, scalable programs.

As a member of the total rewards team, you will partner closely with GTM leaders, HR Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. You will spearhead compensation work across benchmarking, offer review, program design, and job architecture, with particular focus on the needs of a rapidly growing commercial organization.

The shape of the work will evolve as the business grows. At times, you may independently lead key initiatives from strategy through execution. At other times, you will work alongside additional compensation partners and cross-functional resources. Success in this role requires comfort operating with ambiguity, strong judgment, and a willingness to stay close to the details while building for scale.

This is an individual contributor role, designed for a subject-matter expert and hands-on builder.

In this role, you will:

 - Build and evolve compensation programs that support OpenAI’s growing GTM organization.

 - Serve as a trusted compensation advisor to GTM leaders, HR Business Partners, Recruiting, and Finance.

 - Lead compensation analysis and approval for offers, balancing market context, internal consistency, and OpenAI’s compensation philosophy.

 - Own benchmarking and market analysis for GTM roles, translating insights into clear recommendations and scalable practices.

 - Partner on the design and optimization of sales compensation programs, job architecture, and related compensation frameworks.

 - Develop approaches that can flex with changing business priorities, organizational growth, and new talent needs.

 - Move fluidly between strategic design and hands-on execution, including building processes and operating mechanisms where they do not yet exist.

 - Collaborate with the broader Compensation team to share insights and strengthen company-wide programs.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 6+ years of compensation experience, including meaningful depth supporting GTM or commercial organizations.

 - Strong expertise in sales compensation, GTM benchmarking, and compensation program design.

 - Experience building or materially evolving compensation programs in a fast-growing, dynamic organization.

 - A builder mindset: you are energized by ambiguity and comfortable creating structure as the business evolves.

 - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate complex data into practical recommendations.

 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

 - The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a broader team.

 - Experience with job architecture is strongly preferred.

This role is based in our New York or San Francisco office and we aren’t considering remote applications at this time. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office with optional work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. We also offer relocation assistance to new employees.

signals.content:
About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a senior individual contributor to support revenue growth across the Americas (AMER) by helping sales teams structure and close commercially sound deals. You will balance speed and responsiveness with pricing discipline, consistent processes, and appropriate financial and commercial controls.

In this role, you will be the day-to-day Deal Operations partner for AMER account teams, reviewing pricing, discounts, and commercial terms across new business, renewals, and expansions. You will guide sellers through deal requirements, evaluate non-standard requests, and coordinate the approvals needed to move opportunities through contracting and closure.

You will also develop scalable workflows, guidance, and tools that improve deal turnaround times, documentation quality, and consistency across the region.

This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations, with Product and other teams engaged as needed, to resolve deal issues and support accurate execution from quote through contract and booking.

In this role, you will:

 - Serve as the primary Deal Operations contact for AMER account teams, managing deal intake, prioritizing requests, and guiding sellers through pricing, review, and approval processes.

 - Review quotes and proposed commercial terms, including discounts, payment schedules, contract duration, and customer commitments, for accuracy and alignment with pricing guidelines and commercial policies.

 - Build financial analyses and deal models to assess revenue, margin, discount impact, and profitability, and explain the tradeoffs of proposed deal structures to decision-makers.

 - Partner with Sales to structure deals that meet customer needs and OpenAI’s commercial objectives, recommending alternatives when proposed terms fall outside established guidelines.

 - Coordinate deal reviews and required approvals across Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations. Prepare clear recommendations, document decisions, and escalate exceptions to the appropriate stakeholders.

 - Identify risks in non-standard terms and work with Legal and Finance to resolve contractual, billing, and revenue recognition considerations before execution.

 - Maintain complete deal records and approval documentation in CRM, CPQ, and contract management systems, and partner with Revenue Operations to align approved terms, executed agreements, and booking information.

 - Help develop and maintain deal approval policies, escalation paths, pricing guidance, and standardized templates. Improve workflows to reduce bottlenecks while maintaining appropriate controls.

 - Equip sellers with practical guidance and training on deal requirements and approval processes. Apply AI and automation to improve deal intake, knowledge retrieval, and self-service support.

 - Track Deal Desk metrics such as turnaround time, approval bottlenecks, exception trends, and quote accuracy. Use recurring deal patterns to recommend improvements to commercial policies, processes, and tools.

 - 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, commercial finance, pricing, sales operations, or a related function, preferably in a high-growth technology environment.

 - Hands-on experience reviewing and structuring complex enterprise deals and supporting quoting, commercial approvals, and contracting processes.

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience assessing pricing, discounts, revenue, margins, and deal profitability.

 - Knowledge of enterprise software commercial terms and subscription or consumption-based business models, with the judgment to identify issues that require Legal or Finance review.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain commercial tradeoffs, make clear recommendations, and coordinate timely decisions across teams.

 - Experience with CRM systems, configure-price-quote (CPQ) tools, and contract management platforms, along with strong spreadsheet skills.

 - Attention to detail and a track record of improving approval workflows, documentation, and operational processes as a business scales.

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking a Director, Sales & Customer Success Operations – Americas to serve as a senior operator and trusted advisor to our Americas Sales and Customer Success leadership. Reporting to the VP, Field Operations, you will lead sales planning and translate company strategy into a scalable, repeatable Americas go-to-market engine spanning the full customer lifecycle across Commercial, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. This role looks beyond the current quarter: you will anticipate what the business needs next quarter, next fiscal year, and beyond, while running the operating cadence and forecast rigor that keep the region on track today.

You will lead a team of sales and customer success operations professionals and a portfolio of strategic go-to-market initiatives. You will not own the sales or customer success technology stack; instead, you will partner closely with IT, Applications, and other stakeholders to evolve the processes and systems that support the Americas Sales and Customer Success organizations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :

Sales Operations

• Partner with Sales leadership to execute on key imperatives

• Drive seller productivity and remove friction from the sales motion

• Run the operating cadence: forecast calls, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, QBRs, exec readouts

• Improve forecast accuracy and pipeline health

• Support the design of overage models, territories, segmentation, quotas, and capacity planning

• Support Sales compensation, headcount, and incentive design with Finance and People

•

• Serve as the primary strategic and operating partner to Americas Sales leadership, translating company and regional priorities into clear plans and driving execution on key business imperatives.

• Own the Americas sales operating cadence, including weekly forecast calls, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, QBRs, and executive performance readouts, with clear insights, actions, and accountability.

• Drive seller and front-line manager productivity by identifying friction in the sales motion, simplifying processes, and scaling best practices across segments.

• Improve forecast accuracy and pipeline health through consistent inspection standards, stage definitions, and leading-indicator reporting.

• Look ahead across quarters to anticipate business performance, pipeline coverage, and resource needs, and recommend actions before gaps emerge.

Customer Success Operations

• Serve as the operating partner to Americas Customer Success leadership on retention, adoption, and expansion priorities.

• Own Customer Success operating metrics and reporting (gross and net revenue retention, churn, renewal rates, expansion, adoption, and customer health) and drive the actions that improve them.

• Design and operationalize customer lifecycle processes, including Sales-to-CS handoffs, onboarding, health scoring, success planning, renewal management, and escalation/risk playbooks.

• Own renewal and retention forecasting and CSM book-of-business design, including customer-to-CSM coverage ratios.

• Own CS metrics: GRR/NRR, churn, renewals, expansion, adoption, and health

• Lifecycle processes: Sales-to-CS handoff, onboarding, health scoring, success plans, renewals, risk playbooks

• CSM book-of-business design and coverage ratios

• Improve renewal and retention forecasting

• Support CS compensation, headcount, and incentive design with Finance and People

Insights, Systems & Leadership

• Translate complex plans into compelling narratives for the VP, Field Operations, Americas Sales and CS leadership, and the Executive Leadership Team.

• Identify bottlenecks and streamline processes to improve decision speed, seller productivity, and CSM efficiency, including where AI and automation can help.

• Partner with IT, Applications, and other stakeholders to evolve the processes and tools supporting Americas Sales and CS, defining requirements and priorities without owning the systems roadmap.

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of sales and customer success operations and strategy professionals.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in GTM strategy and operations, ideally in the cloud computing space

• They will have a passion for problem-solving and an ability to think strategically and execute methodically, while identifying the root cause for the identified problems

• They should have an aptitude for analytics and data-driven decision-making, and a proven track record of driving successful GTM strategies that include both Product Led Growth and Enterprise Selling motions

• Demonstrated willingness to perform basic tasks such as creating analytics and writing communications, while also conducting sophisticated work for Senior Executives

• Curiosity about business and customers (why do customers do what they do); customer-focused in running Strategy & Operations

• Understanding of various sales tools, how to leverage them effectively, and consult GTM stakeholders on how to properly leverage them to maximize efficiency and selling motions

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

•
10+ years in management consulting, sales, customer success, or business operations, GTM strategy, or business planning in enterprise software or large-scale tech

• SaaS/Consumption experience with deep understanding of ARR and consumption models and their metrics (bookings, pipeline coverage, GRR/NRR, churn, expansion)

• 3+ years of direct people management leading sales ops, CS ops, strategy, or analytics teams

• Track record leading sales planning and running the sales operating cadence with senior Sales leaders

• Track record driving new-business and renewal forecasting, pipeline analytics, and performance governance with senior Sales and CS leaders

• Coverage models, territory and book-of-business governance, quota setting, and capacity planning for a multi-segment Sales and CS org

• Customer lifecycle programs: health scoring, onboarding, renewal management, churn mitigation

• Strong command of metrics and business modeling

• Executive-level communication with VP- and C-level audiences

• Hands-on operator balancing strategy and execution

• Translating business needs into requirements for IT and Applications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• MBA or equivalent advanced degree

• Management consulting or corporate strategy experience in GTM, sales effectiveness, or customer retention

• Business Manager, Chief of Staff, or operating leader supporting Sales or CS executives

• Managing a portfolio of 6–12 month initiatives in a matrixed org

• Building scaled or digital CS motions for long-tail segments

• Using AI tools to improve analysis, forecasting, or workflows

• Salesforce, Tableau, Anaplan, Gong, Snowflake

The base salary range for this position is 147,000 - 246,400 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

PagerDuty is a flexible, hybrid workplace. We embrace and encourage in-person working as an integral part of our culture. Both our employees and external research tells us that co-located collaboration strengthens connections, drives innovation, and accelerates learning.

This role is expected to come into our San Francisco office two times per week , so you can thrive in your new role and fully embrace being a Dutonian!
Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts !

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site .

Your package may include:

• Competitive salary

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Flexible work arrangements

• Company equity*

• ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*

• Retirement or pension plan*

• Generous paid vacation time

• Paid holidays and sick leave

• Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO

• Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*

• Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year

• Company-wide hack weeks

• Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.
