signals.title: GTM Technology Engineer
signals.content:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The GTM Technology team sits within GTM Operations and owns the systems, architecture, and automation that power Plaid's go-to-market motion — Salesforce administration and platform architecture, quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash data integrity, and the evaluation and rollout of new GTM tooling, including AI and agentic tooling. We partner closely with Sales, Finance, and Engineering to make sure the systems behind revenue are accurate, scalable, and increasingly automated.

We're hiring a GTM Technology Engineer to help build and maintain the technical backbone of our GTM systems. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can write production-quality Salesforce code (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL), design clean integrations across our GTM stack (Salesforce, CPQ, contract lifecycle management, sales engagement, data warehouse, and more), and bring an AI-forward, builder mentality to how we automate and scale GTM Operations workflows.

You'll work on everything from diagnosing and fixing Apex logic that drives revenue-critical fields, to building integrations that connect Salesforce with adjacent platforms, to designing and deploying AI-powered agents and automations (using LLM APIs, MCP servers, and agentic workflows) that remove manual work from the GTM org. You'll report into GTM Technology and work alongside Salesforce architects, GTM Operations partners, and Engineering.

Responsibilities

 - Salesforce development: Design, build, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Flows that support core GTM processes.

 - Data integrity & diagnostics: Investigate and resolve issues in revenue-critical Apex services, tracing root causes across triggers, flows, and integration touchpoints.

 - Cross-platform integration: Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM stack (CPQ, CLM/contract tools, sales engagement platforms, data enrichment tools, data warehouse) using middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Tray.io http://Tray.io), REST/SOAP APIs, and event-driven patterns.

 - AI & automation: Prototype and productionize AI-assisted workflows — using LLM APIs, Salesforce-hosted MCP servers, and agentic tooling — to automate manual RevOps processes (deal reviews, data QA, reporting, triage).

 - Platform architecture: Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions (data model, sharing model, integration patterns, CI/CD via tools like Copado, Gearset) that keep the org scalable as Plaid's GTM motion grows.

 - Partnership: Work directly with RevOps, Deal Desk, Sales leadership, and Engineering to translate business requirements into reliable, well-tested technical solutions.

 - Quality & governance: Write testable, documented code; participate in code review and release management; support SOX/ITGC controls relevant to revenue systems where applicable.

Requirements

 - 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience — Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP, platform events, middleware).

 - Experience with CPQ (Salesforce CPQ or similar) and a working understanding of quote-to-cash / lead-to-cash data flows.

 - Hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-powered workflows, agentic systems, or LLM-backed automations that improve operational efficiency — building with AI tools, not just using them.

 - Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills — comfortable tracing a data issue from a Salesforce field back through Apex logic, automation, and upstream integrations.

 - Experience with integration/middleware platforms (MuleSoft, Tray.io http://Tray.io, Workato, or similar) and modern API design.

 - Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), CI/CD, testing discipline, and code review practices.

 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills — comfortable working directly with GTM Operations, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance stakeholders to gather requirements and explain technical tradeoffs.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a proactive, builder-oriented mindset.

 - Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect) are a plus but not required.
   
   

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.



Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice.


Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

signals.title: Senior Customer Success Operations Manager
signals.content:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.


About the Role
We're looking for a Customer Success Operations Manager to own the strategy, planning, and operational backbone of our CS organization. This role focuses on how CS plans, runs, and aligns, building the rhythms, workflows, and cross-functional connections that let the team scale efficiently while delivering a great customer experience.

This is a hybrid role based either in our Paris office or NY office.

What You'll Do
Strategy & Planning

• Partner with CS leadership to set direction and keep the org running on a predictable cadence.

•
Partner with CS leadership on planning, territory design, and segmentation strategy

•
Collaborate with the Data & Analytics team on annual target setting and capacity modeling

•
Lead annual and quarterly planning for CS priorities and operational initiatives

•
Build and run operating rhythms, including QBRs, forecast and business reviews, and planning cycles

Operational Excellence

• Shape how the team engages with customers across the full lifecycle.

•
Own and manage CS Platform as a core part of the CS tech stack

•
Design and refine the CS workflow across the customer journey

•
Build scalable playbooks and engagement models (onboarding, adoption, renewals, expansion, risk management)

•
Design incentive compensation that optimizes customer outcomes

Cross-Functional Alignment

•
Drive collaboration between CS, Professional Services, Sales, Product, and Marketing to operationalize clear roles and responsibilities that enable seamless handoffs, actionable voice-of-customer insights, and value-driven expansion motions

AI, Workflows and Automations

•
Drive adoption of AI and automation across the CS team to streamline workflows and scale CSM capacity

Who You Are
•
5-8 years of Operations experience in Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations in a SaaS or high-growth tech environment

•
Proven experience designing and implementing CS systems, workflows, and success metrics, and AI-driven automations in a mature ($100M+ ARR) revenue organization

•

signals.title: Principal Analyst, Revenue Operations Strategy
signals.content:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Principal Analyst II Revenue Strategy & Operations, (North America)

Why We Have This Role

The Revenue Strategy & Operations team ensures that our global sales/revenue organization is positioned to achieve their highest potential by optimizing revenue opportunities across the globe. We do this by leveraging data from many sources, including internal customer purchasing and usage information as well as firmographic, technographic, and intent data from 3rd party sources. We set high targets for our revenue teams and work to exceed them every quarter. Part of our success comes from having world-class business processes, systems, and tools. We love data and we love to show results in the form of more Sales success. We have impressive members on this team, and will continue to add more top talent!

Qualtrics is seeking a Field Operations partner to support our North America Sales Teams, responsible for setting new business and renewal targets, optimizing territories to ensure the greatest opportunity for each individual rep's success, and leading other key strategic revenue-enhancing initiatives.

How You’ll Find Success

• Love working with data and learning new things

• Love helping others find solutions to problems

• Excellent problem solving, decision-making and analytical skills

• Ability to collaborate with teams across the organization while also being able to work independently and as a self-starter

• Proven ability to meet aggressive deadlines

How You’ll Grow

• Leadership Exposure: significant exposure to key leaders in the North America Sales Organization providing the opportunity to work closely with them as a trusted advisor. Helping you develop strong leadership and communication skills, as well as a deep understanding of the company's strategic vision.

• Strategic Thinking: The role involves collaborating with leadership to develop and implement go-to-market strategies. This strategic involvement will allow you to expand your strategic thinking and planning capabilities, which are highly valuable skills for career growth.

• GTM (Go-To-Market) Expertise: As the role involves working closely with sales & success leaders and monitoring performance metrics, it provides an ideal environment for someone looking to deepen their understanding of the GTM processes and methodologies.

Things You’ll Do

• Serve as trusted advisor to Sales leadership, shaping go-to-market strategy that aligns with company objectives.

• Drive forecasting rigor across all deals, with emphasis on large, multi-stakeholder deals - including multi-threading analysis and executive sponsorship visibility.

• Monitor named-account pipeline, opportunity progression, and win/loss patterns; partner with leaders to close performance gaps.

• Own annual and quarterly GTM planning - business modeling, quota setting, and named-account/strategic territory design.

• Partner with Deal Desk and Legal on negotiation strategy for large, complex opportunities.

• Drive adoption of tools, processes, and operating rhythms - including executive-level deal reviews - from front line to senior leadership.

• Build cross-functional relationships with Finance, Marketing, Enablement, and Ecosystem teams to align strategy with execution.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• 8+ years of relevant experience in Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, or Management Consulting with a focus on the following: Forecasting, go-to-market (GTM) execution, sales compensation and incentive plan creation, and partnering with senior sales leaders

• At least 5 years of experience in the software industry and cloud platform businesses

• Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting and analytics experience required

• Experience with Power BI or Tableau, or other data visualization tools

What You Should Know About This Team

• This team is very tenured at Qualtrics (average 6 years) and has great relationships in various departments

• We play a key role across teams and departments at Qualtrics and get to work on important projects that have regular executive level visibility

• Small close-knit team that enjoys working with each other and working on a variety of different projects that ta

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Workspaces: We have quiet spaces to take a call or for deep thinking, and other spaces dedicated to collaboration.

• Commuter Benefits: We offer a generous monthly allowance to be used for transportation and to help you commute to the office.

• Wellness Reimbursement: This can be put toward wellness activities including gym memberships, spa massages, workout equipment, meditation apps, and much more.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

signals.title: Deal Desk Lead
signals.content:
We’re looking for a Deal Desk Lead to help our GTM teams structure and close deals that support durable revenue growth. You’ll partner with the field, the Head of Revenue Operations, and Finance and Legal leadership to balance customer needs with company priorities.

You’ll own Deal Desk end to end and build the team as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who moves with urgency and finds workable solutions, not simply obstacles or approval paths.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with the field: Engage early on complex opportunities, understand customer needs, and remove obstacles to close. Bring Sales, Finance, and Legal together to resolve issues quickly.

 - Structure deals and balance trade-offs: Shape pricing, discounts, commitments, and payment terms. Weigh customer value, revenue, profitability, and risk, offering practical alternatives rather than a simple yes or no.

 - Own review and approvals: Run a responsive process for nonstandard deals and exceptions. Apply policies consistently and escalate decisions beyond your authority with clear options and a recommendation.

 - Ensure accurate execution: Ensure quotes, order forms, approvals, and CRM records reflect agreed terms. Resolve discrepancies before signature and enable clean handoffs to billing and post-sale teams.

 - Own quote-to-order requirements and delivery: Define business requirements, priorities, and acceptance criteria for quote-to-order workflows. Hold Systems accountable for building and delivering against them, owning business acceptance testing and sign-off.

 - Scale the function: Build playbooks, approval frameworks, and field enablement that reduce recurring friction. Use deal and exception patterns to recommend improvements to pricing and commercial policy. Hire, coach, and develop the Deal Desk team as the business grows.
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Relevant experience: 4+ years in Deal Desk, commercial operations, or a related function in SaaS or another high-growth industry, including complex deal structuring and approvals.

 - Exceptional business partnership: A track record of earning Sales’ trust through responsiveness, practical solutions, and sound commercial judgment that protects the business.

 - Autonomy and extreme ownership: The ability to prioritize independently, surface risks early, and drive issues to resolution without close supervision.

 - Commercial judgment and precision: Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail across deal economics, terms, and documentation, even under tight deadlines. You distinguish material risks from issues that should not hold up a deal.

 - Tact and communication: The ability to handle Sales exception and clarification requests tactfully, influence stakeholders, and escalate to senior leadership appropriately.

 - Hands-on systems expertise: Experience with CRM, quoting or CPQ tools, and approval workflows, plus the ability to translate field needs into actionable business requirements.

 - AI perspective and drive: A strong perspective on how AI is changing traditional quote-to-order workflows, and a passion for putting that perspective into practice across the business.

 - People management: Experience managing and developing direct reports, with the ability to build a team while remaining hands-on.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Evolving business models: Experience with consumption-based, usage-based, or hybrid subscription models.

 - Enterprise complexity: Experience with enterprise procurement and multiyear agreements.

signals.title: Manager, Planning & Strategic Operations
signals.content:
About the Team

Rubrik's Renewal Strategy & Operations team protects one of the most valuable, fastest-compounding assets in enterprise software: $1.57 billion in subscription ARR, growing 32% year-over-year. Every one of those dollars sitsinside a renewal contract - which means protecting and compounding that ARR is one of the highest-leverage jobs in the company.

Renewal Strategy & Operations is the team that builds the operating system for that asset. We sit at the intersection of commercial strategy, systems, and execution, and we are genuinely in a 0-to-1 build phase - the forecasting models, governance frameworks, quoting infrastructure, and playbooks that will run this business at 2x today's scale don't fully exist yet. That's the work: you will be designing the machine.

You'll bring a strategic voice that understands renewals as a business - thinking in terms of root cause, leverage points, and scalable systems. You'll partner directly with Sales, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and IT leaders, and your fingerprints will be on the foundation this function runs on for years.

What You'll Do

Be a strategic partner to the business

• Act as a direct strategic and analytical partner to the Senior Director, translating renewal metrics (ARR retention, churn, NRR/GRR, pipeline coverage) into a narrative leadership can act on.

• Shape how the business talks about renewals in QBRs, and leadership reviews: what matters, why, and what we're doing about it.

Architect the systems this business will run on

• Take end-to-end ownership of how renewal workflows, forecasting models, and quoting frameworks are designed - not just monitored - including multi-year, co-term, and mid-term expansion structures built to maximize ARR retention at scale.

• Build the playbooks, governance frameworks, and standard operating procedures that don't exist yet, with an eye toward what this function needs to look like in two years, not just this quarter.

Own governance and quality as a system

• Run quote governance and data quality as a discipline: root-causing discrepancies across CRM and renewal systems and building the controls that prevent them from recurring.

• Partner with IT and RevOps to define what the systems and automation should actually do, rather than reacting to what they currently do.

Lead cross-functionally, with real ownership

• Be the primary liaison between Renewals Operations and BI/Data teams, and a trusted partner to Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success on renewal goals, definitions, and standards.

• Bring structured thinking to new GTM programs and strategic initiatives - this role is expected to shape strategy, not just support it.

Who You Are

• 6+ years in a strategy consulting, Strategy & Operations at a high-growth or large-scale tech company, or Sales/Renewal Strategy & Operations in a hyper-growth SaaS business - the common thread is structured problem-solving in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

• You see yourself as an operator and builder - someone who wants to put foundations under a business that will still be standing at 2x the scale.

• A structured, first-principles thinker: you can walk into ambiguity, build the framework, and drive it through to execution.

• Strong independent project management instincts: you can define scope, sequence dependencies, manage risk, and drive multiple concurrent initiatives without close oversight.

• Strong communicator, equally effective presenting to senior finance leadership and working through details with an individual analyst.

• B.A./B.S. required; MBA a plus.

• Nice to have: exposure to CPQ tools (Salesforce CPQ), forecasting platforms like Clari, SaaS renewal metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR, churn), or SQL/Python for ad hoc analysis.

signals.title: Sales Operations - Senior Analyst (Japan)
signals.content:
Sales Operations - Senior Analyst (Japan)

Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing enterprise cybersecurity companies. We are looking for a Sales Operations Senior Analyst to lead Japan, one of our key markets. Reporting to the Senior Director of International Sales Strategy, you will be the strategic business partner for Japan. You will design and execute a world-class go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure that scales with our rapid growth. This is a high-impact manager role at the intersection of strategy, finance and regional sales execution.

Rubrikは、急成長を続けるエンタープライズ向けサイバーセキュリティ企業の一社です(ARR 15億ドル、前年比34%成長)。このたび、主要市場である日本を担当するストラテジーマネージャーを募集します。International Sales Strategy担当シニアディレクターにレポートし、日本市場のストラテジック・ビジネスパートナーとして、当社の急成長に合わせてスケールする世界水準のGTM(Go-to-Market)基盤を設計・実行していただきます。戦略、ファイナンス、現場の営業実行が交わる、インパクトの大きいマネージャーポジションです。

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Strategic GTM Leadership: Define and lead the Japan sales strategy, giving the Japan Country Manager and executive leadership data-driven insights to optimize investment and market expansion.

• Territory and Capacity Architecture: Lead annual and long-range planning for Japan, including territory design, headcount capacity models and market segmentation by industry and customer tier.

• Incentive and Quota Strategy: Design and govern a repeatable, data-driven quota allocation process (including JPY and USD considerations), aligning corporate financial targets with field motivation.

• Operational Excellence: Own Japan’s “Rhythm of the Business,” including the forecast process, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and pipeline hygiene, to ensure high predictability.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner with Global Ops, Finance, Marketing and HR so that Japan’s specific needs are reflected in global systems and process rollouts.

• Team Leadership: Build, mentor and lead a high-performing team of Sales Operations professionals, fostering a culture of excellence and analytical rigor.

主な業務内容

• GTM戦略のリーダーシップ: 日本の営業戦略を策定・推進し、カントリーマネージャーおよび経営層に対して、投資の最適化と市場拡大に向けたデータに基づく示唆を提供します。

• テリトリーとキャパシティの設計: 日本市場の年次および中長期の計画プロセスを主導し、テリトリー設計、人員キャパシティモデル、業界・顧客階層別のセグメンテーションを統括します。

• インセンティブとクォータの戦略: 円・米ドルの両面を考慮した、再現性のあるデータドリブンなクォータ配分プロセスを設計・管理し、全社の財務目標と現場のモチベーションを整合させます。

• オペレーショナル・エクセレンス: フォーキャストプロセス、四半期ビジネスレビュー(QBR)、パイプライン管理を含む日本の「ビジネスのリズム」を統括し、高い予測精度を実現します。

• 部門横断の連携: グローバルオペレーション、ファイナンス、マーケティング、人事と連携し、日本特有のニーズがグローバルのシステムやプロセス導入に反映されるようにします。

• チームのリーダーシップ: 高いパフォーマンスを発揮するセールスオペレーション担当チームを育成・指導・統率し、卓越性と分析的な厳密さを重んじる文化を醸成します。

REQUIRED TRAITS

• Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to influence and challenge senior leaders, and comfortable being the “voice of truth” in the room.

• Mindset: Deep understanding of the Japan market, including employment practices, currency impacts and local business customs.

• Strategic Architect: You don’t just report on the business. You identify the systemic levers that will drive the next $3B in revenue.

• Operational Resilience: Proven ability to stay steady in a hyper-growth, high-stakes environment while managing competing priorities.

• Change Agent: Experience leading large-scale organizational transformations and system implementations across borders.

求められる資質

• エグゼクティブプレゼンス: シニアリーダーに影響を与え、時に率直に異議を唱えることができ、その場で「真実を語る存在」であることに抵抗がない方。

• マインドセット: 日本の雇用慣行、為替の影響、日本特有のビジネス慣習など、日本市場のニュアンスを深く理解している方。

• 戦略的アーキテクト: 事業を報告するだけでなく、次の30億ドルの売上を生み出す構造的なレバーを見つけ出せる方。

• オペレーションの強靱さ: 急成長かつ重要度の高い環境で、競合する優先事項を管理しながら冷静に推進できる実績のある方。

• チェンジエージェント: 国境を越えた大規模な組織変革やシステム導入をリードした経験のある方。

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• 7+ years in Sales Operations or Business Operations in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise software environment.

• 5+ years of leadership experience managing teams in a regional capacity.

• Expert knowledge of Salesforce, Clari and Pigment (or similar SPM tools). Experience using AI/ML for predictive forecasting is a plus.

• Advanced financial modeling skills and a track record of using data to drive significant ROI in sales productivity.

• Undergraduate degree required.

必須のスキルと経験

• 急成長中のSaaSまたはエンタープライズソフトウェア企業での、セールスオペレーションまたはビジネスオペレーションの経験7年以上。

• 地域単位でのチームマネジメントを含む、リーダーシップ経験5年以上。

• Salesforce、Clari、Pigment(または同等のSPMツール)に関する高度な知識。AI/MLを活用した予測フォーキャストの経験は歓迎。

• 高度な財務モデリングスキルと、データを活用して営業生産性で大きなROIを生み出した実績。

• 大学卒業以上の学歴。

signals.title: Senior Manager, Quoting Strategy & Operations
signals.content:
About the team:

Our team sits at the center of how Rubrik goes to market. We own the quote-to-cash experience for Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance, from renewals and replacements to approvals and new commercial models. We're building the next generation AI-powered quoting experience that gives reps accurate quotes quickly, without manual cases or guesswork.

We work across Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, Product, and IT, turning complex business scenarios into clear requirements, roadmaps, and shipped capabilities. The work is varied and high-impact. From defining how an AI agent should handle re contracting, to optimizing approval SLAs and new product launch.

We value clear thinking, ownership, and a bias for building things that make the field's job easier. If you like untangling complex systems and shaping how AI changes the way a company sells, you'll feel at home here.

What you'll do:

• Own the roadmap and delivery for Quote-to-Cash systems and AI-enabled quoting, in line with GTM strategy and product portfolio expansion

• Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT, and Product on priorities and tradeoffs, escalating to leadership where decisions are needed

• Lead a team of business analysts and operations managers; set clear expectations, coach for growth, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

• Run and continuously improve the Quote-to-Cash operating model, including processes, data standards, and governance that reduce field friction, improve sales velocity, and ensure quote accuracy

• Design solutions that support NPI, bundling, and commercial innovation, enabling faster launches without compromising operational integrity

• Partner with Sales and GTM leaders to identify and deliver improvements that increase seller productivity, shorten deal cycles, and improve the quoting experience

• Own performance reporting, including KPIs and dashboards on quote health, adoption, and operational efficiency

• Evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI-enabled quoting; build business cases, recommend and lead pilots and implementations, and propose guardrails for what can be automated versus what needs human review

• Partner with IT, Legal, and Finance on data quality, auditability, and risk controls for new capabilities

• Lead change management for new processes and releases, including training, communications, and enablement for global Sales and Operations teams

• Contribute to cross-functional planning forums and leadership reviews, connecting Quote-to-Cash performance to business outcomes

Experience you'll need:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in Sales, Revenue, or Deal Operations, with deep expertise in the quote-to-order lifecycle, including pricing, quoting, approvals, and renewals

• Experience building and scaling quoting and commercial capabilities in high-growth SaaS environments, from design through adoption

• Strong financial and business acumen; able to translate pricing strategies, business models, and GTM motions into scalable quoting solutions

• Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to quoting and deal workflows, such as AI-assisted or agentic quoting, with a practical understanding of where AI adds value and where human control is needed

• Working knowledge of quoting and commercial systems (e.g., Salesforce CPQ) with the ability to guide solution design and hold technical partners to best practices

• Proven track record of delivering large systems and process programs, working across Sales, Finance, Legal, IT, and Product

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to influence senior leaders, synthesize complexity into clear recommendations, and escalate decisions effectively

• 4+ years of people management experience, including leading teams of analysts and/or managers in a fast-paced environment

• Strong command of data modeling, revenue analytics, and business intelligence to inform priorities and performance; comfort with data quality and master data as foundations for reliable AI outputs

• Experience with master data management, pricing governance, and revenue recognition considerations in a SaaS or subscription business is strongly preferred

The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

signals.title: Director, Revenue Operations
signals.content:
At Sanity.io http://Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

Sanity's go-to-market motion runs on the systems, data and process that Revenue Operations owns. As Director, Revenue Operations, you'll own that end to end and will be responsible to build automation into every process and system.  You will take an AI-first mindset to build and maintain a modern Revenue Operations operating system from lead to close. This role will set the example across the GTM function on building with AI to streamline the business. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead a small team, and you'll also be in the systems yourself. You'll design the architecture and you'll build it. You'll report to the VP of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Enablement.




WHAT YOU WOULD DO:

AI Strategy & GTM Automation

 - Lead AI Transformation of RevOps: Execute an AI-first strategy across our GTM technology stack, systematically automating operational tasks to reallocate team capacity toward high-impact strategic growth.

 - Deploy Intelligent Agents: Design and deploy AI capabilities and autonomous agents across core revenue workflows—including pipeline forecasting, lead routing, automated prospecting, and deal intelligence—to drive pipeline velocity and rep productivity.

GTM Systems Architecture & Tech Stack Ownership

 - Own Systems Roadmap: Architect, manage, and continuously optimize our core GTM platform ecosystem, including Salesforce, CPQ, and integrated tools for routing, data enrichment, and prospecting sequences.

 - Drive Operational Precision: Establish and enforce accurate account hierarchies, complex routing rules, and territory mapping to ensure seamless lead-to-opportunity execution.

Data Governance & Account Integrity

 - Data Integrity Framework: Design and implement an enterprise data governance model across the tech stack to guarantee a single source of truth for downstream reporting engines and executive dashboards.

GTM Strategy, Planning & Capacity

 - GTM Strategy & Allocation: Lead multi-tiered account segmentation (Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial), capacity modeling, territory design, and quota allocation to align go-to-market execution with overarching revenue goals.

 - Build the team
   
   - Lead and develop a small RevOps team, while staying close enough to the work to step in where needed.
   
   - Unblock the team technically as well as organizationally.




ABOUT YOU:

 - Based in: [OPEN - North America

 - 7+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a B2B SaaS company, with experience leading a team and owning core RevOps operations end to end.

 - Direct experience with building AI workflows and Agents to automate and eliminate manual work with demonstrated efficiency results.

 - Significant hands-on ownership of Salesforce. You build the reports, manage the objects and diagnose the data problems yourself

 - Direct experience with CPQ, deal desk and quote-to-cash

 - Comfortable in the data, whether that's SQL or a BI tool, and able to say what it means and what to do about it

 - A player-coach orientation. You're not above the details and you're happy owning the work yourself

 - You've partnered with Sales leadership as a peer, brought a clear point of view, and been willing to disagree

 - Experience at a company that scaled through a Series B to D inflection. Usage-based or developer-focused business models are a plus

 - Clear written communicator who documents what they build so other people can pick it up





WHAT WE CAN OFFER:

 - A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

 - Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

 - A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

 - Comprehensive health plans and perks

 - A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

 - Competitive stock options program and location-based salary




WHO WE ARE:

Sanity.io http://Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised an $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 300+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here! https://www.sanity.io/blog/our-sanity-values

Sanity.io http://Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Process Optimization

Strategic & GTM Support

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced manager to lead SOX business process compliance and help keep the trust in our financial reporting as strong as the business we’re building. As part of our SOX Compliance team, you’ll help oversee and strengthen Samsara’s global control environment, protecting the accuracy of our financial reporting and keeping us compliant as we scale. You’ll partner closely with IT and business process owners to design and implement controls, spot gaps early, and drive remediation to the finish line. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Develop, lead, and execute periodic financial risk assessments, materiality calculations, and scoping of the SOX program

• Develop and deliver training to SOX control owners, including process documentation, testing methodology, management review controls, and controls over Information Produced by the Entity (IPE).

• Conduct walkthroughs across all business process areas and work with business process owners to ensure timely review and updates to the control documentation

• Collaborate cross functionally to design leading edge practices with a financial compliance mindset across several complex business process areas.

• Monitor and assess emerging financial reporting risks with the growth and evolution of the business and develop plans to implement appropriate controls to timely address these emerging risks

• Ownership of control deficiency evaluation, aggregation analysis as well as development and execution of related remediation plans.

• Help drive the SOX AI transformation strategy by identifying high-value opportunities, implementing AI-enabled solutions, and driving adoption and new ways of working across the global SOX organization.

• Provide reporting to business leaders on program status, health, and effectiveness of the business process control environment

• Collaborate and align with the company’s external audit and internal audit around financial reporting risks, design of ICFR monitoring systems,and SOX program approach

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 7+ years of SOX 404 / ICFR experience at a Big Four (internal or external audit) or combination of Big Four and public company experience

• Hands-on experience with risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, control design, and deficiency evaluation

• Strong knowledge of order to cash, procure to pay, financial close and reporting controls

• Ability to identify, assess and explain risks and control gaps clearly to executives and other non-technical audiences

• Working knowledge of COSO 2013, PCAOB AS 2201, and SEC ICFR guidance, including management review controls and IPE

• Bachelor's in accounting or finance (CPA and/or CIA preferred)

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience with financial systems such as Netsuite, Salesforce, Workday and Xactly

• Experience using automation or AI tools to make compliance work faster, more reliable, and SOX compliant

• Experience working closely with Internal Audit and External Auditors

• Strong communication skills, including presenting to and influencing senior business leaders

• Demonstrated success managing worksteams/project independently

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$87,975 — $113,850 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

signals.title: Revenue Operations Manager
signals.content:
About the role

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.

What you'll do

Own the enterprise reporting layer

• Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.

• Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.

• Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.

• Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.

• Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

Turn the data into insight

• Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in legal review.

• Build leading indicators and early-warning triggers so leadership sees a coverage or velocity problem 60 days out rather than in the last week of the quarter.

• Pressure-test the forecast. Deliver an independent bottoms-up call and be willing to disagree with the field's number in front of senior leaders.

• Diagnose where to reallocate capacity, headcount, and pipeline generation effort across verticals, and bring the recommendation, not just the chart.

• Produce the analysis behind strategic bets: segmentation changes, territory restructuring, pricing and packaging shifts, new vertical entry.

Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it

• Own top-of-funnel reporting for Sales Development: lead conversion loops, sourced vs. influenced pipeline, meeting-to-opportunity rates, and adherence to the Sales Development Playbook.

• Champion CRM data integrity. Set and enforce completeness standards for qualification fields, next steps, close dates, and competitive tags. No insight survives a dirty pipeline.

• Work hands-on in the GTM stack: Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Clay.

• Partner with GTM Engineering to automate reporting and enrichment, and use AI aggressively to compress your own analysis cycle, e.g., signal-based enrichment, automated variance commentary, first-draft narratives for business reviews.

Support planning and compensation

• Support the Director of Enterprise GTM Architecture through annual and quarterly planning: capacity modeling, territory design, headcount planning, and quota setting.

• Partner with Finance and Legal on the design and modeling of Enterprise and Sales Development commission plans, and own the reporting that tracks whether those plans are driving the intended behavior.

Who you are

• 8+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM strategy, or a highly quantitative business operations role at a high-growth B2B SaaS, PaaS, or AI infrastructure company. Time in management consulting, investment banking, or PE counts toward this when paired with in-house operating experience.

• Analytically hands-on. Deep Salesforce reporting fluency, strong command of at least one BI layer (Looker, Hex, Tableau, Sigma), and comfort writing SQL against a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks). You build the analysis yourself.

• Enterprise sales fluency. You know pipeline coverage math cold, you have worked inside a stage-gate qualification framework such as MEDDIC, and you understand what actually moves a seven-figure, multi-threaded, multi-year deal.

• A track record of reporting people use. You have built dashboards that changed decisions, not dashboards that nobody opens. You can tell the difference and you optimize for the former.

• Structured under ambiguity. You can take a vague, badly-posed question, structure it from scratch, find the root cause, and build a system that keeps it from recurring.

• Commercially and technically curious. You will need to speak credibly about our AI products, our differentiators, and the objections enterprise buyers raise around deployment, security, and data.

• Persuasive with executives. You can challenge the field's forecast with data in a room of senior leaders and keep the relationship intact.

• Genuinely interested in using AI to do this job better, not just to report on selling it.

Nice to have

• Experience in a business with a mixed revenue model (services, platform, consumption) where bookings, revenue, and recognized revenue diverge meaningfully.

• Experience supporting regulated verticals (healthcare and life sciences, financial services) or public sector, where procurement cycles and compliance gates distort the funnel.

• Experience standing up reporting for a sales development organization from scratch.

What success looks like

By 90 days. Core metric definitions are agreed and documented. Weekly enterprise pipeline review runs off a single dashboard you own. You have found and named at least one thing about the funnel that leadership did not know.

By 6 months. Leadership has leading indicators for coverage and velocity by vertical. Your forecast call is one leadership actively wants to hear. Data completeness standards are enforced and measurably improving.

By 12 months. Enterprise reporting is largely self-serve. Your time has shifted from producing reports to answering the strategic questions that shape next year's plan.

signals.content:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As the AVP, Revenue Operations, you will be tasked with building and leading the global operating model for Channel and Partner Operations, Sales Compensation, Renewals Operations, and Quote-to-Cash, turning a complex, multi-motion go-to-market into a scalable, well-governed operation that keeps pace with our growth. Leading a team of regional and operational leaders, you will set the operating cadence, planning, and executive reporting that give Sales, Finance, and the Board a consistent view of the business. You will also shape how we scale through what comes next, from integrating acquisitions and launching new pricing to applying AI and automation across revenue workflows.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Operating cadence and planning: own global forecasting, QBRs, and performance metrics across segments and regions, and lead annual planning for priorities, initiative roadmaps, territory design, and headcount allocation.

• Operating model and team: set the strategy, governance, and performance framework for Channel and Partner Operations, Sales Compensation, Renewals Operations, and quote-to-cash globally, and lead a team of Directors who act as strategic partners to the business, with an org design that scales alongside GTM growth.

• Channel, Partner, and MSSP Operations: scale Deal Registration, Partner SPIFF payments, Partner Activation, co-sell tracking, sourced versus influenced analytics, and the Partner Portal, with automated, standardized processes that support our MSSP program and consumption motions.

• Sales Compensation: drive the annual incentive design cycle (spend analysis, plan design, scenario modeling, communication, and enablement), own all GTM SPIFFs and special incentive programs, and serve as the executive point of contact for Sales leadership on compensation.

• Quote-to-cash and Order Operations: own the quote, order, and booking process end to end, including quoting standards, approval workflows, deal desk escalation, and quarter-end order accuracy, and govern non-standard commercial terms with Finance and Legal.

• Renewals: partner with Global Renewals Sales to scale operations and improve GRR and NRR through aligned process, data, and inspection.

• Executive reporting: own executive and Board reporting for your functions, with consistent metric definitions and narrative quarter over quarter.

• AI and automation: prioritize and manage a portfolio of use cases across these functions, with guardrails set alongside Legal, Security, and Data, and measured adoption and impact.

• M&A integration: lead the operational and systems integration of acquisitions, consolidating partner programs, compensation structures, renewal motions, quoting, and reporting on a clear timeline.

• Readiness and change management: prepare systems, partners, and the Field for product launches, pricing and packaging changes, program redesigns, and international expansion, with the enablement needed to make new processes stick.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 12+ years supporting Sales in an operations capacity, with broad experience across Channel and Partner Operations, Renewals Operations, Sales Compensation, and quote-to-cash.

• 5+ years leading leaders, managing Directors and Managers across multiple functions and geographies, with a track record of building and developing teams.

• High-tech industry experience is required, including Global Enterprise, SMB, and MSSP go-to-market motions through indirect Partner pathways, and SaaS subscription, MSSP billing, and consumption business models.

• Working knowledge of quote-to-cash mechanics, including CPQ, approval and discounting governance, order management, and handoffs into billing and revenue recognition.

• Proven ability to build an operating model and cadence, not just run existing processes, and to translate strategy into measurable business outcomes.

• Experience owning or governing a revenue data model and metric definitions, with systems and reporting held to an executive standard of accuracy.

• Practical experience applying AI and automation to revenue operations workflows, with the judgment to separate real leverage from novelty.

• Experience leading M&A integration or other large-scale transformation, such as systems migrations, program consolidation, or post-acquisition GTM alignment.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics; MBA a plus.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace, Salesforce, CPQ, Partner Portal applications, Clari, and Excel modeling; experience with NetSuite, incentive compensation platforms, and analytics tools such as Tableau a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

As the Sr. Director, Sales Systems & Processes, you will be responsible for scaling and optimizing our Sales systems and processes. The ideal candidate has deep, long-standing expertise in managing CRM, CPQ, forecasting, planning, prospecting and other sales systems at high growth software/SaaS companies and a record of driving large-scale change in how a Sales organization operates. This person will define best-in-class GTM processes and the system capabilities required to support them. This leadership role will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex business challenges while optimizing the sales experience & driving productivity. This is a remote role that will manage a global team reporting into the VP of Revenue Operations & Data Intelligence.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Develop and execute a comprehensive sales capabilities roadmap that is aligned to company and sales strategies.

• Define and execute the AI agenda for Sales — spanning rep-facing workflows, process automation, and the systems stack itself (e.g., prospecting, deal inspection, forecasting, CPQ). Establish standards for data quality, security, and responsible use, and measure impact.

• Own and optimize key Sales processes to ensure our processes are aligned to our overall Global Sales strategies and to ensure our processes are simplified for Sales productivity.

• Own key Sales systems owned by the business (not IT); ownership activities include budgeting, implementing, provisioning, and optimizing systems

• Partner with IT counterparts to align business roadmap with IT capacity and prioritization for Sales systems owned by IT but used heavily by Sales (e.g. SFDC).

• Lead strategic system initiatives on behalf of Sales. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define business requirements, partner with IT to design & deploy optimal solutions, work with sales enablement to ensure sales are effectively trained on new processes.

• Own sales data governance policies and processes; Ensure data governance policies align with sales rules of engagement.

• Manage Sales support; define and manage to key SLAs, root cause analysis & resolutions, quarterly tracking of KPIs.

• Own relationships with software vendors including regular vendor touch points, identifying new features and functionality that align to our strategies and work to implement new features into our existing processes. Work with Procurement and IT to effectively manage software licenses and spend.

• Lead Sales systems and process consolidation following acquisitions, including CRM and data migration, territory and quota mapping, product and price book alignment, and retiring redundant applications.

• Manage a team of Sales Operations managers and analysts; define and track team priorities, manage team capacity, help overcome obstacles for the team.

• Ongoing focus on improving and scaling the sales ecosystem; proactively bring ideas to Revenue Operations leadership on ways to drive productivity and optimize our applications.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 10+ years owning sales processes and the sales technology stack at high-growth software/SaaS companies, built in GTM Systems, Business Systems, or Revenue Operations roles, including 5+ years leading global teams. This is a business-side ownership role, not an IT position.

• Deep, hands-on experience as the business owner of core sales applications, including SFDC and CPQ, Clari, Salesloft, DnB, as well as forecasting, planning, sales engagement, and data enrichment tools.

• Demonstrated experience applying AI within a sales organization — identifying use cases, deploying them in production, and managing data quality, security, and vendor risk.

• Demonstrated experience leading large-scale change in how a Sales organization operates, with measurable results.

• Experience implementing CRM/SFDC best practices.

• Deep knowledge of Lead to Order/Renewal processes in an ACV/ARR environment.

• Ability to listen to the needs of stakeholders, problem solve to find quality solutions and escalate when needed to overcome obstacles.

• Experience partnering with IT: translating field needs into system requirements, negotiating priorities, and aligning to IT capacity.

• Ability to think and behave strategically while delving into details when appropriate, and to run multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Bachelor degree in Business, Management, Technology or related field.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

signals.content:
About Snorkel

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. Accounting Manager, General Ledger & Accounting Operations

San Francisco, CA (Hybrid); New York, NY (Hybrid)

About Snorkel

At Snorkel, we believe meaningful AI doesn't start with the model, it starts with the data. We're on a mission to help enterprises transform expert knowledge into specialized AI at scale. The AI landscape has gone through incredible changes between 2015, when Snorkel started as a research project in the Stanford AI Lab, to the generative AI breakthroughs of today. But one thing has remained constant: the data you use to build AI is the key to achieving differentiation, high performance, and production-ready systems.

We work with some of the world's largest organizations to empower scientists, engineers, financial experts, product creators, journalists, and more to build custom AI with their data faster than ever before.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

About The Role

We are seeking an Accounting Manager, General Ledger & Accounting Operations to own our monthly close end to end and build a close that can withstand an external audit.

This is a hands-on role for a Big Four-trained accountant who can both build and lead. You will report to the Controller and serve as preparer and reviewer for our senior and staff accountants, while building the models and processes that a fast-growing, project-based business depends on: commissions, bonuses, project margins, equity, and debt. You will work closely with Sales Operations, People, Legal, FP&A, and Revenue, and you will mentor the team as you go.

What You'll Do

Close, General Ledger & Audit Readiness

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, including the calendar, task owners, checklist, and final sign-off.

• Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, flux analyses, and balance sheet reconciliations, with timely and documented review.

• Lead cleanup of legacy balances and reconciliations so every account has a defensible, supported position.

• Serve as the day-to-day contact for external auditors, managing PBC lists, walkthroughs, and follow-ups, and anticipate what an auditor will ask before they ask it.

• Design, document, and operate close controls, process narratives, and an accounting playbook.

• Oversee key balance sheet accounts, including cash, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accounts payable, accrued expenses, payroll, commissions, and equity-related balances.

Commissions & Bonus Accounting

• Build our commission calculation model from scratch, including plan logic, quota attainment, accelerators, splits, clawbacks, and crediting rules, and own it going forward.

• Build and manage our bonus calculation and accrual process from scratch, with clear inputs, review steps, and reconciliation to payroll and the general ledger.

• Account for capitalized commissions and amortization, and partner with Sales Operations, People, and Payroll to resolve questions and keep plan documents and calculations aligned.

Project-Based Accounting

• Perform estimate-at-completion (EAC) margin calculations for project-based work, and keep revenue, cost to complete, and margin updated each close.

• Partner with Revenue, Delivery, and FP&A to track project costs, billing milestones, and changes in estimates, and explain margin movements clearly.

Equity & Debt

• Own stock-based compensation accounting, the equity rollforward, and reconciliation to the cap table and equity platform.

• Account for debt, warrants, interest, and issuance costs, and monitor covenant and reporting requirements.

• Support option grants, 409A inputs, tender offers, and financing transactions with accurate accounting and tax and payroll withholding coordination.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Operations

• Work across Finance, Sales, People, Legal, and Operations to answer accounting questions, evaluate new arrangements, and translate accounting for non-accountants.

• Oversee AP, expense, and spend management operations, and support cash and bank reconciliations.

• Drive automation and support ERP, billing, and AP system implementations while preserving audit trail and controls.

Mentorship & Leadership

• Mentor and coach our senior and staff accountants through review, feedback, and hands-on guidance, building their technical depth and close ownership.

• Cross-train the team to reduce key-person risk, and set a standard of documented, no-black-box work.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

• 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big Four or national public accounting audit.

• Experience building commission and bonus calculation models from scratch and managing them through close.

• Experience owning a monthly close end to end and working directly with external auditors.

• Strong experience with equity and stock-based compensation, and with debt and warrant accounting.

• Experience in a project-based environment, including EAC or percentage-of-completion margin calculations.

• Strong U.S. GAAP knowledge and a clear sense of what makes support audit ready.

• Experience reviewing others' work and mentoring senior and staff accountants.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, strong communication, and a track record of working well across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a high-growth SaaS, AI, or technology company, ideally venture-backed.

• Experience building or improving a close process, documenting controls, or supporting a first audit.

• Experience with reconciliation cleanup and resolving aged or unsupported balances.

• ERP implementation experience; familiarity with QuickBooks, NetSuite, Campfire, Ramp, Bill.com, Carta, or Salesforce.

• Bonus: SQL or AI tools to automate reconciliations, classifications, and reporting.

Location

San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (hybrid).

Salary Range

$150,000 - $185,000 USD, depending on experience and scope. Equity and full benefits included.

Join a company with market-proven solutions, robust funding, and rapid growth. You'll shape our accounting infrastructure, influence how we close and report, and help build a world-class finance organization in an environment designed for growth, learning, and shared success.
