signals.title: GTM Automation Engineer
signals.content:
UNLEASH AI INNOVATORS, SECURELY

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate.  It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.


Job Description

The GTM Automation Engineer will be part of a highly collaborative environment where developers, testers and the business work together as a team to deliver the best possible Salesforce-based solutions using agile development. You are experienced with Salesforce.com http://Salesforce.com, APEX and Sales and Marketing Automation systems. You are a problem solver with excellent execution and communication skills. You will use this experience to deliver the systems that will help Snyk in its rapid growth.

 

The GTM Automation Engineer takes ownership of tasks of increasing complexity (for example system design and implementation, advanced technical support requests). They complete tasks with minimal guidance and direction from others. They develop mastery in one or two technical areas, and begin to identify an area of specialization within CIS.

 

 - Handles complex technical issues and escalates problems to higher-level support when necessary.

 - Develops and implements support processes and procedures for improved efficiency and customer satisfaction.

 - Collaborates with other CIS teams and with stakeholders to troubleshoot and resolve system-wide issues, contributing to overall system and infrastructure improvements.

 - Provides user support, training, and documentation to ensure effective utilization of systems & tools.

Specific Requirements for the GTM Automation Team:

 - Develops Sales and Marketing automation solutions while partnering with stakeholders from the different departments that use Salesforce.com at Snyk

 - Implements integrations between Salesforce.com and other systems that support our sales and marketing processes

 - Figures out ways to "find the bug" utilizing top-notch troubleshooting techniques and all the tools and systems available within the GTM organization, and digging deep into code

 - Identifies root causes, and fixes, and develop new debugging tools while working closely with product teams

 - Analyzes and identifies gaps in functional and business requirements; discusses and elaborates with product owners on required changes that align with the SFDC stack and architecture

 - Collaborates with team members to deliver high quality solutions in a timely manner

 - Builds integrations between SFDC and external applications using REST APIs, Auth and Single Sign on, as well as Heroku Connect and other data management systems.

 - Proficiency in understanding the relevant hardware and/or software technologies, including its features, functionalities, and capabilities.

 - Knowledge of managing user profiles, roles, and permissions to ensure data security and appropriate access control.

 - Ability to provide basic customization to end-users and/or clients within the relevant platform, system, or tool based on incoming requests.

 - Ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues, both hardware and software-related, with a logical and systematic approach.

 - Skilled in multitasking, prioritization, and managing projects in a fast-paced environment. 

 - Able to contribute to project success by coordinating tasks and resources.

 - Advanced communication skills to interact with end-users, understand their IT-related problems, and provide effective technical support in a friendly and professional manner. 

 - Ability to summarize and communicate information of moderate complexity to peers and immediate team members. 

 - Takes ownership of assigned tasks and projects, seeking guidance when needed, and showing an emerging willingness to take initiative in contributing to strategic initiatives. 

 - Anticipates challenges before they arise and takes proactive steps to resolve after consulting with the team/manager.

 - Demonstrates willingness to collaborate with team members and seek feedback from managers and senior colleagues. Begins to actively participate in cross-functional discussions.

 - Shows adaptability to changing priorities and requirements in the strategic environment. 

 - Demonstrates a growing interest in learning about the industry, trends in technology, and business strategies.

 - Open to new ideas and perspectives, contributing to brainstorms and discussions with a developing understanding of the organization's strategies. 

 - Beginning to offer creative solutions to challenges.

 - 3-5 years of relevant experience working as a developer, and have a solid SFDC customization and configuration experience.


Specific Skills for GTM Automation:

 - Have development experience with SFDC configuration using Apex, Lightning Components etc.

 - Possess the ability to identify the best automation tool/framework/utility to implement a certain solution or a fix to ‘stop the bleeding’ but also have insight to recommend the long term solution with a keen eye on reducing tech-debt.

 - Thoroughly understand the SFDC deployment processes.

 - Have experience with Agile development methodologies and have worked as part of an agile development team.

 - Have experience with Heroku, python or Node.js development and microservice architectures.

 - Have coding experience and experience with the use of APIs to automate processes and integrate systems.

 - Have experience with Salesforce CPQ.

 - Have experience with Mulesoft.


ABOUT SNYK

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

signals.title: Program Manager, Deal Operations
signals.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) Business Practices team establishes and manages policies and processes for the GTM motion, including deal policy, approval and revenue contracting processes, and other deal related operations (e.g. misbilling, deal support models, etc). The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Business Practices team, responsible for establishing, managing, and improving policies and processes to improve deal quality and velocity for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Our Program Managers are focused on solving GTM’s deal lifecycle challenges to create scalable and efficient deal policies and processes in support of commercial activities. We are looking for a self-starter who has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguous global-scale programs, with multi-layered stakeholder management and significant cross-functional team engagement. The ideal candidate will: (1) have deal policy and process background working at a hypergrowth technology/GTM org, (2) have superior communication skills to work across senior stakeholders across different functions, and (3) thrive when solving complex problems with limited oversight & incomplete data.

Responsibilities

• Be accountable for building and driving large-scale deal lifecycle transformation program changes end-to-end, and be directly responsible for marshaling the cross-functional support and resources needed to accomplish your goals

• Own Business Practices’ CPQ governance across the deal lifecycle by coordinating UAT for new features, ensuring all GA products are available in the CPQ, and establishing scalable best practices for evaluating and prioritizing new CPQ requests.

• Manage directly (or coordinate) the ‘full-stack’ of change management activities across stakeholder engagement and creating champions, messaging/communication planning, support and enablement

• Develop strong collaborative relationships with key stakeholders across Stripe across levels and functions

• Work cross-functionally to proactively identify deal lifecycle improvement opportunities for the GTM teams spanning strategy, people, policy, process, and/or technology

• Seamlessly prioritize among various projects and synthesize data to guide/support strategy and decision

• Make exec level recommendations and drive decisions, where necessary

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• A strong track record of delivering global, complex enterprise deal lifecycle/commercial transformation programs with multiple constituents in a changing, ambiguous environment end-to-end

• Experience with deal management processes, deal process related root cause analysis, and commercial agreements

• 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, management consulting or a related discipline

• Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment

• The ability to diagnose, simplify and structure problems and solutions while having command of “the details”

• Enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality

• Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication experience, influencing across all levels from front lines to executive stakeholders. You set a high-bar in terms of communication effectiveness.

• Comfort with Excel and/or Google Sheet for analyzing large datasets

• Prior experience with Salesforce, CPQ, Deal Approval, Contract Lifecycle Management tools

Preferred qualifications

• Comfort operating with incomplete data and adapting / re-prioritizing activities as business needs change

• Deep problem solving and analysis experience (solving business problems - commercial, operational, financial) in a sales-oriented environment

• A growth mindset and innate curiosity where every interaction is an opportunity to learn and improve (yourself, and those around you)

• You demonstrate leadership qualities throughout your work – taking ownership of challenges, selflessly supporting your colleagues, and setting the standard for quality in your deliverables

• Prior experience with payments and/or SaaS

signals.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. The Sales Compensation team at Stripe is responsible for the overall compensation strategy, design, and payment administration for the global sales organization. We ensure that our objectives align with the compensation program and that our sales teams are paid accurately and on time. We provide thought leadership for the go-to-market initiatives so that performance and compensation are effectively correlated. The Sales Compensation team partners closely with the revenue-generating and support functions across Stripe to support the success of our sales efforts.

What you'll do

You're a key contributor to the sales compensation program design, implementation, and performance assessment of the sales organization. You're passionate about sales compensation and comfortable working in ambiguous situations to identify optimal solutions for our sales teams to succeed. You have experience working across all levels and functions of an organization (preferably in a high-growth environment) to align our priorities with our sales team's motivation. You bring resilience and the ability to both partner and lead in cross-functional situations. You use analytics and quantitative data to support and evaluate decisions.

• Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) (e.g., Salesforce) and Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) (e.g., Captivate IQ, Varicent, Xactly) tools

signals.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The GTM Operations team is responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and teams across Stripe to drive initiatives. Within this, the APAC Sales, Strategy & Operations organization is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth. As a trusted business leader our goal is to help users understand Stripe products and integrate them with ease so they can concentrate on what's most important to them: their business. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem solving. Within Stripe, Sales proudly serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on Stripe’s product roadmap and growth strategy.

What you’ll do

With focus on Stripe’s AUNZ business; responsibilities include resource planning, go-to-market analysis, reporting, quota setting and management, sales process optimization, sales program implementation, sales compensation design and administration. We are looking for a self-starter who has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity, operating in a high-growth environment, and solving problems with limited oversight. The ideal candidate will have significant experience: (1) scaling a technology sales org, (2) contributing to the growth and development of a sales operations team, and (3) superior communication skills to work across the most senior stakeholders.

• Determine go-to-market approaches and structures

• Develop and execute initiatives designed to optimize sales team efficiency and productivity

• Create and manage operational processes such as target setting, forecasting, and budgeting

Who you are

Preferred requirements

• Prior experience in the payments industry

signals.title: Senior Manager, Global Deal Desk
signals.content:
About the Role

Temporal is looking for a Senior Manager, Global Deal Desk to build and lead the function that sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Legal, and GTM Operations. This role is responsible for designing and scaling the frameworks, approvals, and processes that power how Temporal structures, prices, and closes complex commercial agreements — across all segments and geographies.

As the owner of Deal Desk globally, you'll be the go-to partner for our field teams navigating non-standard deal terms, multi-year structures, consumption-based pricing constructs, and international commercial complexity. You'll bring a systems mindset to deal operations and a bias toward building scalable infrastructure — not just clearing the queue.

We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate deal structuring, review workflows, and commercial analysis — not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today.

Responsibilities

 - Own and scale the Global Deal Desk function, serving as the primary escalation path for non-standard deal structures, pricing exceptions, and complex approvals across all sales segments and geographies.

 - Design and maintain deal approval workflows, pricing guardrails, discounting frameworks, and escalation policies that enable field teams to move quickly without creating downstream revenue or legal risk.

 - Lead CPQ strategy, configuration, and governance — partnering with GTM Systems to ensure our CPQ tooling (including Nue) accurately reflects our product catalog, pricing logic, and approval hierarchies.

 - Own the operationalization of Temporal's consumption-based pricing model within Deal Desk — including how usage commitments, ramp structures, drawdown mechanics, and true-up provisions are documented, reviewed, and enforced in the quoting and contracting process.

 - Partner with the VP of GTM Operations and Sales leadership to develop commercial frameworks for international markets — accounting for regional pricing, local currency, tax, and legal entity considerations across EMEA, APJ, and other expansion geographies.

 - Serve as the cross-functional connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and GTM Operations on deal-level issues — translating commercial intent into executable deal structures that satisfy all stakeholders.

 - Partner with Finance on revenue recognition implications of non-standard deal terms, multi-element arrangements, and usage-based constructs; escalate appropriately and maintain clean audit trails.

 - Build and maintain Deal Desk playbooks, templates, and self-serve resources that reduce friction for AEs and reduce unnecessary escalations.

 - Drive adoption and optimization of AI tools within Deal Desk workflows — including AI-assisted contract review, quote generation, deal-structuring support, and commercial analysis.

 - Own Deal Desk reporting and analytics: deal velocity, exception rates, approval turnaround time, non-standard term frequency, and discount trends — surfacing insights to GTM and Finance leadership.

 - Recruit, develop, and grow Deal Desk capacity as Temporal scales, including building team structure and operating norms for a globally distributed function.

Qualifications

 - 7+ years of experience in Deal Desk, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, or a related commercial operations function, with direct ownership of deal structuring and approval workflows.

 - Consumption-based business model expertise: proven experience designing or operationalizing Deal Desk processes for consumption, usage-based, or hybrid pricing models — including quoting ramp structures, commitment tiers, true-up mechanics, and the downstream revenue recognition implications of non-standard consumption constructs.

 - CPQ ownership: hands-on experience administering and evolving a CPQ platform (e.g., Nue, DealHub, Conga, or equivalent) — including product catalog management, pricing rule configuration, approval workflow design, and cross-functional governance.

 - International markets experience: demonstrated experience structuring and approving deals across multiple geographies, with working knowledge of the commercial, legal, and tax considerations that vary by region (e.g., local currency, local entity contracting, regional pricing strategies, VAT/GST treatment).

 - Proven AI-native operating style: hands-on experience using AI tools — such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI, contract intelligence tools, or purpose-built GTM AI — to accelerate deal review, generate quotes, analyze commercial data, or automate repeatable Deal Desk tasks. We want to see how AI is embedded in how you work today, not theoretical familiarity.

 - Deep understanding of SaaS commercial constructs: multi-year agreements, ramp deals, ELAs, co-termination, consumption commitments, and the interplay between deal structure and revenue recognition under ASC 606.

 - Strong cross-functional instincts — able to build trust and work credibly with Sales, Finance, Legal, and GTM Operations simultaneously, and to translate competing interests into workable commercial outcomes.

 - Highly analytical, with the ability to identify trends in deal data, quantify risk in non-standard terms, and communicate findings clearly to senior leadership.

 - Demonstrated ability to build scalable processes, playbooks, and policies — not just solve individual deal problems.

 - Experience hiring and developing Deal Desk or commercial operations talent is a strong plus.

 - Salesforce experience required.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

Much of the infrastructure is already in place, including a homegrown forecasting platform and a strong data foundation, so your focus is running the business on top of it, closing gaps, and defining how Vercel scales into new verticals and wins in large enterprise deals. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Development, Finance, and GTM Systems to sharpen segment and vertical strategy and drive measurable revenue growth. This is a hybrid role with 3 in-office days per week in San Francisco or New York City.

What you will do

• Serve as the strategic and operational partner to Majors sales leadership, using pipeline, win/loss, deal velocity, and retention analysis to guide where and how to grow the business

• Run core operating cadences, including weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and monthly and quarterly business reviews, driving forecast rigor and surfacing renewal risk and upside early

• Own territory and account planning for the segment, building the thesis behind each book, running carves and account transitions, and partnering with Finance on capacity modeling and target setting

• Design and operationalize sales plays and growth programs, from sizing the addressable market to measuring what works in the field

• Partner with Sales Development and GTM Systems to ship scalable tooling, automation, and AI-driven workflows that remove manual work from sellers and leaders

• 8+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Strategy at a high-growth technology company, supporting enterprise or majors sales teams

• High-impact individual-contributor track record, either broad ownership at a scaling startup or a dedicated enterprise or majors focus at a larger company

• Run operating cadences for senior sales leaders, turning pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and QBRs into decisions

• Experience with territory design, account planning, capacity modeling, and target setting alongside Finance and Sales Leadership

• Salesforce expertise, including reporting and dashboards, plus strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets and BI tools, SQL preferred

• Track record of building alignment with senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and Systems in ambiguous, fast-moving situations

Bonus if you:

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. We’re looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer to help Webflow scale our go-to-market systems with quality, scalability, and strong governance. You’ll design and build the Salesforce, CPQ, and integration solutions that our Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance teams depend on every day. This role combines hands-on engineering excellence with the judgment to know what to build, what to simplify, and what not to build at all. You’ll help make our platform easier to use, easier to trust, and easier to extend.

You’ll join a team of 5 architects, developers, and admins who own Webflow’s GTM systems end to end. We don’t have dedicated project managers, business analysts, or QA. Each of us runs our own projects from the first stakeholder conversation through requirements, design, build, testing, and rollout. We work as a community of practice. We share patterns, review each other’s work, and grow the craft together.

 - Full-time

As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will:

 - Own the whole problem, not just the ticket. You’ll shape solutions from the first stakeholder conversation through launch, and bring your designs to a team that reviews, challenges, and builds on each other’s work.

 - Partner with RevOps, MarketingOps, LegalOps, Finance, and Pricing & Packaging leaders to turn business needs into clear designs, with options and tradeoffs that help them decide well.

 - Help own and evolve our Quote-to-Cash platform, from quoting and approvals through contracts and renewals, and help shape where Revenue Cloud Advanced fits.

 - Make the platform simpler. Reuse before you build, consolidate overlapping automation, and retire tools and packages we no longer need.

 - Design resilient integrations across the GTM tech stack, and chase data issues to their root cause even when they span several systems.

 - Build shared AI tooling that speeds up the whole team, from test generation to code review to metadata analysis.

 - Ship with care. Deploy your own changes through Gearset, build in monitoring, and fix production issues before users notice.

 - Raise the bar. Set the Apex, LWC, and security patterns others build on, give thoughtful reviews, and mentor developers and admins.

 - Help shape how we work, not just what we build. Take your turn as Scrum Master, run our ceremonies, and bring ideas that make the whole team faster and better.

 


ABOUT YOU:

Requirements:

 - BS / BA college degree or relevant experience.

 - 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development in a complex Sales Cloud org.

 - Salesforce Platform Developer I and Platform Developer II certifications.

 - Strong Apex, SOQL, Flow, and LWC skills, and a clear sense of when to use each.

 - Deep understanding of the platform’s transaction model, including order of execution, synchronous and asynchronous processing, bulkification, and governor limits, plus experience tuning performance in large-data-volume orgs.

 - Strong grasp of Salesforce security in code, including CRUD, FLS, sharing, injection prevention, and named credentials.

 - Hands-on Salesforce CPQ experience.

 - Experience with source-driven delivery: SFDX, Git, pull request workflows, static analysis, automated testing, and rollback planning in a CI/CD tool such as Gearset or Copado.

 - Experience with event-driven patterns such as Platform Events and Change Data Capture.

 - Experience building and supporting integrations designed for failure, including retries, idempotency, error handling, and clear system-of-record boundaries.

Preferred:

 - Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, and/or Platform App Builder certifications.

 - Experience with identity provisioning or data warehouse integrations.

 - Experience in a B2B SaaS environment

 

You’ll thrive as a Senior Salesforce Developer at Webflow if you:

 - Are comfortable wearing many hats. You’re as confident running a requirements session, managing a timeline, writing test plans, and handling a production issue as you are writing code.

 - Hold a high bar for quality. You write clean, well-tested, well-documented code, and you treat production with care.

 - Design for scale. You build for where Webflow is going, not just where it is today.

 - Value strong governance. Clear standards, peer review, and documented decisions matter to you, and you help others follow them.

 - Challenge assumptions, including your own. You ask why, test ideas with data, and change course when the evidence says you should.

 - Always look for a better way. You reflect on your work and keep improving your skills, our patterns, and our processes.

 - Find the root cause. You use logs, data, and testing to prove what’s wrong before you change anything.

 - Communicate clearly. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a sales leader and to another engineer.

 - Protect focus. You redirect out-of-scope asks into intake, prioritize by value and risk, and leave room for the unplanned.

 - Help create a team where everyone feels safe to ask questions, raise concerns, and admit mistakes.

 - Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.




OUR CORE BEHAVIORS

 - Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

 - Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

 - Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

 - Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

 


BENEFITS

 - Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

 - Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

 - Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

 - Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

 - Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

 - Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

 - Stipends to support our distributed team. Localized support for cell, Wi-Fi, and WFH expenses to help you settle into your best remote life.

 - Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

 

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

 


BE YOU, WITH US

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed https://webflow.com/diversity-equity-inclusion to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. signals.title: GTM Strategy & Operations Manager
signals.content:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.


YOUR ROLE

As a member of Zip’s GTM Strategy & Operations team, you’ll be a key partner to Solution Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and the broader executive team - driving strategic planning, operational execution, and analytical rigor across our revenue engine. This team sits at the intersection of go-to-market execution, company strategy, and systems - giving you a unique seat at the table to shape the trajectory of the business.

You'll partner with Global Solutions Engineering leadership to bring structure to a fast-scaling SE org: standardizing how SEs engage across the deal cycle and driving the cross-functional collaboration with surrounding teams that makes that engagement work in practice.

You'll keep SE capability aligned to a fast-evolving product portfolio — shaping enablement and GTM strategy so a growing team can demo, scope, and defend what's shipping.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own SE operations for the org: Lead day-to-day operations and long-term planning — the capacity and coverage model, hiring and ramp planning against open headcount, comp plan design, metrics, reporting, and "whatever it takes."

 - Act as a strategic thought partner: Be the go-to partner for SE leadership and execs - whether it's solving complex problems, framing key decisions, or bringing structure to ambiguity.

 - Drive GTM cadence and accountability: Run the operating rhythm - owning coverage and staffing reviews, pipeline/deal reviews, QBRs, and leadership syncs. You'll push velocity, track outcomes, and ensure every meeting drives impact.

 - Lead cross-functional execution: Work across SE, Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance to drive strategic initiatives forward - bringing a GTM perspective to company-wide efforts and ensuring alignment across teams.

 - Build with data: Use SQL, spreadsheets, and BI tools to structure analysis, validate  assumptions, and uncover insights that improve GTM execution and drive growth.

 - Own special projects: From coverage model design to GTM enablement to redefining our POC motion - you’ll own critical, high-impact workstreams that move the business forward.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, presales/solutions engineering operations, consulting, investing, or a similar high-performance environment.

 - Strong analytical and modeling skills - you're fluent in Excel/Sheets and can write SQL or are willing to learn.

 - Deep understanding of GTM motions and technical sales cycles, with battle-tested views on SE coverage ratios, POC/technical win rates, demo environment strategy, and capacity planning.

 - Experience working closely with GTM systems like Salesforce, Gong, and PreSales platforms

 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can structure thinking clearly, write concise memos, and present to executives with confidence.

 - Attention to detail - you go deep on problems, sweat the edge cases, and set the quality bar high.

 - High bias for action - you move fast, think in tradeoffs, and find a way forward when others see blockers.

 - Technically inclined — you're not afraid of Salesforce Flows, brittle validation rules, or stitching together data across systems.

 - A collaborative mindset — you're opinionated but open to all perspectives, and you know how to drive alignment across stakeholders.

 - A proven operator — you've managed large, ambiguous projects that required both strategic thinking and tactical execution.

The salary range for this role is $153,000 - $189,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.




PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners for SF or NY employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

 - 💸 401k plan

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

signals.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
signals.content:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Senior Manager to own how our revenue org runs. You'll oversee all Revenue Operations for our three sales and success motions (Brand Partnerships, Brand Success and Retailer Sales) across North America and Europe.

This is an ownership role, not a support role. You'll own the operating system that powers the business: the dashboards, the weekly cadences, the forecast, the goals and the books. You'll partner closely with the Head of RevOps and GTM AI as their right hand on RevOps, and you'll lead and uplevel a growing team of RevOps professionals.

If you love building clean systems, sweating the details, and asking whether the way things are done is actually the right way, you'll fit right in.

What you’ll do

Own the revenue operating system

• Design and run the weekly, monthly and quarterly operating cadences for Brand Partnerships, Brand Success and Retailer Sales, including business reviews and QBRs

• Own the core dashboards and reporting the revenue org runs on, so leaders get a fast, accurate read on the business and act on it

• Build and own our centralized GTM metrics repository, so stakeholders at every level can move through GTM data in a logical flow, from top-line results down to the drivers, and get a holistic picture of the business. Set the metric definitions and data standards behind it

Own forecasting and pipeline health

• Build and run the forecast process across all three motions, from methodology to the weekly forecast call

• Diagnose why forecasts miss and fix the root causes, from stage definitions to pipeline hygiene

• Surface risks and opportunities early enough for leaders to change the outcome

Own goaling and book building strategy

• Set the right goals for each team, both what they're goaled on and how ambitious the targets are

• Design how accounts are segmented, prioritized, assigned and rebalanced across reps and markets

• Take a critical eye to our current approach and change what isn't driving the right behaviors or outcomes

Scale the GTM org

• Audit and simplify processes and workflows so reps spend less time on admin and more time with customers

• Partner with GTM Engineering and Analytics to keep Salesforce and our data foundations clean and reliable, including for AI-powered tools

Lead and uplevel the team

• Hire, coach and develop a high-performing RevOps team with clear ownership, accountability and career paths

• Set a high bar for quality and pace, and build a culture where people call out what isn't working

We're Looking For Someone Who...

Owns it. You don't wait to be asked. When something in the business is broken or unclear, you take it on, make the call and see it through.

Thinks from first principles. You don't just run the playbook. You ask whether the goals, books and processes are right, form a hypothesis and test it.

Is maniacal about the details. You know the numbers cold, your definitions are precise, and nothing goes to a leader that you haven't checked.

Is obsessed with operational excellence. You can't leave a clunky process alone. You simplify, automate and measure whether it got better.

Builds strong teams. You raise the performance of the people around you, coach directly and aren't afraid of hard conversations.

Cares about the reps. You get real satisfaction from making reps' jobs easier and more impactful, and you sit with them to understand how they work.

Is low ego, high motor. You roll up your sleeves, give the team the credit and bring relentless energy.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in Revenue Operations at a high-growth tech company or other relevant experience

• Bachelor's degree from a top-tier university

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize data, generate insights, and communicate to an executive audience

• Expert in Excel or Google Sheets

• Familiarity with analytics and BI tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Tableau, Hex)

• Hands-on experience owning forecasting, goal/quota setting and territory or book design

• Experience leading and developing a team

• Experience supporting multiple sales motions (e.g., new business, account management, partnerships) and global teams

• SQL proficiency

• Experience building internal data products or tools with AI

• Marketplace or two-sided business experience

Salary range:

San Francisco: The salary range for this role is $ 176,000 - $ 242,000 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

• Flexible paid time off, plus company-wide recharge days

• Paid parental leave up to 16 weeks

• Comprehensive health coverage, with options varying by location

• Fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot, including a lifetime reimbursement allowance

• Mental health support and coaching through Modern Health

• Stipends to support your professional development, wellness, and work from home needs

• Employer-sponsored retirement plan, dependent on country of employment

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form ( https://bit.ly/faire-form)

Privacy

For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

signals.title: GTM Strategy & Planning
signals.content:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization helps customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products and platform.

The GTM Strategy & Planning team sits within Revenue Operations and works at the intersection of GTM Leadership, Strategic Finance, and the broader business. We shape how OpenAI invests, organizes, and scales its revenue organization, translating company ambitions into actionable growth strategies, financial targets, capacity plans, and investment decisions.

Our work spans OpenAI’s global GTM organization, including Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and emerging businesses. We partner closely with senior leadership to ensure our resources support the highest-impact opportunities as the business grows.

About the role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic operator to help shape OpenAI’s GTM growth strategy and operating plan.

In this role, you’ll tackle some of the most important questions facing our revenue organization: Where should we invest to accelerate growth? How should we allocate resources across markets, segments, and customer motions? What level of productivity can we expect as we scale? How do we translate ambitious financial goals into executable plans?

You’ll own planning and analytical workstreams spanning revenue targets, investment strategy, capacity and productivity modeling, and GTM organizational design. Working closely with Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, and cross-functional partners, you’ll develop rigorous, data-backed recommendations that inform executive decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong financial and analytical skills with strategic judgment, thrives in ambiguity, and can move between detailed modeling and executive-level decision-making.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY.

In this role, you will:

 - Partner with GTM Leadership and Strategic Finance to translate company financial objectives into growth strategies, resource allocation decisions, and operating plans across regions, segments, and functions.

 - Build headcount, capacity, and productivity models to inform where and how OpenAI invests across Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and other GTM functions.

 - Develop regional, segment, and team-level revenue targets, translating company financial goals into executable plans with clear accountability.

 - Build scenario analyses to evaluate how hiring, productivity, product launches, partner distribution, and other growth levers affect revenue performance and investment requirements.

 - Develop data-driven recommendations on segmentation, coverage models, organizational structure, and resource allocation to support growth and operational efficiency.

 - Lead annual and midyear planning cycles, aligning Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, Field Operations, Data Science, and other stakeholders around a cohesive operating plan.

 - Analyze revenue attainment, capacity, productivity, and other key performance indicators to surface risks, challenge assumptions, and inform strategic decisions.

 - Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership, balancing analytical rigor with business judgment and a company-wide perspective.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, management consulting, or a similarly analytical and strategic role.

 - Have exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills, with experience building complex models that inform strategic, financial, and operational decisions.

 - Understand GTM strategy, revenue planning, capacity models, and the drivers of growth and productivity in high-growth technology businesses.

 - Have experience with SaaS, consumption-based, or usage-based business models and understand how different GTM motions influence revenue growth.

 - Have led complex, cross-functional initiatives, navigated ambiguity, and aligned senior stakeholders with competing priorities.

 - Bring strong strategic judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, translating complex analyses into executive narratives that influence leadership decisions.

 - Demonstrate ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

You may also bring:

 - Experience in AI, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or other technical product businesses.

 - Experience partnering directly with CRO, CFO, or executive leadership teams on strategic planning and investment decisions.

 - Experience designing GTM coverage models, segmentation strategies, or sales productivity frameworks.

 - Experience managing or mentoring team members.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

signals.title: GTM Technology Product Owner - Quote to Cash
signals.content:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a GTM Technology Product Owner with a consultant's mindset to join the Revenue Technology team. This role will own the systems that take a customer from first qualified meeting to signed contract to accurate invoice. You will lead the way as an expert advisor as we build the quote-to-cash (Q2C) experience for a seat and usage-based business, using agentic applications and bespoke tooling that reflect Harvey's unique position in a rapidly evolving industry.

The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience at the intersection of technology and business operations, with a background in consulting or a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. You will operate as an advisor and owner for our Q2C stack, with a deep focus on the pricing, contracting and metering layers. This is a role for a problem solver who has a bias for action and enjoys the challenge of building systems that eliminate friction across the deal lifecycle. You will be comfortable operating with high ownership and the ability to navigate complex requirements from multiple business units.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Roadmap Ownership: Own the Q2C product roadmap end to end, from pricing and packaging through quoting, contracting, approvals, order capture and the handoff to billing. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance to translate business objectives into technical requirements, serving as both project liaison and lead analyst. Operate with extreme urgency and agency once prioritization has been agreed upon with leadership.

 - Headless CPQ & Pricing Architecture: Define how pricing, products and discounting logic live in an API-first, headless CPQ layer so that sellers and agents can all quote from the same source of truth.

 - Contracting, Deal Desk & Approvals: Own the connection between quotes and contracts. Design approval matrices, discount governance and non-standard term workflows that keep deals moving fast while protecting margin and compliance.

 - Usage-Based Metering: Partner with Billing, Engineering and Revenue Accounting to define how metered usage maps to entitlements, credits and invoices, and how that data is surfaced back to sales, customers and finance.

 - Data & Agentic Processes: Leverage AI agents and tools to streamline quote creation, deal review and contract workflows. Work closely with managers and ICs across functions to provide expert level advice about what AI is ready to do, and what should be left to humans.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a liaison between Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, RevOps, Enablement, and GTM Systems to deliver a best in class user experience. Guide strategic evaluations of projects and platforms to help leadership make informed decisions on prioritization.

 - Systems Governance: Manage data integrity and system audits across the Q2C stack. You will document our evolving data models and process flows to ensure we remain scalable as we double in size, and verify that the tools we have adopted are driving ROI.

 


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience: 8+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Systems Architect, with deep ownership of quote-to-cash or quote-to-order systems. Background in consulting or a high-growth B2B tech company is required.

 - Headless CPQ: Familiarity with headless, API-first CPQ applications and how they differ from traditional UI-bound CPQ. You can explain tradeoffs in product catalog, pricing rules and quote APIs.

 - Contracting Systems: Hands-on experience with contracting systems (CLM or equivalent) and how they connect to quoting, approvals and downstream systems.

 - Deal Desk & Approvals: Working knowledge of deal desk operations, discount governance and multi-step approval design.

 - Usage-Based Metering: Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing, including metering, rating, entitlements and how usage reaches billing and the general ledger.

 - AI Expertise: Ability to demonstrate a portfolio of AI first principles. You will be expected to both explain the technical nature of different models and platforms, and show micro-apps you have built on agentic applications.

 - The "Glue" Tech: Proven experience understanding the relationship between technology and users. Strong ability to extrapolate data structures across platforms into a baseline that can be used by both end users and agents.

 - Analytical Chops: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with BI tools. Experience with integration patterns for data warehouses and reverse ETL tooling.

 - Consultative Approach: Exceptional ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and transform them into elegant, scalable technical solutions. Track record of iteration with technical development teams and delivering projects from inception to hypercare.


BONUS POINTS (OPTIONAL)

 - Experience migrating from a legacy CPQ to a modern or headless architecture.

 - Experience as part of a hypergrowth company, building a business function 0 > 1.

signals.title: GTM Strategy & Operations Business Partner
signals.content:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

As a GTM Strategy & Operations Business Partner, you will work closely with GTM leadership to be a deep expert in a critical part of our fast-growing business. These roles support teams across Anthropic's GTM organization and will partner directly with executives to drive strategic analysis, operational efficiency, and growth initiatives while supporting critical global strategic initiatives.

This includes business performance analysis, facilitating operating cadences and powering business reviews, improving operational efficiency, driving strategic initiatives, and supporting the rapid evolution of our sales motions and organization.

We're building for a future where AI dramatically amplifies what strategy teams can accomplish. We're hiring people with the technical depth, business judgment, and executive potential to operate at that frontier — leveraging AI to eliminate routine work and redirect energy toward the strategic and creative challenges that move the business. This role will evolve rapidly, and we need someone with the ceiling and ambition to evolve with it.

Areas These Roles Support

We are hiring GTM Strategy & Operations Business Partners across several parts of the GTM organization. Each role is aligned to a specific area of the business. Current areas include:

• Global Sales Development

• Global Public Sector

• AMER Sales

• Global Partnerships

• Global Strategic Deployments & Success

Responsibilities

Strategic Analysis, Operations & Planning

•
Partner with GTM leaders to analyze and refine strategy for your area of the business including territory planning, resource allocation, performance to plan, and growth initiatives

•
Maintain excellence through business reviews and operating cadences to help achieve company revenue targets and strategic objectives

•
Be audible-ready about GTM efforts and a deep expert in your area's book of business and trends with the ability to cut right to what matters for varying audiences from IC to executive

Data-Driven Decision Support

•
Analyze sales performance metrics and develop insights to optimize performance and improve efficiency using SQL, R, or Python to query, model, and visualize data at scale

•
Leverage Claude to its full capability

•
Partner to create, evolve and maintain reporting mechanisms, using data to go from "what" to "why"

•
Synthesize tangible, strategic recommendations based on go-to-market motions, deal outcomes, partner and customer feedback, and product opportunities

•
Build and maintain dashboards, models, and ad hoc analyses in spreadsheets and BI tools with mastery-level proficiency

Go-to-Market Execution

•
Develop and maintain use case frameworks to capture and standardize how customers derive value

•
Support multiple teams and executives in leveraging insights for new deals, expansions, and retention strategies

•
Partner with GTM teams to evolve and refine sales motions and best practices across segments and regions

Executive Stakeholder Management

•
Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior and executive stakeholders across the GTM organization, delivering insights and recommendations with clarity, conviction, and composure

•
Navigate high-stakes conversations with intense, demanding executives — maintaining poise under pressure while delivering candid, well-supported perspectives

•
Build deep credibility through consistent follow-through, proactive communication, and the ability to challenge assumptions respectfully when the data warrants it

•
Translate complex analyses into executive-ready narratives that drive decisions, managing up effectively across multiple senior leaders with competing priorities

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•
Work closely with Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement, Strategic Finance, and Product teams to drive initiatives and elevate excellence in course of business

•
Support coordination between sales segments, regions, and partnership teams

•
Help prepare materials for executive reviews and planning sessions

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

Must-Haves

•
Deep alignment to Anthropic's mission

•
Experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, management consulting

•
You can independently write queries, build models, and extract insights from large datasets without relying on others

•
Mastery of spreadsheet tools and data (Google Sheets / Excel) — pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and scenario analysis are second nature to you

•
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and compelling executive narratives

•
Deep experience with GTM systems like Salesforce and business intelligence tools

•
Proven executive stakeholder management skills — you have a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and VP-level leaders in high-intensity environments.

•
An ability to pull signal through noise and an internal drive to create clarity. You strive for simplicity as the most elegant solution to complex situations.

•
A demonstrated ability to build trust with and influence a variety of stakeholders, including colleagues and other members of the GTM Strategy and Revenue Operations team

•
A healthy balance of idealism with pragmatism and the highest internal bar for excellence. You have been accountable for the results of your recommendations.

•
Track record of driving forward high-growth sales organizations

•
Disciplined project management and exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities

•
Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred

• Experience with consumption or usage-based models

Preferred

•
10+ years of experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, management consulting

•
Experience in both large Enterprises in technology, finance or professional services, in addition to fast-paced startup building

•
Experience with AI/ML companies and consumption business models

•
Prior experience building frameworks for sales use cases or value propositions

•
Background in scaling sales organizations through 2-3x+ growth periods

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$270,000 — $310,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
