signals.title: Director, EMEA Sales Operations
signals.content:
About the Role

We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region.

 

You will partner directly with the VP of EMEA and the region's Account Executives, Business Development Reps, and Solutions Architects to deliver the insights, enablement, and processes that power territory design, quota allocation, pipeline and forecasting hygiene, and the region's operating cadence. Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function.

 

We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today.

 

Responsibilities

 - Serve as the dedicated Sales Operations partner for EMEA, supporting New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across the region, and knowing when to solve locally versus escalate to global GTM Operations or Systems.

 - Partner with the VP of EMEA and regional sales leadership to deliver actionable insights on net-new pipeline generation, account penetration, and territory design.

 - Own pipeline visibility and forecasting hygiene across all EMEA motions, including large complex enterprise deals, consumption workload ramps, and Commercial/self-serve pipeline.

 - Conduct white-space and TAM analysis to identify high-propensity targets across EMEA's markets, with particular attention to the region's concentration of financial services, banking, and fintech accounts.

 - Identify process gaps across the region's hunting, growth, and hybrid motions, and partner with GTM Systems to scope and implement automation—including AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and increase regional coverage.

 - Analyse regional sales performance (win/loss, deal velocity, conversion, quota attainment) across segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the VP of EMEA and regional leaders; leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface patterns at scale.

 - Build and maintain Salesforce and Omni reporting and dashboards tailored to EMEA, supporting Strategic, Growth, and Commercial views (including CQA/Tiered account, SSU, and workload metrics specific to the region).

 - Support the region's full operating cadence: forecasting calls, QBRs, pipeline reviews, and account planning sessions, often prepping leadership with regional metrics ahead of cross-timezone reviews.

 - Drive annual and in-year planning for EMEA: capacity plans, territory carving and re-carving (including account transitions as reps' territories evolve), and quota allocation across New Logo, Growth, and Commercial.

 - Evaluate new market entry and partner with regional GTM leadership on market expansion priorities, including coverage models and impacts to org design.

 
 

Qualifications

 - Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Field Operations supporting a B2B enterprise or strategic sales organization in technology or software.

 - Proven track record supporting multiple sales motions at once: net-new logo hunting, growth/expansion within existing accounts, and self-serve or hybrid AE-assisted motions.

 - Demonstrated AI-native working style: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI, or purpose-built GTM AI tools) to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable ops tasks, generate insights from large datasets, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making. We are not looking for theoretical familiarity—we want to see how AI is embedded in how you work today.

 - Deep experience across EMEA markets and fluency in the cultural and commercial similarities and differences across these markets.

 - Hands-on experience with building equitable territories, account scoring, quota allocation, and capacity modelling across a multi-country region.

 - Strong Salesforce expertise, including building scalable reports and dashboards across multiple sales motions and segments.

 - Highly analytical, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights for regional sales leadership; comfortable pairing SQL, BI tools, and AI assistants to move faster and go deeper.

 - Strong cross-functional partner who can work effectively with regional sales and SA leadership, global GTM Operations, GTM Systems, and Marketing.

 - Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior regional and global leadership.

 - Able to operate both strategically and tactically depending on business needs.

 - Bonus: experience operating in a consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of how usage impacts forecasting, pipeline, and quota planning for newly acquired and expanding accounts.

 - Bonus: experience evaluating or deploying AI-powered GTM tools (e.g., AI forecasting, account scoring, pipeline intelligence, or conversation intelligence platforms) and driving adoption across a regional sales team.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

signals.title: Staff Revenue Operations Manager, EMEA
signals.content:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

This role, in a nutshell:

Our international business has moved past the proving stage. The teams, the sales motion and the early wins are in place across EMEA, but still very much being built out in META (Middle East and Africa) and APJ. The operational foundation now needs to scale with them. We are hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to be the hands-on operator behind planning, forecasting, territory design, reporting and process quality for these regions.

This is an individual contributor role with a broad remit. You will work directly with regional sales leadership, report into the Senior Director of Revenue Operations EMEA, and apply global standards and systems to the realities of selling across multiple countries, segments and time zones. You will also be the person who raises it when a global standard does not fit a region, with a proposal for what to do about it.

What you will do

Planning and territory design

• Support annual and in-year territory design for EMEA, META and APJ, using account potential, segment, language, legal entity and market maturity to build territories that are equitable and defensible.

• Support capacity and coverage modeling: headcount plans, ramp assumptions, quota allocation and productivity targets tied to the company financial plan. Set different assumptions for markets at different stages, such as an established EMEA business and an earlier-stage APJ business.

• Support sales compensation execution with global Sales Operations and Finance, including plan rollout, quota letters and accurate, on-time attainment reporting.

Forecasting and reporting

• Support in running the forecast cadence for the regions you support: weekly pipeline inspection, forecast calls, roll-up accuracy and the written narrative for global sales and finance leadership.

• Drive the operating reporting rhythm: weekly performance, monthly business reviews, QBRs and regional inputs to Board materials.

• Own pipeline health and funnel analytics, including conversion by stage, segment, region and country, source and campaign contribution, and win/loss patterns. Identify what is driving each result and recommend what to change.

Partnership with regional leadership

• Act as the revenue operations partner to regional sales leaders and their teams, joining leadership meetings and QBRs with data and recommendations that support fast decisions.

• Support leaders at different levels of business maturity and with different priorities, and give each the same standard of analysis and attention.

• Serve as one of the EMEA, META and APJ voices within global Revenue Operations, and keep regional requirements visible in global planning.

Systems, data and process

• Maintain data integrity in Salesforce and the wider GTM stack, including account ownership, hierarchy, segmentation and the reporting fields that executive reporting depends on.

• Work with global GTM Operations on system and process changes, making sure regional needs are represented without fragmenting the global architecture.

• Maintain rules of engagement across regions, segments and teams, and resolve coverage and credit questions fairly and promptly.

• Bring region-specific requirements into process and reporting design, including data residency, GDPR and APAC privacy regimes, and local entity and currency considerations, working with Legal and Finance.

• Partner with Marketing, BDR, Customer Success, Finance and Legal to remove friction from the regional go-to-market process.

What we are looking for

Required

• 7+ years of Sales, Revenue or GTM Operations experience in high-growth Enterprise B2B SaaS.

• Experience with multi-country territory design, quota allocation and capacity planning. EMEA experience is essential, and exposure to META or APJ is a strong plus.

• Expert-level Salesforce skills, including reporting, data models and process design, and sound judgment about what belongs in the CRM and what does not.

• A record of running a forecast process that sales leaders trust, with measurable improvement in forecast accuracy.

• A strong analytical foundation: you can break an ambiguous problem into its parts and reach a recommendation you can defend.

• Clear communication across levels, from a front-line manager's pipeline question to an executive summary, without changing the underlying facts.

• Experience as a trusted operations partner to senior revenue leaders, including giving them unwelcome news when the numbers call for it.

• Comfort working inside a globally managed function: adopting global standards, pushing back where they do not fit, and avoiding regional fragmentation.

• Working knowledge of the modern GTM stack (for example Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, HubSpot, CPQ, and Sigma, Tableau or Looker) and the ability to learn new tools quickly.

• Comfort with international complexity: multiple currencies, legal entities, languages and privacy regimes, and a working day that spans several time zones.

• Willingness to travel across the regions and to the US for QBRs and planning cycles (1 - 2x per quarter)

Nice to have

• Experience supporting public sector or regulated-industry go-to-market teams.

• SQL skills or experience building data models directly.

• Experience mentoring or informally leading analysts or junior operations staff.

How success is measured

• Forecast accuracy improves and leadership relies on the regional roll-up.

• Territories and quotas are in place on time each planning cycle, with few disputes after launch.

• Regional leaders get reporting and recommendations without having to ask for them.

• Salesforce data in the regions meets agreed hygiene standards.

• Regional requirements are reflected in global system and process decisions.

Base Salary Range
£129,144 — £152,152 GBP

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

• We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

• We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

• We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

• We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

• Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

• Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

• 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

• ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

• 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice .

signals.title: Revenue Strategy and Operations , ANZ
signals.content:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Revenue Strategy & Operations partner for Australia and New Zealand, one of our most established markets in Asia-Pacific, you'll work with our ANZ sales leadership to plan and run the business, from the market's largest enterprises and government agencies to its fastest-growing technology companies.

You will be the trusted advisor to our sales leaders on how the business is planned and run: where we invest, how we cover the market, and how we read performance in a consumption business, while building the operational foundations to scale. Much of the work you will do yourself, hands-on.

This role suits a structured thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity: you will often start from an open question, turn it into a clear recommendation, and get leaders who don't report to you aligned behind it.

You'll work closely with Strategy & Operations peers in Singapore, Japan, Korea and India, with global Revenue Operations and Finance, and you'll use Claude every day to do the work of a much larger team.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll report to the head of Revenue Strategy & Operations for Asia-Pacific, who is also based in Sydney, work day to day alongside our sales leaders and team, and spend regular time with customers and colleagues across Australia and New Zealand.

Responsibilities

Go-to-Market Strategy

•
Lead annual and quarterly go-to-market planning for Australia and New Zealand with sales leadership and Finance: set targets, territories and sales capacity, and own the trade-offs behind them.

•
Set how we segment the market and design territories across enterprise, public sector, digital natives and startups, and keep books balanced as the team grows.

•
Align leadership on coverage and investment (which industries and accounts get named sellers, what we cover through partners and self-serve), and revisit the call as the business grows.

•
Shape how we go to market with cloud marketplaces, systems integrators and resellers (co-selling, partner pipeline and joint planning), alongside our partnerships team.

•
Give sales leadership an independent read of the business (consumption, pipeline and performance by segment), with the risks, the opportunities and a recommended course of action, early enough to act on.

Rhythm of the Business & Regional Leadership

•
Own the operating rhythm for Australia and New Zealand (weekly forecast and pipeline reviews, monthly and quarterly business reviews), and make it the place where decisions get made, not where reports get read.

•
Represent the market with Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement, Finance, Marketing and Partnerships; keep its plans aligned with Asia-Pacific and the company, and bring back what works elsewhere.

•
Advise ANZ and Asia-Pacific leadership through planning sessions, performance reviews and leadership updates. Own the narrative, not just the numbers.

•
Influence without authority: bring structure to ambiguous problems, build the case, and drive decisions across teams you don't manage.

Operations & Global Programs

•
Own the market's commercial governance (account and territory decisions, rules of engagement, planning inputs, data standards), working through our global Revenue Operations team, who own the CRM and sales systems.

•
Land global programs, processes and tools in Australia and New Zealand, and be the market's voice back to headquarters when something needs to change.

•
Keep the commercial engine running smoothly across the long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles typical of enterprise and government buyers.

You may be a good fit if you have

Required qualifications

•
8-12 years of experience in B2B SaaS, cloud or enterprise software, including several years leading sales strategy, revenue operations or commercial go-to-market work as the advisor to a sales leader, ideally in Australia or New Zealand

•
Structured thinking: a track record of taking ambiguous, open-ended problems and turning them into options, a recommendation and a decision

•
Analytical depth: you can get from raw data to a recommendation yourself, and you know which three numbers a leader needs to see

•
You have owned annual planning, territory design, quota setting and business reviews for enterprise sales teams

•
Hands-on with Salesforce and data (reports, dashboards and your own analysis); you use the systems yourself rather than administer them

•
Presence and judgement with senior sales leadership and C-level stakeholders, including the confidence to give an unwelcome recommendation, and a record of getting decisions made across teams you don't manage

•
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and at pace; you can build the process while running it

•
A record of advising regional leadership on go-to-market strategy and getting the organization behind it

•
Based in Sydney

Strong candidates may also have

•
Experience in a consumption or usage-priced business (cloud infrastructure, data or AI platforms): planning and forecasting on usage, not bookings alone

•
Management consulting experience (strategy or operations work), ideally combined with time in an operating role

•
A track record of scaling sales organizations through 3x+ growth periods in B2B software

•
Go-to-market experience with the Australian public sector (federal and state), or with partners and cloud marketplaces in Australia and New Zealand

•
Experience in Chief of Staff or Business Operations roles supporting regional leadership

•
You already use AI tools hands-on in your own work

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

signals.title: Business SOX Compliance Manager
signals.content:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced manager to lead SOX business process compliance and help keep the trust in our financial reporting as strong as the business we’re building. As part of our SOX Compliance team, you’ll help oversee and strengthen Samsara’s global control environment, protecting the accuracy of our financial reporting and keeping us compliant as we scale. You’ll partner closely with IT and business process owners to design and implement controls, spot gaps early, and drive remediation to the finish line. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Develop, lead, and execute periodic financial risk assessments, materiality calculations, and scoping of the SOX program

• Develop and deliver training to SOX control owners, including process documentation, testing methodology, management review controls, and controls over Information Produced by the Entity (IPE).

• Conduct walkthroughs across all business process areas and work with business process owners to ensure timely review and updates to the control documentation

• Collaborate cross functionally to design leading edge practices with a financial compliance mindset across several complex business process areas.

• Monitor and assess emerging financial reporting risks with the growth and evolution of the business and develop plans to implement appropriate controls to timely address these emerging risks

• Ownership of control deficiency evaluation, aggregation analysis as well as development and execution of related remediation plans.

• Help drive the SOX AI transformation strategy by identifying high-value opportunities, implementing AI-enabled solutions, and driving adoption and new ways of working across the global SOX organization.

• Provide reporting to business leaders on program status, health, and effectiveness of the business process control environment

• Collaborate and align with the company’s external audit and internal audit around financial reporting risks, design of ICFR monitoring systems,and SOX program approach

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 7+ years of SOX 404 / ICFR experience at a Big Four (internal or external audit) or combination of Big Four and public company experience

• Hands-on experience with risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, control design, and deficiency evaluation

• Strong knowledge of order to cash, procure to pay, financial close and reporting controls

• Ability to identify, assess and explain risks and control gaps clearly to executives and other non-technical audiences

• Working knowledge of COSO 2013, PCAOB AS 2201, and SEC ICFR guidance, including management review controls and IPE

• Bachelor's in accounting or finance (CPA and/or CIA preferred)

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience with financial systems such as Netsuite, Salesforce, Workday and Xactly

• Experience using automation or AI tools to make compliance work faster, more reliable, and SOX compliant

• Experience working closely with Internal Audit and External Auditors

• Strong communication skills, including presenting to and influencing senior business leaders

• Demonstrated success managing worksteams/project independently

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$83,597 — $126,450 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

signals.title: Deal Desk Analyst
signals.content:
G&A at Datadog rapidly scales the physical space, hiring, onboarding, and financial and legal systems to keep our business running in top form.

As a Deal Desk Analyst, you will work cross-functionally with our Sales Operations, Billing, Contracts and Legal teams to provide quoting and deal structuring support to the Global Sales Team. This will be a growth position as Datadog’s business continues to expand.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Develop in-depth knowledge of Datadog’s licensing and pricing models to provide deal structuring and quoting support to our global sales teams

• Be a creative problem solver who finds a way to meet customers’ needs while adhering to Datadog’s selling policies

• Solve customer satisfaction issues following execution of the deal

• Actively negotiate deals directly with the customer as needed

• Work cross functionally across various stakeholder groups including legal, contracts, sales operations, order management, revenue, finance and product management

• Function as point of contact and subject matter expert for Sales on deal pricing matters

• Drive adherence to internal controls, protocols and business rules

• Partner with the team to identify and build AI-powered automations that improve deal desk efficiency and scale our operations

Who You Are:

• At least 2 years of overall experience including related processes such as sales operations, finance, sales strategy or sales enablement

• Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to multi-task

• Strong communication skills

• Ability to work in fast paced, high pressure environment

• Strong quantitative skills

• Strong MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills

Bonus Points:

• Experience with Salesforce and CPQ

• Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar — and a genuine interest in applying AI to automate and scale business processes

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

• Generous and competitive benefits package

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan

• Continuous career development and pathing opportunities

• Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space

• Best in breed onboarding

• Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally

• Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

#LI-Hybrid

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

signals.title: Senior GTM Systems Engineer
signals.content:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As a Senior GTM Systems Engineer, you will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to help Apollo's revenue teams move faster and smarter through aligned processes, scalable systems, and actionable data. You will own Salesforce architecture and process design across the GTM funnel, and act as the systems SME for the business functions you support.

This role sits within the GTM Business Systems team and is focused on turning business problems into elegant, durable system solutions. You will work across GTM, R&D, and IT to govern a multi-instance Salesforce environment, support the next-generation quote-to-cash build ahead of Apollo's pre-IPO scale, and contribute to a growing portfolio of AI-driven GTM builds.

This is a strong fit for an analyst who wants to own architecture decisions rather than execute against a spec, and who enjoys operating as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technical delivery.

What You'll Do

Key Outcomes: Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

• Build a working command of Apollo's GTM business processes and tech stack, and review and update the full systems architecture map and process flow diagrams so the team has a reliable single source of truth.

• Serve as the primary GTM Systems partner for one of the domains the team is organized around (TOFU: Marketing and Partnerships, MOFU: Sales, Success and Onboarding, or BOFU: Internal Tools and BI). Own keep-the-lights-on work and incremental improvements within sprints, become the systems SME for your domain, and lead bi-weekly alignment and backlog grooming sessions to establish a roadmap.

• Partner with Sales leadership and Sales Operations to streamline the renewal process, including opportunity stages, pages, and page layouts.

• Make and defend the architecture calls that do not get faster with AI: whether something should be a platform event or a custom object, and whether a routine field-mapping change will trigger a resync across millions of records.

• Partner with GTM Systems engineers on AI-driven builds such as automated call coaching and deal scoring, demo instance automation, and AI-assisted CRM data capture. Help define the solution, not just configure it. Contribute across the full development lifecycle, from solution design through rollout and feedback.

• Support the design, build, testing, rollout, and maintenance of next-generation quote-to-cash infrastructure in service of pre-IPO activities. This includes refining the opportunity model to reduce friction and increase accuracy for GTM teams processing new business, upsell, and renewal opportunities.

• Own Salesforce initiatives and end-user support end to end. Build and maintain SFDC automation (flows, Apex, LWC), manage users, profiles, roles, and permission sets, administer page layouts, custom fields and objects, and record types, and handle data imports, exports, and upserts.

• Implement and administer Salesforce-integrated tools as needed (for example Chili Piper, Ironclad, Gong), promote Salesforce best practices and end-user adoption, and keep functional and technical systems documentation thorough and current.

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years of business analysis or consulting experience, plus 4+ years of hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform in an administration or development capacity.

• A college degree in a technical field, or equivalent work experience.

• Deep understanding of go-to-market business processes and how systems support them across Marketing, BDR, Sales, and CS/Onboarding.

• Hands-on Salesforce depth: creating and maintaining custom fields and custom objects, managing roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing settings, and building automation with Flow (preferred) and Process Builder. Well versed with Data Loader.

• Demonstrated ability to manage and collaborate with multiple concurrent stakeholders, and to translate a vague business problem into a scoped, well-designed solution.

• A track record of making and defending architecture decisions under ambiguity, not just executing against a spec.

• Experience supporting end-to-end feature and system implementations: discovery and requirements gathering, vendor selection, solution design, build and configuration, QA/UAT, deployment, and training and communication.

• Experience working within Agile methodology, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment while owning multiple projects with high attention to detail.

• Strong logic, analytics, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication and time management. Microsoft Excel power user.

• Nice to have: Salesforce Administrator certification, an active Trailhead account, experience across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, experience in Salesforce environments with 100+ users, and experience at high-growth companies (Series C through IPO, SaaS or PLG preferred).

AI Fluency & Tooling

Apollo operates at the intersection of AI and go-to-market, and our systems team is expected to lead from the front. This role requires genuine fluency in leveraging AI tooling. That means:

• Using AI-assisted development tools as part of your build workflow. Whether it is Salesforce configuration, writing and debugging Apex or Flow logic, or working down technical debt, you should be reaching for tools like Claude, Cursor, or Codex wherever they accelerate delivery, while owning the judgment behind each change.

• Structuring systems and data for AI interpretation. Understanding how to make GTM data clean, well-labeled, and accessible so AI tools can reason over it reliably. This includes object and schema design, field definitions, and semantic documentation.

• Helping build AI-native GTM capability. Partnering on the design and rollout of AI agents and AI-assisted workflows inside the GTM stack, and thinking about where automation should replace manual process entirely.

• Staying current as the tooling evolves. The AI tooling landscape is moving fast. We want systems people who are curious, self-directed learners: people who experiment, share what works, and help raise the floor for the whole team.

• Navigating AI's limitations and pitfalls. Understanding where AI-generated configuration or code can introduce errors, regressions, or false confidence in a production CRM, and implementing validation, testing, and review processes that protect data integrity. You know when to trust AI, when to verify its work, and when to rely on first-principles design instead.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)
$159,000 — $198,000 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)
$138,000 — $172,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

signals.title: Sales Strategy and Operations Manager, EMEA
signals.content:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the EMEA region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with EMEA leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local EMEA markets and customers

 - Support the regional rhythm of the business, including business reviews, forecasting, and pipeline management cadences. Ensure that our global operating priorities are executed thoughtfully locally balancing regional nuance with

 - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics

 - Build reporting and presentations for EMEA sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organization

 - Act as a partner to the EMEA sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

 - Enable smooth, efficient deal execution by supporting day-to-day deal operations, including opportunity hygiene, quote preparation, and coordination of approvals and internal handoffs, helping sellers navigate processes and remove friction throughout the deal lifecycle

 - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment

 - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the EMEA sales org

 - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution

 - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modeling, territory carving, etc.

 - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

 - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue

 - Excellent analytical and quantitative modeling skills; ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results

 - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management

 - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly

 - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people

 - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality.

 - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length

 - Notion power user or desire to learn -- prior Notion experience is not required, but you have the ability and desire to become a pro

signals.content:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online.

Our unique data and solutions empower over 6,000 customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. We are looking for a Deal Desk Manager to join our Deal Desk team. As a Deal Desk Manager at Similarweb, you will support the go-to-market organization throughout their deal cycle by facilitating contract reviews and managing quote-to-cash processes. Reporting to the Head of Deal Desk, you will partner with Similarweb’s global GTM organization, Finance, Legal and Operations teams on policies and processes to accelerate deal cycles and maximize revenue. You possess a team player attitude and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

So, what will you be doing all day?

• Serve as GTM’s trusted advisor as well as the centralized and primary source for all their quote-to-cash requests

• Act as GTM’s main POC, liaison and advocate, managing all internal disputes, and coordinating all cross-functional collaboration throughout the deal cycle with Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders involved in the deal-closing process

• Compliance: trained and fluent in all the company’s commercial policies, ensure all deals comply and otherwise escalate to respective stakeholders accordingly

• Doc review & data alignment: make certain that data is consistent across signed contracts, Salesforce, and subscription management/billing system when processing deals, so all opportunities are processed efficiently and accurately

• Assist legal in reviewing and approving [solely] commercial and/or administrative redlines and work with the Legal-DD playbook to customize non-standard contracts with template language

• Maintain ongoing training and refresher sessions with the GTM teams to emphasize best practices and how-tos

• Constantly work to identify process gaps and bottlenecks and provide solutions for improvements to optimize current processes and workflows

This is the perfect job for someone who brings:

• 2+ years of Deal Desk experience

• Salesforce experience - a must

• Deep understanding of the sales deal cycle and the ability to navigate and progress long, complex sales cycles

• Strong understanding of various licensing models including but not limited to term and subscription-based pricing

• Ability to thrive within a fast-moving environment with organizational changes

• Strong time management, organizational, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment

• Ability to work well under pressure and under critical timelines

• Ability to work extended hours at end of month and end of quarter

• Excellent written and verbal communications skills

• Relevant SaaS experience

Preferred Skills:

• Salesforce CRM / Case management

• CPQ (Configure Price Quote)

• Zuora

**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

The base salary range for this position in the Burlington, Massachusetts area is $100,000 to $125,000, plus benefits, including: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K plan, potential equity, employee stock purchase plan, and paid sick and parental leave.

Individual compensation is based upon several factors, including qualifications and relevant experience.

The base salary range above is for the New York City metro area and could vary for candidates in other locations.

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

You’ll get to sell a product you actually believe in : Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.

You’ll find a home for your big ideas : We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.

We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.

You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.

Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

signals.title: Manager, Revenue Operations Analytics / Revops (Hybrid- Bangalore)
signals.content:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is hiring a Manager, Revenue Operations Analytics to lead and grow our India-based analytics team in Bangalore. This is a senior people management role at the intersection of analytical strategy and operational execution — you will own the day-to-day leadership of five Senior Revenue Operations Analysts and one Data Engineer, while serving as a key strategic partner to Go-To Market (GTM) leadership globally.

You will drive the analytical agenda that informs Smartsheet's growth strategy, aligning data and analysis around pipeline health, sales productivity, retention, territory effectiveness, services utilization, and commission planning. Your team will be at the center of how the GTM organization understands its business and makes decisions.

This role is designed to bring senior analytical leadership into the IST time zone, providing direct, timezone-aligned support to the India-based team while maintaining meaningful overlap with North America Pacific Time leadership. You will also be a bridge to Smartsheet's Bangalore BI and Data Engineering teams, deepening the partnership between Revenue Operations and the broader data platform organization.

You will report to our Sr Manager, Revenue Operation Analytics.

You Will:

• People Leadership & Team Development

• Directly manage 5 Senior Revenue Operations Analysts and 1 Data Engineer in Bangalore, providing day-to-day guidance, coaching, and operational support.

• Set clear priorities, hold the team accountable for high-quality and timely outputs, and own performance management including merit reviews and calibrations.

• Support career growth through regular 1:1s, identifying skill gaps, and coordinating mentorship and development opportunities.

• Partner with HR on recruiting, onboarding, and workforce planning for the Bangalore team.

• Analytics Execution & Business Partnership

• Act as the primary analytics business partner out of our Bangalore office for Global Sales and GTM leaders, translating business questions into structured analysis, reports, and recommendations.

• Lead team execution across Revenue Operations priorities: pipeline health, retention, sales productivity, territory performance, services utilization, and commission planning.

• Help create, evolve, and maintain the Sales reporting infrastructure; mine large datasets to surface insights and monitor for anomalies and data quality issues.

• Partner with Bangalore BI and Data Engineering teams to build scalable analytics solutions and ensure data pipelines meet the team's needs.

• Present findings clearly to stakeholders across the organization — from peer teams to senior GTM leadership — for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Translate functional plans into operational processes; manage team work intake, project tracking, stakeholder updates, and milestone reviews.

• Recommend and implement process improvements that increase team throughput and analytical quality.

• Maintain flexible overlap with North America Pacific Time leadership to stay aligned on priorities, decisions, and escalations.

• Build strong relationships with the Bangalore BI and Data Engineering organizations, connecting Revenue Operations Analytics to the broader data platform.

You Have:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, revenue operations, or a related quantitative discipline.

• 2+ years of direct people management experience, with demonstrated ability to develop and support a team of analysts.

• Deep expertise in SQL and data preparation for analysis, modeling, and visualization.

• Experience with business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent).

• Proven ability to translate business questions into analysis, reports, and recommendations for Sales or GTM stakeholders.

• Experience in Cloud or SaaS go-to-market analytics (pipeline, ARR, retention, sales productivity, or similar).

• Strong communication skills — able to present data and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Comfortable with flexible working hours to maintain overlap with North American Pacific Time leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics, business, or computer science).

Nice to Have:

• Experience with statistical techniques: time series analysis, cluster analysis, multivariate modeling.

• Familiarity with data engineering concepts and ability to collaborate effectively with a data engineer on pipeline and infrastructure work.

• Channel / Partner GTM experience.

• Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with cross-functional teams across time zones.

• Prior experience partnering with BI or Data Engineering teams in a shared-service model.

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. signals.title: Deal Desk Manager, APAC
signals.content:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Deal Desk Team

The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.

Available Location: Singapore

Role Summary

As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.

What you’ll do

• Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Build creative financial models and custom discount strategies that align customer usage patterns with corporate revenue goals.

• Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing data driven insights and workflows to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization. Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.

• Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.

• Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.

Role Specifications & Qualifications

• Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred

• Financial & Sales Acumen: Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus

• Contract & Pricing Knowledge: Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations

• Data & AI Literacy: Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation. Ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.Relentless focus on iterative automation and translating complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic

• Strategic Influence & Negotiation: Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, internal cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments. Partner directly with Sales Management and Account Executives during external customer negotiations, equipping them with counter-proposal options or directly engaging in client commercial discussions to structure win-win enterprise agreements

• Communication: Serve as the single point of contact between Sales, Finance, Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Legal, and Product Management on advising deal constructing and managing deal escalation. Skilled in commercial negotiation strategy, advising Sales on customer-facing concessions, and directly engaging in external negotiations with customer procurement/legal teams to drive deal closure. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders

• Language Preference: Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Japanese would be beneficial for engaging with customers and stakeholders in relevant APJC markets.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
