signals.title: Senior Sales Strategy & Operations Manager
signals.content:
About G2 - The Company


G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.



Now, we have joined forces with Capterra https://www.capterra.com/, SoftwareAdvice https://www.softwareadvice.com/, and GetApp https://www.getapp.com/ to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.



And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.



Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!



About G2 - Our People



At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our  PEAK values— (Performance + Entrepreneurship + Authenticity + Kindness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.



You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI https://company.g2.com/dei and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives https://company.g2.com/gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is a critical individual-contributor position on the Sales Strategy & Operations team, partnering closely with Sales leadership across both G2's recurring revenue (subscription) and advertising businesses. You will independently determine the right methods and metrics for new and ad hoc assignments, proactively build relationships across teams to get work done, and bring structure and rigor to analysis and reporting that helps our GTM leaders make faster, better-informed decisions. When a project or analysis doesn't land as expected, you'll run a thorough retrospective and turn it into a concrete recommendation for improvement




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: 

 - Independently own ad hoc analysis, reporting, and sales strategy for G2's recurring revenue and advertising businesses — scoping and driving your own projects, partnering crossfunctionally to align and execute, and using structured, data-driven thinking to inform go-to market decisions, forecasting, and annual planning

 - Partner with Sales leadership across G2's recurring revenue and advertising businesses, and make recommendations that shape go-to-market strategy

 - Independently determine the right approach for ad hoc analyses across multiple data sets and tools (e.g., customer segmentation, win/loss trends, pipeline health, white space) to answer time-sensitive questions from Sales and Revenue leadership

 - Identify performance trends across the recurring revenue and ads businesses, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for Sales leadership

 - Build and maintain recurring and ad hoc reporting (dashboards, business review materials) that gives Sales leadership real-time visibility into pipeline, bookings, and quota attainment across both business lines

 - Proactively partner with Finance & Strategy, Functional Sales Operations, and the Strategy, Planning & Insights team to streamline shared reporting processes and deliverables 




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

 - 6+ years of sales/business operations, sales strategy, or related analytical experience

 - Strong Excel/G-sheet/BI skills, with experience building reporting and conducting ad hoc analysis across large, complex data sets

 - Fluency in SaaS/recurring revenue and Ads metrics 

 - Strong ability to translate data into clear business recommendations

 - Well-organized and a strong communicator, comfortable working cross-functionally and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - Proven ability to work independently, moving from an ambiguous ask to a polished analysis or recommendation

 - Experience with Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, or similar CRM and BI tools

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field

 - Experience creating executive-level presentations and business review materials 


WHAT CAN HELP YOUR APPLICATION STAND OUT:

 - Experience working in a high-growth SaaS or subscription-based business 

 - Experience supporting both a subscription/recurring revenue business and an advertising or media sales business



Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity



At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box—we are looking for lifelong learners and critical thinkers who can make us better with their unique experiences and drive.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Team

The Enterprise Technology – Agentic Operations team within Okta’s Technology, Data & Intelligence (TDI) organization delivers frontline and specialized business application support across Okta's global enterprise tech stack. Our application landscape is centered on Salesforce and deeply integrated with best-of-breed enterprise platforms, including Clari, DocuSign, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ServiceNow, and Jira.

Our team plays a critical part in realizing Okta’s business outcomes by driving operational clarity, rapid problem resolution, and accountability. We actively empower the broader TDI organization in its core mission: to Accelerate Okta’s Scale and Growth through intelligent automation and resilient systems.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and analytical Senior Business Applications Administrator to anchor the operational health, configuration, and continuous support of our Salesforce ecosystem and interconnected business applications.

In this role, you will support critical Go-To-Market (GTM) functions—spanning Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and CPQ—ensuring system stability, data integrity, and peak user productivity. You will act as an escalation point for frontline support administrators, champion operational excellence, and actively harness cutting-edge AI technologies (such as Gemini, Claude, and proprietary internal AI tools) to modernize incident triaging and drive automated operational workflows.

Duties & Responsibilities

Operational Support & Incident Management

• Advanced Incident Resolution: Triage, diagnose, and resolve Tier 2/3 incidents across Salesforce and connected enterprise applications in alignment with strict response and resolution SLAs.

• AI-Augmented Operations: Leverage generative AI platforms (Gemini, Claude, and internal custom AI assistants) to accelerate root-cause analysis, automate repetitive support workflows, and optimize ticket triage.

• Critical Period Support: Provide dedicated operational readiness and real-time support during high-stakes business periods, including fiscal month-end and quarter-end close cycles.

• Frontline Mentorship: Serve as an escalation partner and technical mentor to frontline system administrators and support analysts.

System Administration & Ecosystem Health

• Configuration & Maintenance: Manage user provisioning, security controls (profiles, roles, permission sets), workflow automations (Flows), custom objects, page layouts, and reports/dashboards.

• Integration Oversight: Maintain data flow and operational health between Salesforce and third-party SaaS platforms (e.g., Clari, DocuSign, Outreach, ServiceNow).

• Release & Change Management: Execute change sets, sandbox seeding, regression testing, and production deployments following structured release management methodologies.

Governance, Compliance & Documentation

• Security & Compliance: Ensure all system changes and administrative practices strictly adhere to TDI security guidelines, data privacy standards, and SOX controls.

• Audit Readiness: Participate in periodic security and access reviews, proactively addressing vulnerabilities and compliance gaps.

• Knowledge Management: Author and maintain comprehensive standard operating procedures (SOPs), system runbooks, and self-service knowledge base articles for global enterprise support teams.

Qualifications

• Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in business systems administration or technical application support within enterprise environments.

• Salesforce Expertise: Strong administrative expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud (configuration, Flow builder, permission management, data loader, reporting).

• Ecosystem & Tooling: Working knowledge of modern enterprise SaaS stacks, including ITSM tools (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) and version control/release tools such as Gearset.

• Compliance & Governance: Solid understanding of enterprise governance frameworks, audit requirements, and SOX compliance procedures.

• Global Collaboration: Proven track record collaborating effectively with cross-functional and distributed teams across multiple time zones.

• Communication & Problem-Solving: Outstanding analytical troubleshooting abilities, active listening skills, and clear technical communication for both colleagues and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Platform App Builder.

• GTM & CPQ Familiarity: Hands-on exposure to Salesforce CPQ, Billing, or common revenue architecture workflows.

• AI & Automation Enthusiasm: Experience incorporating LLM tooling (Gemini, Claude, custom GPTs) or workflow scripts into day-to-day administrative tasks to improve team efficiency.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Netsuite and Coupa is a plus

signals.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations
signals.content:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member serves as a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function, whether that's SDRs, AEs, Partnerships, or Account Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting.

 - Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across their associated functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement.

 - Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:



 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

 - 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies

 - Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution.

 - Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.



What we offer

 - High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)

 - Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.

 - Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

signals.title: AMER Data Analyst - Sales Strategy and Operations
signals.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business.

Responsibilities

• Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews).

• Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making.

• Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management).

• Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development.

• Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains.

• Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems.

• User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways.

• Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level.

• Ability to communicate technical content to non-technical audiences and translate business insights into practical recommendations, with a willingness to grow into presenting to leadership.

• Experience initiating and completing analytical projects, taking a structured approach to solving unique business problems.

• Experience in Salesforce (or other CRM). Intermediate to advanced SQL and strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills.

• Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to creatively solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis in a fast-paced, high-volume business.

Preferred qualifications

• Proficiency in BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).

• Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve analytical and operational workflows.

signals.title: Sales Strategy and Operations, Mergers and Acquisitions
signals.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team works across Corporate Planning, GTM Strategy, Product, and regional Strategy and Operations.

This role will lead the sales strategy and operations work associated with mergers and acquisitions (M&A). You’ll help assess how acquired businesses fit into Stripe’s GTM model and translate acquisition plans into clear operational changes across account placement, territories, coverage, quotas, compensation, reporting, systems, and seller enablement. You’ll partner closely with Corporate Development, Sales, Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Deal Desk, Legal, and regional Strategy and Operations teams to support due diligence, integration planning, launch readiness, and post-acquisition execution.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead the sales strategy and operations work required to assess and integrate acquisitions into Stripe’s GTM organization. You’ll develop integration plans, design operating models, coordinate cross-functional execution, and help sales teams successfully bring acquired products to market.

Responsibilities

• Partner with Corporate Development and GTM leaders during due diligence to assess sales motions, organizational structure, pipeline, customer segments, coverage models, systems, and operational risks

• Translate acquisition strategy into an executable GTM integration plan with clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and success measures

• Design sales operating models for acquired products, including coverage, segmentation, account ownership, rules of engagement, lead routing, specialist support, partner motions, and customer expansion paths

• Evaluate how acquired teams, products, customers, and pipelines should connect with Stripe’s existing sales processes and rhythm of business

• Establish launch and integration readiness criteria covering seller readiness, systems and data, enablement, quoting, reporting, customer handoffs, and post-launch support

• Coordinate execution across Sales, Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Legal, and systems teams

• Identify integration risks and execution gaps, recommend practical solutions, and escalate decisions with clear context and tradeoffs

• Develop reporting and operating mechanisms that help leaders monitor integration progress, field adoption, pipeline health, and business performance

• Support pricing, packaging, product catalog, quota, compensation, forecasting, and quote-to-cash workstreams in partnership with the relevant functional owners

• Help establish durable ownership for ongoing processes before work transitions out of the integration phase

• Build reusable due diligence, Day 1, Day 30, Day 90, launch readiness, and post-integration playbooks for future acquisitions

• Use data and qualitative insights to evaluate integration outcomes and recommend adjustments to GTM strategy and execution

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you’re encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, M&A integration, corporate strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or a similar strategic operating role

• Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in a technology, software, or similarly dynamic business environment

• Strong understanding of business-to-business GTM models, including direct sales, specialist sales, sales development, inbound routing, partner channels, renewals, expansion, and customer migration

• Ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, operating models, workstreams, timelines, and decision frameworks

• Strong analytical skills, including experience using data to identify risks, evaluate options, and measure business performance

• Demonstrated program leadership skills, including milestone management, dependency tracking, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and escalation

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues, recommendations, and tradeoffs to senior stakeholders

• A hands-on approach and the adaptability to work across strategy and execution in a fast-moving environment

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting M&A due diligence, post-acquisition integration, or both

• Experience designing or changing sales motions for new products, acquired products, or new customer segments

• Experience with pricing and packaging, product catalog or stock-keeping unit transitions, quota and compensation planning, or quote-to-cash processes

• Experience integrating sales processes, systems, data, reporting, or teams following an acquisition

• Experience with usage-based business models or financial technology products

• Proficiency with Structured Query Language (SQL), Google Sheets, Excel, or business intelligence tools

• Experience building reusable M&A integration playbooks or GTM launch-readiness frameworks

• Experience working with global sales organizations and regional GTM leaders

• Experience using artificial intelligence and automation to improve analysis or operational workflows

signals.content:
About Outreach
Outreach is a leading agentic AI platform built for revenue teams. Outreach lets revenue leaders hireAI agents that act rather than advise, working as true teammates that expand capacity and embed the skills of top sellers across every go-to-market workflow, from prospecting and engaging accounts to managing deals, coaching reps, forecasting, and retaining and expanding existing accounts. By unifying sales engagement, conversation intelligence, and revenue intelligence in a single connected platform, Outreach gives revenue leaders full-funnel visibility, greater forecast confidence, and more pipeline without adding headcount. World-leading enterprise organizations, including Databricks, SAP, and Siemens, rely on Outreach to power their revenue teams. To learn more, visit www.outreach.ai. 


About The Team
The Revenue Operations team is a strategic partner to Outreach's go-to-market organization, focused on enabling scalable growth, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making across the revenue engine. We work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Customer Success and cross-functional operations partners to design and optimize the processes, tools, and insights that help our customer-facing teams perform at their best. Our Revenue Operations organization is AI-first. We design, launch, and scale AI agents and agentic workflows to drive our GTM motion, and you'll look for places where AI and automation can improve pipeline visibility, process quality, and rep productivity. 
The Role 
Outreach is looking for a strategic, results-oriented Senior Sales Operations Manager to join our Sales Operations team as a business partner to the sales organization. You're a strategic thinker who takes a data-first approach, ruthlessly prioritizes, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, driving repeatability, predictability, and scalability across the business. You will own the Sales Operations function for the sales teams you support and lead a set of cross-functional workstreams that serve the whole go-to-market organization. You'll partner with leaders across Sales, CX, and Marketing as a trusted advisor, driving territory design, forecast strategy, and sales process. This is a high-impact, highly visible individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Sales Operations.


Your Daily Adventures Will Include
Your time will be split roughly evenly between two areas: supporting your assigned sales teams, and owning cross-functional programs across the funnel. Above all, you'll build strong relationships and communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders, keeping every project on track.

Sales Team Business Partnership:

• Territory Design Strategy: Own territory design and ownership strategy

• Define key performance metrics, create reports and dashboards to derive insights into the health of the business, identify areas of weakness, and present improvement recommendations to the segment leader.

• Conduct in-depth business analysis of the supported segments and identify growth opportunities. Develop key insights to drive critical business decisions

• Drive forecast management excellence to ensure sustained, predictable growth.

• Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement in scalable sales/business processes and deliver results.

• Strong stakeholder management skills – able to manage upwards effectively and demonstrate confidence in presenting ideas with executive audiences.

Cross-Functional Ownership

• Funnel Operations: Manage sales processes from opportunity creation to close, optimizing workflows and sales behaviors to improve conversion and revenue growth.

• Pipeline reporting and forecasting: Manage pipeline reporting and forecasting so leadership has accurate, timely visibility into the business. Deliver data-driven insights and business reviews that improve pipeline health, territory performance, and sales productivity.

• Account-based marketing: Partner with Marketing on ABM campaigns, working alongside the business partner for the relevant sales team to align targeting, coverage, and follow-up.

• Dashboards: Build and maintain dashboards that give leaders a reliable single view of the business.

• Data-first advisory: Bring a data-first approach to every conversation with sales leadership: use data to surface insights, test hypotheses, and make recommendations rather than relying on anecdote or intuition.

Our Vision of You
•
7-8+ years of sales operations experience

•
Experience supporting one or more sales segments as a Sales Operations business partner, including territory design, forecasting, and sales leader partnership

•
A data-first mindset: genuinely believes in using data for insight generation, and is comfortable challenging sales leadership with data-backed recommendations. Advanced Excel knowledge (complex formulas, and data modeling) for data analysis.

•
Excellent problem solving and analytical skills with the ability to translate complex ideas and data into consumable insights

•
Pipeline management and forecasting experience. Experience improving sales process, and opportunity management to lift conversion and sales efficiency

•
Strong stakeholder management skills, able to manage upwards effectively and present ideas with confidence to executive audiences

•
Strong communication and presentation skills

•
Solid understanding of the tech industry and the SaaS world, and demonstrable knowledge of sales disciplines

•
Solid functional understanding of Salesforce CRM, with strong experience creating and maintaining reports and dashboards

•
Knowledge of Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, and

•
Experience using AI LLM tools—preferably Claude—to automate routine RevOps tasks, analyze sales data, and build agentic workflows.

•
Strong sense of urgency, initiative, and commitment to see things through to actionable outcomes and result. Flexible team player with a bias for action

•
Ability to balance sharp focus on measurable outcomes with deep and genuine empathy for people, customers, and the business. This is a hands-on position; the ideal candidate must be willing to roll up their sleeves

•
Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a relevant field; MBA is a plus

Why You’ll Love It Here
 
• Flexible time off 
• 401k to help you save for the future
• Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees and their dependents 
• A parental leave program that includes options for a paid night nurse, and a gradual return to work
• Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit
• Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
• Snacks and beverages in the Office, along with fun events to celebrate
• Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like Outreach Women's Network, Latinx community, Outreach Black Connection, AAPI community, Pride/LGBTQIA+, Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military 
 
Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

signals.title: Sales Strategy & Growth Manager
signals.content:
About PayJoy
 
PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.
 
This role


The Growth Manager is responsible for driving PayJoy’s highest-priority sales growth initiatives by strengthening field execution systems, building high-performing merchant partners, accelerating merchant network expansion, and leading cross-functional programs that increase originations per store.
 
This role will be assigned a rotating portfolio of the most critical projects required to achieve PayJoy Philippines’ growth aspirations.


Responsibilities
• Strengthen field execution and selling systems across the sales organization, including Zoho adoption, itinerary planning, visit prioritization, in-store diagnosis, and post-call follow-through.

• Design and operationalize the Hero Merchant program by identifying, acquiring, and scaling the highest-value merchants, with a goal of establishing 2 Hero Merchants per city producing ≥150 originations per month.

• Build and accelerate the merchant network expansion engine by supporting geographic expansion planning, merchant acquisition funnel execution, and field capacity deployment to ensure rapid, predictable growth in active merchants.

• Lead cross-functional growth initiatives with Marketing, Sales Enablement, Promoter Operations, Merchant Operations, and Key Account teams to improve the drivers of average originations per store.

• Analyze merchant- and city-level performance to identify bottlenecks and launch targeted programs that unlock productivity and conversion uplift.

• Build scalable playbooks, operating cadences, and SOPs that enable repeatable execution and sustainable growth across regions.

• Coordinate across internal stakeholders to ensure priority growth initiatives move from strategy to field adoption with measurable impact.

• Champion continuous improvement in merchant productivity, sales discipline, and execution rigor across the national retail network.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Marketing, or similar.

• 10+ years of experience in sales strategy, revenue programs, BizOps, growth, or field execution roles, ideally in high-growth environments such as fintech, retail tech, management consulting, or startups.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort operating through KPIs, funnels, and CRM systems.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and deliver complex projects end-to-end.

• Structured problem solver with the ability to diagnose execution bottlenecks and build repeatable solutions.

signals.title: Sales Strategy & Operations Analyst
signals.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global GTM Operations team is responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and teams across Stripe to drive initiatives. Within the Sales Strategy and Operations team, the Global Product Sales Strategy and Operations team is aligned to each of Stripe’s Product Pillars (Revenue Suite, Money Management and Payments) and are heavily focused on partnering with both GTM and Product to drive the rhythm of business, strategic initiatives, bi-annual planning and execution. We advance the sales policies, processes and tools to drive revenue and growth. Within Stripe, the goal of the Product sellers is to help users understand Stripe’s specialised offerings and recommend the right Stripe solutions and implementation path.

This is an incredible opportunity that plays an integral role in shaping and executing GTM strategies with Sales leaders. You will partner with senior Sales leadership and the broader Sales team to drive the overall productivity and effectiveness of the mid market segment. Responsibilities include go-to-market design, resource planning, quota setting and management, sales process optimization and business analytics. You will also partner with key cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance & Strategy, Functional Sales Operations, Global Systems & Processes, and the Strategy Planning and Insights team to streamline and optimize our internal processes and deliverables (monthly business reviews, weekly forecasting calls, target setting and planning). We are looking for a self-starter who is passionate about their work, detail oriented, analytical and has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity in a high-growth environment, and solving problems with limited oversight

What you’ll do

Our near team focus is on building business foundations. This role will focus on automating dashboards and reports that are intuitive and actionable, and designing and operationalizing systems, tools and processes that are scalable and drive organizational efficiency. You will be executing on operational activities to run the Rhythm of Business, and analyzing pre-sales performance data, metrics and insights. You will be triaging system and data queries, and act as a subject matter expert around Stripe GTM data, systems and processes.

This role will primarily support the Global Revenue Automation Sales Strategy and Operations Business Partner. In addition to engaging with the Sales team, you will also be collaborating with numerous cross-functional stakeholders from across the globe, including: finance operations, sales operations, professional services consulting operations, product and system operations and customer success and renewals operations.

Responsibilities

• Triage, prioritize and answer system, processes and data queries from the Product Sales team, and other cross-functional teams

• Assist with the Rhythm of Business process for weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews

• Build reports and dashboards using SQL, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Tableau, Salesforce and other internally developed systems for key reporting needs

• Ensure quality of data and accuracy of downstream reporting through precise attention to detail

• Design and operationalize systems, tools and processes improvements

• Work cross-functionally to investigate and conduct analysis on system and operational issues

• Documenting business requirements and user stories

• Creating user-friendly documentation and enablement materials

Who you are

If you meet the minimum requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

• 5+ years of work experience in sales/business operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, or business analytics

• Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving unique business problems

• Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis

• Advanced SQL and Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills

• Knowledge of sales data such as customer accounts, opportunities and revenue

• Experience in Salesforce.com as a user and report developer

• Communicate clearly, proactively, and concisely

• An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality, with a bias to action and enjoys “getting things done”, and if questions are unanswered can push forward to find the answers

• Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast-paced and frequently changing environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in gathering business requirements and documenting use story

• Beginner to intermediate knowledge in creative data visualization in Tableau

• Coding experience in Python, React Javascript, Plotly (charts)

• Prior experience in the Payments or SaaS/technology industry

• Bachelor's degree

signals.title: GTM Strategy & Operations Manager
signals.content:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

As a member of Zip's GTM Strategy & Operations team, you'll be the primary business partner to Zip's Customer Success organization — owning the operating rhythms, models, and metrics that determine how the team covers, retains, and grows the customer base.

You'll bring structure to a fast-scaling org: standardizing ways of working across post-sales, and driving the cross-functional collaboration with adjacent teams (from Sales & Account Management to Technical Support) that a coherent customer experience depends on.

You’ll operate as a true business partner and execution arm for our Post-Sales leaders - owning the core rhythms, models, and metrics that power Customer Success performance.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own post-sales operations for the org: Lead day-to-day operations and long-term planning, including book design and rebalancing, segmentation, metrics, reporting, and "whatever it takes."

 - Act as a strategic thought partner: Be the go-to partner for post-sales leadership and execs - whether it's solving complex problems, framing key decisions, or bringing structure to ambiguity.

 - Drive GTM cadence and accountability: Run the operating rhythm - owning book reviews, renewal forecast calls, at-risk and churn reviews, QBRs, and leadership syncs. You'll push velocity, track outcomes, and ensure every meeting drives impact.

 - Lead cross-functional execution: Work across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance to drive strategic initiatives forward - bringing a GTM perspective to company-wide efforts and ensuring alignment across teams.

 - Build with data: Use SQL, spreadsheets, and BI tools to structure analysis, validate assumptions, and uncover insights that improve GTM execution and drive growth

 - Own special projects: From building a renewal forecast process to redefining our health score system - you’ll own critical, high-impact workstreams that move the business forward.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in customer success/post-sale operations, sales strategy, revenue operations, consulting, investing, or a similar high-performance environment.

 - Strong analytical and modeling skills - you're fluent in Excel/Sheets and can write SQL or are willing to learn.

 - Deep understanding of the post-sale customer lifecycle and SaaS business models, with battle-tested views on retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR, churn), account health and CSM/Solutions Consultant coverage models, and implementation/time-to-value velocity.

 - Experience working closely with RevOps systems like Salesforce, Gong, Superset and others.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can structure thinking clearly, write concise memos, and present to executives with confidence.

 - Attention to detail - you go deep on problems, sweat the edge cases, and set the quality bar high.

 - High bias for action - you move fast, think in tradeoffs, and find a way forward when others see blockers.

 - Technically inclined - you're not afraid of Salesforce Flows, brittle validation rules, or stitching together data across systems.

 - A collaborative mindset - you're opinionated but open to all perspectives, and you know how to drive alignment across stakeholders.

 - A proven operator - you've managed large, ambiguous projects that required both strategic thinking and tactical execution.



The salary range for this role is $153,000 - $189,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.




PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

 - 🍽️ Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

 - 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 💻 Home office stipend

 - 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

 - 🍼 Paid parental leave

 - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

 - 💸 401k plan



We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

signals.title: Staff Accountant
signals.content:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is growing, and we’re looking for a detail-oriented, operationally minded, and collaborative Staff Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you’ll support core accounting operations across order-to-cash, accounts receivable, billing, and the monthly close, while owning select day-to-day accounting processes. You’ll work closely with the broader Accounting team to help ensure transactions are processed accurately, issues are resolved quickly, and our financial operations continue to scale effectively as the business grows.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Legal, and other members of Finance to help ensure deals are structured and processed accurately from contract review through billing and accounting. You’ll also contribute to monthly and quarterly close activities, account reconciliations, revenue-related processes, and other operational accounting initiatives.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of critical day-to-day accounting processes while helping us continue to build scalable, well-controlled financial operations for a fast-growing SaaS business.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the order-to-cash process from deal approval through invoicing, collections, and accounting. Review order forms and commercial terms, including payment terms, billing frequency, credits, discounts, and other non-standard terms, and partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to resolve issues that could impact contract execution, billing, collections, or accounting treatment.

• Support recurring invoicing and billing activities, including month-end and quarter-end billing, renewals, usage-based charges, and customer adjustments.

• Support monthly and quarterly close activities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and balance sheet support.

• Monitor accounts receivable, support collections, investigate aging balances, and help resolve customer billing and payment disputes.

• Support revenue-related accounting processes and maintain sufficient documentation to support revenue recognition under ASC 606.

• Support employee expense reimbursement operations, including review, processing, policy compliance, and issue resolution as needed.

• Identify and implement process improvements across Deal Desk, billing, collections, expense reimbursements, and close activities.

What We Are Looking For

• 3+ years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.

• Strong accounting foundation with experience supporting monthly and quarterly close processes, reconciliations, journal entries, and accruals.

• Experience with order-to-cash processes, including customer contracts, invoicing, accounts receivable, collections, and billing operations.

• Working knowledge of ASC 606 and an understanding of how commercial terms can impact billing and revenue recognition.

• Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Legal, or similar teams.

• Experience with ERP, CRM, billing, and expense management systems; familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, Stripe, DealHub, Ramp, or similar platforms is a plus.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage recurring responsibilities alongside close deadlines.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or progress toward CPA certification is a plus.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.
CAN Pay Range
$115,240 — $143,380 CAD

What We Offer

• An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.

• A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

• Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

• Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

• Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

• Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.

• Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.

• Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!

• A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.

• Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness .

signals.title: GTM Strategy & Operations Senior Associate
signals.content:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Associate to join our growing GTM Strategy & Operations team as the product owner for our GTM data and tooling products. Our team solves complex problems that require insight, creativity, and execution through building scalable processes, tools, and systems for our rapidly growing global business. You will own the roadmap, delivery, and adoption of the data products and sales productivity tools that power our Sales and Customer Success organizations, spanning both internally built products and third-party solutions, with decisions guided by speed, cost, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Doing this successfully requires a deep understanding of the “day in the life” for field teams, strong product management instincts, and the ability to translate business needs into build-versus-buy decisions and tooling solutions that help Datadog grow 10x.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

You Will

• Own the product roadmap: Set the vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap for GTM data products and sales productivity tools. Balance field needs, business impact, technical feasibility, cost, and maintainability while making clear decisions about where to invest, consolidate, replace, or retire.

• Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for in-house tools: Write requirements and user stories, define MVPs, establish acceptance criteria, manage the backlog, and partner with GTM Systems, Data Engineering, and Analytics to ship, iterate, and sunset internally built products.

• Establish the product operating model : Create a consistent approach to intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, product ownership, release readiness, feedback collection, and lifecycle management across our portfolio of products.

• Make build-versus-buy calls: Lead structured evaluations (e.g., RFPs, pilots, time-boxed POCs) of third-party tools against in-house alternatives, build business cases, and present investment recommendations to GTM leadership

• Lead AI product strategy: Identify, evaluate, prototype, and scale AI-powered capabilities, whether built in-house or bought, that improve prospecting, enrichment, personalization, and rep workflows, and help define the forward-looking AI roadmap for the Sales and CS organizations

• Measure impact: Define and track success metrics across every tool and data product (e.g., adoption, data quality, time saved, pipeline influenced) and use the findings to make data-driven decisions to invest, consolidate, or retire

• Partner with the field: Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to uncover workflow pain points through interviews, workflow observation, usage analysis and feedback loops. Distinguish user problems from requested features and translate these opportunities into product improvements that directly increase rep productivity.

• Lead launch and adoption: Own release planning, change management, and onboarding in collaboration with Sales Enablement so field teams get maximum value from every product

• Ensure seamless integration: Work with GTM Systems to maintain and improve integrations between our tools, Salesforce CRM, and the broader GTM tech stack and data infrastructure

• Set the standard: Build and enforce governance frameworks, acceptable use policies, and data hygiene standards across all managed tools and data products to ensure consistency and compliance

Requirements

• Experience: 4-6+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, data or analytics roles, product management, or management consulting, ideally within SaaS or high-growth B2B technology

• Product management fundamentals: Proven ability to take a product from problem definition through requirements, prioritization, launch, and iteration, including writing clear PRDs, user stories, scope tradeoffs, and communicating to technical and non-technical teams why the team will or will not invest in a request.

• Build-versus-buy judgment: Experience weighing in-house development against third-party solutions on cost, speed, scalability, and strategic fit, and making a clear recommendation

• Data fluency: Strong understanding of GTM data (contacts, accounts, intent and enrichment signals) and the ability to define data quality standards; comfortable with SQL and working with data warehouses and BI tools to analyze usage and outcomes

• AI innovation: Strong interest in exploring, launching, and scaling new GTM AI technologies, including practical experience prototyping or deploying AI-enabled workflows

• Cross-functional collaboration: Strong track record of partnering with Sales, CS, Engineering, and Data teams to identify pain points and deliver solutions from requirements through rollout

• Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining product metrics, measuring adoption and ROI, and communicating findings clearly to senior stakeholders

• CRM knowledge: Solid understanding of Salesforce CRM and how data products and sales tools integrate into the broader GTM tech stack

• Communication: Effective communicator, both written and verbal, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Ownership mentality: Self-starter who takes initiative, operates independently, and drives projects through to completion without heavy oversight

Bonus Points

• SaaS background: Experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS company managing a GTM or sales tool portfolio or an internal data product

• AI passion: Stays current on the latest AI news, has a passion for experimentation, has fully integrated AI into professional workflows, and vibe codes on the weekend

• Technical aptitude: Working knowledge of APIs and how sales tools connect to CRM systems and data infrastructure; has shipped a prototype or internal tool of their own

• Tool fluency: Hands-on familiarity with the B2B sales technology landscape, including contact intelligence (e.g., ZoomInfo, Cognism), outbound sequencing (e.g., Groove, Salesloft, Outreach), and data enrichment tools (e.g., Clay, Clearbit, Crunchbase)

• Broader stack exposure: Familiarity with adjacent tools such as buyer intent platforms (e.g., Bombora, G2) or conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong)

• Full-funnel experience: Experience supporting tool adoption across Sales Development, Account Executive, and Customer Success teams

#LI-Hybrid
Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:
$129,000 — $172,000 USD

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. signals.content:
SLSQ227R805

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.
Candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role

• San Francisco

The Partner Strategy team works directly with Databricks' Partnerships leaders to drive operational scale across our Consulting and Systems Integrator ecosystem, in an extremely high-growth environment. We give our stakeholders and senior leadership the insights, tools, and decision criteria to shape proactive, effective, data-driven programmatic strategies.

We're looking for a Strategy Manager to be the business partner to the VP of Global Systems Integrators. It's a critical, high-visibility role built on two elements:

• Strategic business partner to GSI leadership. You partner with the VP of Global Systems Integrators to set the strategy and medium- to long-term goals for the business. Then you lead the execution: building scalable processes, building consensus, and running programs end to end. You're the connective tissue across Partnerships, Sales, Product, Finance, Data, Legal, Commercial, and the broader GTM org. You invest the time to know the SI landscape, our GSI partners, and the SI operating model.

• A highly technical, analytical operator. You love working with data. You're AI-fluent, and you use cutting-edge AI and data tools for analysis, problem solving, visualization, and automation. You'll own the executive analyses and deep dives that turn SI performance trends into action.

You must be able to run the day-to-day operating cadence with rigor, while also stepping back to bring a strategic point of view the leader hasn't asked for yet. You will report to the Director of Partner Strategy & Operations.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape and scale the strategy behind one of Databricks' most important growth engines: our Global Systems Integrator partnerships.

The impact you'll have

• Be the strategic business partner to the VP of Global Systems Integrators. Know the GSI partners, programs, and numbers well enough to surface risks, opportunities, and recommendations before you're asked.

• Own the operating cadence for the GSI business. Run the rhythm of the business and give clear visibility into performance against targets.

• Lead executive analyses and deliverables, such as board materials and QBRs, with a point of view, not just data.

• Define and run high-impact cross-functional programs end to end, from strategy through execution.

• Turn data and voice of the field into a better SI strategy. Dig into GSI performance trends and drive them to action that improves SI strategy and programs.

• Guide annual GTM planning for the GSI business: FY and long-range modeling, KPI setting, and HC planning.

What we look for

• Relevant experience. 7+ years of strategy & operations experience (e.g., Enterprise SaaS, top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking, business operations).

• Business ownership. You have the leadership and confidence to partner with VP-level GTM stakeholders like you own the business, not support them from the sidelines.

• Relentless problem solving. You love to analyze, set priorities, and solve complex problems. You dig deeper to find root causes, and you're not afraid to ask questions.

• AI and technical fluency. AI and data tools are part of your daily workflow for analysis, problem solving, data visualization, and automation. You keep learning and growing your skills, and you know the common GTM tech stack (Databricks, SFDC, Tableau, SQL, etc.).

• Comfort with ambiguity. Our GSI business is growing fast in scope and complexity, so things won't always be clean or easy. You embrace that challenge and are excited to build for scale.

• SI ecosystem fluency. You understand the Systems Integrator, GTM, or sales/partner operating model, and you have the judgment to weigh tradeoffs within it.

What this role isn't

• Not an order-taker or reporting function. You're expected to partner with the VP of Global Systems Integrators to set strategy and own outcomes, not wait for tasks to be assigned.

• Not a pure strategy role. You'll lead execution of the initiatives you help define. Building processes and consensus is part of the job, not optional.

• Not a static environment. The GSI business keeps expanding in scope and complexity. If you prefer clean, well-defined problems, this isn't the right fit.

signals.title: Revenue Operations Manager
signals.content:
About the role

Databricks bills customers on usage. Every month, millions of usage records turn into commit drawdowns, invoices and revenue. The Revenue Operations team within Order to Cash organization makes sure that happens accurately and on time.

We’re hiring a Revenue Operations Manager to oversee usage operations and improve how contracts move from booking to invoicing. A key focus is Universal Commitment, our cloud-agnostic commit model. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you’ll lead key month-end close activities for our billing and rating platform, oversee a team based in India, and drive process and automation improvements across Revenue Operations.

You'll work closely with the Order to Revenue Process Compliance team. That team sets usage policy, leads root-cause analysis and owns governance. Your team carries out the work: applying adjustments, keeping usage and billing in balance, and making sure each correction is documented, reviewed and fully reflected in our systems.

What you'll do

Revenue operations and contract setup

• Own the booking review process. Validate orders in the booking queue and serve as the escalation point for upstream teams on complex contract structures.

• Make sure contract and usage settings are correct across our billing and rating platform, ERP and CPQ, so that Universal Commitment and other contract type invoice as intended.

• Advise Deal Desk and Revenue Assurance on whether non-standard terms can be billed (e.g., GPU reservations, per-hour pricing, custom SKUs) before deals close. Provide guidance on new product offerings and ensure operational feasibility prior to finance sign off.

• Define and report Revenue Operations KPIs, such as adjustment volume, close timeliness, and billing accuracy.

Usage operations and adjustments

• Oversee and approve usage adjustments, billing corrections and customer credits in DBAR and the ERP. This covers billing errors, SLA credits and customer satisfaction (CSAT) credits, in line with Usage Compliance policies and approval levels.

• Serve as the escalation point for manual usage processing, including manual usage uploads, reservation and non-standard billing, ledger entries, and retract-and-restate corrections, with a full audit trail.

• Make sure usage-to-contract mapping, including customer workspace moves, PAYG-to-commit conversions and mid-term contract changes, with the correct effective dates.

• Act as the Revenue Operations owner of the refund and credit process, from intake, and validation through execution.

• Approve or deny account provisioning requests (suspend, unsuspend, grace-period extensions) with the Network Operations Center (NOC).

• Oversee usage tracking for customers with special provisions and non-standard language in their order form.

Month-end and quarter-end close

• Lead our contract reconciliation which ingests and compares usage across all clouds at the contractual level. Partner with Engineering, from pre-close through delivery of the final usage file to Revenue Accounting .

• Run usage categorization and commit and PAYG reconciliations, between the billing platform and the ERP across all clouds.

• Own billing finalization (Billing Mass Finalization / ledger freeze), the step that closes each month.

• Partner with the Revenue Accounting on usage flux analysis and contribute to shorten the close timeline.

• Act as preparer and /or reviewer for assigned SOX controls (e.g., usage reconciliation and SKU pricing accuracy) and keep audit evidence ready.Align with RevOps team to continue to improve recon process by assimilating processes across all clouds. Oversee Universal Commit contract reconciliation to ensure completeness.

Team leadership and scale

• Lead and develop the GBS usage team (India). Set priorities, review work, and steadily expand team ownership.Write, maintain and centrally store SOPs for every recurring process, and make sure each critical close task has a trained backup.

• Use SQL and Databricks dashboards to automate reconciliations and reduce manual effort, working toward touchless billing.

Cross-functional partnership

• Partner with the Usage Compliance team. Hand off recurring adjustment patterns and supporting data for root-cause analysis, put new policies into practice, and report adjustment volume and status.

• Work with the Money/DBAR Engineering, IT/Business Systems, Deal Desk, Billing, Collections and Revenue Accounting teams to resolve usage and billing issues quickly.

•

• Serve as subject matter expert on strategic initiatives and projects by working with our commercialization team, engineering, and other GTM and Accounting teams. Will require driving project initiatives in certain cases.

What we're looking for

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field.

• 6+ years in revenue operations, billing operations or order-to-cash, ideally with usage- or consumption-based billing.

• 2+ years managing people, including leading offshore or shared-service teams.

• Hands-on experience with billing or rating systems and a major ERP (e.g., SAP, NetSuite or Oracle), plus Salesforce/CPQ.

• Strong SQL skills. Experience with Databricks is a plus.

• Track record of running month-end close tasks on time, with SOX controls.

• Experience leading or guiding offshore or shared-services teams.

• Clear written communication and a habit of documenting your work and sharing knowledge openly.

Nice to have

• Experience with commit, drawdown and burst contract models, or cloud marketplace billing (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Working knowledge of usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606).

• Experience with system migrations or parallel runs for billing or ERP platforms.
