signals.content:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Role

Decagon is looking for someone to join the Business Operations & Strategy team to lead commercial and pricing strategy. The Business Operations & Strategy team sits within the Founder’s Office, a team of high-agency generalists and ex-founders with extremely high leverage and own things like partnerships, business development, pricing strategy, AI transformation, data/analytics, growth, etc.

Your primary goal will be to accelerate and streamline our enterprise go-to-market motion - working closely with our GTM team to close deals. Initiatives will range from developing pricing & packaging strategy, to building internal deal and pricing processes, to proposal creation and negotiation across our enterprise customer base.

This is an exciting role blending strategic thinking and high-caliber execution. We are looking for highly-motivated problem solvers who combine analytical rigor with world-class relationship building skills.



In this role, you will

 - Work to develop and refine Decagon's pricing and packaging strategy

 - Own end-to-end deal strategy for enterprise opportunities, partnering directly with account executives and sales leaders to build proposals and drive deals to close

 - Build and scale internal pricing / commercial processes to match Decagon’s growth

 - Help shape Decagon’s commercial strategy alongside the rest of the Founder’s Office team

 - Be a thought leader in how to price agentic AI solutions

Your background looks something like this

 - 2+ years of experience in investment banking / private equity / venture capital or high-velocity startups

 - Deep curiosity and desire to solve hard problems

 - Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape solutions as much as you implement them

 - Strong cross-functional collaborator

 - Top tier communication skills - both verbal and written



Even better if you have

 - Experience building or scaling a pricing function at a high-growth or early-stage company

 - Have an intimate grasp on using cutting edge AI tooling to supercharge your productivity

 - Data analytics skills (SQL, Python, etc)
   
   



Benefits

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

 - Parental Leave

 - Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

signals.title: Sr. Systems Analyst, Finance Systems (Zuora)
signals.content:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Sr. Systems Analyst, Finance Systems (Zuora)

Why We Have This Role

The Sr Systems Analyst, Finance Systems plays a critical role in enhancing the integrity, security, and efficiency of our financial systems, with a primary focus on Subscription Management & Revenue Recognition within Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue. This position is essential for aligning our subscription billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting systems with strategic organizational objectives. Within the IT Business Systems team, you will collaborate closely with global finance, sales, and other business systems teams to drive impactful enhancements that support overall financial strategy and business growth.

How You’ll Find Success

• Builder: Demonstrating resilience and decision-making skills by navigating complex and ambiguous situations, seeking guidance, and thoroughly documenting solutions.

• Pacesetter: Displaying decisiveness and focus by independently identifying opportunities for efficiency and optimization across functions, demonstrating strong self-motivation and initiative.

• Finisher: Owning and executing impactful projects from inception to completion, aligning with stakeholders along the way to ensure effective and timely implementation.

• Solver: Being an effective critical thinker, problem solver, and troubleshooter, especially in a dynamic subscription billing environment.

• Collaborator: Fostering cross-team connections and understanding complex business needs to contribute to strategic initiatives and system roadmaps for Zuora and integrated platforms.

How You’ll Grow

• Taking on increasing responsibilities and leadership opportunities as part of a growing and evolving finance systems team.

• Enhancing advanced system development, administration, troubleshooting, and configuration skills within a complex enterprise environment.

• Gaining expertise and leadership skills in collaborating across diverse teams and departments to drive significant business impact.

Things You’ll Do

• Serve as the go-to expert for Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue, driving platform governance, system configuration, functional design, process and system optimization.

• Triage issues, identify required bug fixes and prioritize incidents in partnership with users, and third-party resources.

• Adhere to all aspects of the SDLC, including QA and UAT.

• Build custom solutions using in-app Zuora functionality (Workflows, automations) alongside API tools like Postman. Map data pathways to troubleshoot upstream and downstream data issues while designing future-proof data structures.

• Automate finance operations—including subscription lifecycle management, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition—and drive end-to-end testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance to guarantee billing accuracy.

• Maintain strict compliance with internal SOX control frameworks and external accounting standards, specifically ASC 606 and IFRS 15. Lead SOX and ITGC reviews for Revenue and Billing systems.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Professional fluency in English.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in finance systems development and administration, with significant expertise in Zuora Billing & Subscription Management & Revenue Recognition.

• Proven experience with Zuora configurations and custom development, including product catalog, subscriptions, billing rules, payment gateways, and revenue recognition. Zuora Billing and Revenue certifications preferred.

• Experience tracing and triaging issues to their root cause across connected data flows between Salesforce CPQ, Workato, Zuora, and NetSuite

• Strong understanding of international billing complexities—including multi-currency processing and localized payment gateways—and hands-on experience integrating and managing Avalara for global tax compliance.

• Deep working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue standards and SOX internal control environments.

• Experience and understanding of Relational Database systems and structures, as well as data query and report writing.

• The ability to make sound decisions in uncertain and time-sensitive circumstances.

• A commitment to continuous learning and adapting in a rapidly evolving technological and regulatory landscape.

What You Should Know About This Team

• Partner cross-functionally across Finance, Revenue Accounting, Sales Operations, IT, and External Vendors to translate complex business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and data mapping documents.

• Develop a specialized career in finance systems, continuing to enhance your deep technical expertise in Zuora and related financial platforms with on-going training and certifications.

• Author and maintain comprehensive documentation covering system configurations, integration flows, policies, and operational procedures to ensure long-term platform stability.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Global Wellness Reimbursement program supporting holistic well-being.

• Access to a Global Mental Health Benefit through Ginger, providing 24/7 mental health support for employees and their dependents.

As a Deal Desk Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting our sales team by streamlining processes and ensuring that deals are structured effectively. This position offers the chance to work closely with cross-functional teams, allowing you to gain insights into various aspects of the business while making a tangible impact on our success. If you're looking for a role where your commercial acumen, analytical skills, and collaboration can thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing

• Act as a business partner to Sales and Finance in developing strategies for complex deals with a focus on financial and revenue compliance

• Execute against and maintain EMEA geographic Deal Desk support framework

• Provide Deal Desk support for super-geo Manager

• Enforce and manage approvals for non-standard deals and effectively collaborate across Sales, Finance, and Legal

• Serve as a trusted adviser to sales executives and their teams on pricing, product configuration, and business terms to support sales efforts

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. The Finance Transformation Manager will design, scale, and automate the financial systems and operational processes required to support our quote-to-cash (Q2C) processes. signals.content:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We’re looking for a Sr. Manager of Revenue Strategy and Planning to be a critical leader in the next phase of Cribl’s growth. You will architect global strategies, lead complex business analyses, and drive high-impact programs that accelerate revenue growth. This is a unique opportunity to operate as a force multiplier at a high-growth company, where your responsibilities will scale with your impact.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will:

• Drive GTM strategy & optimization: Lead the evaluation and optimization of the GTM engine. Define overarching KPI frameworks, measure performance, and proactively identify opportunities to accelerate growth and mitigate risk.

• Architect executive reporting: Own the GTM reporting ecosystem. Synthesize complex data into board-level narratives and high-impact insights that drive C-suite decision-making.

• Support annual and long-range planning: Collaborate with GTM leaders, other team members and cross-functional partners on annual and long-range planning.

• Leverage AI to optimize GTM operations: Apply AI tools and workflows to automate analysis, surface insights faster, and improve the efficiency of existing processes.

• Champion Data Governance: Collaborate with the data & analytics team to improve architecture of revenue data and ensure data integrity.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• 7-10+ years of experience in GTM strategy, revenue operations, sales finance, or management consulting, with significant experience in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise B2B environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to turn complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence senior GTM leaders.

• Advanced modeling and AI skills with experience building and scaling dynamic financial and operational models.

• Enthusiastic and self-motivated: Bias for action and strong follow-through on multiple priorities in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

• Strong grasp of SaaS unit economics and how to scale efficiently.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce and BI tools (e.g., Omni).

signals.content:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

You will support our finance organization and be a driver of revenue growth. Working closely with sales and account management leadership, you will ensure quotas are met, we have efficient and scalable commissions processes in place, and define a path for short-term and long-term growth.

Your Area of Focus

• Build and maintain accurate, repeatable reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into revenue performance, quotas, commissions, and key operational metrics; perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis to identify trends, risks, and root causes.

• Support recurring sales compensation processes, including payout validation, commission reporting and reconciliation, quota management, attainment reporting, forecasting, and special incentive administration.

• Investigate compensation, quota, reporting, and data discrepancies end-to-end, identify the underlying cause and broader impact, and partner with the appropriate teams to drive resolution.

• Partner with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Business Systems, Enablement, and other stakeholders to define requirements, improve processes, and implement scalable operational solutions.

• Provide clear, actionable, best-practice recommendations to business leaders that identify opportunities to increase bookings, while demonstrating how proposed solutions empower Sales and Customer Success teams to drive revenue growth and achieve business objectives.

• Own and execute recurring Revenue Operations processes with strong accuracy, prioritization, documentation, and communication, while progressively requiring less day-to-day direction as expertise grows.

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation tools to streamline recurring workflows, improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency as the Revenue Operations function scales.

Your Professional Qualifications

• Required: 2-4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related analytical role, with strong attention to detail.

• Required: Experience in optimizing workflows leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI)

• Required: Proficient in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including working with large datasets, formulas, lookups, and data validation.

• Nice to have: Experience using SQL to query and analyze data; experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse is strongly preferred.

• Experience building reports and dashboards in Tableau or another business intelligence tool.

• Experience working with Salesforce or another CRM and the ability to quickly learn new systems and business processes.

• Structured problem solver with strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills who can identify root causes and communicate clear, actionable findings.

• Strong organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and ad-hoc requests while maintaining accuracy.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.

• Self-driven, curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic, results-driven environment with increasing ownership and accountability.

• Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support analysis, documentation, process improvement, automation, and productivity.

• Experience supporting sales compensation, quota management, forecasting, or sales performance reporting is preferred.

• Healthcare and SaaS experience is preferred but not required.

#LI-SS1 #LI-Remote

About Tebra

Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com .

Our Values

Start with the Customer

We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.

Keep It Simple

Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.

Stay Entrepreneurial

We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.

Better Together

We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.

Celebrate Success

Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are seeking an experienced Sales Operations Manager to partner with our Sales team for Mid-Market, Enterprise & Strategic segments. In this role, you will serve as a business partner on the Regional Sales Operations team, playing a critical role in helping Figma Sales scale revenue across both our self-service and assisted sales motions.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our New York hub or remotely within the Eastern US time zone.

What you’ll do at Figma:

• Serve as a trusted thought partner and strategic advisor to the SVP of AMER Sales — translating business performance, market trends, and field insights into clear recommendations that shape regional priorities, guide investment decisions, and accelerate growth

• Assist the forecasting process for Mid-Market, Enterprise & Strategic, bringing rigor and repeatability to pipeline reviews

• Lead and elevate the operating cadence — MBRs, QBRs, weekly forecast reviews — by synthesizing trends, surfacing risks and opportunities, and driving leadership to clear, timely decisions

• Shape the organizational foundation across the segments by recommending headcount, org design, quota structures, and book-of-business allocation — ensuring the business is set up to scale efficiently and equitably

• Build and maintain intelligence systems — dashboards, performance reports, and automated insights — that leverage AI to compress the time from data to action for sales and finance leadership

• Deploy AI tools and workflows to continuously improve operational processes: from pipeline analysis and forecasting accuracy to identifying patterns in rep performance and segment health that would be impossible to surface manually

• Partner cross-functionally with Sales Systems, Finance, and Data Science to uphold data quality and governance standards — ensuring the insights leadership relies on are trustworthy, timely, and actionable

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

• 5+ years of sales operations experience, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

• Strong analytical and technical skills, with proven expertise in Salesforce, SQL and BI tools (specifically Sigma)

• Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to generate sales insights, including hands-on experience with Claude Code and Codex

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights and deliver sophisticated models, spreadsheets, and executive presentations to senior leadership

signals.title: GTM Systems Administrator
signals.content:
Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here .

About the team

Revenue Operations keeps Alloy's go-to-market engine running. Inside RevOps, the GTM Systems team owns Salesforce and the surrounding stack that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Product depend on every day. As Alloy grows past 900 financial institutions and fintechs, the systems layer is what turns that growth into clean pipeline, accurate forecasts, and fast decisions. This role sits at the center of that work and reports to the Senior Manager, GTM Systems.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll be doing

You'll own the day-to-day configuration, reliability, and user experience of Alloy's Salesforce instance, the system of record for our entire go-to-market org. Within 3 to 6 months you'll be the go-to owner of user support, data quality, and the declarative build work that keeps the GTM stack running.

• Own day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success clouds: objects, fields, page layouts, record types, permission sets, and user provisioning.

• Build and maintain declarative automation (Flows, validation rules, approval processes) as GTM processes evolve.

• Own data quality in Salesforce end to end, including deduplication, validation rules, and routine hygiene audits.

• Act as the first line of support for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success users. Triage tickets, fix configuration issues, and escalate what needs deeper platform work.

• Administer adjacent GTM tools such as Gong and Apollo.io , covering configuration, user access, and troubleshooting so the whole stack stays reliable, not just Salesforce.

• Partner with the Senior Manager, GTM Systems and the wider RevOps team on the Salesforce roadmap and on territory, quota, and forecasting configuration changes.

• Run release management: test changes in sandbox, coordinate deployments, document field-level and process changes, and tell end users what changed.

Who we’re looking for

Must-haves:

signals.title: Senior GTM Technologist, RevOps
signals.content:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location:

• Preferred Locations: San Francisco, Austin, NYC OR Remote

About the Role

Cloudflare’s GTM organization is scaling rapidly, and its RevOps tech stack must scale with it. We are hiring a RevOps Technologist to shape future-state workflows and move our RevOps technology roadmap from strategy and prototype toward secure, scalable execution.

This senior individual contributor will combine deep Sales and Revenue Operations expertise with the hands-on technical fluency to identify strategic solutions and simplified workflows. You'll report directly to the Director of RevTech Strategy & Operations, and be the senior counterpart to our business partners, IT, Procurement, Engineering, Security & Privacy, to ensure our systems are optimized, and governed.

You will transform our rapidly scaling, today’s fragmented tech stack into a secure, orchestrated engine, across vendor platforms, internal tooling, and Cloudflare’s internal orchestration platform (Cloudflare OS). You will set the direction for Build/Buy/Blend opportunities, prototype AI- and automation-enabled capabilities, and partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production.

You will bring an end-to-end view across workflows, systems, data and integrations, to reduce complexity and elevate the seller experience while balancing technical feasibility with business value.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage the existing RevOps stack, but actively reimagines a scalable, best-in-class stack with a stellar seller experience. If you thrive on challenging the status quo, hands-on building with cutting-edge technology, and turning bold GTM ideas into high-impact reality, we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Do:

Shape the Future of RevTech & GTM Systems

• Drive the AI-first RevOps technology roadmap across internal systems, Cloudflare OS, vendor platforms, and new build opportunities, to improve seller efficiency and effectiveness.

• Identify where the stack needs to scale, simplify, or modernize based on jobs-to-be-done, user needs, and workflow friction points.

• Connect technology decisions across the broader GTM ecosystem (workflows, systems, data, integrations, and dependencies) rather than optimizing individual tools in isolation.

• Apply AI, agents, automation, and emerging technologies to practical opportunities that reduce friction, and modernize GTM operations.

• Document current state-workflows, systems, dependencies and pain points to identify exactly where the stack needs to scale or simplify, and translate findings into clear future-state designs and recommendations.

Design, Prototype & Automate

• Translate sales capabilities “jobs-to-be-done", workflow context, and user needs into clear technology requirements and solution approaches balancing user experience, scalability, and technical feasibility.

• Architect solutions across the RevTech landscape that work cohesively with existing CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, data, and other seller technologies.

• Leverage Cloudflare OS, AI, agents, and automation to prototype and build secure solutions, validating where tech adds value vs. human judgement is required.

• Partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production, aligning on the APIs, MCPs, integrations, and security.

Drive Technology & Investment Strategy

• Advise on build, buy, blend, or retire decisions based on time-to-value, scalability, security, cost, and flexibility.

• Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary SaaS dependency, utilizing Cloudflare OS or internal capabilities where appropriate.

• Bring a technical and strategic lens to technology investments, partnering with Procurement, Software Asset Management, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate vendors and inform a ROI-backed roadmap investments.

Own Governance & Systems Standards

• Define governance, intake models, and decision guardrails for RevTech and AI use cases.

• Participate in cross-functional AI initiatives to evaluate, prioritize, and scale AI-enabled seller workflows.

• Establish auditable RevTech change controls with clear governance based on risk and impact.

• Ensure vendors and internal builds comply with security, privacy, data, and AI standards.

Strategic Partnership & Communications

• Build trusted relationships across GTM, tech teams, business partners and vendors as a trusted advisor on priorities, trade-offs, and future-state direction.

• Translate complex tech concepts and ROI assessments into clear, decision-ready executive recommendations and business impact analyses.

• Leverage external benchmarks (e.g., Gartner) and industry trends to inform tool strategy.

• Support the RevTech budget planning and stewardship in partnership with business partners, Finance and procurement.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

• 8+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Ops, Business Systems, or related roles within B2B SaaS organizations.

• Deep understanding of B2B seller workflows, sales processes, and the broader GTM technology ecosystem.

• Deep, hands-on experience across GTM technology ecosystem, including CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, revenue orchestration, enablement, data, and automation (e.g; Salesforce, Clari, Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Highspot, LinkedIn Navigator, Clay etc.)

• Hands-on experience with AI, agents, and automation, with ability to rapidly prototype solutions, test assumptions, and solve business problems.

• Solid conceptual and practical understanding of how modern tools connect via APIs, data flows, and “headless” architecture (separating the custom UI a seller uses from the backend).

• 5+ years driving cross-functional technology initiatives, from discovery, vendor evaluation and solution design to secure implementation and adoption across the enterprise.

• Proven track record of evaluating technology options, identifying build/buy/blend opportunities, developing ROI-backed recommendations, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive enterprise alignment.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, marketing, or a technical field is required (Master’s or advanced degree, or AI/data training, is a plus).

Nice to Have

• Hands-on building with emerging AI agent frameworks, custom GPTs, or AI-driven workflow tools to enhance seller productivity.

• Background in consulting or solution architecture, with exposure to advisory frameworks (e.g; Gartner, Forrester).

• Certifications: Salesforce (Advanced Administrator, Sales Cloud, AI Associate) or any relevant AI, or business systems certifications.

• Familiarity with Cloudflare products, commercial negotiations, and tech marketplace dynamics.

• Experience standing up internal automation platforms or replacing SaaS tools with internal builds.

Compensation

Estimated compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level of experience!

•
San Francisco Bay Area (San Francisco, San Jose): Estimated Annual Salary of $145,000 - $230,000

•
Major Metro Hubs & Select Remote (Boston, Kirkland, NYC Metro, DC Metro, plus Remote CA, CT, MA, NJ, WA): Estimated Annual Salary of $132,000 - $182,000

•
Other Remote States (CO, IL, MD, MN, NV, NY, RI, VT): Estimated Annual Salary of $120,000 - $165,000

•
CO ONLY Application Deadline: January 24, 2027

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. signals.title: Revenue Accounting Manager
signals.content:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is looking for a Revenue Accounting Manager to own key areas of our revenue accounting and Order to Cash functions in a high-growth SaaS environment. This is a hands-on individual contributor role built for someone who wants deep technical ownership: the deferred revenue process, the end-to-end allowance process, contract modification accounting, and the revenue implications of new AI-driven business models.

You will be a core contributor to the revenue close alongside the broader team, while carrying full ownership of your areas end to end. A significant part of this role is forward-looking: helping shape how Benchling recognizes revenue on consumption-based products and how we track and account for AI partnership economics as those models evolve.

If you are motivated by technical revenue accounting, cross-functional partnership, and building processes for products that do not have a settled playbook yet, we would love to meet you.

This role is based out of the San Francisco HQ and reports to the Head of Revenue Accounting. There are no direct reports, though you will help coach the revenue accounting team and review their work.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the deferred revenue process end to end - deferred revenue, contract asset, and unbilled receivables schedules, rollforwards, reconciliations, and supporting analytics.

 - Own the allowance for credit losses from methodology through audit deliverable, partnering with Collections and Sales on customer risk, and own supporting memo.

 - Perform technical analysis for contract modifications, under ASC 606, and lead SSP analyses and complex revenue arrangement memos.

 - Lead or assist in AI and usage-based product initiatives - establish revenue recognition positions for consumption-based arrangements and build the tracking/reporting process for AI partnership fees.

 - Own professional services revenue (fixed-fee, T&M) end to end, and drive process optimization across PS revenue with Services Operations.

 - Prepare materials and present financial results in quarterly close presentations.

 - Own revenue and deferred revenue flux analyses across all streams, and participate in the monthly/quarterly/annual close for your workstreams.

 - Lead or assist on special projects such as new product and pricing model launches, entity or geographic expansion.

 - Owner for designated audit areas during the annual audit - managing PBC deliverables, resolving auditor inquiries, and driving issues to closure.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - BS/BA in Accounting, strong GAAP/GL/financial statement command. CPA strongly preferred.

 - 7+ years progressive revenue accounting experience in a SaaS/software company, with deep hands-on ASC 606 expertise including complex, non-standard arrangements.

 - End-to-end ownership of an allowance for credit losses or similar reserve process, including audit support.

 - High-growth SaaS experience spanning subscription and professional services revenue; public accounting/public company experience strongly preferred, IPO or first-year SOX a plus.

 - Track record owning SOX-compliant processes and driving automation - you've replaced a manual process with a scalable one.

 - Proficiency with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management; advanced Excel/data skills.Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ.

 - Strong communicator who can influence cross-functionally without formal authority, and self-directed under close deadlines.




HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

signals.title: Accountant
signals.content:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a hands-on Accountant to support and progressively take ownership of key accounting processes across sales commissions, revenue, and cost of revenue. This role will apply US GAAP and ASC 606 fundamentals through disciplined month-end execution, reconciliations, audit support, and process improvement. The successful candidate will take ownership of recurring commission accounting activities, support cost of revenue allocations and flux analysis, and provide backup coverage for revenue contract reviews and related accounting conclusions. The role will partner closely with Revenue, Payroll, Sales Operations, Finance Systems, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and external auditors. This is a strong fit for an accountant who can move from source data to accounting conclusion to a complete, well-supported close deliverable—and who is comfortable improving processes in a fast-growing technology company.

You will:

• Own the monthly commission accounting workflow from plan and payout inputs through accruals, capitalization, amortization, expense recognition, actuals, and reconciliation.

• Evaluate which commission costs should be expensed versus capitalized and maintain support for the accounting conclusion.

• Prepare and review commission accruals, commission payable entries, reversals, deferred commission entries, and amortization schedules.

• Reconcile commission payable, deferred commission, commission expense, payroll, contractor bills, and cash-related activity across entities and periods.

• Investigate variances between estimates, accruals, approved payouts, payroll actuals, and final settlement amounts.

• Partner with Sales Operations, Payroll, Accounting Operations, and Finance Systems to resolve plan, eligibility, hierarchy, mapping, and data-quality exceptions.

• Maintain clear documentation of the commission computation, accounting treatment, journal-entry flow, review controls, and open items.

• Support the monthly and quarterly cost of revenue close, including completeness, cut-off, classification, allocations, reconciliations, and flux analysis.

• Prepare allocation workpapers for cloud, LLM, hosting, support, on-call, and other relevant costs using documented drivers; investigate material movements and data gaps.

• Provide backup coverage for revenue accounting and contract reviews during peak periods and planned absences.

• Review commercial arrangements and support ASC 606 conclusions relating to contract modifications, material rights, variable consideration, standalone selling price, and deferred revenue.

• Prepare concise accounting analyses and translate conclusions into journal entries, revenue schedules, reconciliations, and controls.

• Prepare audit-ready schedules, reconciliations, workpapers, and explanations for internal and external audit requests.

• Support walkthroughs, PBC requests, sampling, issue resolution, and remediation tracking.

• Design and execute reviewer controls over commission, revenue, and cost of revenue processes, including completeness, accuracy, cut-off, approval, and evidence-retention controls.

• Maintain SOPs, process narratives, control descriptions, and recurring close checklists.

• Escalate accounting judgments, control exceptions, data limitations, and close risks early and clearly.

• Partner with Finance Systems and process owners to improve NetSuite, spreadsheets, data integrations, reconciliations, and reporting workflows.

• Identify and support practical automation and AI opportunities while maintaining data validation, human review, controls, and auditability.

• Work closely with Sales Operations, Revenue, Payroll, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and other stakeholders to resolve data issues, exceptions, and close dependencies.

• Communicate accounting requirements clearly and drive timely follow-up on inputs, approvals, and open items.

About you:

• Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.

• 1–3 years of experience in accounting, audit, financial reporting, or a related finance role, with exposure to month-end close and reconciliations.

• Working knowledge of US GAAP; exposure to ASC 606, commission accounting, revenue, or cost of revenue is an advantage but not required.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with NetSuite or another ERP and interest in automation or AI are preferred.

• Clear communication, attention to detail, ownership, learning agility, and ability to work effectively across teams.

Location:

•
This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits:

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

signals.content:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As an Order Management Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our order management processes. You will leverage your expertise to support the operations department with critical tasks such as creating non-standard and complex quotes, generating order forms, completing sales orders, and overseeing the end-to-end processing of deals. We facilitate critical deals to ensure success by efficient coordination between departments. Your contributions will be key to driving operational efficiency and ensuring that our sales orders are processed accurately and on time.

To fit in perfectly; You should have a collaborative aptitude, an eagerness to learn, and a keen attention to detail. Thriving on feedback & seeking opportunities for improvement. Given the supportive nature of our Fin Ops team, a team-first mentality and the ability to work seamlessly with others is essential. In this fast-paced role, you will be expected to uphold the highest standards of quality while navigating multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

What You'll Do:

• Manage complete Sales Force Quote to Cash cycle

• Identify and resolve Q2C technical issues

• Provide guidance on complex deal structures

• Quote Creation and Completion

• Order Cancellation.

• Account Renewals

• Contract Buyout Quotes.

• Opportunity Stage Amendments.

• Package Upgrade/Downgrade

• Vendor Finance deals

• Account Audits

• Strong Business Communication Skills in English

• Proficient experience with Microsoft Excel and Word.

signals.content:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

At Motive, our Operations team ensures the entire organization runs smoothly, scalably, and strategically. We are seeking a Business Operations Manager to join our team and focus on the Service organization, which includes the Implementation, Installation, and Customer Education business units. This role is crucial for overseeing all internal processes and systems to ensure a smooth and efficient customer experience and to drive overall business objectives and growth.

You will act as the central nervous system for the Services organization, optimizing workflows and managing operational processes across these critical teams. Your ability to think strategically, adapt quickly, and manage resources effectively will be essential for success. This role will bring a data-driven perspective to operational process management, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.

You will collaborate closely with various teams, including Sales, Support, and Product. Your mandate is to ensure the new customer experience is smooth, builds trust, and is as efficient as possible for our customers and our business.

What You'll Do:

• Pinpoint drivers of services performance and lead initiatives to improve the new customer experience and team efficiency

• Partner with cross functional teams to scope and execute strategic projects to reduce workflow friction and inefficiencies for the Services organization

• Manage weekly and monthly business processes, escalating deviations from goals and expectations

• Be the connective tissue between Services and the rest of the business

• Ad-hoc reporting requests through Salesforce and other platforms

• Become a trusted advisor for sales leadership, offering an operational lens on how to tackle business problems at scale

What We're Looking For:

• 3+ years of Field Sales/Revenue Operations experience, at a high-growth SaaS company in the Mid-Market or Enterprise segments

• Exceptional spreadsheet and data management skills to quickly structure analyses, answer key business questions, and drive decision making

• Experience in building Salesforce reports and dashboards, knowledge in how SFDC applications integrate with each other, and ability to enable sales on SFDC best practices and related tools

• Experience partnering with Sales Leadership on initiatives such as weekly forecasting, territory alignment, ROE, QBRs and other related projects

• Experience identifying and leveraging AI-driven tools and solutions to enhance sales operations efficiency and effectiveness.

• Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter - you will take the initiative to own projects and can operate well with little guidance

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple concurrent projects in a rapidly changing, hyper-growth environment

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Pay Transparency

Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. signals.title: Senior IT Product Manager, Accounting
signals.content:
About the team:

Rubrik's mission is to secure and accelerate the world's AI transformation. IT is where we apply that to ourselves. We're moving Rubrik's own enterprise off a traditional application stack and onto an intelligent one.
Our goal is what we call the Thinking Enterprise: applications that run the business instead of just recording it. They learn from our data, act through our agents, and improve with each decision. That work is already underway, and we'd like you to help build it.
We build the internal products our Accounting, Controllership, and Tax teams use every day, the tools that decide how fast we close the books and how much we can trust the numbers.

About the role:

In our approach to accounting, agents understand the chart of accounts, the accounting policy, and the transaction in front of them, and they carry an entry from the source event through to a posted, audit-ready record.
If you're curious about why every task on the close calendar sits where it does, and whether most of those tasks can be run by agents as the work happens, so that only the final close needs to be locked down and compliant; if you know which steps can be questioned and rebuilt and which must follow the rules every time; and if you're excited about shortening the close by removing manual effort, then you're in the right place.

What you'll do:

• Lead product strategy for accounting (general ledger, close, intercompany, reconciliations, fixed assets, Sub-ledger accounting, and commissions), rebuilding rather than patching.

• Bring an AI-first approach, introducing agents, evals, and automation into real accounting workflows with audit-level stakes.

• Design how agents are built and tested: break complex accounting work into well-scoped steps, define evals, and set clear human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approvals and audit-sensitive decisions.

• Apply first-principles thinking, taking a legacy close task, asking why it exists, and building what replaces it.

• Own the vision and roadmap for next-generation accounting capabilities, from journal entry to financial statements.

• Prototype quickly with AI tools, validating logic, data flows, and control points before engineering engages.

• Partner with finance system developers (onsite and offshore), AI architects, Internal Audit, and vendors to turn prototypes into scalable, SOX-compliant products; lead UAT, training, and adoption through go-live and beyond.

Experience you'll need:

• Prior experience building accounting or financial products at a product company, on Oracle, SAP, or Workday Financials, as a product manager, product owner, or architect.

• Hands-on delivery of AI-enabled or agentic workflows in an enterprise. Even if you've taken only one module to production, you can explain how you broke it down, how you evaluated it, and where the model did and didn't earn its keep.

• Deep understanding of accounting principles (US GAAP, ASC 606) and the end-to-end close. We're looking for people who understand the full capability, not just operators.

• 8+ years across product management, finance systems, or accounting operations in enterprise, or a body of work that speaks louder than the year count.

• Track record of turning complicated accounting and finance problems into simple, scalable products.

• SOX and audit fluency, and experience leading onsite/offshore delivery teams.

• Comfort with AI tooling: you use AI-assisted coding and low-code tools to prototype and test ideas quickly.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to align Controllership, Tax, Accounting Operations, Internal Audit, and executive leadership (including CFO staff) behind a bold direction.

• Nice to have: NetSuite, Xactly, and Blackline/FloQast experience; working knowledge of P2P and O2C.

The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

signals.title: GTM Systems Engineer
signals.content:
WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. 

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About the Role
We're hiring a GTM Systems Engineer to design, build, and scale the technical infrastructure behind our go-to-market engine. You'll own the architecture that connects our CRM, marketing automation, sales tools, and data warehouse, turning manual processes into reliable, automated workflows. Partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships and GTM Operations, you'll translate needs from the field into solutions that improve data quality, speed up our teams, and give leadership a trusted view of the sales funnel.

In this role you will:

 - Architect, build, and maintain our GTM tech stack, including CRM, CPQ, marketing automation infrastructure, and more.

 - Design and own integrations and data flows between GTM systems and the data warehouse using APIs, webhooks, and reverse ETL

 - Build automations to improve data hygiene, pipeline accuracy, deal desk processes, etc.

 - Develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps

 - Ensure data integrity across systems through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, and monitoring

 - Partner with Ops and Data Engineering to support reporting, dashboards, and forecasting infrastructure

 - Evaluate, implement, and retire tools as the business scales, with thoughtful documentation and change management

Requirements for the role:

 - 4+ years in GTM Engineering, Business Systems, Revenue Operations, or a technical Sales/Marketing Ops role at a high-growth company

 - Deep hands-on experience administering and customizing a CRM (Salesforce), including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations

 - Experience building and maintaining CPQ and billing systems is preferred

 - Genuinely curious & interested in AI, with experience applying it to your day-to-day work

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery)

 - Experience building integrations with APIs and automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Tray.io http://Tray.io); scripting in Python or JavaScript is a strong plus

 - A systems-thinking mindset: you design for scale, document your work, and care about clean data

 - You thrive in high-intensity, high-autonomy environments and enjoy owning problems end to end


OUR COMMITMENT

signals.title: Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager, Mid-Late Sales Funnel
signals.content:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



The team owns the operational strategy and execution of our mid-to-late GTM Sales motion for the NAMER Upmarket organization, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. We build and evolve the sales processes, workflows, data, and policies that enable sellers to effectively manage opportunities, navigate complex deals, and convert pipeline into predictable revenue.



Our work spans opportunity management, forecasting, complex deal strategy and structuring, contracting workflows, and Rules of Engagement. We work hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate critical deals and day-to-day business challenges, while identifying where broader processes, policies, data, or systems need to evolve. We partner closely across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other GTM teams to improve seller effectiveness, sales efficiency, conversion, and revenue predictability as the business scales.



What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:

 - Own the strategy and day to day operations for the Upmarket mid-to-late sales funnel, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. Develop a strong point of view on the sales processes, stage management, opportunity management, workflows, and seller behaviors needed to improve conversion, sales efficiency, and predictable revenue growth.

 - Own and evolve the operational workflows and data that support contracting and complex deal execution, ensuring sellers have clear, scalable paths from opportunity through contract and close. Serve as a go-to strategic and operational partner for creative and complex deal structures, working hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate non-standard scenarios while partnering closely with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Use insights from individual deals to identify recurring friction and drive improvements to the processes, policies, data, and systems that enable the business to close effectively at scale.

 - Shape deal strategy and the operational processes that support complex sales motions, partnering with sellers, Sales leadership, Deal Desk, Finance, and other teams to navigate complex opportunities while identifying where broader process, policy, or system changes can make it easier and more effective to close business at scale.

 - Evolve the Rules of Engagement and the cross-functional policies that govern how GTM teams work together throughout the sales cycle, bringing clarity to ownership, handoffs, deal scenarios, and areas of competing priorities. Lead alignment across Sales and other GTM organizations as our sales motions and business needs evolve.

 - Own and evolve sales forecast cadences, facilitating forecast reviews with Sales leadership to scrutinize pipeline health and deal-specific risks.

 - Identify and lead strategic improvements to our mid-to-late funnel operating model, using data, field insights, and deep sales process expertise to diagnose where opportunities are getting stuck or where seller effectiveness can improve. Lead complex initiatives from problem definition and recommendation through senior stakeholder alignment, hands-on implementation, and measurement of business impact in partnership with GTM Systems & Analytics and other cross-functional teams.



How to be successful in this role:

 - 12+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, or a related function within B2B SaaS, with significant experience supporting complex Upmarket sales motions.

 - Mid to late funnel GTM experience and opportunity-to-close processes across Commercial, Mid-Market, and Enterprise. You understand opportunity management, sales stages and methodology, forecasting, pipeline health, complex buying cycles, and how decisions throughout the funnel impact revenue outcomes.

 - Strong experience with complex deal strategy and Deal Desk, including pricing and approvals, contracting workflows, non-standard deal structures, and complex commercial scenarios. You’re comfortable getting into the details of an individual opportunity and partnering with sellers to develop creative paths to close while balancing the broader needs of the business.

 - A hands-on operating style with the ability to move fluidly between setting direction and getting into the weeds across opportunities, data, account and opportunity hierarchies, systems, processes, and seller workflows. You’re naturally investigative, able to identify root causes and patterns, and turn what you learn into scalable improvements.

 - Strong business judgment and a clear point of view. You combine data, GTM expertise, and field context to make recommendations in ambiguous situations, evaluate tradeoffs and downstream implications, and advocate for a direction while remaining open to new information.

 - Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functionally, from frontline sellers to senior Sales and GTM leadership. You can build alignment across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other partners, navigate competing priorities, and challenge constructively without relying on direct authority.

 - Experience serving as a trusted partner to senior Sales leadership—understanding the needs of the business, bringing a point of view on what should change, and staying close enough to the work to help drive outcomes.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

 - Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work—demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.  



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

signals.title: Senior Revenue Systems Specialist
signals.content:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Senior Revenue Systems Specialist to join our team!

Revenue Systems owns the go-to-market technology stack at Greenhouse, from first outreach through renewal. As a Senior Revenue Systems Specialist, you’ll own systems work across both pre-sale and post-sale: Salesforce, our sales system of record, and the platforms our Customer Success and Customer Marketing teams work from every day, currently Gainsight and Accord. Breadth is a key aspect of this role, and you’ll have real latitude to shape where the stack goes next.

Who will love this job

• A systems generalist - you enjoy working across a stack rather than being confined to one corner of it, and you’re comfortable moving to where the work is

• A solutions-oriented partner - you can hear what the business is trying to accomplish and turn it into something that works, and you stay with a problem until the desired outcome is achieved

• A curious builder - you want to understand why a process exists before you automate it, and you’re comfortable saying when something doesn’t seem to make sense, including to the people asking for it

• An owner - you take a project from first conversation through rollout and adoption without needing it project-managed for you

• An AI-fluent operator - you already use tools like Claude, Glean, or ChatGPT in your day to day, and you’re interested in what they can do inside a revenue stack

What you’ll do

• Own and build solutions in Salesforce, including data model design, declarative automation, validation, permissions, page layouts, and reporting, taking projects from scoping and intake through rollout, adoption, and documentation

• Administer our post-sale platforms, including Gainsight and Accord, alongside our Customer Success Operations team, covering the rules engine, journey and email programs, surveys including NPS, and the workflows behind customer health scoring, CSM assignment, and account transfers

• Own integrations between Salesforce, Gainsight, and the rest of the stack, standing up new ones independently and eliminating the recurring failures that come with the existing ones

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Customer Marketing on their requests, working out whether the fix belongs in a system or somewhere else, and seeing it through to a working solution either way

• Lead platform migration and consolidation work as our tech stack changes, from evaluation and vendor assessment through data movement, cutover, and adoption

• Hold a point of view on where the stack should go, surfacing the opportunities and the risks in our implementation rather than waiting to be asked

• Document what you build, and bring request volume down over time through automation and self-service

• Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

• Several years in revenue operations, customer success operations, business systems, or platform administration.

• B2B SaaS experience.

• Deep hands-on Salesforce administration experience: data model design, declarative automation, permissions and sharing, reporting, and the judgment to know when not to build. You should be comfortable making medium to large changes to a production org and reasoning about the performance and scale implications of your configuration choices.

• Hands-on ownership of Gainsight or a comparable post-sale platform (e.g., Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat), with enough depth to configure independently and to hold a credible view on whether the platform is serving the business.

• Experience standing up integrations without support, and a record of eliminating recurring failures rather than only resolving them.

• Experience owning a platform migration or consolidation end to end, including the data movement.

• A track record of taking a problem from the first report through to a working solution.

• Comfort operating as the most knowledgeable person in the room on a platform, and the instinct to bring others along rather than becoming the only one who can do the work.

• Clear writing. A real part of this job is explaining to a non-technical stakeholder what you built and how to use it, or what went wrong and what you did about it.

 - 2-4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Deal/Order Operations, Revenue Operations, or Order Management

 - Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex deal structures

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC) as a CRM, including opportunity and quoting workflows

 - Exposure to CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, DealHub, Ironclad CLM, or similar), with a basic understanding of how pricing and approvals are operationalized

 - Experience managing or working within a ticketing or queue-based support model (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce cases, or similar)

 - Prior involvement in CRM/CPQ projects or enhancements, such as documenting requirements, participating in testing, or supporting system rollouts

 - Ability to communicate clearly with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes are still being defined

We’re looking for a Sr. Manager of Order-to-Cash (OTC) to own and evolve our billing and collections function as ClickHouse continues to scale. You’ll work cross-functionally with Revenue Accounting, Sales, Legal, FP&A, and other operations teams to build scalable processes and workflows.

What You’ll Be Doing

 - Establish the operating model, processes, controls, and team structure for a scalable Order-to-Cash function. Hire, develop, and lead the team as the business grows.

 - Establish policies and guidelines for pay-as-you-go and commit billing models, invoice adjustments, collections strategy, and billing systems change management.

 - Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for new product/process introduction (NPI) initiatives, including changes to current billing processes and systems.

 - Own the billing systems tech stack that maps metered usage to contract entitlements and billable usage, in partnership with our Billing Engineering and Finance Systems teams. Drive system and process improvements, including AI adoption, automation initiatives, and integrations to streamline workflows.

 - Maintain strong AR health through proactive aging reviews, collections coordination with the sales team, and timely resolution of billing inquiries.

 - Support monthly accounting close activities including reviewing contracts, reconciliations, usage trends, invoice trends, AR write-offs, and analytics.

 - Support external audit activities and manage PBC requests related to OTC.

 - 8+ years of progressive order-to-cash and billing operations experience, including 5+ years focused on billing and collections in a SaaS or technology company.

 - Experience with automation tools and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, Stripe, Salesforce CPQ).

 - Experience with marketplace platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP) and reports.
